docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Mythic bee type is the first and only bee rarity type to be added in an update.
  • Buoyant Bee is the only bee to dislike no fields.
  • If the player's internet is lagging (slow internet), the bees have a high chance of being slower at fighting mobs, making honey, and collecting pollen.
  • If the player moves off the pad in front of their hive while converting honey, the bees will stop converting. However, they will not stop if the player only barely leaves the hive.
  • Moving closer to the hive will cause bees to convert honey faster as they will not need to fly as far to get to the player and back.
  • If the player gets too far from their bees, they will fly to the player, ignoring every flower and mob in the way.
  • When bees are sleeping in their hive slot, they emit faint "Z" particles for a little while until they wake.
  • If the player jumps with over 20 jump power while their bees are making honey, they will stop converting.
  • The higher the player's bees' level, the more effective they are at attacking, converting, and collecting.
  • The average attack of a bee is approximately 3.
  • All event bees have only one disliked field (except for Windy Bee, which dislikes two).
  • A bee spins and emits white sparkles before a bee produces a token. However, if a bee gives off green sparkles, that means the bee is about to collect critical pollen or do critical damage.
  • The Marshmallow Bee is the only "item bee."
  • All bees of the legendary rarity or higher (legendary, mythic and event) have a "special" physical feature (e.g., Spicy Bee's exhaust pipes, Festive Bee's "lid," Tadpole Bee's size and trail, Gummy Bee's translucent body, etc.). Some Epic bees also have at least one feature (e.g., Commander Bee's helmet).
  • Legendary and Mythic are the only rarities of bee that can be used to activate the special pads found around the map; Legendary for the Honeystorm and Special Sprout Summoner, and Mythic for the Mythic Meteor Shower Summoner.
  • The Common rarity is the rarity that contains the least number of bees, with only 1.
  • The Epic bee's rarity is tied with the Event bee's rarity for having the most bees, being 11.
  • Exhausted Bee and Photon Bee still return to the hive and rest when a player dies/resets, despite their unlimited energy.
  • The maximum number of bees the player can have is 150. This can be achieved if the player has 50 Spicy Bees that all simultaneously produced inferno and 2 Fire Bees. This number can be further increased to 250 if the player is in a corrupted field while 50 Spicy Bees that all simultaneously produced inferno and each token was duplicated. During Beesmas 2020 and Beesmas 2021, the maximum number of bees the player can have at one time is 266. From the previous total of 250, 3 Gummy Bees can be summoned from the Gummy Siege, three bees from Onett's Lid Art (including a level 20 Bumble Bee and a level 1 Baby Bee), a level 20 Honey Bee from Honey Bee's Honey Wreath, and a maximum of 9 bees from the Honeyday Candles.
  • All summoned bees can convert pollen at the hive in a random slot.
  • All gifted bees have a star on the model.
  • Mythic bees are the only rarity not to have a gate representing them.
  • Lion Bee is the only bee to like the Ant Field.
  • Sun Bear mentions that bees only have abilities on the Mountain.
  • In order, the color of the hive slots according to rarity are:
  • Bronze (Common).
  • White (Rare).
  • Yellow (Epic).
  • Light Blue (Legendary).
  • Purple (Mythic).
  • Green (Event).
  • The color of a bee's face in their hive slot is dependent on their color with red bees having a red face, blue bees have a blue face, and colorless bees having a black face.

The bee(s) with the most:

  • Base Attack: Lion Bee (10).
  • Attack: Precise Bee and Digital Bee [Max Red Drives] (16)
  • Base Speed: Ninja Bee and Photon Bee (21).
  • Speed: Digital Bee [Max Drives] (21.9).
  • Base Conversion: Diamond Bee (250/sec).
  • Base Energy: Photon Bee and Exhausted Bee (Unlimited).
  • Base Energy Excluding Unlimited: Lion Bee and Buoyant Bee (60)
  • Base Gather Amount: Fuzzy Bee (16.7/sec).
  • Conversion: Tabby Bee [1000x Tabby Love] (533/sec).
  • Gather Amount: Digital Bee [Max White Drives] (33.75/sec).
  • Abilities: Fuzzy Bee, Spicy Bee, Tadpole Bee, Buoyant Bee (4).

The bee(s) with the least:

  • Base Attack: Baby Bee (0).
  • Base Attack (Higher than 0): Basic Bee, Bumble Bee, Hasty Bee, Looker Bee, Rad Bee, Diamond Bee, Music Bee, Tadpole Bee, Digital Bee (No Red Drives) and Festive Bee (1)
  • Base Speed: Baby Bee, Bumble Bee, Exhausted Bee, and Demon Bee (10.5).
  • Base Conversion: Fuzzy Bee (6.7/sec).
  • Base Energy: Tadpole Bee (10).
  • Base Gather Amount: Tadpole Bee (1.7/sec).

docs.title: Beesmas Feast
docs.text:
Beesmas Feast Information Usage Obtaining bond, Bitterberries, and various treats Requirement(s) Completion of Polar Bear's Beesmas quest Cooldown 90 minutes Location Behind Polar Bear

The Beesmas Feast is a Beesmas-exclusive machine which can be unlocked after completing Polar Bear's Beesmas quest.

It can be used every 90 minutes. When used, it grants the player bond for all of their bees and a variety of treats. It is positioned behind Polar Bear. The amount of bond and rewards are affected by the amount of Polar Power the player currently has.

Upon digging into the feast, two notifications appear: 🍴 Serving up some Beesmas Dinner 🍴

🍴 More Polar Power = Larger Servings! 🍴

If a player walks onto the platform without completing his quest, it displays this message, "An empty plate... where’s the Beesmas Feast, Polar Bear?"

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• A variety of foods can be seen on the Beesmas feast. These include:
  • Bitterberries.
  • Treats.
  • A floret of broccoli.
  • A carrot.

  • A stew that seems to contain chives, onions, corn, peas, and meat.

  • Polar Bear's feast design is reminiscent to Big Ol' Turkey Legs, a running gag within the ThnxCya community.

  • Polar Bear's dialogue after you complete his Beesmas 2020 quest directly referenced this, with the phrase "A big ol' turkey and treat...".
  • Onett stated on Discord that the Beesmas Feast was made using the Hostage Chicks from the Egg Hunt 2020 event.[1]
  • The eating sound is a cut out section of the song "Nom Nom Nom Nom Nom Nom Nom", made by Parry Grip.
  • The Beesmas Feast used to drop all the 4 treats but was changed in Beesmas 2022.
  • It was introduced in Beesmas 2020, and has returned in every Beesmas since.
  • During the end of Beesmas 2025, after rebooting servers, Onett forgot to remove the Beesmas Feast causing it to stay in older servers after removing the rest of Beesmas.

docs.title: Beesmas Lights
docs.text:
Beesmas Lights would appear in fields as the player collects pollen after completing Science Bear's Beesmas Lights quest.

They fall from the sky in a similar way to the Star Shower passive, taking 2 seconds to fall. Whenever a Beesmas Light is caught, it grants the Inspire buff and converts based on the player's convert total. If the player doesn't catch it, the light collects pollen instead. Beesmas Lights spawn after collecting 25 Ability Tokens (with a 30 second cooldown), dropping 5 lights into the field. Beesmas Lights spawn in any field, including the Ant Field.

If the player approaches the switch for the Beesmas Lights, located beside Science Bear and has not yet completed his quest, a text box will display reading the following text: "This [sic] Beesmas Lights aren't powering on..."

The Beesmas Lights switch.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Beesmas Lights has the same function as the Star Shower passive with the difference of the fact that the star shower is more focused in a small area than Beesmas Lights.
  • This means that if the passive is disregarded, the Beesmas Lights are the only way to get the inspire buff without gifted bees or redeeming certain codes.
  • Catching a falling Beesmas Light has a 1 in 10,000 chance to reward a Red/Blue/Green/Yellow Falling Beesmas Light sticker (depending on the color of the light).
  • Even though falling Beesmas Lights were introduced during the Beesmas 2020 event, the Beesmas Light decorations along the mountain were present during prior Beesmas events.
  • Over the course of the removal of several Beesmas events, Beesmas Lights would still fall into fields a few days after Beesmas was over.
  • Bubble Bee Man's Beesmas quest dialogue also tends to take longer to be removed.
  • The text displayed when standing under the light switch for the Beesmas Lights displays "This Beesmas Lights" instead of "The Beesmas Lights". This is likely an oversight by Onett.

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

docs.title: Beesmas Tree
docs.text:
Not to be confused with Beesmas Tree Hat, a Beequip with a similar name.

The Beesmas Tree is a feature that appeared in every Beesmas between 2019 and 2025. The Beesmas Tree allows the player to view their collected ornaments, who they are from, and what boosts they give. In Re://:Swarm, viewing the tree also gives the Snowman, Honey Jar and Boxing Glove ornaments. The tree is located in front of the Ant Gate, near the Noob Shop, and next to the hives.

The Beesmas Tree.

docs.title: Beesmas 2025
docs.text:
The Beesmas Tree made another return in Beesmas 2025, functioning the exact same way as during Winter Beesmas 2024. Conducting a gift exchange with an NPC would grant players an ornament that would grant special boosts on the Beesmas Tree.

The bottom row holds five ornaments. They are given, from left to right, from Black Bear, Mother Bear, Brown Bear, Panda Bear, and Science Bear. The second row of the tree holds another five ornaments. They are, from left to right, from Polar Bear, Dapper Bear, Onett, Spirit Bear, and Robo Bear. The third row of the tree holds four ornaments. They are, from left to right, from Gifted Riley Bee, Gifted Bucko Bee, Stick Bug, and an unobtainable ornament from an unknown NPC (arguably Sun Bear). The ornaments on the 4th row of the Beesmas Tree hold two ornaments. They are, from left to right, Honey Bee and Gummy Bear. The ornament on the top of the tree is Bubble Bee Man's ornament, which was never made obtainable.

Hidden at the bottom of the tree, there is 1 Whirligig along with 5 Bitterberries. On top of the trunk of the Beesmas Tree, there is 1 Gingerbread Bear token.

docs.text:

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

Bitterberry

"Increases bond with a bee by 100. Small chance to cause Mutations."

A Bitterberry is a type of treat that, when fed to a bee, raises its bond by 100 and has a 1/1000 chance to make it mutated. The chance is boosted to 1/100 if the bee is radioactive. These are not the favorite treat of any bee.

docs.title: Black Balloon
docs.text:
Black Balloon

"Floats over the field for 5m. Stores up to x25 your capacity and increases pollen inside 4x."

COOLDOWN

15 min

CAP

25

The Black Balloon is a consumable item that was added in the 2021-12-26 update. Once used, it creates a black balloon over the field the player is in. The balloon floats over the field for 5 minutes before floating to the hive balloon, storing the pollen collected underneath it. The pollen collected below is multiplied by 4, and it holds up to 25 times the player's capacity. Only 1 Black Balloon can be summoned in a field per player.

Black balloons have a cap of 25 in the player's inventory. Obtaining one while already having 25 will not add a Black Balloon to the player's inventory, unless obtained from robux packs, quests, or codes.

  • As an exceptionally rare drop from a Spider.
  • Completing Dapper Bear's 12th quest rewards 1 black balloon and other items.
  • Sticking the Black Star Sticker to the Sticker Stacker rewards one Black Balloon.
  • As a drop from Robo Party mobs.
  • Purchasing the Saint Puff's Pack in Bee Bear's Catalog during Beesmas 2025 gives you 1 Black Balloon and other items.

Black Bear is a quest giver located at the very beginning of the game. He is one of the eight permanent Quest Bears that can be accessed in the game, with the others being Brown Bear, Mother Bear, Panda Bear, Science Bear, Dapper Bear, Polar Bear, and Spirit Bear. After the player has completed all of Black Bear's main questlines, the player can obtain repetitive quests every hour, similar to Brown Bear.

He is usually the first quest bear to be accessed, along with Mother Bear, Brown Bear, and Traveling Bears (only during special events). He provides quests to players to help them progress in the game and to provide extra goals to reach for. This particular bear focuses on pollen collecting. He is located near the Ticket Tent and the Red Cannon, but he is also near the Sunflower Field and the Hives. Black Bear was a quest giver for the Egg Hunt 2019 and Egg Hunt 2020 events and was one of the NPCs to give an Ornament quest for Beesmas 2019. He also had a quest during Beesmas (2020 and beyond) for the Honey Wreath.

Black Bear's quests require collecting pollen for him. In return, he will give the player various rewards, including Honey, Royal Jelly, a Silver Egg, a Gold Egg, a Diamond Egg, a Star Jelly, and eventually gives a Mythic Egg. He also gives many side rewards in the later quests.

Through all of his quests, he rewards 2,352,532,300 Honey. When doing the quests for the Diamond Egg, he will give1 Royal Jelly every 4 quests for a total of 5 royal jellies, and a Diamond Egg. When doing quests for the Star Jelly, he'll reward 5 Tickets and aRoyal Jelly for every quest completed except the quest "Solo On The Stump,” for which Black Bear gives 10 Tickets instead of the usual 5 Tickets.

docs.title: Dialogue
docs.text:
Black Bear gives a lot of information in his quest dialogues. Some of the information he gives is not found anywhere else in-game.

Quest Dialogue Sunflower Start Hi, I'm Black Bear. You look like a promising new honey maker! I happen to be a honey connoisseur. That means I know a lot about honey. And if you're willing to go through my training, you'll be making tons of honey in no time! First off: Collect 100 pollen from the Sunflower Field!

-During-

In the real world, bees make honey out of nectar, not pollen. But this is Roblox! Anything goes! Come back when you've collected 100 pollen from the Sunflower Field.

-Completion-

Nice job! Here's a reward. Come talk to me again when you're ready for another quest.

Dandelion Deed The pollen from each field produces slightly different honey. Most people can't tell the difference, but I can. That's why I love it here, there's such a variety of flower patches! Each field is different. Sunflowers, mushrooms, clovers... But today I've got a hankering for Dandelion-flavored honey. Why don't you collect some pollen from the Dandelion Field? 250 should be enough!

-During-

The bears on this mountain are all friendly, like me. But the same can't be said for the bugs... And you don't even want to know what rude creatures live further up! Anyways, come back when you've collected 250 pollen from the Dandelion Field.

-Completion-

Nice job! Here's a reward. Come talk to me again when you're ready for another quest.

Pollen Fetcher Aren't bees amazing! They collect pollen, make honey, and even defend you from attackers. But did you know some bees are even more amazing than others? There are 4 classes of bees [sic]: Basic [sic], Rare, Epic, and Legendary. Basic bees [sic] all look and act the same, but there are different types of Rares, Epics, and Legendaries. And those all have special abilities! Some of them are faster or stronger. Some of them even create tokens that give you special boosts! Those bees are pretty hard to get in Basic Eggs... But a [Silver Egg] has a guaranteed chance of being at least a Rare. If you complete my next few quests, I'll give you a [Silver Egg]! But don't expect it to be easy. First: Collect 500 pollen.

-During-

[Silver Eggs] usually hatch into Rare bees, but sometimes Epic or Legendary. [Gold Eggs] usually hatch into Epic bees, but sometimes Legendary. [Diamond Eggs] usually hatch into Legendary bees, but sometimes Mythic! Anyways, come back when you've collected 500 pollen.

-Completion-

Nice job! Here's a reward to hold you over. A few more quests and the [Silver Egg] is yours! That's right, no egg yet! You've got to work for it!

Red Request (Old dialogue) There are 3 color's of flowers on this mountain, red, white, and blue. If a bee is red, it collects 50% more pollen from red flowers. And if a bee is blue, it collects twice as much from blue flowers. Working in fields that match the color of your bees helps you collect pollen faster! For my next request, I want you to collect 600 pollen from red flowers.

(New dialogue) There are 3 color's of flowers on this mountain, red, white and blue. If a bee is red, it collects twice as much pollen from red flowers. And if a bee is blue, it collects 50% more from blue flowers. Working in fields that match the color of your bees helps you collect pollen faster! For my next request, I want you to collect 600 pollen from red flowers.

-During-

There are tokens which boost the amount of pollen you get from colored flowers. You can get them from special bees, or if you're lucky you might find one in the flowers. Anyways, come back when you've collected 600 pollen from red flowers.

-Completion-

If you're lucky, you might run across a [Strawberry] while gathering in the fields with mostly red flowers. If you see leaves popping out of the flowers, you should collect pollen near that area. That's where you're most likely to find [Strawberries] and other treats. Ok, here's a reward to hold you over. Two more quests and the [Silver Egg] is yours!

(Old Dialogue) Nice job! Here's a reward to hold you over. Two more quests and the [Silver Egg] is yours!

Into the Blue Pollen from blue flowers has always tasted slightly minty to me. Brown Bear tells me it's all in my head... He just doesn't have a refined taste pallet [sic] like I do. Speaking of blue flowers, could you collect 1000 pollen from blue flowers for me?

-During-

Blue is minty. Red is spicy. That's why there's a Blue bee made of snow and a Red bee made of fire! If you're lucky, you may get one of them in the [Silver Egg] I give you. Come back when you've collected 1000 pollen from blue flowers.

-Completion-

Nice job! Say, did you find any [Blueberries] out there? Fields with mostly blue flowers occasionally produce [Blueberries] you can feed to your bees. Here's a reward to hold you over. One more quest and the [Silver Egg] is yours!

(Old Dialogue) Nice job! Here's a reward to hold you over. One more quests [sic] and the [Silver Egg] is yours!

Variety Fetcher Variety is the spice of life! It's also the spice of honey. If you collect me pollen from a variety of flower fields, I'll give you my [Silver Egg]! I'll take 1000 pollen from the Mushroom Field, the Clover Field, and the Blue Flower Field.

Some people believe eating honey made from local flowers helps combat allergies. I eat honey from everywhere! Maybe that's why I never get the sniffles? Anyways, come back when you've collected 1000 pollen from... ...the Mushroom Field, the Clover Field, and the Blue Flower field.

Impressive! With your dedication, I trust the bee that hatches from this [Silver Egg] will go on to become a fine honey maker. Here you go!

I may be a bear, but I'm a lover, not a fighter. That's why I stay down here, away from all the aggressive monsters in the fields. Anyways, come back when you've collected 4000 pollen from the Bamboo Field.

Red Request 2 Some bees have special abilities, for example... The ability Red Boost increases the amount of the pollen you get from red flowers by 15% for 15 seconds. Panda Bear is so intimidating! I thought pandas were suppose to be gentle creatures. Anyways, come back when you've collected 5000 Red pollen.

From my experience, red bees tend to be feisty. Rascal Bee is a little mischevious - it produces bombs that collect red pollen, and it's a good fighter too! And Rage Bee is always upset and angry! But it's great for firing up your other bees in battle. Well, here's a reward to hold you over. 8 more quests [sic 7 more quests] and the [Gold Egg] is yours!

Cobweb Sweeper Arachnophobia is a big word that means fear of spiders. I've probably got that... Then again I'm afraid of most things. Hopefully you're braver than me! Collect 6000 pollen from the Spider Field.

Come back when you've collected 6000 pollen from the Spider Field.

Wow - you really are brave! What was fighting the spider like? Did you get bit? Actually... I don't think I want to know... Anyways, here's a reward to hold you over. 7 more quests [sic 6 more quests] and the [Gold Egg] is yours!

Leisure Loot How about some leisurely gathering? You know, down here where it's safe. Collect 3000 pollen from the Sunflower, Dandelion, Mushroom, and Blue Flower fields.

Come back when you've collected 3000 pollen from the Sunflower, Dandelion, Mushroom, and Blue Flower fields.

Anyways, here's a reward to hold you over. 6 more quests [sic 5 more quests] and the [Gold Egg] is yours!

White Pollen Wrangler White pollen produces honey with a neutral flavor, I'd say. But that makes it a great blank slate when mixing up artisinal honey blends! The worst thing about white pollen is collecting it. Why? Because without benefits of Red or Blue Boosts... And without the colored-matching bee collection bonus... Come back when you've collected 10,000 White pollen.

Wow, that's a lot of white pollen! Looks like you and your bees are covered in snow! Anyways, good job! Here's a reward to hold you over. 5 more quests [sic 4 more quests] and the [Gold Egg] is yours!

Pineapple Picking I read pineapples contains enzymes that help you digest proteins. That doesn't affect me, though... I only eat honey. Another cool fact about pineapple: In most languages, they're known as Ananas. I wonder why English is different? All this talk about pineapple gives me an idea! Collect 13,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch.

Come back when you've collected 13,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch.

-Completion-

Nice job! Here's a reward to hold you over. 4 more quests [sic 3 more quests] and the [Gold Egg] is yours!

Pollen Fetcher 2 I'm not feeling picky! I just want to eat. Why don't you collect 16,000 pollen. I don't care where you get it.

Come back when you've collect 16,000 pollen.

That wasn't too bad, was it? Oh - here's a tip. Make sure you try to accept as many quests at once [sic] time as possible. Here's a reward to hold you over. 3 more quests [sic 2 more quests] and the [Gold Egg] is yours!

Weed Wacker Ever wonder why some of the plants here are so big? Some of the flowers are tiny, but some of them are as big as a house! I mean, what's up with the roses over there? I learned to stop asking questions about this place ages ago... Anyways, collect 10,000 pollen from the Strawberry, Bamboo, and Clover fields.

It's not just the plants. I mean... think about the bugs. Ladybugs are 10 times larger than the bees! Nothing makes sense! Come back when you've collect 10,000 pollen from the Strawberry, Bamboo, and Clover fields.

Nice job! Here's a reward to hold you over. 1 more quests [sic] and the [Gold Egg] is yours!

Red + Blue = Gold If you complete this final quest, I'll give you the [Gold Egg]! You ready? Collect 25,000 Red pollen, and 25,000 Blue pollen.

-During-

Come back when you've collect [sic] 25,000 Red pollen and 25,000 Blue pollen.

-Completion-

Nice job! You've earned this [Gold Egg] for sure! But I've got even better stuff to give you, if you put in just a bit more work! Hatch the egg and report back. The fun's just begun!

Colorless Collection By now I bet you feel pretty at home here. That means you're finally ready for some real-deal honeymaking! My upcoming requests are for top-beekeepers only. I believe you've got what it takes! Complete my next 20 quests, and I'll give you my most valuable possession: A [Diamond Egg]! [Diamond Eggs] always hatch into Legendary or Mythic bees. They're the best of the best. Oh, and to help you out, I'll give you a [Royal Jelly] for every 4 quests you complete before then. Let's kick off with something simple. Collect 50,000 White pollen!

-During-

Collecting White pollen can be hard because your colored bees don't get any bonuses. Although Red and Blue bombs don't collect White pollen, you should still collect them: They boost the power of your other bombs for a few seconds, which can really add up! Come back when you've collected 50,000 White pollen.

-Completion-

Nice job! That wasn't too hard. 3 more quests and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 19 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Spirit of Springtime It's always nice here, cause it's always spring! Not too hot or cold for me, it's juuust right. Flowers always in bloom, bees always buzzing... I couldn't ask for a better home! Let's do something in the spirit of springtime: Collect 30,000 pollen from the Strawberry and Sunflower Fields.

-During-

I wonder why it's always spring? Science Bear says it might have something to do with where we are on the globe. I didn't even know we were on a globe! Don't globes spin? The sky rarely seems to move... Too tricky for me to think about. Anyways, come back when you've collected 30,000 pollen from the Strawberry and Sunflower Fields.

-Completion-

Nice job! I bet it smells good in those fields! 2 more quests and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 18 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Weed Wacker 2 I wonder what the mountain would look like without the bees. Do you think the flowers would grow taller and taller? That would be a big mess, I wouldn't be able to stand it. I guess I'd have to clean things up myself. Oh no... Thankfully I can count on you and your bees! Here's the next lesson in your quest to becoming the top honeymaker: Collect 40,000 pollen from the Dandelion and Bamboo Fields... ... What? I promise it's a lesson! I'm not just trying you to get you to do my dirty work... Who would do such a thing?

-During-

I know a lot about honeymaking [sic], but I'm not actually a honeymaker. It takes a special type of person to work with bees. Someone like you! Come back when you've collected 40,000 pollen from the Dandelion and Bamboo Fields.

-Completion-

Nice job! Don't you feel smarter now? 1 more quest and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 17 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Pollen Fetcher 3 As you become a better and better beekeeper, the types of your bees become more important. Top honeymakers [sic] depend on special combinations of bees for maximum effect! You can specialize in bees of a certain color, or bees that make bombs for huge combos. Thinking of the composition of your swarm will take your honeymaking [sic] to the next level! Next up, collect 100,000 pollen.

-During-

Finish this quest, and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]! Come back when you've collected 100,000 Pollen.

-Completion-

Nice job! That was a pretty tough stretch of quests. To help you out, here's a [Royal Jelly]! 16 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Lucky Landscaping Do you believe in luck? I do! At the very least, I know this for a fact: The "Luck" stat in the game increases the rate at which you find special tokens in flowers. I'm convinced you can increase your luck by farming certain fields. Science Bear tells me I'm just being superstitious... It can't hurt to try though, can it? Collect 100,000 Pollen from the Clover Field.

-During-

I know deep down that Science Bear is right, But I can't help but feel like the Clover Field is lucky! I mean, why else would people fixate on four leaf clovers? Come back when you've collected 100,000 Pollen from the Clover Field.

-Completion-

Nice job! Do you feel any luckier? 3 more quest and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 15 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Azure Adventure Blue bees are calm, cool and collected. If you discover 4 types of Blue bees, you can enter their clubhouse. Inside you'll find a portal that teleports you to yours truly! This next lessons specifically for your Blue bees. Collect 150,000 Blue Pollen.

-During-

The leader of the Blue Bees is Bucko Bee. I wonder who put him in charge? If it was up to me, I'll make Ninja Bee the leader. Anyways, come back when you've collected 150,000 Blue Pollen.

-Completion-

Nice job! 2 more quests and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 14 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Pink Pineapples I never get tired of honey made from White pollen. It's got a neutral but distinct flavor that pairs well with everything. Mixing and matching of pollen of different colors and fields, now that's where it's at! Let's give it a try now! Collect 80,000 Pollen from the Pineapple Patch and 80,000 Red pollen.

-During-

I can't stand going to the Pineapple Patch myself. The mantis gives me the heeby jeebies... That's not a problem for you, though. You're the bravest beekeeper I know! Come back when you've collected 80,000 Pollen from the Pineapple Patch... And 80,000 Red pollen.

-Completion-

Nice job! One more quest and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 13 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Blue Mushrooms By now I'm sure you've noticed you collect pollen much faster from fields higher up. That's because they have a higher ratio of large flowers. But the best honeymakers[sic] can't just farm those! Some of the best honey comes from the most basic fields. That's why I'll be needing this: Collect 100,000 pollen from the Blue Flower and Mushroom Fields [sic]

-During-

Finish this quest, and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]! Come back when you've collected 100,000 pollen from the Blue Flower and Mushroom Fields.

-Completion-

Nice job! That was a pretty tough stretch of quests. To help you out, here's a [Royal Jelly]! 12 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Cobweb Sweeper 2 I hardly ever venture past the 5 bee gate... Why does the spider have to be right there? To top that off, it sits on one of my favorite fields! I guess it's not that bad, though, now I've got you! Collect 250,000 Pollen from the Spider Field.

-During-

Panda Bear calls me a wimp because I'm scared to walk past the spider. Whatever! At least I have better tastes. Come back when you've collected 250,000 pollen from spider field.

-Completion-

Nice job, you made that look so easy! 3 more quests and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 11 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Rojo-A-Go-Go It's not always quantity that matters when it comes to honey. A dash of pollen from a specific field can make all the difference! Brown Bear thinks it's a waste of time... So unrefined. I'll show you what a dash of pollen can do. Collect 300,000 Red pollen and 8 pollen from the Cactus Field. That's right! Just 8.

-During-

Even a little bit of pollen can take time, cause you still gotta travel up the mountain. It's worth it though. Collect 300,000 Red pollen and 8 pollen from the Cactus Field.

-Completion-

Nice job! A dash of cactus pollen adds a distinct zing to your honey! 2 more quests and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 10 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]! Half way there!

Pumpkin Plower I know it's not fall, but I've got a craving for pumpkin! Pumpkin honey has a toasty, savory flavor that can't be beat. I don't get to enjoy it often though... Cause of the you know what that lives in the cave up there. What a bully! Can't bully a beekeeper as tough as you though! Could you go up there and collect 315,000 pollen from the Pumpkin Patch?

-During-

Brown Bear told me there's a Royal Jelly behind a pumpkin up there. Brown Bear seems to know where all the Royal Jelly is, and then some... I wonder how he got all of that jelly? Anyways, come back when you've collected 315,000 pollen from the Pumpkin Field.

Nice job! This'll make enough pumpkin honey to last me all year! 1 more quests[sic] and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 9 more quests and I'll give my [[[Diamond Egg]]]!

Bouncing Around Biomes That whole area behind the 15 Bee gate is too intense for me. Mantises, scorpions, werewolves… It's straight out of a horror movie! You seem to be making yourself to be making yourself at home up there, though. So why don't you collect 180,000 pollen from the Cactus field and Pine Tree Forest?

Theres a [Royal Jelly] on top of one of the trees in the Pine Tree Forest. I wonder how you get up there? Come back when you've collected 180,000 pollen from the Cactus Field and Pine Tree Forest?

Nice job! 3 more quests and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 7 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

That lets you stay out in fields longer before you need to return to your hive. Nice job! Did you use any accessories to help you out? 2 more quests and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 6 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg].

For one, you can specialize your hives with all Red bees for maximum combos! On top of that, it's actually pretty close to the hives. For your bees at least - they don't have to fly very far to go to sleep! Why don't you test it out? Collect 450,000 pollen from the Rose Field.

Theres many fields to focus on, and many ways to construct your hive. I wonder which strategies are better? How's the Rose Field strategy going? Come back when you've collected 450,000 pollen from the Rose Field.

Nice job! That seemed pretty effective. 1 more quests and I'll give you a [Royal Jelly]. 5 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Search For The White Clover I can't get over the Clover Field! I just know theres something special about it. Maybe the reason it hasn't been making us lucky is cause we're not collecting from the right type of clover. I bet we need a special type of clover - a White Clover! The other bears assure me those don't exist... To be honest, I don't really trust them anyhow. Let's find one and prove them all wrong! Collect 300,000 White pollen and 200,000 pollen from the Clover Field.

Brown Bears spends all his time near the Clover Field. He's never explained why, but I think it has something to do with his [Royal Jelly] stockpile. Maybe theres something over there that gives you lots of [Royal Jelly]? Maybe he's actually hiding all the White Clovers for himself! Hurry, collect 300,000 White pollen and 200,000 pollen from the Clover Field.

-Completion-

Well, any luck? Did you find a White Clover? … No? Dang… That's okay you still deserve this, a [Royal Jelly]! Just 4 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Stomping Grounds You can't go forward without looking back. Well, you probably can, but then you'll forget stuff. And remembering things is really is really important for becoming a top honeymaker. So for your next lesson, let's revisit some of the first fields you ever worked in. Collect 100,000 pollen from the Sunflower, Dandelion, Mushroom and Blue Flower Fields.

Just cause they're easiest to access, that doesn't mean the pollen is any lower quality. To me, honey from the small flower fields is a delicacy! It takes longer to collect, and all that work gives it more flavor. Come back when you've collected 100,000 pollen... from the Sunflower, Dandelion, Mushroom and Blue Flower Fields.

-Completion-

Nice job! I know it takes a while, but it's worth it. Just 3 more more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Collecting Cliffside A top beekeeper needs to know the whole mountain like the back of their hand. And the only way to do that is to spend ages getting to know each and every field. For this next lesson, let’s revisit the area behind the area behind the 5 Bee gate! Collect 250,000 pollen from the Strawberry, Spider, and Bamboo Field.

-During-

Even though he's tough, we owe a lot to Panda Bear. He's the strongest of us all, and he keeps the bugs and baddies in check! Well, along with you and your bees on course. Come back when you've Collected 250,000 from the Strawberry, Spider and Bamboo fields.

-Completion-

Nice job! Your bees made quick work of those fields! Just 2 more quests and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Mountain Meandering You really are the most impressive beekeeper I’ve seen yet! And I’ve seen a lot of beekeepers while standing here by the hives... But before I’ll give you my [Diamond Egg], you’ve got to pass my final tests, and they’re the toughest of all!
