Collect 275,000 pollen from the Rose Field, Pine Tree Forest, Pumpkin Patch... Cactus Field and Pineapple Patch. You’ve never failed me before, so I know you’ll be able to do it!

-Completion-

Amazing! You're some kind of honey hero! Just one more quest and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]!

Quest Of Legends This mountain isn't very big, but it can seem pretty complex. Do you remember the first day you came here? It's funny how much smaller it feels once you've worked all over it. You and your bees probably know this place better then anyone else! Complete this last quest, and I'll give you my [Diamond Egg]. As you probably know, it always hatches into a Legendary Bee! A Legendary Bee deserves a Legendary Beekeeper. Collect 500,000 White, Red, and Blue pollen to prove that's you!

-During-

This place changes over time. Sometimes in surprising ways! You have to check in on us every once in a while, even if you think you've seen it all. You might find something new that draws you back in! But for now, let's finish up these lessons. Collect 500,000 White, Red, and Blue pollen.

-Completion-

I knew you had it in you from the start! Just look at you and your bees now, a real sight to behold. You probably know more about honey than I do at this point. I can't think of anyone better to have this, my [Diamond Egg]! It always hatches into a Legendary bee! Oh, but we're not done yet. Get ready for more extreme honeymaking.

High Altitude

If you couldn't tell already, I'm not the bravest bear. Lots of things spook me, but nothing spooks me quite as much as heights! That's part of why I hang around down here by the hives. Just thinking about walking along a steep cliff gives me the chills! This is a bit of a problem, cause some of the best pollen... Can only be obtained from the flower field on the mountain top. Why don't you help me out, since you're so brave and all? If you complete these next 20 quests, I'll have something very special for you. And for each one, I'll also throw in 5 [Tickets] and a [Royal Jelly]! Collect 500,000 pollen from the Clover Field and 750,000 pollen from the Mountain Top Field.

-During-

Oh no, I'm never going up there. Come back after you've collected 500,000 pollen from the Clover Field and 750,000 pollen from the Mountain [sic].

-Completion-

Oh boy, I just got dizzy watching you hike up there! Great work! Ok, now let me tell you more about that special prize I have in store for you. Have you heard about Gifted Bees? They're a lot like regular bees, but more special. Any type of bees can be Gifted. You know they're gifted because they've got unique colors and they're covered in. They got enhanse [sic] powers - they collect 50% more pollen, convert 50% more, and attack 50% harder! But most importantly, they grant bonuses to the entire swarm! Well, I just happen to have a special item that always grants you a Gifted Bee. It's called a [Star Jelly]! And if you complete 19 more quests, it's all yours. For now, why not try out this [Field Dice]? Give it a roll and it'll boost a random field!

Blissfully Blue Honey is my absolute favorite food. But everyone once in a while, I enjoy some fresh, ripe [Blueberries]! Luckily for us, they're easy to come by out here. Just collect pollen from fields with mostly blue flowers, and you'll be burried in [Blueberries] in no time. Collect 1,400,000 blue pollen... Collect 800,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field... Collect 500,000 pollen from the Blue Flower Field... Oh, and collect 50,000 blue pollen from the Pineapple Patch. Just to make things a little more exciting.

-During- The Pineapple Patch is almost all white pollen. That 50,000 blue pollen might just be the most difficult part of this lesson! Collect 1,400,000 blue pollen... Collect 800,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field... Collect 500,000 pollen from the Blue Flower Field... And collect 50,000 blue pollen from the Pineapple Patch.

-Completion- Nice job! How many [Blueberries] did you gather? Hmm... probably not enough. Take these [Blueberries] too! After 18 more quests, and I'll give you my [Star Jelly].

Rouge Round Up All that blue pollen is making me blue. Let's heat things up with a bit of red! Collect 1,600,000 red pollen... Collect 900,000 pollen from the Rose Field... Collect 700,000 pollen from the Strawberry Field... And collect 400,000 pollen [sic] from the Cactus Field!

-During- All things in moderation, except for honey. You can't have too much honey! That's what a wise bear once said. Collect 1,600,000 red pollen... Collect 900,000 pollen from the Rose Field... Collect 700,000 pollen from the Strawberry Field... And collect 400,000 pollen [sic] from the Cactus Field!

-Completion-

That was some spicey [sic] hot pollen gathering! Oh, too spicey [sic]! Here's a nice batch of [Strawberries] to help cool you off. Nice work! Just 17 more quests and the [Star Jelly] is yours!

White As Snow Fields full of white flowers can be so serene! Like a silent plain covered in a thick sheet of fresh snow. Snow that has to get collected and turned into honey. Not real cold snow, I don't like that stuff at all... Polar Bear does. What a weirdo! Anyways, collect 1,500,000 White pollen... Collect 700,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 400,000 pollen from the Spider Field... And collect 300,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field!

-During-

Why would anyone ever like the cold? You can't grow flowers if it's snowing. And you can't make honey without flowers. Anyways collect 1,500,000 White pollen... Collect 700,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 400,000 pollen from the Spider Field... And collect 300,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field!

-Completion-

You and your bees make it look so easy! We'd probably run out of honey in just a few days, if not for you. Here's a bunch of [Pineapple], to how much I appreciate it. Just 16 more quests and I'll give you my [Star Jelly]!

Solo On The Stump A long time ago, there used to be a big tree on the mountain. It was just way too big - it blocked the sun and everything! Nothing could grow below it, not even flowers. It was terrible. Until at some point, some giant bear came and cut it down. After that, all the plants could flourish! As you can see. At least this is what I've heard, makes sense to me. Anyways, you can still see the stump the tree left behind. And on top of the stump is a great flower field! At least it would be great, if not for the big snail that lives there. It distracts any bee who enters the field, so they're no help in collecting. If you want pollen from the Stump Field, you've got to do it by hand! Since I've only got paws, I need you to do it. Collect 1,000,000 pollen from the Stump Field! It'll be tricky, so if you complete this quest, I'll give you 10 [Tickets]!

-During-

I wish I could've seen the bear that cut down that tree. Maybe one day it'll come back. That would be nice cause it could probably defeat the [Stump Snail]. Anyways, collect 1,000,000 pollen from the Stump Field!

-Completion-

Why doesn't the snail just go away! It's probably just looking for those [Gumdrops] scattered around the field. Anyways, for completing that extra difficult quest, here's 10 [Tickets], and 30 [Gumdrops]! Complete 15 more quests, and you'll also earn a [Star Jelly]!

Colorful Craving Have you earned any amulets? There's many types of amulets, and they all help you make honey faster in some way. They're similar to gear you buy from shops, but they're earned from challenges. They look like little trinkets that hover around your head - almost like a bee. And each one is a bit different, offering different boosts. A [Moon Amulet] is earned by collecting 100 [Moon Charms]. An [Ant Amulet] is earned by playing the Ant Challenge. And [Star Amulets] can be generated after you've collected enough different types of Gifted Bees! Anyways, you should really check them out. After you check out some red and blue pollen, of course. Collect 1,500,000 Red pollen... Collect 1,500,000 Blue pollen... Collect 1,000,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest... And collect 600,000 pollen from the Mushroom Field!

-During-

I can't decide which color I'd prefer. They both sound so good! Collect 1,500,000 Red pollen... Collect 1,500,000 Blue pollen... Collect 1,000,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest... And collect 600,000 pollen from the Mushroom Field!

-Completion-

Nice job! You and your bees are so versatile. Here's some [Field Dice] for a bit of fun! Just 14 more quests, and I'll give you my [Star Jelly]!

Pumpkins, Please! I try to cycle through pollen sources to keep my diet well rounded. As well rounded as a honey-based diet can be, that is. It feels like it's been ages ages since I've had some pumpkin-flavored honey. And you've got to eat pumpkin honey if you want to grow strong as a pumpkin. Collect 2,000,000 pollen from the Pumpkin Field [sic]! It'll be healthy!

-During-

I would never eat a pumpkin! No way! My palette is tuned into the delicacies of honey and honey only! Pumpkin-flavored honey, that's a whole different story. Collect 2,000,000 pollen from the Pumpkin Field [sic]!

-Completion-

Pumpkin honey makes you strong, clover honey makes you lucky, and so on. Science Bear says there's very little difference between the types of honey, nutrition wise. Won't he look silly in a few years when I'm strong as a pumpkin while he's still puny. Nice job! To celebrate, I've got a [Magic Bean] for you! Plant it in a field to summon a Sprout. Collect pollen to make it grow. Eventually, it'll scatter prizes all over the field! Just 13 more quests and I'll give you that [Star Jelly] as well!

Smorgasbord A little of this, a little of that, that's the only way for me. Variety isn't only delicious, it's also smart! By collecting from each of the different flower fields, you can earn a variety of badges. Each badge has it's [sic] own badge in the Badge Menu, as I'm sure you've noticed by now. It's important to obtain many badges to maximize your honeymaking [sic] stats! For that reason, you should try to spend time in each and every field. Collect 500,000 pollen from each of the following: Sunflower Field, Clover Field, Bamboo Field, Pineapple Patch, Cactus Field, Rose Field, and Mountain Top Field!

-During-

Sometimes I feel full when eating one thing, but suddenly hungry when I start eating another thing. I wonder how that works. Anyways, collect 500,000 pollen from each of the following: Sunflower Field, Clover Field, Bamboo Field, Pineapple Patch, Cactus Field, Rose Field, and Mountain Top Field.

-Completion-

Now that's what I call a smorgasboard of pollen! Great job! Here's some more [Field Dice]. Just 12 more quests and I'll give you my [Star Jelly]!

Pollen Fetcher 5 As your hive grows big, you can eat through a field's pollen faster and faster. This can become a problem when the flowers stop growing fast enough to keep up! Luckily, there are [Sprinklers] for sale in the Badge Bearer's Guild to help fix this. Stick a [Sprinker] in a field, and it was cause [sic] nearby flowers to grow faster. You may want to look into one soon! Cause I'll only be asking for more and more! Collect 6,000,000 pollen!

-During-

6,000,000 pollen seems like a lot... But when you can collect anywhere, it's really not so bad!

-Completion-

By earning a variety of different badges, you unlock better [Sprinklers] in the shop. As you progress, this will become important! Good job by the way, here's 5 [Micro-Converters]. They're a real time saver. Complete 11 more quests, and I'll give you that [Star Jelly]!

White Clover Redux I still keep thinking about it. It even keeps me awake at night. The White Clover, where is it? And how lucky would we be if we could only find it! I bet that thing gives +1000% Loot Luck, maybe more. Loot luck increases the chances of obtaining items when defeating bugs and monsters. With enough Loot Luck, you'd probably get a billion [Tickets] from every ladybug! That's probably why Brown Bear is hiding all the White Clovers... Doesn't want to ruin the [Ticket] economy and devalue [Royal Jellies]. You can't stop us, Brown Bear. Collect 3,000,000 White Pollen and 3,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field.

-During-

You know, when you think about it, finding anything rare is probably lucky. I mean, what are the odds of finding it, if it were so rare? Hmm... well I guess it doesn't really make any sense. Anyways, Collect 3,000,000 White Pollen and 3,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field.

-Completion-

Still nothing? Well gosh... Ok Brown Bear. You win this time. For your efforts, here's extra [Royal Jellies]! Just 10 more quests until the [Star Jelly] is yours!

Strawberry Field Forever Collecting pollen can be a bit hypnotizing. You can fall into a trance, running around collecting tokens. It's relaxing, but also a little alarming! What if you fell into a loop of collecting pollen forever? Well, at least you would get a whole lot of honey. And that's good, I think - well maybe not SO much, [sic] Er, I mean, well yes, hm... Anyways, it's nothing to get hung about. Collect 6,000,000 pollen from the Strawberry Field.

-During-

I don't have to worry about how I spend my time. Cause I'm a virtual bear! I'll be here forever, I think. Come back when you've collect [sic] 6,000,000 pollen from the Strawberry Field.

-Completion-

Oh, you’re back! I thought I lost you. Nice job! Here’s even more [Strawberries] for you! Just 9 more quests and I’ll give you my [Star Jelly].

Tasting The Sky I have an idea for a special honey blend, inspired by: the big blue sky! With just the right blend, I hope to evoke the sensation of flying free in the air with a single spoonful. It’s a tall task, but I think I can pull it off. Collect 6,000,000 Blue pollen… Collect 3,000,000 pollen from the Mountain Top Field… And collect 1,000,000 pollen from the Sunflower Field.

-During-

I impress myself sometimes with my honey concoctions. Collect 6,000,000 Blue pollen… Collect 3,000,000 pollen from the Mountain Top Field… And collect 1,000,000 pollen from the Sunflower Field.

-Completion-

You see, the blue pollen represents the sky itself. The Mountain Top pollen, well that gives up the height factor. And the Sunflower Field pollen - that’s the secret ingredient. It represents the sun. Great job! Here’s some [Sunflower Seeds] to keep with the theme. Only 8 more quests and I’ll give you a [Star Jelly]!

Whispy And Crispy Honey made from Dandelion Field pollen feels more light and airy to me. It makes sense, given how dandelions are known to be blown around. Textures are very important when it comes to how we experience food. At least for a civilized bear like me! Collect 4,750,000 pollen from the Cactus Field… And 1,500,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field.

-During-

Polar Bear and I both share an appreciation for food. Brown Bear will eat any old meal, and Panda Bear just eats bamboo. They don’t know what they’re missing! Collect 4,750,000 pollen from the Cactus Field… And 1,500,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field.

-Completion-

That Cactus Field pollen will add a zesty bit of crunch I bet! Nice job! Here’s some [Micro-Converters] to help speed things up. Just 7 more quest [sic] and I’ll give you my [Star Jelly]!

Walk Through The Woods You’re really close to getting that [Star Jelly], so how about I tell you more about Gifted Bees? The Gifted Hive Bonuses they offer can be seen in the Bee Menu. For example, you can see that a Gifted Basic Bee offers x1.2 pollen to your entire hive! Gifted Hive Bonuses can only be obtained once per type, so 2 Gifted Basic Bees will still only gifted x1.2 pollen. But duplicate Gifted Bees are still useful! They have 50% higher gather amount, conversion rate, and attack damage! They also produce “Inspire” ability tokens that double your pollen for 5 seconds. Ok, enough reading. How about a peaceful stroll through the woods? Make sure you take your bees though, it can be dangerous out there. Collect 8,000,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest… And 5,000,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field.

-During-

Gifted Bees can be obtained in a variety of ways. [Star Jellies] and certain eggs always give Gifted Bees. [Royal Jellies] have a 1 in 250 chance of transforming a bee into a gifted bee. By feeding bees their favorite type of treat, there is a tiny chance they [sic] become Gifted. And by feeding bees a [Star Treat], they'll always become gifted! Come back when you've collected 8,000,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest... And 5,000,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field.

-Completion-

How was your walk? Nice job! Here’s a [Blue Extract]. Just 6 more quests and the [Star Jelly] is yours!

Get Red-y I’m not necesarilly [sic] a fashionable bear, but I recognize the importance of a good outfit. Especially for beekeepers like you! The accessories you can buy in the shops are crucial for improving your honeymaking abilities. For example, the shoulder guards you can find in the Red and Blue HQs… Offer tons of benefits, like increased container space, and colored pollen boosts! Make sure you’re upgrading your gear - it’s worth the investment. For this next quest, an [Elite Red Guard] would do wonders! Collect 10,000,000 Red pollen… Collect 4,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field… And collect 1,500,000 pollen from the Stump Field.

-During-

Amulets and equipment are what separates good beekeepers from master beekeepers! Collect 10,000,000 Red pollen… Collect 4,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field… And collect 1,500,000 pollen from the Stump Field.

-Completion-

That Stump Snail really slows things down, doesn’t it! Imagine if your bees were so strong that you could defeat it. Anyways, nice job! Here’s a [Red Extract] to help you put that wardrobe together. Just 5 more quests until I give you my [Star Jelly]!

One Stop On The Tip Top When you’re out of field boosts, and you just need honey fast… The Mountain Top Field is the place to be! It contains only large colored flowers so you can collect extremely fast. Why don’t you give it a shot? Collect 15,000,000 pollen from the Mountain Top Field - easy peasy!

-During-

Remember, you've still got to collect from the other fields to earn your badges. But for now, collect 15,000,000 pollen from the Mountain Top Field.

-Completion-

See what I mean? That field is fast! But remember, you should collect from other fields to earn your badges. These [Field Dice] ought to help! Ok, just 4 more quests until the [Star Jelly] is yours!

Blue Mushrooms 2 As you may have noticed by now, I like to keep things straight forward. [sic] When it comes to quests, collecting pollen is all I’m about! But as you progress as a honeymaker, you’ll be faced with more types of tasks than that. If you really want to improve, you should be doing Science Bear’s quests as well! His quests can be tricky, requiring stuff like collecting tokens. But his rewards are great! I hear he’s even working on some sort of [Translator] device. Anyways, let’s get back to business! Collect 6,000,000 pollen from the Blue Flower Field… And collect 6,000,000 pollen from the Mushroom Field.

-During-

Come back when you've collected 6,000,000 pollen from the Blue Flower Field… And collect 6,000,000 pollen from the Mushroom Field.

-Completion-

A [Translator], huh… I wonder who you could talk to with one of those! Aliens? Ghosts? Maybe even the bees! Anyways, nice job! Here’s some [Micro-Converters]. Only 3 quests to go until the [Star Jelly]!

Pretty Pumpkins As you know, I eat pumpkin-flavored honey to make me strong. But that’s not all I do to take care of myself. I don’t like to brag, but I’m proud of my fine coat of fur. Nobody says anything, but I can tell the other bears are jealous. What’s my secret? Rose-flavored honey! Collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Pumpkin Patch… And collect 12,500,000 pollen from the Rose Field.

-During-

It's hard work looking this good. Come back when you've collected 10,000,000 pollen from the Pumpkin Patch… And collect 12,500,000 pollen from the Rose Field.

-Completion-

Everyone else says that if you want to look good and be strong, you're got to exercise. To each their own! Nice job! Here's something pretty to go with that rose-flavored honey: some [Glitter]! Just 2 more quests to go until the [Star Jelly] is yours! I wonder which Gifted Bee you'll get?

Black Bear, Why? The bees are our best friends! Well, most of them anyways. There are a few that tend to cause a bit of trouble. The worst one is Vicious Bee! What a bad bug. This bully of a bee tends to go rogue and attack innocent beekeepers. But if you can manage to collect 250 [Stingers] - you can win one over! It's a great bee to have for taking down big baddies due to it's "Impale" ability. And it's essential if you want to excell [sic] at the Ant Challenge or Stick Bug Challenge. From what I've heard, it tends to hang out in certain fields. Why don't you check them out? Collect 15,000,000 Red and Blue pollen... Collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Cactus Field... Collect 6,000,000 pollen from the Spider Field... And collect 4,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field. ... What? I know it sounds hard, but you can do it!

-During-

Vicious Bee isn't the only bee that causes trouble! One time, I saw a strange bee destroy a whole field with powerful gusts of wind! I wonder if there are any other mysterious bees roaming free out there? Anyways, collect 15,000,000 Red and Blue pollen... Collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Cactus Field... Collect 6,000,000 pollen from the Spider Field... And collect 3,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field.

-Completion-

Vicious Bee is scarily strong! If any bee could take down the Stump Snail, I bet it would be Vicious. Anyways, nice job! Here’s 15 [Stingers] that’ll help you claim a Vicious Bee of your own. Just 1 more quest to go and my [Star Jelly] is all yours!

Bee A Star You've proven yourself to be a truly spectacular honeymaker! In my mind, you're a star! And it's only fitting that a star should receive my [Star Jelly]. Complete this final quest, and it's yours! It's a doozy, though. Collect 20,000,000 White pollen... Collect 8,000,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest... Collect 8,000,000 pollen from the Rose Field... Collect 3,000,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... And Collect 3,000,000 pollen from the Sunflower Field!

-During-

The quest for Gifted Bees is where your honeymaking journey truly begins. And my [Star Jelly] will kick things off! Collect 20,000,000 White pollen... Collect 8,000,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest... Collect 3,000,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... And Collect 3,000,000 pollen from the Sunflower Field!

-Completion-

You never let me down! A true beekeeping superstar. So this is for you - my [Star Jelly]! This is where your journey to becoming a top honeymaker really begins. Keep making honey, keep discovering bees, and try to discover as many Gifted Bees as possible! Each one improves your hive, and makes obtaining the next Gifted Bee easier. With a bit of dedication, you'll have a hive full of Gifted Bees before you know it! That's all the main quests I've got for now. Science Bear ought to keep you busy, though!

Bamboo Boogie 2: Bamboo Boogaloo Guess what? While you were working for that [Star Jelly], I found something even rarer... A [Mythic Egg]! A special egg that always hatches into a Mythic Bee. Mythic Bees are even rarer than Gifted Legendary Bees! Can you believe that? On average, only 1 in 25,000 [Royal Jellies] transforms a bee into a Mythic Bee. They're so rare, we thought they were just myths for the longest time. But they're not! If you complete 20 more quests, I'll give you the [Mythic Egg]! I hope you're ready, cause I'm excited to see which bee is inside. Playtime is over - now the real quests begin: First up, collect 30,000,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field.

-During-

All Mythic Bees have special unique abilities. I've also heard that each one unlocks another ability when they become Gifted. But can you imagine how hard it would be to obtain a Gifted Mythic Bee? Collect 30,000,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field.

-Completion-

Nice job! Have you had enough bamboo? I don't blame you! Let's move on and leave the rest of that bamboo for Panda Bear. Complete 4 more quests, and I'll give you another [Star Jelly]. Complete 19 more quests, and I'll give you the [Mythic Egg]!

Rocky Red Mountain Up on the Mountain Top, it can get pretty chilly. A spoonful of honey made from Red pollen will warm you right up. And so will the Flames produced by Fire Bee and Demon Bee when they gather! Stand near the Flames, and you'll charge up your Flame Heat. Flame Heat grants bonus Red pollen, Red Instant Conversion, and Bee Attack! That could help you out in this next quest: Collect 30,000,000 Red pollen... Collect 20,000,000 pollen from the Mountain Top Field... And collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field!

-During-

The Fire Mask and Demon Mask can also produce Flames! Combining those masks with many Red bees helps provide Flame Heat consistently. Collect 30,000,000 Red pollen... Collect 20,000,000 pollen from the Mountain Top Field... And collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field!

-Completion-

The Flames produced by Fire Bee, Demon Bee, and Spicy Bee can't actually be real fire. I mean, if they were, this place would have burned down ages ago! Complete 3 more quests, and I'll give you a [Star Jelly]. Complete 18 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

Can't Without Ants The pesky ants of the Ant Challenge used to be a real problem. Before they got locked away in that case, they made ant hills all over the place. If we didn't have beekeepers like you to keep their population in check, we'd probably be overrun again. For this next quest, you'll need to take part in an Ant Challenge. Why? Because pollen from the Ant Field produces a zesty honey that can't be beat! Collect 50,000,000 pollen and 2,500,000 pollen from the Ant Field.

-During-

The [Ant Amulet] from the Ant Challenge provides a bunch of useful stats. In fact, all Amulets are useful and essential to top-tier beekeeping. Collect 50,000,000 pollen and 2,500,000 pollen from the Ant Field.

-Completion-

Nice job! You made quick work of the ants. Say, what's your highscore in the Ant Challenge? Mines 0. I would never set foot in there! Complete 2 more quests, and I'll give you a [Star Jelly]. Complete 17 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

The 15 Bee Zone The flower fields in the 15 Bee Zone are all pretty good. Not as good as others, like the Mountain Top Field or Coconut Field, but not bad. Honey-wise, however, they're top notch fields. Such a variety of exotic flowers! Collect 15,000,000 pollen from every field in the 15 Bee Zone.

-During-

You've got to be careful with honey made from the Cactus Field. Every once in a while, a [Stinger] slips through! Collect 15,000,000 pollen from every field in the 15 Bee Zone.

-Completion-

After that, your badges for the 15 Bee Zone should be coming along nicely. Make sure you claim them, cause the rewards are great. Here's an example: The Pumpkin Badge really speeds up the time time [sic] it takes to convert pollen into honey at the hive. But it only works at the hive! Why does that matter? Well, some abilities like Honey Mark, Coin Scatter, and Diamond Drain improve with convert rate. The Pumpkin Badge only increases convert rate at the hive, so it won't affect those abilities in the fields. Complete just 1 more quests [sic], and I'll give you a [Star Jelly]. And complete 16 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

Bubble Trouble How much do you know about Bubbles? They're produced by Bubble Bee, Tadpole Bee, the Bubble Mask, and Frogs. When you pop them, they collect pollen - mostly Blue pollen - and replenish the flowers. For every Blue bee in your hive, and every Gifted Blue bee type in your hive, the Bubbles collect more! In a hive full of Blue bees, Bubbles can become your main source of pollen, believe it or not! Collect 80,000,000 Blue pollen... Collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Stump Field... And collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Blue Flower Field.

-During-

Any player can pop your Bubbles for you, but don't worry The pollen collected by the Bubble is yours, no matter who pops it. Collect 80,000,000 Blue pollen... Collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Stump Field... And collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Blue Flower Field.

-Completion-

Nice Job! [sic] How many Bubbles did you pop out there? Well, I know that quest was quite a doozy, so I've got a special reward for you: A [Star Jelly]! That's right, I found a few more of them! Complete 15 more quests, and the [Mythic Egg] is yours too!

Sweet and Sour Of all of our senses, taste is my favorite. Blending flavors adds a variety to our lives. In fact, yummy tastes are the meaning of life, at least for me! Imagine eating the same boring meal every day... Well, I guess as a bear that only eats honey, I'm one to talk. But let me tell you: there's TONS of different flavors in honey, as long as it comes from the right sources. I've got a hankering for a specific blend that's both sweet and sour. Collect 60,000,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... And 30,000,000 pollen from the Mushroom Field.

-During-

You know who else is both sweet and sour? Spirit Bear. She's the nicest old bear most of the time, but sometimes she's just grumpy and mean! Collect 60,000,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... And 30,000,000 pollen from the Mushroom Field.

-Completion-

You and your swarm make all quests look easy! But there's always room for improvement. Make sure you're leveling up your bees with the [Treats] you're earning in these quests. Choose the bees you want to level up wisely: some give more bang for your buck. Event Bees like Tabby Bee and Vicious Bee are great choices for leveling. Complete 4 more quests, and I'll give you a [Star Jelly]. Complete 14 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

Rare Red Clover I've figured out more about the mysterious Clover Field. I was right! Farming in that field raises your Loot Luck. How? Through the Clover Field badges! They permanently increase your chance of obtaining prizes from enemies. But I've also heard that if you find one very special clover, you can get even more Loot Luck. The Red Clover, a clover 1000 times rarer than the White Clover! We've got to find it. Collect 120,000,000 Red pollen and 40,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field.

-During-

Later in your beekeeping career, other resources, like Glitter and Glue, become just as important as honey. You'll need them to craft the most powerful gear available. That's why Loot Luck is so important! Farming crafting materials from enemies is much faster with Loot Luck. Collect 120,000,000 Red pollen and 40,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field.

-Completion-

You mean to tell me after all of that, you didn't find a single Red Clover? We're [sic] you even looking? Maybe we need to get you some glasses. That's ok though. At least we're making progress on your Clover Field badges. Complete 3 more quests, and I'll give you a [Star Jelly]. Complete 13 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

Low Tier Treck Now that you're a real deal professional beekeeper, you've probably gotten used to triple flowers. Those flowers grow in the more advanced fields unlocked when you've got 25+ bees. Triple-flowers grant x3 Pollen, making fields full of triple-flowers great for honeymaking. But the single and double flowers are important too! Important to my taste buds, at least. The honey from those flowers is nuanced, subtle, and not overly sweet. Let's collect a ton of pollen from all the worst fields in the game! Collect 12,000,000 pollen from the Strawberry Field, Spider Field, Bamboo Field... Blue Flower Field, Mushroom Field, Dandelion Field, and Sunflower Field! [sic missing Clover Field]

-During-

You and your bees are out in the fields all day, while I just stand around. You know these fields way better than I do! This quest ought to be easy. Collect 12,000,000 pollen from the Strawberry Field, Spider Field, Bamboo Field... Blue Flower Field, Mushroom Field, Dandelion Field, and Sunflower Field! [sic missing Clover Field]

-Completion-

Nice job! Hope you aren't too tired - that was a lot of walking around. Complete 2 more quests, and I'll give you a [Star Jelly]. Complete 12 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

Okey-Pokey I admit that I'm a delicate bear. That's why I could never farm in the Cactus or Rose Fields myself. The thorns would go right through my fur. They'd prick up my paws! Good thing you and your bees are so thick-skinned. You're super tough! Collect 150,000,000 White pollen... And collect 50,000,000 pollen from the Rose Field and Cactus Field!

-During-

As if the Rose thorns weren't bad enough, you've also go [sic] scorpions to deal with! But I suppose those [sic] are no problem for you anymore - not with that many bees. Collect 150,000,000 White pollen... And collect 50,000,000 pollen from the Rose Field and Cactus Field!

-Completion-

Okey-pokey! Moving right along! Just 1 more quests [sic] until I give you a [Star Jelly]. And 11 more quests until I give you the [Mythic Egg]!

Pollen Fetcher 6 I've been a bit picky lately, haven't I? How about we let you call the shots for this one? Collect 250,000,000 Pollen from wherever you want! Sounds like a lot, but when you combine your boosts, it's not that bad. Just let the [Field Dice] and Wind Shine winds take you whereever's [sic] best. After that, I'll give you a [Star Jelly]!

-During-

Quests like this are the best! You can finish them at the same time as doing other quests or working towards your badges. Collect 250,000,000 pollen! Any pollen will do.

-Completion-

Nice job! See? It's not that hard when you use your boosts! By combining field boosts, consumable items like [Extracts], [Glitter] and [Glue]... And if you're lucky, maybe even a promo code... Leads to hundreds of millions of pollen in no time! And with that, here's another [Star Jelly]! Complete 10 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

Capsaican Collector

I never thought I'd say this, but honey's gotten a bit... boring. Don't get me wrong! It's still the love of my life! But it needs a little kick, a little pazazz. Let's spice things up! The Pepper Patch is the ultimate source for smokin' hot honey. Whip me a scorching blend to rekindle my love for honey! Collect 120,000,000 pollen from the Pepper Patch... Collect 50,000,000 pollen from the Spider Field... And collect 20,000,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field.

-During-

I like things spicy, but not SPICY spicy. That's why we'll need a little Dandelion Field pollen. It'll mellow things out. Collect 120,000,000 pollen from the Pepper Patch... Collect 50,000,000 pollen from the Spider Field... And collect 20,000,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field.

-Completion-

Oh yeah, now that's hot! You know who else is hot? Spicy Bee. Spicy bee is a Mythic Bee that's all about Flames and fighting. It summons Flames and Fire Bees. Both of those help out a ton in combat! Maybe your [Mythic Egg] contains a Spicy Bee? Let's keep going to find out. Complete 4 more quests, and I'll give you a [Gifted Silver Egg]. Complete 9 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

Mountain Mix A perfect balance of red and blue pollen results in perfectly rounded honey. And hives mixed with red and blue bees are more versatile. Capable of using more fields! But mixed hives aren't always the best. Going full red or blue can result in faster honeymaking. It all depends on your playstyle, and most importantly, the current balance of the game. Let's do a little bit of mixed gathering for now. Collect 200,000,000 Red pollen, 200,000,000 Blue pollen... And 200,000,000 pollen from the Mountain Top Field!

-During-

As you progress, you'll have to make some big decisions. Which items should you buy? Which bees should you use? Which color should you focus on? There's no perfect answer, and as the game changes you'll probably want to change too. Collect 200,000,000 Red pollen, 200,000,000 Blue pollen... And 200,000,000 pollen from the Mountain Top Field!

-Completion-

Good work! Did either of the colors give you trouble? Hives specialized in 1 color are usually better for farming lots of honey. But they can really struggle at quests that require the opposite color. Complete 3 more quests, and I'll give you a [Gifted Silver Egg]. Complete 8 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

You Blue It There are some high-pressure moments in the life of a beekeeper! Like when you're pushing for a new best amulet in a challenge. Or when you're trying to line everything up just right during a boost. Early on, honeymaking is way more relaxed. Now [sic] things are more intense. During high-pressure moments, stay focused or you might blow it! Collect 350,000,000 Blue pollen... Collect 50,000,000 pollen from the Blue Flower Field... And collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Ant Field!

-During-

Collecting pollen in the Ant Field can be a pain, but at least you don't have to convert in there! Collect 350,000,000 Blue pollen... Collect 50,000,000 pollen from the Blue Flower Field... And collect 10,000,000 pollen from the Ant Field!

-Completion-

Nice job! You came out clutch! Complete 2 more quests, and I'll give you a [Gifted Silver Egg]. Complete 7 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

Variety Fetcher 2 A little bit of this, a little bit of that. You know me by now! I like a little bit of everything. Collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Pepper Patch... Collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Strawberry Field... And collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest!

-During-

My quests are just about the pollen, nothing extra like Ability Tokens. Brown Bear and I know what's up. Pollen is the most important! Collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Pepper Patch... Collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Strawberry Field... And collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest!

-Completion-

Nice job! That was some good old-fashioned pollen collecting! I like to keep things simple with my quests. Unlike Science Bear and Spirit Bear. In my opinion, their quests are too confusing. Just 1 more quest, and I'll give you a [Gifted Silver Egg]. Complete 6 more quests, and I'll give you the [Mythic Egg]!

Getting Stumped The Stump Snail stumps even the best beekeepers every once in a while. You've got to defeat it if you want to do any real farming on the Stump Field. Or you could just use a hive full of Baby Bees. They ignore the Stump Snail because they're too dumb to notice. Collect 500,000,000 pollen and 300,000,000 pollen from the Stump Field!

-During-

Although bee attack is useless for pollen collecting, it's important for taking down the Stump Snail. Collect 500,000,000 pollen and 300,000,000 pollen from the Stump Field!

-Completion-

Did you stump the Stump Snail? Did it give you nice rewards? It's a great source of [Glue], and other stuff like [Star Jelly]. But you know what's even better than [Star Jelly]? This [Gifted Silver Egg]! Here's a secret tip: hatching the egg works, but donating it to the Wind Shrine might be even better. The Wind Shrine tends to give the biggest and best boosts when people donate rare eggs! Sometimes the honey you make from those boosts is worth way more than the egg you donated. But you never know with the Wind Shrine! That thing is hard to understand. Complete 5 more quests, and I'll give you a [Mythic Egg]!

Weed Wacker 3 You're a legitimate professional now! But even professionals forget things sometimes. As you move into the late game, make sure you're keeping up with all the fundamentals: Are you leveling up your bees? Are you crafting quality equipment? Are you earning all your badges? Are you making sure you have many Gifted Bee Types in your hive? Are you using [Neonberries] and [Bitterberries] to give your bees the right mutations? Are you using your Field Boosters? The Wind Shrine? And gathering Nectar? Are you stocking up on items like [Micro-Converters], [Field Dice], [Jelly Beans]... And using them together to get the most out of your boosts? Being a beekeeper requires a ton of preparation and resource management. The Global Top Honeymakers don't just mindlessly grind all day long, They plan ahead and use all their resources wisely! Oh boy... I don't think I could handle all that stress! That's ok though. I'm good at what I do (eating honey). Collect 400,000,000 pollen from the Pepper Patch... Collect 200,000,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field... And collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field.

-During-

I hate [Bitterberries]! They're just foul! But the bees seem to love them. They haven't got refined palette like we do. Thank goodness, too, because [Bitterberries] are the best way to give bees beneficial mutations. Collect 400,000,000 pollen from the Pepper Patch... Collect 200,000,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field... And collect 100,000,000 pollen from the Clover Field.

-Completion-

Nice job! You cleared up all those weeds real fast! Your bees are like an awesome army of lawnkeepers that work non-stop without pay. Complete 4 more quests, and I'll give you the [Mythic Egg]!

All-Whitey Then Have you met Spirit Bear? She's the oldest bear I know. She's also the sleepiest bear, and the richest bear... And definitely the most talkative. She just won't stop talking! But she knows a thing or two about honey for sure. Especially honey from White pollen. If you're interested in fine White honey and tons of [Glitter], be sure to do her quests! Collect 500,000,000 White pollen [sic 600,000,000 White pollen] ... Collect 60,000,000 White pollen from the Spider Field... Collect 40,000,000 White pollen from the Dandelion Field [sic 40,000,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field] ... And collect 10,000,000 White pollen from the Cactus Field. There's not a lot of White pollen on the Cactus Field, but it's there, and it's worth it!

-During-

Spirit Bear is so old, I'm surprised she even has the energy to talk that much. Collect 500,000,000 White pollen [sic 600,000,000 White pollen] ... Collect 40,000,000 White pollen from the Dandelion Field [sic 40,000,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field] ... And collect 10,000,000 White pollen from the Cactus Field.

-Completion-

Nice job! When it comes to collecting White pollen, your swarm does quite all-white! Complete 3 more quests, and I'll give you the [Mythic Egg]!

Red Delicacy Gifted Riley Bee knows a secret method for making the most delicious red honey. The trick is you've got to use red pollen from mostly white fields! The pollen's rarity, and the effort put into collecting it, makes it a true delicacy. Sounds crazy, right? Well, let's try it ourselves and find out! Collect 700,000,000 Red pollen... Collect 150,000,000 Red pollen from the Strawberry Field... Collect 50,000,000 Red pollen from the Pumpkin Patch... And collect 25,000,000 Red pollen from the Coconut Field!

-During-

Collect 700,000,000 Red pollen... Collect 150,000,000 Red pollen from the Strawberry Field... Collect 50,000,000 Red pollen from the Pumpkin Patch... And collect 25,000,000 Red pollen from the Coconut Field!

-Completion-

Nice job! That looked like it took some extra effort. But the honey will be worth it, surely. At least I hope so! Complete just 2 more quests, and I'll give you the [Mythic Egg]!

Boss Battles Take a look at your swarm now. It sure looks strong! You've come a long way. Remember when you hive was just a bunch of Basic and Rare Bees? Look at how much they've leveled, too! Stuff like the Werewolf is no match for you anymore. But no matter how tough you get, there always seems to be someone tougher. To truely [sic] be a top honeymaker, you've got to keep fighting your way to the top! Collect 600,000,000 pollen from the Coconut Field... Collect 600,000,000 pollen from the Stump Field... And collect 25,000,000 pollen from the Ant Field!

-During-

If you think bosses we know now are tough, you don't even know! This mountain has seem all kinds of big baddies, and it will surely see more. Collect 600,000,000 pollen from the Coconut Field... Collect 600,000,000 pollen from the Stump Field... And collect 25,000,000 pollen from the Ant Field!

-Completion-

Oh good, you're done! Those fields are way too intense for me. I couldn't even watch! A hive as strong as yours is perfectly suited for a Mythic Bee. Just 1 more quests [sic] and the [Mythic Egg] is yours!

Myth In The Making There are all sorts of myths, but they all have something in common. Each one starts as a story so great and fantastic, that it lasts for eons and eons! With your talent as a beekeeper, your story is sure to go down as a great myth as well! Bears all over will rave about your bees and your honey for ages to come! Let's prove it right now, with my most challenging quest yet. After this final test, you'll be ready to hatch a Mythic Bee! Collect 1,000,000,000 Red pollen, 1,000,000,000 Blue pollen... And 50,000,000 pollen from EVERY field! (Except the Ant Field)

-During-

Every time I talk to her, Mother Bear can't stop gushing over you and your bees! You've made all of us bears proud. I know you'll be able to complete this quest in no time! Collect 1,000,000,000 Red pollen, 1,000,000,000 Blue pollen... And 50,000,000 pollen from EVERY field!

-Completion-

You've done it again! You truly are a legend! Your swarm is the pride of the mountain. At least in my mind! I can't think of anyone else who more deserves this: My [Mythic Egg]! Let's see what Mythic Bee destiny has in store for you. You've completed the last of my main quests. They seemed to go by so fast! But from here on out, I'll still give you random quests to keep you busy. Maybe some day I'll find something even rarer to give you. Until then, keep making honey! Talk later!

Repeatable Quests I can keep you busy with some good, old fashioned questing if you like! These quest [sic] may be repetitive, but at least they give you something to do while we both wait for an update. I've written down your next refresher course in the Quest Menu!

-During-

Hatch bees, collect pollen, make honey! Come talk to me when you've finished the "collect pollen" part I've written in the Quest Menu.

-Completion-

You never let me down! Here's a little something as a thank you. I can give you a quest once an hour, so check with me again later!

-Cooldown-

I can give you 1 quest an hour! Check back with me later.

Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue 2018 Oh, hello there! You are given a choice to give a present to Black Bear or continue talking like normal. You choose to give him a present. For me? You shouldn't have! Let's see what it is... Oh, a jar of honey imported from the tropics! I can taste distinct notes of banana and mango. Delicious! You know me too well. I've got you a little something as well. docs.title: Beesmas Quest - Black Bear's Honey Wreath

docs.text:
Requirements Rewards
  • Collect 5,000 Pollen.
  • Convert 5,000 Pollen at the hive.
  • Collect 500 Honey from Bloom Petals.
  • Collect 50 Honey Tokens.
  • Collect 5 Tokens from Leaves in the Dandelion Field.
  • Collect 5 Tokens from Leaves in the Blue Flower Field.
25,000 Honey

5 Tickets 5 Micro-Converters 1 Royal Jelly 1 Gingerbread Bear Access to the Honey Wreath

Quest Dialogue Black Bear's Honey Wreath

There's no better time than winter to join Re://:Swarm! All season long, we celebrate Beesmas. A festival of bees and joy. And we do that by putting up decorations that help you make honey faster! For example, I just put up a Wreath to try to motivate everyone. But as you can see, it's pretty bland... But I think we can salvage it. If you're willing to collect some stuff! Once it's done, we'll all be feeling really motivated I bet. Here's what we need: Collect 5,000 Pollen... Convert 5,000 Pollen into Honey at your hive... Collect 500 Pollen from Bloom Petals. You'll get these by swinging at the tall flowers that sometimes pop up. Collect 50 Honey Tokens... These drop from everything! And collect 5 tokens from Leaves in the Dandelion Field and the Blue Flower Field. When you see Leaves jumping up from specific flowers, be sure to scoop around them for a surprise.

-During-

N/A

-Completion-

You gathered the supplies, now I'll do the hard work. ...(cut cut)...(snip snip)... Ta-dah! It's the Honey Wreath! It's even more motivating than I imagined. Now that it's done, you may admire it once every 30 minutes. When you do, its splendor will instantly convert all pollen in your bag into Honey Tokens! That'll certainly speed up your honeymaking. Things are starting to look festive around here! If you talk to the other bears, I'm sure they'll have other Beesmas decorations to work on. Merry Beesmas!

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Black Bear proudly calls himself a "Honey Connoisseur" in his dialogue. This is what the "Black Bear's Title?" hint (behind the Instant Converter where Tunnel Bear is) refers to, leading to the Code "Connoisseur".
  • He is the third bear to have a list of endless repeating quests.
  • Black Bear uses the Cartoony Animation Package.
  • He is the only quest giver to have normal quests and repeatable quests.
  • The repeatable quests used to be given one after another, with no cooldown.
  • As of now, the repeatable quests have a cooldown of one hour.
  • After the 2020-04-06 Update, where Black Bear got his Mythic Egg quests, if the player already had a repeatable quest, it was unable to be turned in until they had completed all of Black Bear's Mythic Egg quests.
  • Black Bear is one of the twelve Cub Buddy skins.
  • He is self-aware that he is in a Roblox game, along with Panda Bear, Mother Bear, Bee Bear, Science Bear, and Spirit Bear, as he says, “But this is ROBLOX! Anything goes!” He also says "the 'luck' stat in the game," mentions waiting for an update to happen, and mentions that he's a 'virtual bear.'
  • He was the first bear to give a Diamond Egg, with Panda Bear being the second, Brown Bear being the third, and Dapper Bear being the fourth.
  • He was the second bear to give a Mythic Egg, with Brown Bear being the first and Dapper Bear being the third.
  • He, Mother Bear, and Brown Bear were "nice" in 2018, as stated by Bee Bear during the Beesmas 2018 Event.
  • In "Pretty Pumpkins" during dialogue, originally it was only "Test.". This was a mistake, and the actual dialogue was added sometime later.
  • He, Panda Bear, and Spirit Bear are the only bears that mention the history of the mountain.
  • He mentions a mysterious bee once "destroyed an entire field with powerful gusts of wind" in the "Black Bear, Why?" dialogue. This was later revealed that said bee was Wild Windy Bee.
  • He is acrophobic, or afraid of heights, as said in the quest "High Altitude".
  • He is also arachnophobic, or afraid of spiders, as said in the quest "Cobweb Sweeper".
  • In the Egg Hunt 2019 Event, Black Bear had instructed to collect 200 pollen from the Sunflower Field, but when the player got the quest, it told them to collect 200 pollen from the Dandelion Field instead.
  • In the dialogue for "Colorful Craving", he stated that 250 Moon Charms were needed to generate a Moon Amulet, but only 100 are needed. This was fixed in an unknown update.
  • The "Rojo-A-Go-Go" quest is the quest that requires the least amount of pollen collected from one field that being 8 pollen from the Cactus Field.
  • Black Bear references external many multiple times throughout his quests.
  • The "Bamboo Boogie 2: Bamboo Boogaloo" quest's name is reminiscent of the film title "Breakin’ 2: Electric Boogaloo."
  • The quest "Strawberry Field Forever" is a reference to The Beatles' "Strawberry Fields Forever" song.
  • The quest "Pumpkins, Please!" may be referencing the popular game "Papers, Please".
  • The quest "All-Whitey Then" could be a reference to actor Jim Carrey and one of his catchphrases "Alrighty then!"
  • Black Bear has the most amount of quests in the game, with a total of 75 quests (excluding repeatable & event quests).
  • The quest “Sweet and Sour” may be a reference to what Gummy Bear says when a player approaches him in Lair.
  • Excluding event quests, Black Bear and Brown Bear are the only quest givers that only require pollen to be collected.
  • In "Weed Wacker 2," Black Bear explains to the player that he isn't convincing the player to do his "dirty work."
  • In “Azure Adventure” Black Bear explains to the player that would pick Ninja Bee to lead the Blue HQ, as opposed to Bucko Bee.
  • In his 'During' dialogue for "Pollen Fetcher 4", Black Bear asks for 375,000 pollen from the Mushroom and Blue Flower fields, even though the quest is 375,000 of any pollen from any field.
  • Black Bear's quests from Sunflower Start to Myth in the Making in total requires 10,203,376,458 pollen. Out of this, 5,694,179,858 pollen can be from any field or specific fields, 2,079,010,600 is Red Pollen, 775,360,000 is White Pollen, and 1,654,826,000 is Blue Pollen.
  • In total, Black Bear rewards 2,339,381,200 Honey, 288 Royal Jellies, 30 Field Dice, 1 Silver Egg, 1 Gold Egg, 1 Diamond Egg, 1 Mythic Egg, 1 Gifted Silver Egg, 205 Tickets, 130 Blueberries, 165 Strawberries, 160 Sunflower Seeds, 255 Pineapples, 130 Gumdrops, 13 Magic Beans, 23 Micro-Converters, 3 Red Extracts, 3 Blue Extracts, 1 Glue, 198,000 Treats, 2 Glitter, 20 Stingers, 3 Star Jellies, 30 Ant Passes, 1 Enzymes, 4 Boxes-O-Frogs, 50 Bitterberries, 76 Moon Charms, 10 Coconuts, 1 Purple Potion, and 3 Tropical Drinks.

docs.title: Blender
docs.text:
Blender Information Usage Crafting consumable items from ingredients Requirement(s) Access to the Badge Bearer's Guild Cooldown None Location Inside the Badge Bearer's Guild

The Blender is a machine located in the Badge Bearer's Guild. The machine's usage is to create consumable items from pre-existing items. However, the player is only able to craft one type of item at a time. There is a total of 24 different items that the machine can craft.

docs.title: Crafting
docs.text:
Each item takes 5 minutes to craft and the timer only counts down when the player is in-game, unless they have an Offline Voucher, in which it will stay active for up to 24 hours after they log out. The player can end the crafting process at any time by clicking on the "End Crafting" button. This will give the player all finished items, and all unfinished items will be turned back into their ingredients and given back to the player. If the button is green, then everything has been blended. If not (red button), then the Blender has not finished blending. The player can also speed up the blending for a varying amount of Tickets. For every 1 item being crafted, the Blender requires 1 more ticket to speed up. Except for Moon Charms and Gumdrops, for which each ticket serves for speeding up whole 10 items.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• There is a Star Jelly token on top of the lid of the Blender. It can be obtained by repeatedly jumping on the handle with enough Jump Power or by standing on the gate to the Ace Badge section and gliding towards the top. Additionally, you may perform a difficult head-hitter to get it.
  • If you select to craft something but not actually ‘blend’ it, when you leave the blender and open it up again, it would show that you would select the number of red extracts you want to craft, even if the amount displayed is above the amount you would be able to craft with your resources, though you won't be able to select the Confirm option.
  • During the start of the Beesmas 2022, players could make progress for "collect items" quests through blender refunds; however, this was soon fixed.
  • Crafting something that requires 2 or more strawberries will appear as [-n Strawberrys], being incorrectly spelt as the correct word should be strawberries.

Crafting something that requires enzymes will appear as [-n Enzymess], being incorrectly spelt with an extra s at the end. However, if you craft the enzymes themselves, the correct spelling will appear. * The message above the buttons while crafting appears differently if one has the Offline Voucher redeemed. If the player has the Offline Voucher redeemed, it will say: "You've redeemed the offline voucher! The blender will continue running for up to 24 hours while you are offline."

docs.title: Bloom Shaker
docs.text:
Bloom Shaker

"Grows Blooms in the field you're standing in. Catch their Petals for Honey and boosts."

COOLDOWN

3 minutes

CAP

100

A Bloom Shaker is an inventory item added in the 2025-12-25 update. When used, three blooms will grow in the field the item is used in. It has a 3-minute cooldown. The blooms that are summoned by the bloom shaker will last for a minute, the default for any blooms. The only current renewable source for Bloom Shakers are Riley Bee's and Bucko Bee's "Petals" quests.

  • Completing Riley Bee's "Petals" quest rewards 1 Bloom Shaker and other items.
  • Completing Dapper Bear's 16th quest rewards 1 Bloom Shaker and other items.
  • There is a Bloom Shaker token on top of the Dapper Bear's Shop.

docs.title: Bloom
docs.text:
Blooms are passive field-based entities that can spawn naturally on fields or be summoned using a Bloom Shaker. It first appeared in the 2025-12-25 update. They manifest as large flowers adorned with colored petals. The maximum amount of petals a bloom can contain scales with its level.

Collecting petals from blooms gives the respective petal's buff, and honey equal to half of its original HP. Petals will give at least guaranteed 50 honey when collected, even if the bloom's health is under 100 pollen.

When a bloom is first created, it has a 20-second timer and a set "base" petal colour, which will generally make up the majority of the bloom. Once the pollen requirements are met, the bloom will pop, scattering each petal on the bloom in a circular pattern. Once popped, another "child" bloom of higher level and identical base colour will spawn. After a minute after the original "parent" bloom had spawned, child blooms of that parent will no longer be spawned. When a bloom is created, it has a small chance to be "mutated", where one or more petals are a different colour to the base colour of the bloom. As level increases, the chance of a bloom being mutated increases. A parent bloom being mutated does not affect the chance of a child bloom also having a mutation.

Hitting blooms with a Petal Shuriken (either from Petal Wand or Petal Belt's ability) makes them spawn bonus petals. It also deals 20% of the remaining HP and 5% of the Bloom's max HP.

docs.title: Levels
docs.text: Blooms have multiple levels. Each time a bloom is defeated, it respawns at a higher level, similarly to how puffshrooms work.

docs.title: Petals per Level
docs.text:
A bloom has different amounts of petals depending on its level. The number of petals a bloom can have is capped at 11, at level 20 or above.

The formula below can be used to find the number of petals a bloom of any level below 20 will have. \(\lfloor (level\times 2)\div 5\rfloor +3\)

Level Range Petals 1–2 3 3–4 4 5–7 5 8–9 6 10–12 7 13–14 8 15–17 9 18–19 10 20+ 11

docs.title: Petals
docs.text:
Once the required amount of pollen is collected within the bloom's radius, it explodes, releasing multiple petals that scatter around in arranged in a ring around its position. Collecting these petals grants a stack of petal buff and honey, with the amount scaling based on the bloom's level and field it's on. Its petals are randomized but have altered chances depending on the field. However, the Hub Field's petals have nearly equal chances as each other.

Additionally, each petal provides a temporary boost corresponding to its color, working similarly to Jelly Bean boosts. These boosts can stack up to 100 times, with each individual stack lasting 10 seconds. Every stack grants at least +40% Unique Instant Conversion.

docs.title: Blue Cannon
docs.text:
The Blue Cannon is located on a rock platform between the Pine Tree Forest and the Rose Field, neighbouring the Royal Jelly Shop. It is available for use once the player has discovered 16 bee types. If used without certain buffs or items, such as the Parachute or Glider, it will usually shoot the player to the 1 row of flowers of the Clover Field closest to Brown Bear; however, it may occasionally undershoot the player to the Slingshot or between the Mushroom and the Dandelion Field. It has a 5-second cooldown period.

It can be used in unison with either the Parachute or Glider to collect the Royal Jelly token on top of the tallest dandelion in the Dandelion Field. Players who have acquired either the Parachute or Glider can also use the Blue Cannon to reach the Star Hall.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This is one of the four cannons in the game, which the other three cannons are Yellow Cannon, Red Cannon, and Gummy Cannon.
  • This is one of the three transportational cannons in the game, which the other two cannons are Yellow Cannon and Red Cannon.
  • The Blue Cannon has a cooldown of 5 seconds. While this is not normally possible to see during regular gameplay as the cannon launches the player too far to return in 5 seconds, the cooldown can be seen by using the Glider/Parachute glitch to stop all momentum as soon as the player exits the cannon.
  • This cooldown is shared by all the transportational cannons.

The Blue Clay Planter is a reusable planter that was added in the 2021-12-26 update. Alone, it grows in about 6 hours and stores around 3 million pollen. When harvested, it grants bonus Blue Extracts and Micro-Converters. It is purchasable in the Blue HQ.

docs.title: Growth, pollen and nectar
docs.text:
• Grows in 6 hours of playtime alone, and grows faster here: x1.25 in fields with blue flowers. A flower-colour bonus is weighted by how much of the field is that colour.
  • Glitter used in its field speeds it up: x1.5 for one, rising in halving steps up to x2 at 6 stacks. The stacks stay on the planter until it is harvested.
  • Holds 3,000,000 pollen at full growth. A harvest gives capacity × growth × pollen bonus. Pollen bonus: x1.25 in fields with blue flowers, x0.75 in fields with red flowers.
  • Nectar multipliers: x1.2 Refreshing, x1.2 Comforting. On harvest it gives one Nectar type from its field, lasting grow time × growth × multiplier × 3 seconds.
  • Up to 3 bees can sip from it at once. Blue bees are x1.25 as likely to sip from it; Red bees never sip from it.

Note: The shop text says +50% Blue pollen, but the game gives x1.25 Blue and x0.75 Red pollen.

docs.title: Puffshrooms
docs.text:
When it reaches 95% growth, it has a 17% chance to smoke and spawn 3 Puffshrooms (one at the planter and two nearby) at levels 4 to 5.

Rarity odds:

  • Common 75%
  • Rare 19%
  • Epic 5.9%
  • Legendary 0.1%

docs.title: Drops
docs.text: A full harvest gives 16 item tokens. Harvesting early gives fewer, in proportion to growth, but always at least 1. Tokens are filled in this order: guaranteed items (full harvests only), then field rules, then random picks from the pool below.

docs.title: Guaranteed
docs.text:
On every full harvest:

  • 1 Blue Extract
  • 1 Micro-Converter
  • 3 Honeysuckle
  • 1 Ticket

docs.title: Field rules
docs.text:
• In the Spider Field: +10 to 15 Micro-Converters (any growth).
  • Blue Flower Field or Rose Field: +5 Honeysuckles. Sunflower Field: +10 Honeysuckles.
  • Mountain Top Field: Cool Backpack sticker, 1% when full (0.2% when not).
  • A full harvest in a blue field (Blue Flower, Bamboo, Pine Tree) followed by one in a red field (Mushroom, Strawberry, Rose, Pepper): 1 Purple Potion.
  • Full in the Spider Field: 1 Swirled Wax (every 30 days). Clover Field: 1 Caustic Wax (every 30 days).

docs.text:

The Blue Extract Dispenser is a dispenser added in Re://:Swarm. It is located in the Blue HQ near Bucko Bee, right next to the Blueberry Dispenser. When used, it grants the player Blue Extracts, honey, blue boost x10 and haste x5.

It has a cooldown of 8 hours and has no requirements, so any player can use it.

docs.title: Honey and Blue Extract reward amounts
docs.text:
The amount of honey and Blue Extracts given is based on the number of Blue bees the player has in their hive. More specifically, let cnt be the number of Blue bees in the player's hive:

  • The amount of Blue Extracts the player receives is equal to 10 + cnt, so it always gives at least 10.
  • The amount of honey the player receives is equal to (10 + cnt)1.5 rounded to the nearest whole number, times 200, or 500 if the result is less than 500.

docs.title: Blue Extract
docs.text:
Blue Extract

"Grants x1.25 Blue Pollen for 10 minutes."

COOLDOWN

10 minutes

The Blue Extract is an inventory item added in the 2018-11-25 update. The purpose of it is to use it as material to craft equipment and accessories, or for a 10-minute boost that grants x1.25 Blue Pollen. The buff cannot stack, and will only reset its timer if the player used a Blue Extract when the effect is already active. Using a Purple Potion or Super Smoothie will override the buff.

A blue extract token.

docs.title: Ways to Obtain
docs.text:
• Using the Blue Extract Dispenser in the Blue HQ, which gives 10 plus one for each Blue bee in the hive every 8 hours.
  • Crafting it via Blender for:
  • 50 Blueberries
  • 10 Royal Jellies
  • Matching a pair of blue extracts in Mega Memory Match (worth 1 blue extract) or Extreme Memory Match (worth 3 blue extracts).
  • As a reward from the Wind Shrine.
  • Purchasing bundles from Bee Bear's Catalog:
  • The Super Snowman Bundle gives 25 blue extracts + other items.
  • The Snow Queen Bundle gives 25 blue extracts + other items.
  • As a stack reward for adding certain Stickers to the Sticker Stack:
  • Flying Ninja Bee Sticker rewards 1 blue extract.
  • Blob Bumble Bee Sticker rewards 1 blue extract.
  • Menacing Mantis Sticker rewards 1 blue extract.
  • Small Blue Chick Sticker rewards 1 blue extract.
  • Tadpole Sticker rewards 1 blue extract.
  • Cool Backpack Sticker rewards 1 blue extract.
  • Bubble Wand Sticker rewards 1 blue extract.
  • Tide Popper Sticker rewards 1 blue extract.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text:
• As a rare drop from rhino beetles and mantises.
  • As a common drop from King Beetle and Diamond Aphids.
  • Farming in the Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, Pine Tree Forest, or the Stump Field can rarely drop blue extracts.
  • A rare drop from leaves in the Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, Pine Tree Forest, or the Stump Field.
  • As a rare drop from sprouts (the odds increase depending on the rarity of the sprout and if the sprout is located on the blue fields).
  • As a drop from a Festive Gift (if Festive Bee is gifted) or Festive Mark.
  • As a rare gift from a cub buddy.
  • As a drop from the certain Planters:
  • The Blue Clay Planter, and Hydroponic Planter are guaranteed to drop blue extracts when harvested at 100% growth.
    • The Hydroponic Planter drops extra blue extracts in blue fields (the Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, Pine Tree Forest, and the Stump Field).
    • Planting the Hydroponic Planter in the Blue Flower Field, then the Bamboo Field, then the Pine Tree Forest, then the Stump Field results in an additional 100 Blue Extracts (36-day cooldown).
  • Planters harvested in blue fields may drop blue extracts.
  • As a drop from a Wind Shrine badge shiver.

docs.title: Quests
docs.text:
• Gifted Bucko Bee's quests will always reward at least one blue extract when completed.
  • Black Bear gives blue extracts on the following quests:
  • Walk Through The Woods gives 1 blue extract and other items.
  • Bamboo Boogie 2: Bamboo Boogaloo gives 1 blue extract and other items.
  • You Blue It gives 1 blue extract and other items.

docs.text:
Blue Field Booster Information Usage Boosting a random blue field for 15 minutes Requirement(s) Access to the Blue HQ Cooldown 45 minutes Location On the top floor of the Blue HQ, next to Gifted Bucko Bee

The Blue Field Booster is a machine that provides a field boost to a random blue field for 15 minutes. It is located on the second floor of the Blue HQ. In order to use it, the player has to have discovered at least 5 different blue bee types. It has a cooldown of 45 minutes.

  • In an update, Bamboo Field Boost was nerfed from 200% to 100% pollen.

docs.text:
Blue Flower Field

FIELD COLOR

Blue

BEE PREREQUISITES

None

NECTAR TYPE

Refreshing Nectar

43 × 17 flowers

731

BEE PREFERENCES

The Blue Flower Field is one of the five starting fields any player can visit upon starting the game. It is the first blue field accessible in the game. It is protected by a level 1 rhino beetle.

On the north-east side of the field, a glass-like panel can be seen in the wall, with a blue flower leading into it. Making contact with it will teleport the player inside King Beetle's Lair.

You can find the Blue HQ on the other side of the field.

This field can spawn honey, blueberry, neonberry, ticket, blue boost, blue extract, and magic bean tokens when collecting pollen.

Item Drops list Blueberries (12.5% Chance)

Blue Extracts (0.0133% Chance) Neonberries (0.0111% Chance) Magic Beans (0.002% Chance)

Bees that like the Blue Flower Field include Bumble Bee, Bubble Bee, Bucko Bee, Frosty Bee, Baby Bee, Diamond Bee, Ninja Bee, and Buoyant Bee. Bees that dislike the Blue Flower Field include Rage Bee, Bear Bee, and Festive Bee.

This field grants Refreshing Nectar when a planter is planted here.

This is a 17×43 field made up of 731 flowers. The flowers are blue and white, in sizes of single and double.

docs.title: Obtaining Boosts
docs.text:
• Using the Blue Field Booster may give a Blue Flower Field Boost. When it does, it will give +300% Blue Flower Field pollen for 15 minutes.
  • Using glitter will add 100% Blue Flower Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out.
  • Using field dice, smooth dice, and loaded dice may add +100% - 300% Blue Flower Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out.
  • Blue Flower Field Winds can be obtained through the Wind Shrine or codes. They have a base of +20% instant Blue Flower Field conversion and gives +5% instant Blue Flower Field conversion and +25% Blue Flower Field pollen for each stack. Blue Flower Field Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times.
  • It can be boosted by the King Beetle Amulet. If it has a Blue Flower Field Boost, it can boost the field by +1% to +100%.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This field is adjacent to the Blue HQ and King Beetle's Lair.
  • Sometimes, the giant Bubble Wand model on the Blue HQ gets a face and will blow bubbles towards this field, along with the Mushroom Field, Clover Field, and Dandelion Field, to produce sparkles.
  • In the early days of the game, the decorative flowers in this field used to face upwards. This was changed since rhino beetles would get stuck behind the flowers, unable to attack.
  • However, you can still see the decorative flowers facing upwards in the tutorial.
  • According to Spirit Bear, this field used to be the "Blueberry Field."
  • According to Onett, the reason why it isn't Blueberry Field is because the blueberry 3D texture he finds/makes are too close to being a "Blue ball".[1]

docs.title: Blue HQ
docs.text:
Blue HQ Location Behind the Blue Flower Field

The Blue HQ is a two-story base with many features. The entrance can be found at the far end of the Blue Flower Field, located in the Starter Zone. It has a Bucko Bee model above the entrance. To enter, the player must have discovered 4 different blue bee types. The Blue HQ is the blue counterpart to the Red HQ.

On the roof, there is an enlarged Bubble Wand. This wand occasionally grows a face and blows sparkles to nearby fields. This includes the Clover Field, Mushroom Field, Blue Flower Field, and the Dandelion Field.

docs.title: Interior
docs.text:
On the first floor, there are four different objects:

  • A Blue Teleporter that will teleport the player near the Ticket Tent and Red Cannon,
  • A set of blue items for sale, (See the 'Store' section below.)
  • The Blueberry Dispenser, which gives a varying amount Blueberries depending on the number of * blue bees the player has in their hive every 4 hours,
  • The Blue Extract Dispenser, which gives 10 Blue Extracts plus one for each blue bee every 8 hours,
  • The All-Time Top Blue Collectors leaderboard, which shows the top 100 players who have collected the most blue pollen.

On the second floor, there are more features:

  • A Royal Jelly token located near the front window.
  • A Blue Field Booster that gives a 15-minute duration field boost for either the Stump Field (1 stack, only when Stump Snail is on cooldown), Pine Tree Forest (1 stack), Bamboo Field (1 stack), or the Blue Flower Field (3 stacks), and has a 45-minute cooldown.
  • Gifted Bucko Bee, who will require a Translator for it to hand out quests,
  • The Top Bucko Bee Helpers leaderboard, which is located to the left of Gifted Bucko Bee and shows the top 100 players who have completed the most Bucko Bee quests,
  • The Daily Top Blue Collectors leaderboard, which is located to the right of Gifted Bucko Bee and shows the top 100 players who have collected the most blue pollen in a day.

docs.text: There's a store in the Blue HQ that sells nine items. To open the store, press E when near the store's items and not on the Blue Teleporter, Blueberry Dispenser, the Leaderboards, or the second floor.

docs.title: Blue Teleporter
docs.text:
The Blue Teleporter is a portal located inside the first floor of the Blue HQ. When activated, it will instantly teleport the player behind the Red Cannon and next to the Ticket Tent. The transportation is one-way; thus, the destination teleporter cannot be used to travel back into the Blue HQ.

To activate the Blue Teleporter, the player must walk onto the white teleport pad and press the "E" key on their keyboard if they are on PC or laptop. However, if they are on mobile, then they must walk onto the pad and tap on the button that appears at the top of the screen.

The destination of the Blue Teleporter.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Like its Red Counterpart, the Blue Teleporter used to have an animation where the rings would revolve in circles, but it can get bugged to the point where the rings will start to slow down until they completely stop.
  • There is a bug in which if you tap it multiple times in a very short timeframe, the number of times you go through the portal increases, even if you only go through it once.
  • The inner parts of the Blue Teleporter used to be a sphere, rather than a circle.

docs.title: Blueberry Dispenser
docs.text:
This piece of content contains information obtained through datamining.

Due to the nature of the information, details may be inaccurate or outdated.

Datamined information: The formula for the amount of Honey and Blueberries received based on the number of bees in the player's hive. The table was made using in-game tests. — February 26th, 2026

Blueberry Dispenser Information Usage Grants:

Blueberries Honey x10 Blue Boost Tokens x5 Haste

Requirement(s) Access to the Blue HQ Cooldown 4 hours Location Inside the Blue HQ. to the right

The Blueberry Dispenser is a Dispenser located on the first floor of the Blue HQ, next to the Blue Teleporter. When used, it grants the player honey, haste x5, blue boost x10, and 1 blueberry for each Blue bee in the player's hive.

It has a cooldown of 4 hours.

If the player does not have any blue bees in their hive, it will not grant any blueberries.

Unlike in Bee Swarm Simulator, the player does not need to be in the Bee Swarm Simulator Club to use this.

docs.title: Honey and Blueberry reward amounts
docs.text:
The amount of honey and blueberries given is based on the number of Blue bees the player has in their hive. More specifically, let cnt be the number of Blue bees in the player's hive:

  • The amount of honey the player receives is equal to \(\left\lfloor {cnt}^{1.5}+0.5\right\rfloor \times 200\), or 500 if the result is less than 500.
  • The amount of blueberries the player receives is equal to cnt.

Below is a table of the amount of honey a player receives, given the number of Blue bees they have.

docs.title: Blueberry
docs.text:
Blueberry

"Increases your bond with a bee by 25."

A Blueberry is a type of treat that can be fed to a bee to raise its bond by 25. However, when fed to a Bumble, Cool, Bubble, Frosty, Bucko, Diamond, Music, Tadpole, or Buoyant Bee, the amount of bond they gain is doubled. These bees also have a small chance of becoming gifted when fed blueberries, though this only happens with a 0.0125% (1 in 8,000) chance for Rare bees, 0.01% (1 in 10,000) chance for Epic bees, 0.0083% (1 in 12,000) chance for Common and Legendary bees, and 0.00417% (1 in 24,000) chance for Mythic bees per blueberry. Feeding a radioactive bee a blueberry has a 0.004% (1 in 25,000) to mutate a bee.

docs.title: Ways to Obtain
docs.text:
• From using the Blueberry Dispenser inside the Blue HQ. The player will get one blueberry per blue bee in their hive per use.
  • As a reward from the Ant Challenge.
  • Redeeming certain valid codes:
  • 1MLikes (Gives 1 blueberry + other stuff).
  • 15MMembers (Gives 15 blueberries + other stuff).
  • As a reward from memory matches.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text:
• Farming in the Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, Cactus Field, and the Pine Tree Forest.
  • Harvesting leaves in these fields may also yield blueberries.
  • As a drop from Rhino Beetles, Mantises, and King Beetle.
  • As a drop from a Festive Gift or Festive Mark.
  • As a gift from your Cub Buddy.
  • As a reward for completely growing any sprout except for Moon, Gummy, and Debug sprouts.
  • Planting a sprout in the Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, Pine Tree Forest, or Stump Field yields 6x more blueberries than other fields.
  • Harvesting sparkles (Higher chances in blue fields).
  • As a drop from Puffshrooms.
  • As a drop from planters in blue fields.
  • Non-blue fields that contain a significant portion of blue flowers can drop Blueberries (Clover Field, Cactus Field, Mountain Top Field).
  • When in blue fields, Paper Planter drops multiple Blueberry tokens in increments of 1, 3, 5, and 10.

docs.title: Quests
docs.text:
• Gifted Bucko Bee may reward the player blueberries as a special reward.
  • Spirit Bear gives blueberries on the following quest:
  • Out-Questing Questions gives 1 blueberry.
