docs.title: Bond
docs.text:
Bond is a mechanic that is equivalent to the leveling system found in many other games. When bees have a high enough bond with the player, they will level up, gaining the following boosts per level above 1:

  • +5% gather amount.
  • +10% conversion amount.
  • +5% energy.
  • +3% movespeed.

Bond can be checked at any time by clicking on the bee's hive slot and it will show the bee's bond and stats.

A bee will automatically gain bond when collecting pollen in a field. When collecting pollen, each bee type has different opinions of each field and either likes, is neutral toward, or dislikes any given field. If a bee has a sad emoticon over its head, it means that the bee does not like that field and will gain only minimal bond from collecting pollen in that field. If it has a happy emoticon instead, it likes the field and will gain extra bond. If it doesn't have an emoticon at all, it's neutral towards that field and will gain the usual amount of bond. Bees can be fed treats to increase the bee's bond by 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, or 1000 depending on the type of treat the bee is fed. If the player feeds a bee its favorite treat, it will gain double the amount of bond it would otherwise get, as well as having a very low chance to become gifted or mutated. Bond is also rewarded from defeating mobs and collecting a Puppy Love token from Puppy Bee.

The amount of bond a bee can get from treats can also be increased via the gifted Puppy Bee's ability, giving a 20% boost to all bond, and one of the Moon Amulet's abilities to increase bond by 10% from treats. The Reindeer antler beequip also gives a 3% boost to all bond when equipped on the Puppy Bee. Having these buffs combined will give the player a total of a 33% boost to all bond for their bees, the max the player can achieve within the game.

A bee's bond does not reset after a level up; however, the information window only shows the bond required for the next level, so it can appear as if the bond went down to zero. (This is why when feeding a bee a treat, the server message on the lower right of the screen and the chat will have a different number than the bee information window.) A bee's rarity does not affect how much bond it needs to level up. Both a Common and Mythic bee at level 1 would require 10 bonds to level up. Bond does not diminish when using Royal Jellies or replacing it with an egg.

Mobs also have levels, which affects whether a bee will hit, or miss its attack. If the bee has the same or a higher level than the mob, it is guaranteed to hit. If the bee is one level lower than the mob, it has a 50% chance to hit the mob. If the bee is two levels down, it only has a 25% chance to hit, and so on.

The formula to calculate the chance of hitting a mob is: \(1/[2^{(monsterlevel-beelevel)}]\)

The maximum level a bee can achieve is 25. It is generally difficult to reach levels above 20, but if a bee reaches the maximum level, the bee will still gain bond.

  • Temporary bees can still be leveled up.

  • Leveling a full hive of 50 bees from level 0 to level 25 would cost 500Qn Honey (500 quintillion) honey in treats.
  • With the maximum Bond from Treats currently possible (133%), this cost could be reduced to about 376Qn Honey (376 quintillion) honey in treats.

docs.title: Boost Market
docs.text:
Boost Market Location Past the Bear Gate on the right.

The Boost Market is a shop in the 30 Bee Zone. It is usable in Re://:Swarm.

Every 30 minutes, the shop allows the player to purchase a market boost at a certain price. The price depends on the number of people who have purchased that specific boost, much like in a real stock market. It costs both Tickets and Honey to purchase a boost. These boosts last for 30 minutes. Market boosts could also be obtained from certain codes, like RedMarket, or the ones used in the Ready Player Two event.

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

docs.title: Box-O-Frogs
docs.text:
Box-O-Frogs

"Summons 3 Frogs that last for 3 minutes."

COOLDOWN

60 seconds

CAP

15

Box-O-Frogs is an inventory item that was added in the Beesmas 2019 update. When used, three gifted frogs will be summoned in any field the player is currently standing in, which last for three minutes, that can collect tokens, produce bubbles around the field (if spawned in a field), and attack hostile mobs.

It can also be used outside of a field, but the frogs summoned will aimlessly hop, which then won't do anything unless one of the frogs is in the field. The frogs have infinite HP and cannot die.

  • Completing Black Bear's "Boss Battles" quest rewards 3 Boxes-O-Frogs and other items.
  • Adding the BBM From Below Sticker to the Sticker Stack rewards 1 Box-O-Frogs.
  • A low chance to drop from Onett's Lid Art.
  • A low chance to drop from Brown Bear's Stockings.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Brave Bee and Basic Bee are the only bees in the game that don't produce any ability tokens unless they are in their gifted form or have a beequip that grants an ability token.
  • The Brave Bee Gate has a large model of a Brave Bee on it.
  • Brave Bee is the strongest Rare bee in terms of attack, with a base attack power of 6.
  • The Brave Guard, which is purchased in the Pro Shop, has a special design, name, and stats dedicated to Brave Bee.
  • Brave Bee's body color scheme is a darker version of the Vector Bee's colour scheme.
  • Brave Bee is one of the 16 bees to have a sticker based on it.
  • During Bee Bear's "Ability Token Tidings" quest Bee Bear refers to Brave Bee and Basic Bee as "Poor little merely mortals bees".
  • Bee Bear also says they aren't magic because they can't create ability tokens.
  • Although it is non-functional, Brave Bee is the only bee in the game to have a coded disliked treat, being blueberries.

docs.title: Broken Drive
docs.text:
Broken Drive

"Looks like a poorly preserved computer part. Maybe someone can fix it..."

COOLDOWN

No cooldown

The Broken Drive is an inventory item that was introduced in the 2023-05-07 update. They can be used to activate Science Bear's quest to repair Robo Bear. After completing Science Bear's quest the Broken Drive will be replaced with a White Drive.

A Broken Drive can be found behind the Robo Pass Dispensers in the 30 Bee Zone, which is the only way to obtain one.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Broken Drive is the only type of drive that can't be used during the Robo Bear Challenge.
  • The Broken Drive is the only type of drive that can only be obtained once, as the others can be repeatedly earned through the Robo Bear Challenge and bought with Cogs.
  • This also means the Broken Drive is the only type of drive that cannot be used to craft a Glitched Drive or a Digital Bee.
  • Players do not need to fix the Broken Drive to unlock the Robo Bear Challenge if Robo Bear was previously repaired during Beesmas 2022.
  • This item and the Plastic Egg are the only items whose sole purpose is to complete a quest.

Brown Bear is a quest giver and one of eight permanent bears that can be accessed in the game, the others being Black Bear, Mother Bear, Panda Bear, Science Bear, Dapper Bear, Polar Bear, and Spirit Bear. He is located behind the Clover Field and next to the Wealth Clock and the Top Brown Bear Helpers leaderboard. His quests primarily focus on collecting pollen from randomized fields. After initiating a quest, a new one will be available in 1 hour.

docs.title: Quests
docs.text: Brown Bear is an infinite quest giver. His quests requires collecting pollen from a selection of fields, scaling up in difficulty the more the player completes, with the reward also getting bigger the more difficult it gets. Certain quests are only given if the player has reached a minimum number of bees.

docs.title: Scaling
docs.text:
The amount of quests the player has to collect from a field is defined by the function \(P(x)\), where \(x\) is a hard-coded number that is different for each quest. The value of \(P(x)\) scales with the number of Brown Bear quests the player has done.

The function \(P(x)\) is defined as follows:

  • \(cnt\) be the number of Brown Bear quests the player has done as of claiming the quest.
  • We define 3 variables:
  • \(base=\left\lfloor {\frac {2500\times x+0.5}{100}}\right\rfloor \times 100\)
  • \(inc=\left\lfloor {\frac {5000\times x+0.5}{100}}\right\rfloor \times 100\)
  • \(max=\left\lfloor {\frac {10000000000000\times x+0.5}{100}}\right\rfloor \times 100\)
  • Then, we take the following steps:
  • \(basePollen=base+cnt\times inc\)
  • \(scaling\) be equal to:
    • \({({\frac {cnt}{1000}})}^{4}\) if \({\frac {cnt}{1000}}<1\)
    • \({({\frac {cnt}{1000}})}^{2}\) otherwise
  • \(requiredPollen=basePollen+(max-basePollen)\times scaling\)
  • \(interval=10^{\max(\left\lfloor \log _{10}(requiredPollen)\right\rfloor -1,1)}\)
  • \(roundedPollen=\left\lfloor {\frac {requiredPollen}{interval}}+0.5\right\rfloor \times interval\)
  • The function returns \(roundedPollen\).

If you want to unlock Epic, Legendary, and even Mythic Bees, you'll need [Royal Jelly] for sure. I've got plenty to share, and not just [Royal Jelly]... After certain milestones, I'll give all sorts of cool rewards, including Gold, Diamond, and even Mythic [Eggs]! But those'll [sic] come way down the road. For now, let's keep it simple. Check out the quest I've put in your Quest Menu, and report back when you've collected all the pollen.

The quests required you to collect pollen from 1 field in a certain zone, with the pollen requirement changing depending on the number of bees in the player's hive, and the zone the field is in.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Before the 2020-04-19 Update, Brown Bear's quests only focused on a single Field and were scaled relative to the number of bees in the player's hive.
  • Prior to the 2018-09-10 update, Brown Bear gave a "daily" quest every 16 hours. However, after the 2018-09-10 update, it changed to 4 hours. After the 2020-04-19 update, he gave a quest every hour.
  • There is a Royal Jellies token on a hill behind Brown Bear. The player can reach it by having high Jump Power or by using the Parachute or Glider and glide down to it from the top of the Blue HQ roof.
  • He is one of the three permanent Bears that can be found in the Starter Zone, the others being Black Bear and Mother Bear.
  • Brown Bear, Polar Bear, and Black Bear are the only three bears with infinite quests.
  • Brown Bear is typically the first bear to start giving endless quests for new players. He is also one of the six quest givers that give repeating quests.
  • Brown Bear is the only bear that guarantees royal jelly and tickets for the completion of each quest.
  • Brown Bear uses the Knight Animation Package, the same as Sun Bear.
  • He, Black Bear, and Mother Bear were "Nice" in 2018, as stated by Bee Bear during the Beesmas 2018 Event.
  • If the player gave Brown Bear a Present during the Beesmas 2018 Event, he would give a star jelly and Clover Field Boost x4.
  • The Brown Cub rewarded for completing 300 of Brown Bear's quests is one of the six Cub Buddy skins.
  • Lipsisas was the first player to get a Brown Cub Buddy skin.
  • The Beesmas 2020 present dialogue is a merge of Beesmas 2018 and 2019.
  • Brown Bear is the only NPC that you can give presents to that could receive the same present twice.
  • Brown Bear is the only infinite quest bear whose quests scale in difficulty.
  • Excluding event quests, Black Bear & Brown Bear are the only bears that only require pollen to be collected.
  • If someone somehow gets the Brown Cub Buddy from Brown Bear without owning a Cub Buddy first, they will need to obtain the Black Cub as it only acts as "equipment" for the Cub Buddy.
  • Brown Bear is stated to have known Spirit Bear since he was a cub.
  • Brown Bear is also stated by Spirit Bear to be very reserved - meaning he does not let on much to others.
  • Brown Bear is one of the 3 Bears along with Robo Bear and Bee Bear to give out a cub buddy
  • Brown Bear visited the Wind Shrine as revealed by Spirit Bear. It is unknown what he was doing, but he was not donating.
  • Brown Bear is stated by Black Bear to spend most of his time near the Clover Field. Coincidentally, the same field that is above King Beetle’s Lair. Black Bear also states that it could have something to do with his Royal Jelly stockpile.

Bubble Bee Man Overview Species Roblox Catalog Hat Location Inside the 30 Bee Zone (Currently)

Behind the Global Top Battlers Leaderboard (Beesmas 2018- Beesmas 2019)

Bee Prerequisites 30 (Currently)

5 (Beesmas 2018-Beesmas 2019) bees

Bubble Bee Man is a temporary quest giver on the inner top of the Bear Gate (only accessible during nighttime due to the moon platforms, and also requiring a Moon Amulet to be owned). Bubble Bee Man is one of the four temporary quest givers, along with Sun Bear, Gummy Bear, and Bee Bear.

He has given out a Beesmas quest almost every year since 2018.

Note that all dialogue is written as-is, with all misspellings and grammar mistakes.

docs.title: BBM isn't sorry
docs.text:
After finishing all 15 other Beesmas 2025 quests, Bubble Bee Man gives the quest "BBM isn't sorry". It has 40 tasks, and its rewards are:

  • 67,676,676,676 Honey
  • 67 Box-O-Frogs
  • BBM's Blessing, a permanent buff: x2 Pollen, x100 Convert Rate at Hive, x20 Capacity, x50 Blue Pollen, x10 Pollen From Bubbles, x2.5 Goo, x10 Honey at Hive and +25% Instant Blue Conversion
  • 1 Custom Cub Skin

Completing the same 15 quests also lets you claim his separate Beesmas reward, which does not include the Blessing.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Bubble Bee Man originated from Mah_Bucket's fan-event called "Beesmas", which Re://:Swarm participated in.
  • Bubble Bee Man is the only NPC to own two different NPC pads for itself, the other being behind the Global Top Battlers Leaderboard near Panda Bear. However, it was removed during Beesmas 2019.
  • During Beesmas 2018, Bubble Bee Man also gave the player a quest after they obtained the first Beesmas Badge (Beesmas Believer) from Bee Bear.
  • Bubble Bee Man is the only NPC to have deliberate grammatical errors, typos and misspellings in their dialogue.
  • Bubble Bee Man is one of the two NPCs that rewards an Accessory as a reward for completing his quests, along with Sun Bear.
  • Bubble Bee Man is actually a Roblox Hat.
  • Strangely, as the Roblox hat, both the texture and the model have the name: Bubble Bee Man.
  • Bubble Bee Man is the only NPC whose dialogue contains references to other Roblox games.
  • Bubble Bee Man is one of the six Quest Givers that are not bears, along with Onett, Gifted Bucko Bee, Gifted Riley Bee, Honey Bee, and Stick Bug.
  • Bubble Bee Man is one of the three quest givers that require the player to defeat the Stump Snail, the others being Stick Bug and Onett.
  • In old servers, you can still see Bubble Bee Man giving his dialogue even if you did not complete his quest.
  • After the 2019-02-01 Update, there is a royal jelly token in front of Bubble Bee Man and an enzyme token on the other side of the platform where one of the present tokens was previously located.
  • Regarding the quests needed to get completed, including Bee Bear's quests, the five Gifted Riley Bee quests, the five Gifted Bucko Bee quests, and Science Bear's quests to get the translators for delivering the presents, you needed to complete at least 100 quests in total in order to complete Bubble Bee Man’s Beesmas 2018 quest (B.B.M. Mission).
  • During Beesmas 2018, if the player tried to talk to Bubble Bee Man before making a present with Bee Bear, he would say to come back later when they have made a present with Bee Bear, meaning they would need to earn the first Beesmas 2018 Badge (Beesmas Beeliever) before being able to start his quest.
  • Bubble Bee Man’s quest during Beesmas 2019 (B.B.M's Ornament) was originally planned to require the player to pop 3,333 Bubbles, but this got changed before the release of the quest since Onett thought it would be a "great meme."
  • He is the only quest giver that is solid.
  • When finishing his Beesmas 2020 quest, he says that you can use the Naughty List every 22 hours, but you can actually use it every 8 hours.
  • He is the NPC that gives the least and most amount of Honey when finishing a quest (14 and 40,023,627,477,283 respectively).
  • All of Bubble Bee Man's quests contain his initials B.B.M. or BBM.
  • During Beesmas 2020, Bubble Bee Man stayed a week after the end of the event so some people could finish his quest (Snowbears, snowflakes, and Festive Nymphs stayed too as they were part of his Quest).
  • Before they were removed, Bubble Bee Man was the only quest-giver to reward Evictions.
  • This NPC is commonly abbreviated as "BBM".
  • During Winter 2024, if you've claimed Bubble Bee Man's quest in a server on version 563+, but then joined a server which is on a version before 563, it will show only one requirement for B.B.M's Naughty List, that being "Make nf Honey." This, of course, is impossible to complete.
  • Bubble Bee Man's Beesmas quest dialogue tends to stay around after the end of its Beesmas event much longer than expected.

docs.text:
• Bubble Bee is the blue counterpart of Fire Bee.

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

docs.text:
• This, the Fire Mask, Honey Mask, Riley Guard and Bucko Guard all represent epic bees.
  • The Bubble Mask represents the Bubble Bee, having an ability similar to it.
  • Before the 2019-04-05 Update, the Bubble Mask's stats were:
  • +25% Bee Gather Pollen
  • +25% Instant Conversion
  • +30% Damage Reduction
  • +11% Bee Ability Rate
  • +115% Luck (Loot Luck)
  • +25% Blue Bomb Pollen
  • x1.15 Blue Pollen.
  • Before the 2019-09-28 Update, the Bubble Mask didn't have any Passive Ability. Other stats were also changed.
  • If the player owns the Bubble Mask, its passive is inherited by the Diamond Mask.

docs.title: Bubble
docs.text:
Bubbles are objects that can be produced by certain tools, abilities, or passive abilities. Bubbles have a percentage chance to be spawned by certain bees when gathering. Bubbles spawn on the flower that the bee gathered and last for 4 seconds. When popped, they collect 4 red, 6 white, and 8 blue pollen from 29 surrounding flowers (+15% per gifted blue bee type, +5% per bee level) and cause nearby flowers to grow back to full.

Bubbles can be generated by Bubble Bee, Tadpole Bee, frogs, the Bubble Wand, Bubble Mask and Diamond Mask's Bubble Bombs passive, and the Pop Star passive.

Bubbles can be popped by other players, petal shurikens, coconuts, tornadoes, Star Saw, Fuzz Bombs, the Dark Scythe's trail, Puppy Bee's Fetch and the Tide Popper's waves.

Popping bubbles helps to grow Pop Stars and will increase Bubble Bloat. The bigger the Pop Star grows, the more bubbles it will spawn.

If a player pops a bubble belonging to another player, the pollen collected by the bubble will be granted to the owner of the bubble. This also applies to Pop Star growth.

docs.title: Gathering Bubbles
docs.text:
The Gathering Bubbles passive gives a chance for a bee to spawn a bubble while gathering pollen from a field. Gathering Bubbles+ gives a higher chance for a bee to spawn a bubble.

There is a 25% chance (50% if gifted) for Bubble Bees' Gathering Bubbles passive to spawn a bubble while gathering, and a 65% (85% if gifted) chance for Tadpole Bees' Gathering Bubbles+ passive to spawn a bubble while gathering.

A Bead Lizard gives from +10% Gathering Bubbles chance to +12% Gathering Bubbles chance for an individual bee.

docs.title: Bubble Pollen
docs.text:
Bubble Pollen is the amount of pollen that bubbles can collect. The player can check how much bubble pollen they have in the system page.

Bubble Pollen can be increased by a few ways.

  • The Diamond Mask gives a x1.5 Bubble Pollen multiplier.
  • The Bubble Mask gives a 1.25x Bubble Pollen multiplier.
  • Gifted Bubble Bee gives a x1.25 Bubble Pollen multiplier.
  • Beequips:
  • A Bead Lizard can give +1% Bubble Pollen as a hive bonus from waxing.
  • A Bubble Light gives from +15% Bubble Pollen to +30% Bubble Pollen for an individual bee. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +60% Bubble Pollen.
  • A Bubble Light can give +1% Bubble Pollen as a hive bonus. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +11% Bubble Pollen.
  • A Camphor Lip Balm can give 15% Bubble pollen hive bonus. Using waxes can increase the amount up to 25% Bubble pollen.
  • Cog Amulets:
  • The Bronze Cog Amulet can give from +3% Bubble Pollen up to +5% Bubble Pollen.
  • The Silver Cog Amulet can give from +5% Bubble Pollen up to +6% Bubble Pollen.
  • The Gold Cog Amulet can give from +8% Bubble Pollen up to +9% Bubble Pollen.
  • The Diamond Cog Amulet can give extra Bubble Pollen.
  • The Supreme Cog Amulet can give from +15% Bubble Pollen up to +20% Bubble Pollen.
  • Robo Bear Challenge:
  • Epic Upgrades:
    • Pop-Up: This upgrade gives x2 Bubble Pollen.
    • RGB: This upgrade gives x1.25 Bubble Pollen.

docs.title: Improving Bubbles
docs.text: Aside from increasing the amount of pollen that bubbles can collect, the player can also improve bubbles a few other ways.

docs.title: Golden Bubbles
docs.text:
A Golden Bubble is a special variant of a bubble that can only occur when a golden balloon floats over a normal bubble or it can be summoned by a gifted frog.

When a golden bubble is popped, it collects +100% more pollen than a normal bubble per field boost stack, contributes 50% more time to Pop Star's bubble bloat than a normal bubble, has 100% Instant Conversion (unless going into a balloon), and has a 10% chance to spawn a honey token.

The only way to increase the Golden Bubble pollen besides Field Boost is with Camphor Lip Balm.

docs.title: Instant Bubble Conversion
docs.text: Instant Bubble Conversion is how much pollen collected by the bubbles is instantly converted. There are currently no ways to increase Instant Bubble Conversion.

docs.title: Bubble Duration
docs.text:
Bubble Duration affects how long bubbles last before they disappear. The base duration is 4 seconds and can be increased to 5 seconds. There is currently only one way to increase Bubble Duration. Note that bubbles spawned from Bubbles Bombs last 8 seconds (10 seconds if one has a Gifted Tadpole bee).

  • Gifted Tadpole bee grants +25% Bubble Duration

docs.title: Other Improvements
docs.text:
Certain upgrades from the Robo Bear Challenge can be used to improve bubbles.

  • Epic Upgrades:
  • Invert: This upgrade makes bubbles collect x4 pollen from red flowers.
  • Pop-Up: This upgrade gives x1.5 Bubble Lifespan.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The maximum Bubble Pollen a player can have at a time is 925%. This can be achieved by having the Diamond Mask (x2), a Bead Lizard (+1%), three Bubble Lights (+33%), a camphor lip balm (+25%), a Supreme Cog Amulet (+20%), Gifted Bubble Bee (x1.25), activating the Sticker Stack with certain stickers (+6%), Pop-Up upgrade (x2), RGB upgrade (x1.25).
  • Popping a bubble has a 1/1,000,000 chance to spawn a Tadpole sticker.
  • Bubbles are the counterpart of flames.

docs.title: Buffs & Debuffs
docs.text:
Buffs and Debuffs are one of the core gameplay mechanics. The player can obtain them from amulets, quest givers, items, ability tokens, codes, and different dispensers. Some buffs and debuffs are exclusive to one source, such as the Splinter Trap can only be obtained from the Stick Bug Challenge, while others can be obtained in different ways, such as blue boosts can be obtained from the Blueberry Dispenser, bees, and flowers.

All status effects can be found in the top margin of the screen, above the main menu. The effects are sorted from left to right, with newer effects appearing on the right. Hovering over the icon for a buff/debuff will give information on the stack amount, effect, and duration (if possible). On certain devices, icons for accessories can also be found here instead of next to the hotbar.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Puffshroom Blessing, Festive Nymph Blessing and Robo Party Blessing are currently broken and stop working after rejoining a server, even if it still displays above. A player has to refresh it after a rejoin to keep it applied.
  • Onett is aware of this bug and has attempted to fix it, being unsuccessful so far.[1]
  • The icon for the Frozen debuff is the asset of Ice Cube, a character from the animated web series Battle for Dream Island.
  • The 3YearParty code (now expired) used to reward unlimited gumdrops for an hour, but there was a glitch where if the player left and rejoined the game, the buff would disappear. Onett later removed the buff from the code.
  • The shortest buff is Coconut Haste Surge (2 seconds) while the longest is the Honeyday event, Launch Code Boost, and Galentine's Blessing (48 hours each).
  • Speaking to Onett during Beesmas would give the player the Honeyday Event buff, even without claiming the hive (if it hadn't been claimed yet).
  • The Splinter Trap icon is the same as the Haste+ icon, which is ironic since they have the opposite effect.
  • Receiving more stacks of Robo Bear Challenge is less detrimental. For example, in round 2, the debuff is x0.12 capacity, which is better than x0.1 in round 1.
  • Haste+ was originally planned as one of Ninja Bee's abilities, but was soon scrapped.[2]

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This bee, Digital Bee, Windy Bee, and Festive Bee are the only bees that can grant boosts to all the players on the server.
  • This bee, Commander Bee and Frosty Bee are the only 3 bees in the game that wear hats.
  • As such, the Buoyant Bee is the only hat-wearing bee that is not an Epic.
  • This is the only bee to not dislike any field.
  • Onett stated on Discord that the reason why Buoyant Bee has no disliked fields is that it's supposed to be a "happy" bee.
  • The Buoyant Bee and the Lion Bee have the most amount of finite energy.
  • The Buoyant Bee, Precise Bee, and Fuzzy Bee are the only Mythic bees to be added since the release of the original three Mythic bees.
  • The Buoyant Bee and the Precise Bee are the only two bees to have their own Robux pack in the same update.
  • The Buoyant Bee and Windy Bee are the only bees to be able to produce a White Boost token. Buoyant Bee, however, only produces it through Surprise Parties, meaning it has to be gifted in order to produce white boost tokens.
  • If you have a lot of Balloon Blessing, the bee will have the same attack as Lion Bee because of the Balloon Enthusiast passive.
  • If the player is not in a field when another player in the same server activates a Surprise Party, the subtitle for it will appear on the player's screen but won't summon any Golden Balloons.
  • Gifted Buoyant Bee's hat glows.
  • This bee's gifted form is similar to Bumble Bee's gifted appearance.
  • Additionally, both Buoyant Bee and Bumble Bee are the only bees to have gifted abilities that multiply a player's base capacity.
  • This bee used to be able to summon Blue Bomb+ tokens, but it was nerfed to Blue Bomb in the 2022-12-26 update.

The Cactus Field is a field located past the Honey Bee Gate and lies right beside the Pumpkin Patch. It is protected by the Werewolf.

This field can spawn honey, treat, strawberry, blueberry, ticket, magic bean, bitterberry, and stinger tokens when collecting pollen.

Bees that like the Cactus Field are Bomber Bee, Hasty Bee, Commander Bee, Demo Bee, and Vicious Bee. Bees that dislike the Cactus Field are Exhausted Bee, Baby Bee, Music Bee, Tadpole Bee, and Tabby Bee.

This field grants Invigorating Nectar when a planter is planted here.

A Level 4-7 Rogue Vicious Bee has a chance of spawning in this field.

This is a 33×18 field, containing 594 flowers. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of double and triple.

docs.title: Obtaining Boosts
docs.text:
• Using the Field Booster may give a Cactus Field Boost. When it does, it will give +100% Cactus Field pollen for 15 minutes.
  • Using glitter will add 100% Cactus Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out.

Using field dice, smooth dice, and loaded dice may add +100% - 300% Cactus Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't maxed out and is based on the type of dice used. * Cactus Field Winds can be obtained through the Wind Shrine or codes. They have a base of +20% instant Cactus Field conversion and give s+5% instant Cactus Field conversion and +15% Cactus Field pollen for each stack. Cactus Field Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times. * The Icicles Beequip can grant up to +10% Cactus Field pollen. * It can be boosted by the Shell Amulet. If it has a Cactus Field Boost, it can boost the field by +5% to +27% depending on the amulet rarity.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This is the only field where three types of treats can be found naturally in the same place.
  • This is the fourth-smallest field in the game, the smaller ones being the Pumpkin Patch, Strawberry Field, and the Stump Field.
  • It is possible to hide behind the cactus closest to the Pine Tree Forest so the werewolf cannot attack the player.
  • This is one of six fields where fireflies travel to, with the others being Bamboo Field, Pineapple Patch, Rose Field, Spider Field, and Strawberry Field.
  • This is one of three fields that is protected by the werewolf, the others being the Pumpkin Patch and the Pine Tree Forest.

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

docs.title: Candy Planter
docs.text:
Candy Planter "Grows in about 4hrs. Grants bonus Gumdrops, Jellybeans, and x1.2 Motivating Nectar." Stats Cost5M Honey5 Magic Beans30 Gumdrops3 Jelly Beans5 Soft Wax ReusableYes Inventory cap- Shop limit1 Grow time4 hours Grows fasterx1.25 in Pineapple Patch, x1.25 in Strawberry Field, x1.25 in Coconut Field Pollen bonusNone (not working in game) Nectarx1.2 Motivating Pollen capacity1,000,000 Item tokens14 Puffshroom chance14% Puffshroom level4 to 5 Guaranteed itemsNone

The Candy Planter is a reusable planter added in the 2021-12-26 update. Alone, it grows in about 4 hours and stores 1 million pollen. When harvested, it grants bonus Gumdrops and Jelly Beans. It can be purchased at the Dapper Bear's Shop.

docs.title: Growth, pollen and nectar
docs.text:
• Grows in 4 hours of playtime alone, and grows faster here: x1.25 in Pineapple Patch, x1.25 in Strawberry Field, x1.25 in Coconut Field. A flower-colour bonus is weighted by how much of the field is that colour.
  • Glitter used in its field speeds it up: x1.5 for one, rising in halving steps up to x2 at 6 stacks. The stacks stay on the planter until it is harvested.
  • Holds 1,000,000 pollen at full growth. A harvest gives capacity × growth × pollen bonus. It has no working pollen bonus (see the note below).
  • Nectar multipliers: x1.2 Motivating. On harvest it gives one Nectar type from its field, lasting grow time × growth × multiplier × 3 seconds.
  • Up to 3 bees can sip from it at once.

Note: The game data has a x1.1 pollen bonus for White, but it is stored as a field named "White" instead of a flower colour, so it never applies. The Candy Planter gives no pollen bonus in practice.

docs.title: Puffshrooms
docs.text:
When it reaches 95% growth, it has a 14% chance to smoke and spawn 3 Puffshrooms (one at the planter and two nearby) at levels 4 to 5.

Rarity odds:

  • Common 80%
  • Rare 15%
  • Epic 5%

docs.title: Drops
docs.text: A full harvest gives 14 item tokens. Harvesting early gives fewer, in proportion to growth, but always at least 1. Tokens are filled in this order: guaranteed items (full harvests only), then field rules, then random picks from the pool below.

docs.title: Field rules
docs.text:
• In the Blue Flower Field, Strawberry Field or Pineapple Patch: +5 Gumdrops (+10 if full).
  • Strawberry Field: Pink Cupcake sticker, 1% chance when full (0.3% when not).
  • Full in the Stump Field: 10 Glue on every 3rd full harvest in a row there, or a 6% chance otherwise; at most once every 7 days.
  • Full in the Cactus Field: 1 Swirled Wax, once every 30 days. Full in the Mountain Top Field: 1 Caustic Wax, once every 30 days.

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

docs.title: Capacity
docs.text: Capacity is a mechanic that shows how much pollen the player can store at a time. Capacity can be increased in a variety of ways including buffs, items, stickers, and amulets. Capacity can be increased by static amounts or by multipliers. Static increases can be shown simply through addition symbols (+) while multipliers can be shown through multiplication symbols (x) or percentages (%). The player's Capacity is displayed in the top-middle section, labelled as "Pollen" and also on the player's bag. The player can see how much their capacity is multiplied by looking for the Capacity Multiplier stat in the System Page.

docs.title: Bags
docs.text:
Each bag adds a static amount of Capacity for the player. These are typically the bulk of the static amount of Capacity that the player can hold at once.

docs.title: Caustic Wax
docs.text:
Caustic Wax

"A glowing hunk of beeswax. Has a 25% chance to GREATLY improve a Beequip - but a 75% chance to DESTROY it!"

Caustic Wax is an inventory item and a type of wax added in the 2021-12-26 update that can be used on a Beequip to boost its stats. Upon usage, it has a 25% chance of greatly improving the Beequip's stats; however, it has a 75% chance of permanently destroying the Beequip instead, destroying the Beequip and also wasting the Caustic Wax. Caustic Wax has Upgrade Value of 4.

It also can be used to craft a variety of different items, such as planters and tools.

When successfully applying Caustic Wax to a bee's Beequip, a message pops up saying: The Wax improved the Beequip!

If the wax fails to upgrade the Beequip, a message will pop up saying:

The Wax destroyed the Beequip...

Prior to the removal of Permanent Beequips, using a Caustic Wax on a Festive Wreath or Reindeer Antlers resulted in the following message:

Cannot use this wax on a Permanent Beequip

docs.title: Cave Monster
docs.text:
Cave Monster Location Inside Werewolf's Cave Respawns Every 30 minutes

Not to be confused with the Spider, which has a similar appearance.

The Cave Monster is a level 11 mob that spawns inside the Werewolf's Cave. They look identical to a spider, except that they lack eyes. Cave Monsters make eerie whispering noises when the player gets close to them. A Honeystorm and a Mythic Meteor Shower (and during the Beesmas events, a Snow Storm) can make it bright enough to see their bodies.

Their primary purpose is to guard a Gold Egg located at the end of the cave. The best way to reach it is to have Haste+, Haste x5 or higher, or by using the glider. Be aware that the roof of the cave is not very high, so it is easy to hit your head and slow you down.

It is possible to defeat the cave monster. However, they move very fast, so some slower bees will be unable to reach them. The best way to defeat them is by activating the Emergency Coconut Shield and running quickly toward the gold egg token. Cave Monsters are the only mobs to (albeit rarely) drop a Honey Bee Egg. If the player does not have the Coconut Canister, another method is to quickly move into and then out of their spawning zone. You can also use the Star Saw passive ability from the Supreme Star Amulet or Festive Bee's Beesmas Cheer ability. It takes 30 minutes for one to respawn and they don't count as spiders towards quests from bears.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text: • Honey Bee Egg (somewhat rare)

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Onett had stated that cave monsters have a rare drop and can only be obtained by defeating them, but he also said that the drop is not very useful. This was later confirmed to be a Honey Bee egg. Onett had also jokingly said that "Saving the honey bee from the cave monsters was the ultimate goal of Re://:Swarm."[1]
  • Their noises can be heard throughout the entire map, along with Mondo Chick, Commando Chick, and a few other things.
  • Cave monsters were the first mobs that are able to instantly kill the player and one of two mobs that instantly kill the player upon touching them (the other being Tunnel Bear).
  • This makes the cave monsters the most lethal non-boss mob in the game.
  • Cave monsters have the second highest base level of any mob in-game, with the Coconut Crab having the highest.
  • Cave monsters, King Beetle, Tunnel Bear, Rogue Vicious Bee, Stick Bug, RBC mobs, Wild Windy Bee, aphids and Commando Chick are the mobs who don't belong to any particular fields.
  • There used to be 4 cave monsters because the gold egg was once the rarest item in the game.
  • Cave monsters have one of the fewest possible amounts of drops in the game, only behind ants, and RBC mobs, which have none.
  • Cave monsters, Coconut Crab, RBC Mobs, Snowbear, and ants are the only mobs that don't drop honey upon death.
  • Cave monsters are currently the only mobs with a set respawn time that quest givers do not require the player to defeat.
  • Cave monsters are the only defeatable mobs that do not have a health bar.
  • Between the 2018-11-25 and the 2018-12-25 updates, the Cave Monsters had a health bar that revealed they were level 11 and had 400 health.
  • When donating the Honey Bee Egg to the Wind Shrine, there is a decent chance it will spawn Bean Bugs. This makes killing the Cave Monster somewhat useful as some quests require collecting tokens from Bean Bugs.

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

docs.title: Chicks
docs.text:
Chicks are mobs that were added as part of the Egg Hunt 2020 event. They could spawn in a variety of places depending on their type, and have a special ability to hide inside their eggshells, increasing their defense and the chance for a bee's attacks to be blocked.

There are five different types of chicks: Chicks, Hostage Chicks, Spotted Chicks, Commando Chicks, and Mondo Chicks. Chicks, Spotted Chicks and Hostage Chicks cannot deal damage to players while the Commando Chick and Mondo Chick can. When a chick loses all of its health points, it gets captured, and the game will notify the player in the chat. Chicks, Hostage Chicks, and Spotted Chicks were removed from the game at the end of Egg Hunt 2020.

docs.title: ChickChick
docs.text:
This was removed from the game.

Location Sunflower Field Respawns Every 30 seconds

Normal Chicks were passive mobs that could have appeared in the Sunflower Field and would spawn randomly when players were collecting pollen. The chicks could've spawned with a level range of 1–15. They could only spawn if the player had Black Bear's Sunflower Corral Quest active.

docs.title: Hostage ChickHostage Chick
docs.text:
This was removed from the game.

Location Mob drops Respawns Every 30 seconds

The Hostage Chicks were passive mobs that had a chance of spawning after defeating a hostile mob or a Boss (Defeating ants or other chicks would not spawn a hostage chick). They could spawn with a level range of 1-15 and would always despawn 30 seconds after spawning. Mobs that are more difficult to defeat, such as Tunnel Bear, were more likely to cause a hostage chick to spawn. Hostage chicks that spawn from more difficult mobs will have higher health, level, and better rewards than ones that spawn from easier mobs.

Location Shops Respawns Every 30 seconds

The Spotted Chicks were passive mobs that could appear inside of the Noob Shop, Pro Shop, Ticket Tent, and the Blue Maze. Spotted chicks could spawn with a level range of 3–9.

Capturing a spotted chick would cause another spotted chick to spawn in a different location. If a spotted chick was captured in the Noob Shop, another spotted chick would spawn in the Ticket Tent, and vice versa. Similarly, if a spotted chick was captured in the Pro Shop, another spotted chick will spawn in the Blue Maze, and vice versa.

docs.title: Commando ChickCommando Chick
docs.text:
Main article: Commando Chick

Location Commando Chick's Hideout Respawns Every 30:00 (25:30 with Gifted Vicious Bee)

The Commando Chick is a mini-boss that spawns in its hideout. Its hideout is located to the left of Brown Bear and the Wealth Clock. To cut the vines, the Clippers, Scissors, Scythe, or Dark Scythe needs to be equipped. Once the vines are cut, they will never grow back.

The Commando Chick has a respawn time of 30:00 (25:30 with Gifted Vicious Bee). When Commando Chick hides in its egg, it throws grenades (1 if it has more than 2/3 of its health, 2 if it has less than 2/3 of its health, 3 if it has less than 1/3 of its health, 4 if less than 1/100). The egg cracks after a few seconds, also causing it to stop moving for a few seconds.

The Commando Chick deals 20 damage when colliding with the player and 50 damage if the player is near a grenade when it explodes. Starting at 150 health and level 3, the chick increases in health and level with each successive capture, reaching level 6 by the fifth capture. The chick will grow another level after a progressively higher number of captures per level up.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text:
Main article: Commando Chick drops

  • Honey From Tokens will increase the honey output of each capture.
  • Loot Luck will not impact any drops from Commando Chick.
  • Many drops will always occur after a certain number of Commando Chick captures.
  • Drops Mythic Egg upon the 50th capture.
  • Drops Star Treat upon the 100th capture.
  • After 200 captures, Commando Chick drops a Commander Bee Egg.
  • For a full list of known drops, see Commando Chick drops.

docs.title: Mondo ChickMondo Chick
docs.text:
Main article: Mondo Chick

Location Mountain Top Field Respawns Every 45 minutes - 1 hour

The Mondo Chick is a level 8 boss mob located in the Mountain Top Field. It respawns every hour at the full hour (1:00, 2:00, 3:00, etc.; not in time zones that are a fractional number of hours away from UTC), and its respawn timer can be found on the side of the Mountain Top Shop. The respawn time is unaffected by the Monster Respawn Time stat. Its rewards are shareable between players.

The Mondo Chick will always spawn at level 8 with 300,000 health. It automatically takes 333 damage each second, causing its health to reach 300 after 15 minutes. If it isn't defeated within 15 minutes of spawning, it will despawn in a similar fashion of the Commando Chick. After despawning, a server-wide message will say "🐣Mondo Chick got away!🐣" Like the Coconut Crab, the faster the Mondo Chick is defeated, the better the rewards will be. Due to its large hitbox and damage, it is recommended to put distance between the player and the Mondo Chick.

Sometimes, the Mondo Chick will hide in its egg, allowing it to block some attacks. However, when it is hiding, it stops moving until it comes out again. The egg can be cracked early by dealing 7500 damage to it.

When it runs out of time, it will jump out of the field towards the Lion Bee Gate entrance.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• According to Sun Bear, the chicks are invasive to the Mountain. Their eggs are also considered exotic.
  • According to Mother Bear, the Spotted Chicks dislike the sun.
  • According to Black Bear, Bees don't hurt chicks when attacking. They work together to calm them down and capture them as they are "frightened".
  • Although other player's Commando Chicks can't damage the player directly, their grenades can. A player's bees can also damage other players' Commando Chicks.
  • Interestingly, the Commando Chick is considered a mini-boss although every player has their “own” Commando Chick.
  • The Mondo Chick's noise can be heard throughout the entire map.
  • This is also the case with the Cave Monsters.
  • The Mondo Chick is the only mob that has a fixed spawn point in the Mountain Top Field.
  • The Spotted Chick is the only mob in the game that spawned in shops.
  • During the soft launch of the Egg Hunt 2020 update, the Mondo Chick only had 250,000 health. It was later changed to 300,000 the following day.
  • It is possible for a Rogue Vicious Bee to spawn in the Mountain Top Field and assist in killing the Mondo Chick, as its spikes can deal damage to mobs.
  • If the player already has the Mondo Chick Blessing buff and defeats another Mondo Chick, the new blessing will override the old buff, resetting its timer and possibly degrading or upgrading the buff depending on the time took to defeat the Mondo Chick.
  • Mondo Chick, Stick Nymphs and Festive Nymphs are the only mobs in the game that take passive damage, meaning it takes damage without any players, mobs, or any other entities actively attacking it.
  • Onett has said on discord that he dislikes Mondo Chick "on a personal level".
  • Based on one of Onett's discord messages, the Hostage Chicks may have been cooked for the 2020 Beesmas Feast.
  • If a bee lands a critical hit on a chick that is hiding inside its egg, it will ignore the damage reduction and do the normal amount of critical damage.
  • If the Mondo Chick falls out of the Mountain Top field and into another field, when defeated, the rewards will spawn in that field it was defeated in. However, if it dies outside of a field, their drops will form in a ring.
  • As of the Beesmas 2020 update, the Mondo Chick no longer drops Marshmallow Bees.
  • There was a glitch where Commando Chick would stay in its egg and would not go out of its egg, even when it is moving. This can also make some player's bees keep on missing their shots. The easiest way to fix this glitch was to exit Commando Chick's Hideout and re-enter it.
  • Chicks, Ants, Aphids, Stick Nymphs, Mechsquitos, Cogmowers and Cogturrets are the only mobs that come in different varieties.
  • Commando Chick is the only chick with red eyes; all other chicks have black eyes.

docs.title: Cloud Vial
docs.text:
Cloud Vial

"Summons a Cloud in the field you're standing in. Lasts for 3 minutes."

COOLDOWN

1 second

CAP

10

The Cloud Vial is a consumable inventory item that was added in the 2019-09-28 update. Once used, it will spawn a cloud in the field you are standing in.

The player can have a maximum of 10 in their inventory at a time. Obtaining more than 10 will not be added into the inventory unless obtained from a quest, Sticker Stack reward, or Ornament Presents.

The summoned cloud will move around the field. It grants a 25% (50% with Gifted Windy Bee) pollen boost if the player is under it, while causing flowers under the cloud and sprouts in the field to grow faster. If there is a sprout in the field, the clouds will help the sprout grow by connecting to the sprout with a straight blue line. The growing speed applied to the sprout increases with the pollen amount required for the sprout. Using it on a field with a planter causes the planter to grow 8% faster per cloud, capping at 20%. Each field has a limit of clouds, with bigger and higher-tier fields having a higher limit. If the limit for clouds has reached, using anymore clouds will result in the following message: There are too many clouds in this field. Windy Bee's Rain Cloud ability will ignore this field and will not further summon anymore clouds into the field.

It can't be used in the Ant Field, attempting to do so will result in the following message: You can't make clouds in a challenge field.

It also can't be used in the Hub Field, attempting to do so will result in the message: You can't make clouds in the Hub Field.

Donating a Cloud Vial to the Wind Shrine after having donated a Spirit Petal will give the player a chance to obtain a Windy Bee Egg if they do not already own a Windy Bee.

docs.title: Cloud
docs.text:
Clouds are small, white rain clouds that can be summoned through various methods (listed below). They move around the field aimlessly over a 1-5 minute time span, depending on the source of the cloud, raining over 49 surrounding flowers and functioning as secondary sprinklers. Clouds can also help grow a sprout if there is a player in the same field although the pollen given to the sprout depends on the type of sprout and the field. If a player is under a cloud, they will receive the Cloud Boost buff which gives +25% pollen and +10% Unique Instant Conversion (+50% Pollen and +20% Unique Instant Conversion if the player has a Gifted Windy Bee) and lasts for up to 8 seconds. Clouds can also accelerate a planter by up to 20% with 6 clouds (around 8% with 1 cloud), however keeping a cloud in a field for hours is expensive making this method not viable for buffing planters.

There can only be a maximum of 6 clouds on a field at a time. If the player attempts to use a cloud vial to summon another cloud, a message will pop up saying: There are too many clouds in this field.

Clouds cannot be summoned in the Ant Field. Attempting to do so will result in the following message: You can't make clouds in a challenge field.

docs.title: Methods To Summon
docs.text:
• Using a cloud vial (3 minute duration).
  • Receiving field winds from the Wind Shrine (5 minute duration).
  • Activating/Defeating Wild Windy Bee (3 minute duration).
  • Summoned by a player's Windy Bee (1 min duration + 10 sec per level of Windy Bee)

docs.title: Types
docs.text:
There are two different types of clouds: The Rain Cloud and the Windy Cloud.

Rain Cloud: The rain clouds are the ones that are summoned through donations to the Wind Shrine, by using a cloud vial and while fighting Wild Windy Bee. They are beneficial to players and give the cloud buff, grow sprouts, and regenerate flowers. These clouds are also spawned by tamed Windy Bees.

Windy Cloud: The Windy Cloud is a cloud that is only seen when a Wild Windy Bee has appeared. The cloud floats over a field and contains Wild Windy Bee inside it. Once a player approaches it and jumps up into the cloud, it will become a rain cloud and Wild Windy Bee starts to attack. Like rain clouds, it is still able to give the cloud buff, grow sprouts, and regenerate flowers.

Collecting a Cloud token will give the player the message: 🌧️ Windy Bee summoned a Cloud in {Field Name}. 🌧️ If another player's Windy Bee spawns a cloud in your field, a message will appear announcing: 🌧️ {Username}'s Windy Bee summoned a Cloud in this field. 🌧️

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Rain from the Clover Field is visible in King Beetle's Lair, rain from the Mountain Top Field is visible in the Werewolf's Cave and rain from the Pepper Patch is visible in the Petal Shop.
  • Clouds have a faint sound of raindrops.

The Clover Field is one of the five starting fields any player is able to visit upon starting the game. It is protected by a Ladybug and a Rhino Beetle.

docs.title: Events
docs.text:
• A Puffshroom may naturally spawn here between the 15th minute (xx:15) and 45th minute (xx:45) of the hour.
  • A level 1-3 Rogue Vicious Bee may spawn here.
  • An active Wild Windy Bee may move to this field.
  • During a Stick Bug Challenge, if Stick Bug is in Sunflower Field or Bamboo Field, he will move to this field.

This field is a 26x29 field, containing 754 flowers. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of single and double.

This field can spawn treat, red boost, blue boost, ticket, magic bean, royal jelly, gold or diamond egg and star jelly tokens when collecting pollen.

Bees that like the Clover Field are Basic Bee, Cobalt Bee, Crimson Bee, Brave Bee, Looker Bee, Stubborn Bee, Music Bee, Puppy Bee, and Tabby Bee. Bees that dislike the Clover Field are Lion Bee and Photon Bee.

Planters planted here produce Invigorating Nectar.

docs.title: Obtaining Boosts
docs.text:
• Using the Field Booster may give a Clover Field Boost. When it does, it will give +200% Clover Field pollen for 15 minutes.
  • Using glitter will add 100% Clover Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes, if it isn't already maxed out.
  • Using field dice, smooth dice, or loaded dice may add +100% (field dice) - 300% (loaded dice) Clover Field pollen for 15 minutes if the boost isn't maxed out yet.
  • Clover Field Winds can be obtained through the Wind Shrine or codes. They have a base of +20% instant Clover Field conversion and give +5% instant Clover Field conversion and +20% Clover Field pollen for each stack. All Field Winds (Including Clover Field Winds) can stack up to a total of 13 times.
  • It can be boosted by the King Beetle Amulet. If it has a Clover Field Boost, it can boost the field by +1% to +100%.
  • It can be boosted by the Shell Amulet. If it has a Clover Field Boost, it can boost the field by +5% to +30% depending on the amulet rarity.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The field booster for the Clover Field has been decreased three times. In the 2018-07-11 update, it was decreased from x5 to x4, in the 2019-04-05 update it was decreased to x3, and in the 2019-09-28 update, it was decreased to x2.
  • Before the 2018-07-11 update, the Clover Field had 39 rows instead of the current 26 so it had 1131 flowers, and it was the largest field in the game. It is no longer the largest field in the game, with only 5 less flowers than the new largest, the Pineapple Patch.
  • The Bubble Wand on top of the Blue HQ will sometimes blow sparkles on to this field, along with the Mushroom Field, Blue Flower Field and Dandelion Field.
  • The Honeystorm Summoner used to be where the Wealth Clock is currently, but when the Wealth Clock was added, the Honeystorm Pad was moved to right beside the bush in the Clover Field where the Rhino Beetle spawns.
  • The King Beetle Lair is right under this field.
  • This is the first field the player can encounter in the game that is defended by two mobs.
  • When a Rogue Vicious Bee spawns in the Clover Field, its spike can be seen in King Beetle's Lair, which can still be activated.
  • If a sprout is in the Clover Field, the stem and the light can be seen in King Beetle's Lair.
  • Clover Field has a higher chance than any other field of dropping royal jelly when a sprout pops.
  • This field also has a low chance of spawning a star jelly.
  • If the player has the Spark Staff, is in the King Beetle's Lair, and jumps, they are able to collect pollen from the Clover Field.
  • This is the only field that gives eggs.
  • This is the only starting field with roughly the same amount of Single and Double flowers, while the other 4 fields in the Starter Zone all have around 90% Single flowers, and the rest being Double.

Cobalt Bee is a Blue Event bee. It can be obtained by purchasing a Cobalt Bee Egg in the Ticket Tent for 250 Tickets.

Its abilities are enhanced when Crimson Bee is also in the hive.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a Star Treat, Gingerbread Bears or Aged Gingerbread Bears.

Cobalt Bee likes the Clover Field and the Pine Tree Forest. It dislikes the Pineapple Patch.

docs.text:

docs.text:
• +350,000 Capacity.
  • +75% Capacity.

  • +102% Loot Luck.
  • +100% Honey From Tokens.
  • x1.1 Coconut Field Pollen.

  • Every 30th boost token collected fires 30 Petal Shurikens around you. Every bee hit will instantly convert 10,000 (+6% of their Convert Amount, +4% per Field Boost stack) pollen into honey. It has a 30 second cooldown before another usage.
  • +Passive: Combo Coconuts.
  • Every 40th Coconut you drop onto a field (through items or abilities) becomes a Combo Coconut. When caught by any player. Combo Coconuts are kicked and fall again, onto your own field if caught on the first drop within the blue circle, or onto another players field. Every time they are kicked, they speed up, and gain stacks of Coconut Combo. Many more stacks are granted if caught by other players in fields with different colors. Catching the Coconut grants a buff that grants between 25% to 75% Unique Instant Conversion, between x1.2 to x2 Pollen, Red Pollen, Blue Pollen, White Pollen, Bee Attack, and Honey From Tokens. When the Coconut fails to be caught it despawns and reapplies the buff to all players who caught it at least once.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This, the Porcelain Port-O-Hive, the Red Port-O-Hive and the Blue Port-O-Hive are the only containers in the game that require materials other than honey to craft it.
  • If its items were to be crafted using the Blender, it would cost 25 billion Honey, 1750 Coconuts, 15000 Pineapples, 15000 Sunflower Seeds, 7500 Strawberries, 7500 Blueberries, and 9000 Royal Jellies to craft. It would also take 87.5 hours of Playtime to craft the Materials, or 1050 Tickets to speed up crafting.
  • When the Coconut Canister was first added, it was crafted with 150 Coconuts instead of 250 Coconuts, as this was the maximum amount you could hold at the time.
  • This is the only container that gives Passive Abilities.
  • This is one of the only two items in the game that gives 2 passives without having to buy another item. The other one is Gummy Boots, not including certain Supreme Star Amulets.
  • The red and blue "buttons" on each side of the canister repeatedly glow, alternating to represent the lights on ambulances. This was likely added to fit with the passive Emergency Coconut Shield, which also gives off a siren sound upon activation.
  • The buttons' flashing alternation is synced with every player who has the item equipped.
  • Note that the player must take damage directly from a mob to activate the Emergency Coconut Shield. For example, taking damage from the fire trail of Fire Ants, from the lawn mower or dying from an Obby does not activate this ability.
  • When the Emergency Coconut Shield is activated, it does not protect you from the 'Twigs' ability from Stick Bug.
  • There is a rare bug that makes it when the Emergency Coconut Shield is activated when you should've died, you will have a very small amount of health instead.

docs.title: Coconut Cave
docs.text:
The Coconut Cave is a cave located next to the Coconut Field. To access the cave, the player is required to defeat the Coconut Crab when it respawns out of the cave, If the player has not defeated the Coconut Crab yet and attempts to enter the cave (without actually standing in the field), they will be teleported back to the spawn place. There is also an invisible barrier on top of the Cave to prevent players from entering the cave when the Coconut Crab is not defeated yet, this is used to avoid lagging players from entering the cave without Coconut Crab being defeated.

The interior contains the Fastest Crab Slayers Leaderboard, the Coconut Dispenser, and a shop where the player can buy the Coconut Clogs, the Coconut Canister and the Coconut Belt.

docs.title: Coconut Crab
docs.text:
Coconut Crab Location Coconut Field Respawns Every 36 hours (1.5 days)

30.6 hours (1.275 days) (with Gifted Vicious Bee)

The Coconut Crab is a level 12 boss mob that defends the Coconut Field. It has 250,000 health and moves along the back wall of the Coconut Field. Like Tunnel Bear, chicks (besides the Commando Chick), Aphids, Wild Windy Bee and Puffshrooms, the player has a limited amount of time (two hours) to defeat it. After 2 hours, its health resets. The amount of time left can be found above its health.

Unlike the Stump Snail and the Commando Chick, its health will not save, meaning it must be defeated without leaving the field. If the player leaves, its health will reset, and it will go back inside the Coconut Cave. Once defeated, it will take 36 hours (1.5 days) or 30 hours and 36 minutes (1.275 days) if the player has a Gifted Vicious Bee to respawn.

The loot it drops is scattered around the field, similar to a Sprout's drops and the Mondo Chick's drops. However, only the player who has defeated their own Coconut Crab can see and pick up the tokens. A Token Link can also be used to pick up the tokens, along with the Windy Bee's Tornado, Vector Bee's Triangulate, or Precise Bee's Target Practice. The quality, quantity, and rarity of the items dropped vary depending on the time taken to defeat the Coconut Crab, similar to the Mondo Chick. But even if you kill it in a slow time the drops you get can still be rare.

docs.title: Attacks
docs.text:
The Coconut Crab alternates between two attack types:

  • Claw attack: The Coconut Crab will try and line itself up with the player, then proceed to jab quickly with its claws. Each hit deals 180 damage before Defense is applied. It will attack 7 times, then pause to move to where the player is standing and repeat it twice more, attempting to claw the player 21 times in total.
  • Coconut attack: The Coconut Crab will move to the middle of the back wall. It will then jump up a total of 8 times, each jump causing 1 large coconut to fall into the field. Each coconut deals 150 damage before defense is applied. The first coconut to fall will always target the player, but the others will randomly fall around the field.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text:
Note: Some of the quantity and the quality of rewards dropped depends on how fast it took to kill the crab.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• Avoid making contact with the Coconut Crab's hitbox, as doing so will deal a large amount of damage. If your defense is too low, it may be lethal.
  • The claw attack can be avoided by passing the Coconut Crab by walking or gliding as it moves closer. It will lock onto the player's position once the player is in front, wait for a moment, and jab its claws. If they continue moving, they will pass by the attack. Sometimes, the Crab may not stop in place and will continue to follow in the opposite direction. If this happens, it is often easiest to change direction and cross it once more.
  • Using the Glider and gliding around the claws can allow players to dodge all hits from the claws and may get 1 or 2 hits from them.
  • Do not stay in the middle of the field when the Coconut Crab's coconut attack is finished (unless the player has high movement speed), as the Crab will almost immediately begin its claw attack, resulting in massive damage.
  • Avoid stepping outside the field while fighting, as this will reset the Coconut Crab's heatlh.
  • Touching the walls of the Coconut Field can reset Coconut Crab's health occasionally.
  • Having too much jump power may cause the player to exit the field's range vertically, thereby causing Coconut Crab to reset its health.
  • It is possible to stand on the edge of the Coconut Field's walls and defeat the Coconut Crab from there due to a bug that allows players to. When the player jumps at the right time, they can avoid the falling coconut attack (right after its second jump hold space until the coconut falls on top).
  • Have bees that have a high attack and/or are specialized in attacking, such as Rage Bee, Spicy Bee, Lion Bee, Precise Bee and Vicious Bee will be necessary to quickly defeat the Coconut Crab.
  • Be sure to also have Music Bees and other bees who produce Focus tokens for Critical Chance/Power, as they will also play a major role.
  • Bees with the Token Link ability are recommended to collect tokens that are in high-risk areas.
  • Activating all 3 Targets or getting shot by Precise Bee's Target Practice will collect all tokens.
  • Own certain gifted bees:
  • The Gifted Looker Bee grants +25% Critical Power and Gifted Tabby Bee grants +50% Critical Power.
  • The Gifted Brave Bee grants +1 Bee Attack while the Gifted Rage Bee grants +10% Bee Attack.
  • The Gifted Commander Bee grants +3% Critical Chance.
  • The Gifted Precise Bee grants +3% Super-Crit Chance.
  • ALL gifted bees deal ×1.5 more damage.
  • Before fighting the Crab, collect Focus tokens first on the Pepper Patch. Once the player has a ×10 stack of focus, jump immediately to the Coconut Field.
  • Players can also collect a Melody token (if possible, without losing the focus stack) for more critical power, making the focus tokens much more effective.
  • If the player owns a Precise Bee, try and stack Precision to increase Super-Crit chance.
  • Stand behind the Coconut Tree farthest from the Coconut Cave and closest to Spirit Bear. The Crab gets stuck and cannot move. This gives the bees a better opportunity to defeat the Crab.
  • Level bees up to Level 12 or higher. Bees with a lower level than the mob will most likely miss when they attack. Bees with levels much lower than the level of the mob will have a higher chance of missing their attacks on the mob. Bees with an equal level or higher than the mob will never miss.
  • Using a Stinger gives a ×1.5 Bee Attack buff for 30 seconds.
  • If owned, using 3 stingers will activate Star Saw which will deal damage to the Coconut Crab and collect tokens that would be dangerous to collect otherwise.
  • Since the Coconut Crab has a large hitbox, using Coconuts has a good chance of hitting it and dealing large amounts of damage.
  • The Coconut Crab drops many coconuts, so the player will most likely get all of their used coconuts back.
    • If the player has coconut canister equipped, they could intentionally go up to coconut crab before he does his falling coconuts attack to deal heavy damage to him, though this is risky as you lose a ton of health and it only usually ends up with only 1 falling coconut, but it does trigger the 5 falling coconuts from coconut emergency.
  • Using Oil gives ×1.2 to both Player Movespeed and Bee Movespeed for 10 minutes, which helps bees attack faster and helps the player in avoiding the claw and coconut attacks.
  • Using a Tropical Drink gives +5% Critical Chance for 10 minutes, which increases critical chance.
  • The Demon Mask or Fire Mask are recommended to defeat bosses like Coconut Crab as their passives and bonuses allow the player to get higher attack damage.
  • If owned, try equipping Beekeeper's Boots, Coconut Clogs or Gummy Boots for an extra +1, +2 and +3 Bee Attack each respectively.
  • If the player only has the Gummy Mask equipped, they can still trigger Gummy Morph to temporarily increase their Gummy Bee's attack by using Gumdrops. The Gummy Mask also increases bee ability rate, which can be useful for defeating the Coconut Crab.
  • Green jelly beans give +3% critical chance for 1 minute. If the player can collect 3 green jelly beans, it will give a +5% critical chance total.
  • A player with the Coconut Canister equipped can intentionally activate the Emergency Coconut Shield which for 10 seconds, grants ×1.25 Bee Attack and 100% Defense and drops 5 falling coconuts onto the field.
  • Owning a Cub Buddy while fighting the Coconut Crab can be beneficial as they can collect tokens even in the Coconut Crab or in front of a Coconut Crab attack.
  • (Only during Beesmas Events) Using Onett's Lid Art, Gummy Beacon, Honeyday Candles, and Honey Wreath (after completing Honey Bee's Beesmas quest) grants extra bees to help the player defeat the Crab.
  • The timer is very lenient, even for a player who just got to the 35 Bee Zone. However, it would most likely be a tight timer if the player doesn't own the Vicious Bee.
  • Having Nectars like Invigorating Nectar grants x1.01 - 1.1 Bee Attack and Motivating Nectar for +1% - 5% Bee Ability Rate.
  • If the crab is lagging, try moving opposite the crab to the other side of the field. If it is doing its Coconut Attack, then move to the corner of the field to avoid getting hit by one. However, sometimes the coconut may hit the corner of the field, so the player must keep moving around until they find an empty space in the field.
  • Standing half-side in the field and half-side out can cause the crab to go left and right constantly and can't attack. Be aware that any more into the field can cause it to start attacking and any less will cause it to run back to the cave (i.e. despawning).
  • The Beesmas Cheer buff gives x2 Bee Movespeed, this benefits the player similarly to how Oil does.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Coconut Crab has the highest base level of any mob in the game, even surpassing Cave Monsters, which are level 11.
  • The Coconut Crab has the third-highest base health out of all mobs, right behind the Mondo Chick at 300,000 health, and the Stump Snail at 30 million health.
  • The Coconut Crab is the only boss mob that spawns in a cave (not including the Stump Snail as it is considered a mini-boss).
  • The Coconut Crab is the only mob to deal enough damage instantly kill the player upon getting hit by its falling coconut or touching it. Stick Bug is the only one to rival this with its flailing sticks attack at higher levels.
  • The Coconut Crab is based on the real-life equivalent "Birgus latro", more commonly known as the "Coconut Crab".
  • The Coconut Crab is one of the fastest mobs in the game, second to Stick Bug in the later levels of its Stick Bug Challenge.
  • The Coconut Crab is the largest mob in the game. The only thing to rival this mob would be a high-level Snowbear.
  • The Coconut Crab is similar to the Stump Snail in the sense that it stops the player from easily grinding in their guarded fields without defeating the "guardian" of the said fields.
  • The Coconut Crab is also the only mob that is protecting a shop. Defeating the Coconut Crab will allow the player to gain access to the Coconut Cave and will allow the player to farm in the Coconut Field with ease.
  • According to Spirit Bear, the Coconut Crab isn't native to the game. It's an invasive species, accidentally brought in when she imported coconuts from far away. It used to be very small, but with Spirit Bear's neglect to remove it, the Coconut Crab grew big and now defends the Coconut Field.
  • The sound that plays when a coconut from the Coconut Crab's coconut attack can be found here.
  • Once the Coconut Crab has been defeated, standing on top of the Coconut Cave will not cause the player to teleport back to spawn. The teleportation is to prevent players from cheating by defeating the Crab on that platform, so it does not teleport the player if it has been defeated as that removes the purpose.
  • If looked closely, two tiny green spheres can be spotted right in front of the Coconut Crab. The purpose of those spheres is to collide with Coconut Crab's claws to stop them from extending.
  • This, cave monsters, Robo Bear Challenge mobs and ants are the only mobs that don't drop Honey upon defeat.
  • The Coconut Crab is the only one of these to drop item loot.
  • Around the Beesmas 2022 update, if the player had beaten their record of how fast they had defeated the crab, their record would not have been recorded and would revert to their former best time before the update. This was the same case as Mondo Chick's.
  • This, Mondo Chick and Puffshrooms are the only mobs that scatter their loot on the field when defeated instead of a ring, being in the form of rings if it is outside the field.
  • Onett once accidentally put Coconut Crab's HP to 20.
  • If you jump out of the coconut field but quickly get back in it, the coconut crab's HP bar will be reset, but not its timer.
  • If Digital Bee stuns the Coconut Crab as it is dropping coconuts, it will immediately revert to the claw phase after the stun wears off.

docs.title: Coconut Dispenser
docs.text:
Coconut Dispenser Information Usage Obtaining Coconuts Requirement(s) Access to the Coconut Cave Cooldown 4 hours Location Inside the Coconut Cave, to the right

The Coconut Dispenser is a dispenser located on the right side of the Coconut Cave. The player will need to defeat the Coconut Crab to gain access to it, similar to the rest of the content in the Coconut Cave.

The dispenser has a cooldown of 4 hours. When used, the player will receive a certain number of coconuts, based on the quality of their Coconut Badge. They will also be granted a x1 Coconut Field Boost. This remains static, meaning the Coconut Badge will not affect the field boost multiplier.

Badge Tier Coconuts Junior 3 Cadet 5 Hotshot 7 Ace 10 Master 12 Grandmaster 15

There is a secret entrance that leads to a tunnel that can be entered by jumping on top of the dispenser and into a small portion of the wall. Inside the tunnel, there are 3 tokens that grant 5 tickets, 5 jelly beans, and 1 enzyme each.

docs.title: Coconut Field
docs.text:
Coconut Field

FIELD COLOR

White

BEE PREREQUISITES

35 bees

NECTAR TYPE

Refreshing Nectar

FIELD DIMENSIONS

30 × 21 flowers

FLOWER COUNT

630

BEE PREFERENCES

LIKE

DISLIKE

None

The Coconut Field is a field added in the September 28, 2019 update, located past the Windy Bee Gate and next to Spirit Bear. It is home to and protected by the Coconut Crab.

The field can spawn honey, treats, coconuts, tropical drinks, ticket and magic bean tokens when collecting pollen.

Bees that like the Coconut Field are Vector Bee, Buoyant Bee, Digital Bee, and Windy Bee. There are no bees that dislike the Coconut Field.

This field grants Refreshing Nectar when a planter is planted here.

A level 1-20 Wild Windy Bee has a chance to spawn in this field.

This is a 30x21 field, containing 630 flowers. The flowers are white, red, and blue, and the only natural size is triple.
