docs.title: Frog
docs.text:
Frog Location All Fields

Frogs are passive mobs added in the 2019-12-23 Update. They despawn after a set period of time (3 minutes if summoned by a Box-O-Frogs or 20 seconds (+2s per level) if summoned by a Tadpole Bee).

There are two types of frogs: normal frogs and gifted frogs. Normal frogs can be summoned by collecting a Summon Frog ability token generated by Tadpole Bee or by using a Box-O-Frogs, and the gifted variant can be summoned by a Box-O-Frogs or a Gifted Tadpole Bee with a 10% (+2% each level) chance of summoning it when collecting its Summon Frog ability token. Gifted frogs have a longer tongue range, faster token collection and attack, 50% more attack, a chance to summon Gold Bubbles while hopping, and can hit balloons with their tongue to convert pollen into honey tokens.

Neither players nor frogs can inflict harm on one another, nor can they be harmed by hostile entities.

docs.title: Abilities
docs.text:
• Upon summoning, frogs will hop around the field until they despawn, creating Bubbles on their 2nd, 3rd and 4th hop.
  • Frogs can collect Ability Tokens, Honey Tokens and other Tokens (such as rewards from Mobs) for the Player by using their Tongues, which can also create Bubbles.
  • Frogs can attack Hostile Mobs (dealing x5 the damage of the attack power of the Tadpole Bee that summoned them or dealing 7 damage) when summoned from a Box-O-Frogs. This attack ignores accuracy checks.[1]

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Frogs are the only mob in the game that can be summoned by an ability token. It is also the only passive mob that is passive to players, but hostile to harmful mobs.
  • Frogs, Cub Buddies, and Windy Bee (with its Tornado Ability) are the only entities that can collect tokens from flowers, leaves, and sprouts for the player.
  • Frogs, Rogue Vicious Bee, and Wild Windy Bee are the only mobs that can deal damage to other hostile mobs with attacks.
  • However, frogs are the only mob that will deliberately attack other mobs, as Rogue Vicious Bee and Wild Windy Bee will only "attack" other Mobs if they happen to be where they are going to Attack.
  • Collecting bubbles from frogs summoned by other players will currently grant pollen to both players and would also add to both players' quest requirements.
  • The frog and the Rogue Vicious Bee are the only mobs that can be spawned by using an item, with the items being the Box-O-Frogs and the Night Bell respectively.
  • Frogs can sometimes fall outside of the field they are in if it is at a high enough elevation. If this happens, they will hop around uselessly until they despawn.
  • At the end of Beesmas 2020, Onett spawned frogs under the name of the "Honeyday-Cleanup Frog Crew".
  • At the end of Beesmas 2021, Onett spawned frogs under the name of the "Frog Foundation".
  • Frogs are the only mobs capable of spawning bubbles.
  • The frog and Rogue Vicious Bee are the only mobs to have a gifted variant.
  • Frogs will only spawn facing towards the 30-Bee Zone, or away from the Hive.
  • Frogs are the only passive mobs that can be summoned by a Bee.

docs.text:
"Always gives a bee a Gathering Mutation."

The Gathering Atomic Treat is a treat that always gives a bee a Gather Amount mutation. It works like an Atomic Treat, but the mutation is always Gather Amount instead of a random one.

docs.title: Giant Ant
docs.text:
Giant Ant Location Ant Field while the Ant Challenge is active.

A Giant Ant is one of five mobs that is part of a family called ants that are exclusively found in the Ant Challenge, past the Ant Gate.

This is one of the last Ant Challenge mobs that the player will encounter, appearing every fifth wave.

Giant Ants are enormous versions of the normal ant that relentlessly pursue the player. They have a relatively slow movespeed. However, they have large amounts of health, more than any other type of ant, and high attack power, also more than any other type of ant, to compensate for their slow speed.

A Giant Ant's level can increase depending on what wave of the Ant Challenge the player is on. They can range from level 1 up to level 16.

Giant Ants are one of the most threatening of the five ant types, as they are have high amounts of health and chase the player nonstop.

docs.title: Strategies
docs.text:
• Due to the Giant Ant's high health, they can 'tank' hits from bees and allow the smaller, faster ants to attack the player with a much lower chance of being defeated. Their size makes them much harder to avoid. The player should bring bees with high attack such as Lion Bee to deal enough damage to defeat Giant Ants.
  • The player can also use a Stinger to help deal extra damage against the Giant Ant.
  • They always appear every fifth wave on a side of the map so the player can prepare for their arrival.
  • Vicious Bee's Impale can deal high amounts of damage to single targets which can help take away tons of health from Giant Ants. Windy Bee's Tornado can help chip away a Giant Ant's health and also take out other ants that are hiding behind the Giant Ant. Digital Bee can also stun Giant Ants and allow them to take extra damage via Mind Hack.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Giant Ants are the only ant to follow a spawn pattern where they appear every five waves (5th, 10th, 15th, etc.).
  • Every 40th wave has two Giant Ants spawn instead of one.
  • This is the only ant to have health in the thousands.

docs.title: Gifted Bee
docs.text:
Gifted bees are a special type of bee with improved stats (x1.5 more collection, convert rate, and attack) and a buff called a "Gifted Hive Bonus." It improves the performance of the player and/or their bees, similar to badges.

Every time the player uses a Royal Jelly or hatches an egg, they have a 0.4% (1 in 250) chance to get a gifted bee. Similarly, feeding a bee its favorite treat has a chance for it to turn gifted, though this only happens with a 0.0125% (1 in 8,000) chance for Rare bees, 0.01% (1 in 10,000) chance for Epic bees, 0.0083% (1 in 12,000) chance for Common and Legendary bees, and 0.00417% (1 in 24,000) chance for Mythic bees per favorite treat. Feeding a bee a Gingerbread Bear also has a 1% (1/100) chance of turning it into its gifted version. Feeding a bee an Aged Gingerbread Bear has a 1.1% (~1/91) chance of turning it into its gifted version.

Star Treats will always turn the chosen bee into its gifted version. This is the only method that can turn Event bees like Bear Bee and Tabby Bee into a gifted bee (excluding gingerbread bears). If the player feeds a Star Treat to an already gifted bee, the bee will only gain the bond and no extra benefits. Star Egg will always hatch into a non-event gifted bee that is not already found in the hive unless the player already has all non-Event bees in their gifted forms, in which case it hatches into a random non-Event gifted bee instead. Star Jelly will always turn the chosen bee into a random non-Event gifted bee, using the same odds as a royal jelly (except for a Gifted Basic Bee).

A gifted bee's UI upon obtaining will cycle through colors, with text saying, "⭐ Your [type] Bee Transformed Into A Gifted [type] Bee!⭐" and a sound plays.

On top of the Noob Shop, there is a chamber called the Star Hall. There, the player can generate Star Amulets and claim royal jellies depending on the number of gifted bees they currently have, as well as giving them Haste+ for 1 minute.

You can tell what gifted bees you have by looking at the "⭐" icon in the bee menu. There is no star if the gifted variant hasn't been discovered yet, a faded star if it's been discovered but isn't in your hive, and a black star if you have it currently in your hive. This can help track what bees are needed for Star Amulet progress.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Since Bear Bee is now purchasable from the Robux Shop, players who purchased a Bear Bee from the game launch event had their Bear Bee turned into a First Edition gifted Bear Bee.
  • Therefore, this makes Bear Bee the only Event bee that can be gifted without the use of a Star Treat or Gingerbread Bears.
  • Multiple gifted bees of the same type do NOT stack their hive bonus multiple times, nor do they count towards the number of gifted bee types in the hive. However, they will still have improved stats over their normal version.
  • Using a royal jelly or a non-gifted egg on a gifted bee will almost certainly make the bee LOSE ITS GIFTED STATUS. The chance of the new bee being gifted is 1/250.

  • Tadpole Bee used to give two different gifted hive bonuses before the 2024-05-23 update.

Gifted Bucko Bee is a quest giver and one of three permanent Quest Bees, the others being Gifted Riley Bee and Honey Bee. Quest Milestone Honey Amount Every 100th quest \(25,000,000\times Q\) Every 5th quest \(2,500,000\times \left\lfloor Q^{0.95}\right\rfloor\) All other quests \(1,000,000\times \left\lfloor Q^{0.9}\right\rfloor\)

Quest Milestone Honey Amount Every 100th quest \(25,000,000\times Q\) Every 5th quest \(2,500,000\times \left\lfloor Q^{0.95}\right\rfloor\) All other quests \(1,000,000\times \left\lfloor Q^{0.9}\right\rfloor\)

docs.title: Gingerbread Bear
docs.text:
Gingerbread Bear

"A cookie shaped like a bear! Gives 250 bond to the fed bee and has a 1% chance to turn that bee Gifted."

This article is about the item. For the similarly named Gingerbread Cub skin, see Cub Buddy.

Not to be confused with an Aged Gingerbread Bear.

A Gingerbread Bear is a unique type of treat that was added in the 2020-12-25 update. It is obtainable by checking Mother Bear's Gingerbread House, defeating certain mobs and bosses, opening Gift Boxes, completing Bee Bear's quests, giving Presents to certain NPCs around the map, completing NPCs Beesmas quests, using Onett's Lid Art, and buying certain Robux Packs.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Gingerbread bears have 2 functions. The player could save them up and spend it on Bee Bear's Catalog during the Beesmas 2020, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2025 events, or feed them to bees. In addition to granting bond, it has a 1% chance to make them gifted. They can also be saved up until the next Beesmas event, where they turn into Aged Gingerbread Bears.

The formula of turning a bee gifted: \((1-0.99^{x})\times 100\%\) (𝑥 is the number of the Gingerbread Bears fed to a bee)

docs.title: Ways to Obtain
docs.text:

  • Using Mother Bear's Gingerbread House (1 for every 2 hours of playtime).
  • As a prize from the Winter Memory Match.

  • Finding it behind the Sticker Stack Machine.
  • Finding it in the Beesmas Tree near the 20 bee zone.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Gingerbread Bears, along with Snowflakes, are the only currencies that can be used in Bee Bear's Catalog.
  • However, unlike Snowflakes, Gingerbread Bears are not removed from the player's inventory when Beesmas ends and are still obtainable and usable.
  • This, along with the Star Treat and Aged Gingerbread Bears, are the only items in the game that can turn Event bees gifted.
  • This and the Festive Bean are the only event items that are infinitely renewable outside of an event.
  • Feeding 100 Gingerbread Bears to a bee does not guarantee to turn it gifted. The chance of it becoming gifted is around 63%.

docs.title: Gingerbread House
docs.text:
The Gingerbread House is a Beesmas-exclusive machine which can be assembled after completing Mother Bear's Beesmas quest.

It sits between Mother Bear and the Treat Shop. When activated, the house gives 1 Gingerbread Bear for every 2 playtime hours, which can be built up over time.

If the player attempts to use the Gingerbread House before it is completed, it will display text that reads: This Gingerbread House is far from complete...

The Gingerbread House stand before Mother Bear's Beesmas quest is completed.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The Gingerbread House has gumdrops for decorations at the corners, a Gingerbread Bear in the middle, and a candy cane acting as a possible chimney.

Its only use is to produce a Gingerbread Bear every 2 in-game hours. If the player is offline, it does not generate any, unless they have redeemed an Offline Voucher, in which it will stay active for up to 24 hours after they log out.

Upon completing the quest, the Gingerbread House can be used immediately for one Gingerbread Bear.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Gingerbread House stores multiple gingerbread bears at the same time, meaning that multiple gingerbread bears can be collected in one go after 4 or more hours.
  • Even though the cooldown to collect resets once it was collected, the timer for generating gingerbread bears does not. For example, if a player with 3 hours in-game checks the house, they will only get 1 gingerbread bear and the cooldown will reset to 2 hours. The timer saves that extra hour, so the player will get 2 gingerbread bears if they collect after 3 more hours (6 hours total).
  • This now has been changed and now the timer saves.
  • The Gingerbread House was introduced in Beesmas 2020, and has returned on each Beesmas since.
  • Quest givers such as Bee Bear require the player to interact with the Gingerbread House a varying amount of times.

docs.title: Glider
docs.text:
The Glider is a gliding tool that can be purchased at the Mountain Top Shop, it is the upgraded version of the Parachute.

Crafting Ingredients Statistics 5,000,000 Honey Speed 70 Float -24

It allows the player to glide much quicker and change direction faster than the Parachute. To activate it, jump, then jump again while in mid-air. If the player goes airborne through some other method (a cannon, for example), double jump; to disengage it, jump once more or make contact with ground. The gliding feature is hardcoded to the player, and they will glide even during a lag spike; although, the Glider doesn't immediately appear.

The primary use of the Glider is to glide to places on the map that would otherwise be inaccessible. It can be used to collect some of the Royal Jelly and Ticket tokens around the map and can be used to perform several shortcuts. The Glider, along with the Parachute, are the only ways to obtain the Diamond Egg token below the platform in the 30 Bee Zone. It is also used to reach the Star Hall located on top of the Noob Shop. The Glider can also be used to dodge mobs, since most of them don't have a high detection range in the air. Combined with the cannons (especially with the Red Cannon), it is one of the most efficient ways to travel around the map.

The Glider's gliding speed is not affected by boosts that enhance the player's movement speed, such as Haste, Haste+, Bear Morph or Oil.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Glider and the Parachute are the only gliding tools in the game, excluding the unobtainable Debug Glider.
  • With the Glider, it is possible to glide outside of the map.
  • However, it is also possible to exit out of the map via a Wild Windy Bee blowing at the player with a gust of wind.
  • If the player enables shift-lock, they can slightly strafe to one side while using the gliding tools.
  • The Glider is located on top of the Mountain Top Shop as a decoration, similar to how a Parachute model is located on top of the Pro Shop.
  • The Glider is the second cheapest item in the Mountain Top Shop, after the first hive slot.
  • It was the third cheapest item in the shop before the Eviction was removed.
  • The Glider along with the Parachute can be used to move during a game of Memory Match.

docs.title: Glitter
docs.text:
Glitter

"Boosts the field you're standing in, granting +100% pollen for 15 minutes."

COOLDOWN

15 minutes 5 seconds

Glitter is a craftable inventory item that was added in the 2018-11-25 update. It grants a +100% pollen boost in the field the player is standing in for 15 minutes upon activation. If used in a field with a planter, the planter gains a 25% growth rate boost until it is harvested. Glitter has a 15-minute and 5 second cooldown between uses. This is to prevent the user from stacking the item's buff for one field.

It can be used in all fields except the Ant Field. Attempting to do so will result in the following message: You can't boost a challenge field

  • This is the only consumable to grant a Field Boost of the player's choice.
  • Spirit Bear mentions in one of her quest dialogues, Spirit's Starter, that glitter was once so rare that 1 pouch of it costed 5 million honey.
  • Glitter's raw ingredients cost:
  • 375 Strawberries
  • 375 Blueberries
  • 500 Pineapples
  • 25 Royal Jellies or 25M Honey
  • 1 Magic Bean or 20 Tickets

docs.title: Glue Dispenser
docs.text:
Glue Dispenser Information Usage Grants Glue based on goo badge rank and the Unlimited Gumdrops buff Requirement(s) Access to Gummy Bear's Lair (Requires goo hotshot badge) Cooldown 22 hours Location Gummy Bear's Lair

The Glue Dispenser is a dispenser located in Gummy Bear's Lair, behind the location where the player teleports to. It can be used every 22 hours and dispenses glue (number given depends on what goo badge the player has) along with the Unlimited Gumdrops buff for 3 minutes. The type of goo badge doesn't affect the duration of the buff.

Goo Badge Rank Glue Hotshot 2 Ace 3 Master 4 Grandmaster 5

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Using this is one of the two only ways to get the Unlimited Gumdrops Buff, the other being certain codes.

  • It is the only dispenser that requires the player to have a certain badge to access, as the Gummy Bear's Lair requires the player to have Goo Hotshot or above to enter.

  • This, the Free Ant Pass Dispenser, Ant Pass Dispenser, Free Robo Pass Dispenser, Robo Pass Dispenser, and the Coconut Dispenser are the only dispensers to not grant haste.
  • This is the only dispenser that can give a passive ability.
  • This, the Free Robo Pass Dispenser, and the Free Royal Jelly Dispenser are the only dispensers with a 22-hour cooldown, the longest in the game.
  • This and the Coconut Dispenser are the only dispensers to give more items based on the rank of a badge.
  • The player cannot collide with the neon green decoration around the platform, which means they can go underneath the white platform.

docs.title: Glue
docs.text:
Glue

"Grants x1.25 Bee Gather Pollen and Tools for 10 minutes."

COOLDOWN

10 minutes

Glue is a craftable inventory item added in the 2018-11-25 update. Its purpose is as a creating material for accessories, or as a 10-minute boost that grants x1.25 Bee Gather Pollen and tools when used directly. The buff cannot stack and will only reset its timer when another glue is used when one is currently active. Using a Purple Potion or Super Smoothie will override the buff.

docs.title: Ways to Obtain
docs.text:
• Crafting it in the Blender for 50 Gumdrops and 10 Royal Jellies.
  • Black Bear gives glue on the following quests:
  • All-Whitey Then gives 1 glue and other items.
  • Black Bear's repeatable quests occasionally reward glue.
  • Brown Bear will give glue on the completion of these quests:
  • Brown Bear's 140th quest rewards 1 glue.
  • Brown Bear's 235th quest rewards 1 glue.
  • Brown Bear's 310th quest rewards 3 glues.
  • Brown Bear's 395th quest rewards 5 glues.
  • Science Bear gives glue on the following quests:
  • Chemical Analysis rewards 1 glue and other items.
  • Epistemological Endeavor gives 4 glues and other items.
  • As a rare drop from mobs such as the Spider, Werewolf, Puffshroom, King Beetle, and Coconut Crab, or guaranteed from the Stump Snail.
  • As a drop from Robo Bear Challenge (The chances are affected by the round the challenge ends at)
  • A drop from Armored aphids.
  • Small chance of dropping from the Dandelion Field, Pumpkin Patch, and the Stump Field in place of a honey token.
  • A rare drop from leaves that appear in the Pineapple Patch, Dandelion Field, Pumpkin Patch, Stump Field, or Spider Field.
  • A rare drop when collecting pollen in the Pineapple Patch, Spider Field, or the Pumpkin Patch.
  • Rarely, a glue token can appear from collecting goo from flowers.
  • You can claim 2-5 Glues from the Glue Dispenser depending on your Goo Badge. Hotshot rewards 2, Ace rewards 3, Master rewards 4, and Grandmaster rewards 5 Glues. The Glue Dispenser is located inside Gummy Bear's Lair.
  • As a drop from Gummy Sprouts.
  • As a rare drop from Festive Gifts (if Festive Bee is gifted).
  • As a rare drop from Festive Mark.
  • As a badge reward by donating to the Wind Shrine.
  • Matching a pair of glue in Memory Match.
  • Capturing Commando Chick the 5th time drops 1 Glue.
  • As a rare drop from the Candy Planter, Blue Clay Planter, Pesticide Planter and Festive Planter.
  • Planting the Candy Planter in the Stump Field 3 times in a row will guarantee at least 10 Glues (Can give 20 glues, 1 week cooldown)
  • A glue token is hidden behind the big pineapple in between the Pineapple Patch and the Stump Field.
  • As a Stack Reward for adding certain stickers to the Sticker Stack:
  • Right Facing Stump Snail rewards 1 glue.
  • Yellow Sticky Hand rewards 1 glue.
  • Glowering Gummy Bear Rewards 1 glue.

docs.title: Golden Cogmower
docs.text:
Not to be confused with Cogmowers, the more common counterparts of Golden Cogmowers or Party Cogmowers, the Beesmas edition of Cogmowers.

Golden Cogmower Location Clover Field, Pineapple Patch, Pumpkin Patch or Mountain Top Field while the Robo Bear Challenge is active.

A Golden Cogmower is a mob that appears during Robo Bear's Challenge, known for its distinct golden and bronze accents, which separates itself from its much more common counterpart, the Cogmower. They are the rarest mob type that appears in Robo Bear Challenge, only spawning a total of 3 times:

  • once on either rounds 3, 4, or 6;
  • once again on either rounds 12, 14, or 16;
  • and once more on either rounds 21, or 22.

They can appear only on 4 following fields:

  • Clover Field
  • Pineapple Patch
  • Pumpkin Patch
  • Mountain Top Field

They do not despawn until the round is over. Unlike regular Cogmowers, Golden Cogmowers will not follow the player if they go to another field, they stay in the random field they spawned in.

Golden Cogmowers rise up from the field before slowly moving around the field, draining flowers they pass over. The higher the level of the Golden Cogmower, the more pollen is drained. Golden Cogmowers bounce off of the edges of the field. They also only take half as much damage from Critical Hits.

A Golden Cogmower's level can range from 6-22, depending on what round of Robo Bear Challenge the player is on.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text:
• 14-20 Cogs(Guaranteed)
  • Wavy Yellow Hive Skin(Unbelievably Rare)

docs.title: Strategies
docs.text:
• Golden Cogmowers don't aim for the player, allowing players to easily sidestep them.
  • Stand near the Golden Cogmower, this will allow your bees to lock on to the Golden Cogmower and quickly deal damage.
  • Vicious Bee provides very strong single-target damage. Digital Bee can also stun the Golden Cogmower in place and allow it to take extra damage via Mind Hack (this still allows the Golden Cogmower to take half the damage from critical hits).
  • After starting a round, quickly use the Red Cannon to check all fields for a Golden Cogmower. The cogs it drops can help you afford 1 or 2 extra upgrades during the challenge.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Golden Cogmowers have a more common counterpart known as a Cogmower.
  • While they don't have a Robo Party variant, the Party Cogmower behaves similarly to the Golden Cogmower as they will not leave the Field they spawned in.
  • Golden Cogmowers are the only mobs in the Robo Bear Challenge to drop loot.

docs.title: Golden Gushers
docs.text:
Golden Gushers Requirement 10 Ace Badges Cost 333,333,333 Honey Description Three gorgeous sprinklers with enormous range.

The Golden Gushers are the 3rd tier sprinkler available for purchase in the Badge Bearer's Guild. To unlock it, the player must obtain 10 different Ace badges. Once the player unlocks it, they can purchase it for 333,333,333 (~333.3 million) honey. Its description reads, "Three gorgeous sprinklers with enormous range."

The Golden Gushers are comprised of 3 individual sprinklers.

Its radius extends to 8 flower tiles, its rate is 4.5 seconds, and its power is 8.

Golden Rake Overview Price 20,000,000 Honey Shop Mountain Top Shop Pollen Collection Range 16 Flowers (48 on every 5th scoop) Collecting Pattern 7 pollen from 4 lines of 4 patches collectedyou (facing up)Every 5th scoop reaches 12 tiles ahead (48 flowers). Collecting Time 0.75 sec Base Collection 7 Flowers Single Double Triple Large Star White 7 14 21 28 35 Red 7 14 21 28 35 Blue 7 14 21 28 35 Special Multiplier(s): None

The Golden Rake is a tool that was added in the 2019-04-05 update. It can be purchased in the Mountain Top Shop.

Crafting Ingredients 20,000,000 Honey

The Golden Rake collects 7 pollen from 4 lines of 4 patches in 0.75 seconds. It gets supercharged for every 5th scoop, collecting 7 pollen from 4 lines of 12 patches for every fifth scoop. It emits sparkles. Its average base pollen collection rate is 149.333 pollen per second, 238.933 pollen per second when including the supercharged collection.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• If the supercharged Golden Rake is activated right when the player turns their body, the rake will collect sideways.
  • Like all the other tools with an ability, it still activates when the player is not in a field.
  • This is the superior version of the Rake, which can be bought in the Noob Shop for 800 Honey

docs.title: Goo
docs.text:
Goo is a purple-to-teal substance that gives the player bonus honey when spread across flowers. Using gumdrops is the easiest and most common way to manually spread goo. To collect goo, collect pollen as usual (with tools, bees, and/or their ability tokens) from flowers that are covered in goo.

The following formula shows how much bonus honey a player gets from goo. Let p equal the amount of pollen collected from a puddle of goo, and f the amount of flowers inside the puddle. \(p\sqrt{\frac{f}{200}}\)

This means that the larger the goo puddle, the more bonus honey the player gets. For example, collecting 500,000 pollen from a goo puddle of 80 flowers would grant roughly 316,228 bonus honey.

Goo can be freely shared with other players. Collecting goo depletes the underlying flowers, but does not actually "use up" the goo itself, unless you collect goo with the Gummyballer. Goo puddles disappear on their own over a short period of time.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Gummy Cannon doesn't always shoot in the center of fields. Sometimes, the gumdrops landed outside of the field, making them vanish and sometimes going to the surrounding fields.
  • If a gumdrop falls outside of a field and does not land on a flower, it disappears.
  • Gummy Bee's Glob and Gumdrop Barrage abilities both spread goo in fields.
  • Activating Gummy Mask's Gummy Morph passive ability covers the entire field the wearer is in with goo.
  • Whether goo is pink or teal is decided based on the flower it falls on. For example, the top-left flower (Closest to Mushroom field) in Dandelion Field will always have pink goo, whereas the bottom-left flower in Dandelion will always have teal goo. This is only visual and does not affect earned honey.

docs.title: Gumdrop Shop
docs.text:
The Gumdrop Shop is a shop introduced in the 2018-05-26 update, located between the Spider Field and the Bamboo Field. It can be used to purchase gumdrops with tickets, in increments of 3, 30, and 300.

It is decorated with a teal gumdrop on the top, a picture of the gumdrops item on the sides with a pink background, a teal base, and gray rims.

The description of the shop is: "Use while standing in a field to cover flowers in goo. Goo grants bonus honey."

docs.text: Gumdrops Tickets 3  1  30  10  300  100

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:

docs.title: Gumdrops
docs.text:
Gumdrops

"Use while standing in a field to cover flowers in goo. Goo grants bonus honey."

COOLDOWN

0.5 seconds

Gumdrops are an inventory item that was introduced in the Gummy Invasion Event. When used, gumdrop blobs fall from the air and splatter goo if they hit a flower. Goo grants an additional 40% bonus honey, with bigger goo puddles granting even more bonus honey. Gumdrops can also be used to craft other gear, such as the Gummyballer.

Placing gumdrops in a hotbar slot triggers an ON/OFF switch to appear beneath it. Toggling the switch allows the player to use gumdrops automatically every half a second. The switch can be turned off by manually using gumdrops in any way.

docs.title: Ways to Obtain
docs.text:
• Crafting via Blender for:
  • 3 Blueberries
  • 3 Strawberries
  • 3 Pineapples
  • Spending Tickets at the Gumdrop Shop grants 3 Gumdrops for each ticket.
  • As a reward for completing certain Black Bear and Brown Bear quests.
  • Receiving Science Bear's "Chemical Analysis" quest gives the player 10 Gumdrops.
  • As a Cub Buddy gift in increments of 1 or 5.
  • As a possible reward for participating in the Stick Bug Challenge. The number of Gumdrops rewarded increases with score.
  • Collecting tokens from the Supreme Star Amulet passive, "Gummy Star".
  • There is a token worth 5 Gumdrops in a block near the Ant Gate, it is most likely the gumdrop token left behind from the Gummy Invasion event in 2018.
  • Redeeming certain valid codes:
  • BeesBuzz123 (Gives 10 Gumdrops + other stuff).
  • 15MMembers (Gives 15 Gumdrops + other stuff).
  • GumdropsForScience (Gives 15 Gumdrops).
  • As a Stack Reward for adding certain stickers to the Sticker Stack:
  • The Silly Tongue rewards 25 Gumdrops.
  • The Yellow Walking Wiggly Person rewards 25 Gumdrops.
  • The Gummyballer rewards 25 Gumdrops.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text:
• As a drop from any planter.
  • As a drop from Festive Gifts.
  • As a drop from Puffshrooms.
  • As a drop from catching mythic meteors.
  • As a drop from certain mobs. (Anywhere from 0 to 2,500 gumdrops per mob, depending on Loot Luck and the type of mob.)
  • As a drop from leaves in the Stump Field.
  • As a drop from a Gummy Sprout or a Festive Sprout.

docs.title: Gummy Beacon
docs.text: The Gummy Beacon is a Beesmas 2020+ machine that can be unlocked after completing Gummy Bear's Beesmas quest. It is located on top of the Noob Shop, on the corner closest to the Royal Jelly Dispenser next to the Clover Field, in front of the Star Hall. If the player attempts to activate it without completing Gummy Bear's Beesmas quest, it reads: "The satellite dish isn't working, but it still emits bad vibes..." Completing his quest allows the player to activate a Gummy Siege.

docs.title: Gummy Siege
docs.text:
Upon activating, a platform will appear with Gummy Bear and Gummy Bee in front of the Gummy Beacon, and the Gummy Morph tune will play. Then, it will summon three level 8-20 Gummy Bees for five minutes. Gummy Bear will begin to shoot goo puddles at random fields similar to the Gummy Invasion event. The targeted field will also spawn Gumdrops tokens. Gummy Bear will pick five random fields (excluding the Ant Field and Hub Field), and shoots goo for one minute per field, making the Gummy Siege 5 minutes long. The cooldown for Gummy Siege is 45 minutes.

When it starts, two server-wide messages will appear saying the following lines: Gummy Bear: "Artillery has arrived, Gummy Soldier {Username}."

Gummy Bear: "Beesmas ends now. Commence GOO YEAR celebrations!"

As Gummy Bear targets fields, more server-wide messages will appear showing which field is being targeted:

Gummy Bear: "Sight set on {Field Name}!"

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This is the second and currently the only way of making Gummy Bear appear in the mountain, the first being using the Gummy Cannon.
  • Although Gummy Bear is shown during the siege, he can still be seen in his lair.
  • This is also the only way that the Gummy Cannon can appear.
  • This is one of the 4 machines that summons temporary bees, the others being the Honeyday Candles, Onett's Lid Art, and Honey Bee's Honey Wreath.
  • This is the only way to have more than 1 Gummy Bee, though it is only for a limited amount of time.
  • The Gummy Bees given by the Gummy Beacon can help player activate the Gummy Morph very quickly by spawning tokens that contribute towards the passive.
  • This and Onett's Lid Art are the only ways to have multiple Event Bees. However, they only last for a limited amount of time.
  • The Gummy Bees from the Gummy Siege are not affected by the Gummy Morph Passive from the Gummy Mask, however their abilities will still contribute to activating the passive.
  • After the Beesmas 2025 update, The summoned Gummy Bee NPC will appear extremely shaky when it idles. This is due to its model still using Roblox's old movement engine that broke with an update.

docs.title: Gummy Bear's Lair
docs.text:
Gummy Bear's Lair is a location that can only be accessed by having a Goo Hotshot Badge or above.

To get into the lair, touch the Gummy Bee model on the Gummy Bee Claimer and use a gumdrop. The player can reach the egg claim by going behind the Ant Leaderboard and following the path (where there's also an ant pass token). They can also climb the Stinger Dispenser, go across the gate and reach the Egg Claim or use a cannon, such as the Red or Yellow Cannon in combination with the Parachute/Glider.

If the player doesn't have the Goo Hotshot Badge, then the following message will prompt: Only Goo Hotshots can hear Gummy Bee...

Otherwise, the player will be prompted to use gumdrops to enter the Lair with this message:

The Gummy Bee wants Gumdrops

The lair contains Gummy Bear and Gummy Bee. It also has the Glue Dispenser, which activates the Unlimited Gumdrops passive, allowing gumdrops to not decrease in count when used. Additionally, it has a shop that sells the Gummy Mask, Gummy Boots and the Gummyballer.

docs.title: Gummy Bear's Dialogue
docs.text:
When the player walks up to Gummy Bear without having the Gummy Mask or Gummy Boots bought, he will say the following in chat and through notifications:

Gummy Bear: "What's sweeter than honey?"

"Glorious gumdrops... they're just the start!"

"A sweet and sour, ooey-gooey universe..."

"Can't you see it too?" (slight pause)

"What's that Gummy Bee?"

"They're not seeing clearly?"

"YOU'RE ALWAYS RIGHT!"

"GOO-dbye, beekeeper... HAH!"

After he finishes his speech, Gummy Bear will instantly kill the player, sending the player back to their hive.

If the player owns the Gummy Mask or the Gummy Boots, they can talk to Gummy Bear, but he does not give a quest, unless it is Beesmas. It is not required to have either of the two equipped to talk to him.

Dialogue A beekeeper approaches, Gummy Bee!

The player is given two options: "Talk to Gummy Bear" or "Return to hive".

-Talk to Gummy Bear-

Our Gummy Army marches forward at a steady, viscous pace. An inevitable ooze that envelopes all things, uniting us all! This glorious gummy world awaits you and your Gummy Bee as well. A place where nothing is bitter, and EVERYTHING is sweet!

-Return to hive-

Back to work, soldier!

The player is teleported to their hive.

If the player has bought the Gummy Mask after Beesmas 2021, only the dialogue of talking to Gummy Bear will activate.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Players should avoid going to Gummy Bear's Lair if they have a lot of pollen in their container, as they will eventually die due to Gummy Bear killing them or by the player needing to reset their character. However, the player can avoid losing pollen by rejoining the game, using a Micro-Converter to convert all of the pollen beforehand, or using a Whirligig.
  • During Beesmas 2020 and 2021, the player would be able to exit the lair if they have given Gummy Bear a present.

docs.title: Token locations
docs.text:
• 1 Glitter behind the Gummy Boots case.
  • 1 Star Jelly in front of Gummy Bear.
  • 1 Enzymes in the corner of the lair.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Before Beesmas 2020, the only way to leave the lair without exiting or losing connection to the game is to die. The player can die by either courtesy of Gummy Bear or by resetting their character.
  • This is currently the only location not connected to the mountain; instead, it is high up in the sky. The player is able to see the silhouette of the lair if they look closely at the sky.
  • Bee Bear refers to Gummy Bear as naughty in 2018, most likely because he kills the player upon finishing his dialogue, and the fact that he tried to "invade" the mountain.
  • Originally, the lair required the Goo Ace Badge or above, which was a mistake on Onett's end. It was quickly fixed to allow people with Goo Hotshot as well, so there could be more players that could actually access the lair.
  • This, the Ace Shop, and the Badge Bearer's Guild are the only places that require badges to enter them.
  • Gummy Bear's Lair is the only location that requires a specific badge to enter.
  • Before the 2019-04-05 update, the Gummy Bee that was used to teleport was on top of the Ticket Tent. Now Gummy Bee is replaced with a model of Festive Bee and was instead put at the Ant Field.
  • When Gummy Bear's Lair first came out, it said, “Gummy Bee wants 1 Gumdrop.” Now, it says “The Gummy Bee wants Gumdrops.”
  • However, if the player is visiting Gummy Bear's Lair for the first time, standing on the Gummy Bee model will say "The Gummy Bee wants 1 Gumdrops."
  • Spirit Bear mentions how to get to the lair in her quest dialogue.
  • Some players may experience lag when they are getting close to Gummy Bear.
  • This shop and the Petal Shop are the only shops with items in a triangular formation.
  • The player can experience minor glitches in the lair.
  • When the player walks up to Gummy Bear, he sometimes fails to kill the player after he finishes his speech.
  • After Gummy Bear kills the player, their body parts will slip down until they reach the end of the shop. If the player presses E at the right time, they will be stuck in the shop, resulting in the Shop Trap glitch. Only leaving the game could fix this glitch.
  • On rare occasions, Wild Windy Bee can push the player to Gummy Bear's Lair, making them glitch into it.

Gummy Bear is an NPC that resides in his lair, killing players who go near him without any gear sold in the shop. Either the Gummy Mask, Gummy Boots, or Gummyballer needs to have been purchased to talk to him, though they aren't required to be worn. The player must have the Goo Hotshot Badge or above to enter Gummy Bear's Lair, and have 20 bees to access the 20 Bee Zone as the Gummy Bee Claimer is at the entrance of it.

The player can either talk to him, which gives a short paragraph of dialogue about the Gummy Army, claim his Beesmas quest or give him a present (during Beesmas), or teleport the player back to their Hive. If a player who does not have any of the Gummy gear would like to see Gummy Bear without losing their pollen, they should empty out their bag before going into the lair. If the player is already inside the lair, the player can use a Micro-Converter to empty their bag, or a Whirligig to teleport them back to their hive. The whirligig must be used before the dialogue begins, otherwise the player will still die as it ends, regardless of the fact they are no longer in the lair.

His first appearance on the mountain was during the Gummy Invasion on May 26, 2018. He gave 15 quests that rewarded the player a Gummy Bee Egg at the end of the questline. During this event, he used the Gummy Cannon to shoot Gumdrops at fields and cover flowers with goo. He targeted every field except the Mountain Top Field (and the Stump Field, Coconut Field, and Pepper Patch, as they weren't in the game at that time). Gummy Bear left on June 24, 2018, and returned as an NPC in the Nov. 25, 2018 update in his current location, accessible through the Gummy Bee model that used to be on the Ticket Tent.

Starting from Beesmas 2020 and continuing throughout the following Beesmas events, he gave out a Beesmas quest called "Gummy Bear's Goo Years Beacon".

docs.title: Lair Dialogue
docs.text:
If the player walks close enough to Gummy Bear in his lair, and that player does not own the Gummy Mask, Gummy Boots or Gummyballer, the following dialogue will appear in chat, and in the player's notifications:

"Gummy Bear: "What's sweeter than honey?"

"Glorious gumdrops... they're just the start!"

"A sweet and sour, ooey-gooey universe..."

"Can't you see it too?" (slight pause)

"What's that Gummy Bee?"

"They're not seeing clearly?"

"YOU'RE ALWAYS RIGHT!"

"GOO-dbye, beekeeper... HAH!"

After the last line, Gummy Bear will use the point emote and kill the player, taking them back to spawn.

Even if the player uses a Whirligig during the dialogue to exit the lair, the dialogue will continue regardless, and they will still be killed when Gummy Bear's dialogue ends.

If the player owns the Gummy Mask, Gummy Boots or Gummyballer, they can talk to Gummy Bear, but he does not give a quest.

Dialogue A beekeeper approaches, Gummy Bee! -Talk to Gummy Bear-

Our Gummy Army marches forward at a steady, vicious pace. An inevitable ooze that envelopes [sic] all things, uniting us all! This glorious gummy world awaits you and your Gummy Bee as well. A place where nothing is bitter, and EVERYTHING is sweet!

-Return to your hive-

Back to work soldier!

docs.title: Dialogue
docs.text:
Quest Name Dialogue Begin The Goo Invasion BOOM! SPLAT! HAH... I am Gummy Bear! This is my bee, Gummy Bee. And that's my Gummy Cannon! I'm on a mission to spread my sweet Gummy Bees all around the universe! I'll cover this whole mountain in GOO to claim it for my GUMMY EMPIRE! YOU will join my cause! Complete all 15 of my initiation quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg]! First, Collect 500 goo. When I shoot gumdrops from my Gummy Cannon, they cover flowers in goo. Collect pollen from those flower to receive bonus honey, and GOO! The bigger the goo puddle, the more honey and goo you get! You can also create goo with [Gumdrops], I've got some for you behind my cannon. Activate your [Gumdrops] while standing in a field to cover the flowers in goo! If you need more [Gumdrops], you can get them from defeating enemies. Try teaming up with your friends to share [Gumdrops] and create large puddles! I'll tell you when I'm about to fire my cannon at a field. Let's get GOO-ing!

-During- Flowers covered in goo give you bonus honey (and goo) when you collect from them. The bigger the goo puddle, the more you get! When I shoot gumdrops at a field, always look for the biggest puddle. You can even combine your own [Gumdrops] with existing puddles to create even larger ones! Go try it! Collect 500 goo. -Completion- GOO-d job! HAH. Gummy Bee says it thinks you look promising. I'm not convinced yet! Come back when you're ready for the next test.

Patient Plundering Each place I invade offers something new to my Gummy Empire. I've heard the flowers on this mountain produce rare Honey Tokens! I need you to collect some of those to help fund my mission. Collect 5 Honey Tokens while you gather 2,000 more GOO! Remember: Always collect from the largest goo puddle! It gives you the most goo. And if you need more [Gumdrops], you can get them from defeating bugs!

-During- It takes dedication and patience to find Honey Tokens. Those are only some of the virtues I require out of a Gummy Soldier. Go out there and prove you've got what it take. Collect 5 Honey Tokens and gather 2,000 more goo! -Completion- With each quest you prove yourself more loyal to my GUMMY EMPIRE! I'll give you some [Gumdrops] each time so you can keep spreading the goo too. We won't stop until this entire mountain is PINK and TEAL.

Piecewise Invasion I've planned this invasion for months! I've figured out the optimal method of gooing up this place field by field. Gummy Bee is my advisor. And it's telling me we need to tackle the Clover Field! Take my advice: work together with other Gummy Soldiers to share [Gumdrops]. You'll both benefit from the goo. You will not complete my tests without teamwork. Collect 3,500 goo from the Clover Field! GO GO GO GO GO GO!

-During- Why would anyone oppose the GUMMY CAUSE? My only objective is to make the universe sweeter. You are here to help me accomplish that! Collect 3,500 goo from the Clover Field. -Completion- Gummy Bee says you did a fine job out in those clovers. I say you've got a long way to go!

Colorful Conquest Goo does not discriminate - white, red or blue, it doesn't matter. ALL flowers are GOO FLOWERS to me! Get out there and gunk them all until their colors are just a distant memory! Collect 2,000 goo from White, Red, and Blue flowers and collect 10 Honey Tokens.

-During- People think I'm soft cause I'm physically soft and squishy. I use this to my advantage to catch my adversaries off guard. Nobody expects my GUMMY INVASION! Collect 2,000 goo from White, Red, and Blue flowers and collect 10 Honey Tokens. -Completion- I'm starting to open your eyes to my gummy ways. You see it now: GOO is GREAT! Gummy Bee says we're making great progress. Let's not lose our momentum!

Stickier Than Spider Webs Spiders and their webs are nothing compared to Gummy Bees and their goo. Those puny arachnids guard those White flowers like their lives depend on it! Guess what SPIDERS, those belong to ME now. Collect 20,000 goo from the Spider Field.

-During- Nothing is good unless it's squishy and sweet. You look sort of squishy, probably not sweet though. You'll have to compensate for your lack of sweetness through hard work. Collect 20,000 goo from the Spider Field. -Completion- Spiders are nothing before our gummy might! Gummy Bee says those fools should have stayed in their cave. Good work soldier, but we've still got more to do.

Four Front Assault Gummy Bee says let's stop playing games. I'm inclined to agree!!!!! Each and every one of these fields will fall to my confectionary cannon. BOOM BOOOOM! No more chit chat, this is an invasion! Collect 30,000 goo.. Collect 5,000 goo from the Mushroom, Blue Flower, Strawberry, and Bamboo Fields... And collect 20 Honey Tokens!

-During- Get going soldier: Collect 30,000 goo.. Collect 5,000 goo from the Mushroom, Blue Flower, Strawberry, and Bamboo Fields... And collect 20 Honey Tokens. -Completion- What a mess - just how I like it! And it'll only get messier from here!

Total Gummification All around the universe, we're in the midst of war... A war between GOO and everything that's not GOO. All other conflicts are TRIVIAL DISTRACTIONS. Now collect 60,000 more GOO!

-During- I ain't picky if the goo is sticky. Collect 60,000 goo. -Completion- Gummy Bee says "No flower will remain un-gummied!" Just 8 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg] of your own.

Artillery Lessons: Slingshot A good Gummy Soldier must know how to use artillery. My Gummy Cannon takes years of experience to man, you're not ready for it. I'll start you off on something smaller - the SLINGSHOT. BOING BOING! Collect 80,000 goo from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 30 Honey Tokens... And use the Slingshot 10 times.

-During- You'll need to discover a certain number of bee types to use the Slingshot and Cannons. To discover more types, try transforming your bees with Royal Jelly. You can buy Royal Jelly for Honey at the shop near the Rose Field. You can also buy it for tickets from the dispenser near the Noob Bear's Shop. Now back to work: collect 80,000 goo from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 30 Honey Tokens... And use the Slingshot 10 times. -Completion- My Gummy Cannon is used to shoot gumdrops, but the other cannons on the map are used to shoot YOU into the sky. They're the fastest way to move around the map. Just 7 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg] of your own.

GOO Away, Bugs Look at all those bugs sipping up slime faster than I can spread it... These beetles have got to go! Gummy Bee says your swarm looks like it could make quick work of them. Collect 100,000 goo and defeat 10 Ladybugs, 10 Rhino Beetles, and 3 Spiders.

-During- Gummy Bee is a military mastermind, but it only has 1 attack. With GOOd strategy, even a lone Basic Bee can take down a Werewolf. Come back when you've collected 100,000 goo and defeated 10 Ladybugs, 10 Rhino Beetles, and 3 Spiders. -Completion- SPLISH SPLAT SPLAT! BUGS BE GONE JUST LIKE THAT! Just 6 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg] of your own.

Colorful Conquest 2 As you trudge your way through the goo, you get sweeter and sweeter... That's how it is with all things! I can tell you don't quite understand it yet. It'll seep in in due time. Collect 80,000 goo from Red and Blue flowers... Collect 80,000 goo from the Clover Field... And use the Slingshot 20 times...

-During- I cycle through each of the 13 themed fields. Sure enough, I reach them all. Collect 80,000 goo from Red and Blue flowers... Collect 80,000 goo from the Clover Field. And use the Slingshot 20 times... -Completion- YES! HAHA! It's happening... the gooification is almost complete. Just 5 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg].

Artillery Lessons: Yellow Cannon I love nothing more than firing endless barrages of Gumdrops at pristine fields of flowers. There's something so satisfying about the KABOOM of a cannon! You will come to know it too! Collect 200,000 white goo... Collect 40 Honey Tokens... And use the Yellow Cannon 30 times...

-During- You may not be able to experience that joy of launch gumdrops with explosives, but at least you can still fire cannons. Collect 200,000 white goo... Collect 40 Honey Tokens... And use the Yellow Cannon 30 times. -Completion- AHAH! Isn't it a rush? Just 4 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg].

Peace Through Goo-nity Gummy Bee and I are made of the very same goo! We are practically one creature. I want to feel that same closeness with all other things. By GOO-IFYING the universe, I will unite us all! Help me in my mission of GOO-nity. Collect 200,000 from Red flowers... 200,000 goo from the Pumpkin Patch... And 200,000 goo from the Cactus Field.

-During- If you need some more Gumdrops try using the code "Tapioca" Those'll help you finish this up: Collect 200,000 from Red flowers... 200,000 goo from the Pumpkin Patch... And 200,000 goo from the Cactus Field. -Completion- Gummy Bee says it's starting to feel close to you too! That means it's almost time... Just 3 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg].

Artillery Lessons: Blue Cannon My primary objective is to make everything SWEETER. It may not seem that way when I'm being so strict, hahaha! I'm someone who understands that to get anything done you've got to be POWERFUL. I use the power of my Gummy Cannon to enforce my will on the universe! You are on your way to doing the same! Next up: Collect 100 Honey Tokens... Collect 300,000 goo from Blue flowers... Collect 300,000 goo from the Rose Field and Pine Tree Forest... And use the Blue Cannon 40 times!

-During- There is no greater force in the universe than my Gummy Army. All things fall to the slow, viscous march of my gooey might. Keep working, you're part of my cause! Collect 100 Honey Tokens... Collect 300,000 goo from Blue flowers... Collect 300,000 goo from the Rose Field and Pine Tree Forest... And use the Blue Cannon 40 times! -Completion- Gelatinous judgement is upon us!!! All unsweet things must let my goo seep in or be banished from existence! What's that Gummy Bee? You see our glorious gooey victory approaching fast? I see it too!!!! Just 2 more quests...

Goo-ing Goo-mmando I like it sweet, the mobs like it SOUR! That will not do... oh no no. "Put an end to the beasts once and for all!" Gummy Bee whispers in my ear. My sweet little bee always knows best, HAH! You - my loyal recruit - are you ready for a sweet little bee of your own?? PROVE YOURSELF TO ME, UNSWEET MEATY CREATURE! Collect 500,000 goo from White flowers... Use the Blue and Yellow Cannons 20 times each... And defeat 10 Mantises, 10 Scorpions, and 3 Werewolves.

-During- There's nothing squishy or sweet about those vile creatures! They work for the forces of SALT, SOUR, AND MEAT. Not in my GUMMY epoch... no sir... Collect 500,000 goo from White flowers... Use the Blue and Yellow Cannons 20 times each... And defeat 10 Mantises, 10 Scorpions, and 3 Werewolves. -Completion- Gummy Bee! Look! Our soldier is beginning the final transformation!!! As you collect the GOO, the GOO also collects YOU! Just 1 more quests and I'll know your transformation is complete...

Candy Conquest AHHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! Look Gummy Bee - it's almost ours! Not just the mountain, but the beekeepers too. Well trained soldiers of the Gummy Empire! There's only one thing left for YOU to do... Hatch a Gummy Bee of your own! Then, just like me, you'll never be alone. You'll never be lost. Gummy Bee will always guide you with it's gooey gifts! All you need to do is finally finish globulating this unGOO-dly mountain. Collect 750,000 goo... Collect 75,000 goo from the Strawberry Field, Dandelion Field, Spider Field... ...Pineapple Patch, and Pumpkin Patch... Collect 250 Honey Tokens... And use the Slingshot, Yellow Cannon, and Blue Cannon 30 times each.

-During- BOOM! GLUGSPLUGGLUGLGLGOOL. SPLAT SPLAT SPLAAAAT. By now you ought to speak MY language! Collect 750,000 goo... Collect 75,000 goo from the Strawberry Field, Dandelion Field, Spider Field... ...Pineapple Patch, and Pumpkin Patch... Collect 250 Honey Tokens... And use the Slingshot, Yellow Cannon, and Blue Cannon 30 times each. -Completion- Gummy Bee says "We are done here." Not so fast sweet little bee! YOU, beekeeper, answer me honestly... How sweet is your soul? How squishy is your mind??? When you close your eyes, do you see the undulating waves of PINK and TEAL? Of course you do!!!!!!!!! So take it now, hatch it quick and let it lead you - this [Gummy Bee Egg]! The universe is big, and so much of it is still ungummied... So much left to absorb into my empire! HAH! I trust you will maintain the rule of goo here. GOO-DSPEED GUMMY SOLDIER!

Conclusion Huh? Gummy Bee... what's gotten into you??? ...Yes I know this place is the perfect place for a Gummy Bee now... But we're not looking for a place to rest! You've always told me the GOO MUST SPREAD!! It's time to go. OH. You, soldier, listen here: Why don't you and your Gummy Bee go help out the other recruits? The more Gummy Bees on the mountain, the more you help our cause.

Gummy Bee and I have been watching your progress. You've crafted our gear, and begun your march down the sweet and sticky path of a Gummy Soldier. GOO-d decision, beekeeper. Now PROVE yourself to me! A new year, a GOO YEAR, has begun! Your goo year's resolution: Prepare the beacon at once.

-Completion-

GOO-d work, soldier! The beacon is nearly charged! Gummy Bee, initiate confiGOOration sequence. Aligning sugar signals... proceeding with pectin protocol... HAHAH! The Gummy Beacon is online! While my Gummy Bees aid you in a swift and brutally goo-ful blitz! Bee Bear was a FOOL to attempt Beesmas this late! It ends now! Let's usher in the GOO YEAR with a BANG!

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Gummy Bear was originally the traveling bear for the Gummy Invasion event, spanning from May 26 to June 24, 2018 (30 days, or 4 weeks and 2 days). He gave 15 quests with a final reward of a Gummy Bee Egg. He came back in the 2018-11-25 Update.
  • Onett added 1 more week to the Gummy Bear's timer when he first arrived because many players requested an extension.
  • Gummy Bear uses the Levitation Animation Pack.
  • Gummy Bear is one of two bears (the other being Shadow Bear) to float, rather than stand on the ground.
  • Like all of the permanent bears (except Spirit Bear and Dapper Bear), he also has his own Bear Morph. Unlike them, the player doesn't need a Bear Bee to get it, but rather it can be activated by Gummy Mask's Gummy Morph Passive Ability.
  • Gummy Bear is the only traveling bear to have a morph of his own.
  • Gummy Bear brought the following during his visit to the mountain:
  • A Gummy Bee, which could have been seen flying around him.
    • Gummy Bear was the first bear to introduce his own bee, with Bee Bear being the second, introducing Festive Bee, and Robo Bear being the third, introducing Digital Bee.
  • A Gummy Cannon, which he used to fire Gumdrops at fields and the only cannon the player is unable to use for transportation.
  • The Gumdrop Shop where the player could buy gumdrops with Tickets (which was moved to its current position near Panda Bear).
  • In total, the players could have received up to 31 tickets from his quests.
  • Gummy Bear is translucent, like the candy he is named after. (His colors of pink and teal, on the other hand, don't resemble any of the colors of classic gummy bear candy.)
  • Gummy Bear is the first and currently only bear to have colors unnatural to their real-life counterpart.
  • Gummy Bear gave a code in the dialogue of one of his last quests "Peace Through Goo-nity", which was the "Tapioca" code.
  • Spirit Bear has stated that Gummy Bear was made out of gumdrops. In addition, according to his dialogue, he and his Gummy Bee are made of the same goo.
  • Gummy Bear, Tunnel Bear and Onett were "Naughty" during the Beesmas Event, as stated by Bee Bear.
  • Gummy Bear was featured in the "Dance Party" advert.
  • Gummy Bear appears in the Goo Badge for its icon.
  • He was voted as the strongest bear in Onett’s StrawPoll voting.[1]
  • He is also the first and only quest-giver that can kill the player.
  • He is the second bear out of three bears that can kill the player, the first being Tunnel Bear and the third being Snowbear.
  • Gummy Bear, Sun Bear and Bee Bear have all had a second visit to the mountain, but Gummy Bear is the only one to stay permanently (for now).
  • Gummy Bear was the first bear to require the usage of transportation devices (cannons and the Slingshot) to complete his quests.
  • Gummy Bear is one of four NPCs to have moved locations, with the other three being Honey Bee, Bubble Bee Man, and Sun Bear.

docs.title: Gummy Bee Claimer
docs.text:
The Gummy Bee Claimer (called the Gummy Bee Egg Claim in Bee Swarm Simulator) is a platform that can be found beyond the Ant Gate. It's located on a ledge near the Ant Challenge and the hives. It can be reached by going through the gap behind the Top Ant Exterminators Leaderboard, going on top of the Ant Gate, or by walking on top of the hives to the egg claim.

The player can combine 2,500 Gumdrops here in order to receive a Gummy Bee Egg, once.

docs.title: Claiming the Egg
docs.text:
Standing on the white platform prompts players with a message saying, "Combine 2500 Gumdrops into a Gummy Bee" if they haven't claimed a Gummy Bee Egg. If the player already owns one, the text saying, "You Already Own a Gummy Bee" is displayed.

Whenever a player forms a Gummy Bee Egg, a slight remix of "gbtune1" (the music played around the Gummy Bee Claimer and in Gummy Bear's Lair) is played throughout the map and a server-wide announcement is made reading: 🎉 {Username} has formed a Gummy Bee 🎉

docs.title: Teleporting to the Lair
docs.text:
Standing on the Gummy Bee model without the Goo Hotshot badge prompts the player with " Only Goo Hotshots can hear Gummy Bee...

Using gumdrops when this message is shown will not teleport the player to Gummy Bear's Lair. If the player has the Goo Hotshot badge, standing on the model prompts the player with: The Gummy Bee wants Gumdrops

Using Gumdrops while standing on the model with Goo Hotshot teleports the player to Gummy Bear's Lair. A Gummy Bee is not required to enter the lair.

Gummy Bee is a Colorless Event bee. It can be purchased for 2,500 Gumdrops from the Gummy Bee Claimer.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a Star Treat, Gingerbread Bears or Aged Gingerbread Bears.

Gummy Bee likes the Pineapple Patch, Mountain Top Field, and the Stump Field. It dislikes the Pumpkin Patch.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• There is a model of the Gummy Bee on the Gummy Bee Claimer. Using gumdrops right after touching it and receiving the message; "The Gummy Bee wants gumdrops" will teleport the player to Gummy Bear's Lair. The player must have the Goo Hotshot Badge to enter the lair, or else there is a message that says "Only Goo Hotshots can hear Gummy Bee...".
  • Gummy Bee is the only Event bee that doesn't have extra body parts.
  • Gummy Bee and Fireflies share the same face, which resembles Basic Bee's face.
  • The Gummy Bee is the fourth Event bee to be released in an Update.
  • This bee was also the first bee to ever be a prize for completing the Quests of a Traveling Bear.
  • It was also the third bee to have been unobtainable for a while.
  • The Gummy Bee, Bear Bee, Tabby Bee, Puppy Bee, Festive Bee, Digital Bee, and Windy Bee are the only Event bees which can be a First Edition Bee.
  • This is the only bee that is translucent.
  • The Gummy Bee was once obtainable through completing all 15 quests of Gummy Bear.
  • Before the 2019-04-05 Update, the player could buy Gummy Bee in the Ticket Tent for 500 Tickets.
  • Festive Bee took the place of Gummy Bee in the Ticket Tent after the 2019-04-05 Update.
  • The Gummy Bee and Diamond Bee are the only bees that have a sparkle effect that surrounds their bodies.
  • Gummy Bee emits a faint light from its eyes that can be easily seen in dark places.
  • This is the only Event bee to have a Mask based on it, the Gummy Mask.
  • The other bees that have a mask based off them are Honey Bee, Diamond Bee, Demon Bee, Bubble Bee, and Fire Bee.
  • Gummy Bee is the third bee in the game to at some point cost a currency besides tickets, the first being Bear Bee (Robux), the second being Vicious Bee (Stingers), and the fourth being Windy Bee (Cloud Vials).
  • This bee, Bear Bee, Festive Bee, Photon Bee, and Tabby Bee are the only bees whose signature abilities are directly buffed by being gifted.
  • If it were to be bought by buying gumdrops from the Gumdrop Shop, it would cost 834 Tickets, with 2 gumdrops left over.
  • When Gummy Morph is active, this bee has the highest base attack, an attack of 303 being about 30 times the base attack of Lion Bee.
  • Gummy Bee can find two stickers when in a specific field:
  • Gummy Bee has a chance to find a Launching Rocket Sticker in the Clover Field.
  • Gummy Bee has a very rare chance to find a Yellow Sticky Hand Sticker in the Sunflower Field.
  • In the in-game stat menu for Gummy Bee, its convert amount is stated to be 720 more than the normal amount (80). However, it is actually 620 more.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• In order to craft this item, a total of 100,000,000,000 honey, 168,750 blueberries, 200,000 pineapples, 168,750 strawberries, 250 magic beans, and 16,250 royal jellies are needed. Also, keep in mind that crafting all the glue, glitter, red extracts, and blue extracts require a total of 6,250 minutes, which is equivalent to 104.16 hours or 4.3 days (minus drops from mobs and quest rewards and using tickets to speed crafting.) If crafting gumdrops and moon charms are included, in total the crafting would take 156,250 minutes, or 2,604.16 hours, or 108.5 days. Added together, it would take 162,500 minutes, or 2,708.8 hours, or 112.8 days. The gumdrops, strawberries, magic beans, and royal jelly amount is for crafting the items required to craft the Gummy Boots.
  • These are the first boots to have a passive ability, as the Coconut Clogs were not in the game when the Gummy Boots were added.
  • These are the first boots that could not be obtained by Sun Bear, followed by the Coconut Clogs.
  • This, the Gummy Mask, and Shell Amulets are the only accessories that give a goo buff.
  • Behind the Gummy Boots figure in the shop in Gummy Bear's Lair, there is a glitter token.
  • The player needed this or the Gummy Mask in order to talk to Gummy Bear for his Beesmas quest.
  • The Gummy Boots were necessary if the player wanted to give Gummy Bear a present.
  • Before the 2021-12-26 update, these boots were the most expensive item in terms of honey, excluding hive slots.
  • These still remain the most expensive pair of boots available to purchase.
  • Initially, the Goo Trail passive ability covered only one flower, directly underneath the player, in goo. This has been buffed to the nearest 5 flowers.
  • During the release of the Gummy Boots, it costed 999 glue, 300 glitter, 300 red extracts, and 300 blue extracts in order to be crafted. However, the price was later nerfed to 500 glue, 250 glitter, 250 red extracts, and 250 blue extracts on the 2021-12-26 update. Everyone who bought the Gummy Boots before the update were refunded the extra items when Beesmas 2021 was released.
  • Unlike other items like the Diamond Mask, the Gummy Mask, and the Demon Mask, the Gummy Boots do not require another item to 'inherit' the passive, rather having two passives regardless of whether the player has bought the Coconut Clogs. This makes it one of the only two items to have this characteristic, the other being the Coconut Canister, as it's the first and only bag to have passives.

The Gummy Mask is a mask available for purchase in Gummy Bear's Lair. It can be reached by touching the Gummy Bee model on the Gummy Bee Claimer and using gumdrops if the player has obtained the Goo Hotshot badge.

Crafting Ingredients 5B Honey

250 Glues 100 Enzymes 100 Oils 100 Glitter 1 Satisfying Vial

Once 30 regular gumdrops are used or 10 Ability Tokens from Gummy Bee are collected, Gummy Mask's passive ability (Gummy Morph) activates.

The appearance of the Gummy Mask has a teal gumdrop on top emitting tiny bubbles. Below that is a pink dome with a neon teal disc and a pink disc underneath. The Gummy Bee face is placed on a pink barrier surrounding the player's face.

  • The passive is activated every 20 Mark Tokens. When it does, 300% of the player's total Hive Convert Amount will be converted and scattered into honey tokens, which cannot be collected through a Token Link (visible only to the player, Honey Tokens last one minute). The passive has a cooldown of two minutes before being able to be used again.
  • +Passive: Gummy Morph:
  • The Gummy Mask will trigger every 30 gumdrops used OR 10 Gummy Bee ability tokens collected (+1 stack per gumdrops used, +3 stacks every Gummy Bee ability). When it triggers, it will turn you into Gummy Bear, your Gummy Bee will glow and leave a trail. In addition, the field will be fully covered in goo. As Gummy Bear, you will gain +75% goo, instantly converting all of it, and have increased jump power and player speed. As Gummy Bee glows, it will gather 1000% more pollen, gain +300 attack, and move 200% faster for 10 seconds. This passive does not have any cooldown time.

docs.title: Gummyballer
docs.text:
This piece of content contains information obtained through datamining.

Due to the nature of the information, details may be inaccurate or outdated.

Datamined information: How much pollen Gummyballer collects on its own. — December 19th, 2024

Gummyballer Overview Price 1,500 Glue, 2,000 Gumdrops, 50 Caustic Waxes, 50 Super Smoothies, 5 Turpentines, 3 Satisfying Vials, 10T Honey Shop Gummy Bear's Lair Pollen Collection Range 29 Flowers Collecting Pattern Ball collectedyou (facing up) Collecting Time 1 Base Collection 9 Flowers Single Double Triple Large Star White 22.5 45 67.5 90 112.5 Red 22.5 45 67.5 90 112.5 Blue 22.5 45 67.5 90 112.5 Special Multiplier(s): Takes goo, if there is goo when collecting pollen it increases the stack of your gummyball.

The Gummyballer is a tool that can be crafted in Gummy Bear's Lair.

Crafting Ingredients 10T Honey

1,500 Glues 2,000 Gumdrops 50 Caustic Waxes 50 Super Smoothies 5 Turpentines 3 Satisfying Vials

It collects 9 pollen from 29 patches in 1 second and boosts it by x2.5. It has an average base pollen collection rate of 652.5 pollen per second.

Every swing absorbs any collected goo and removes it from the flower. In return, it gives 12 seconds of "Gummyball" buff with a max of 1000 stacks. The amount of Gummyball stacks per collected goo patch is proportional to how fresh the goo is (the more faded the goo is, the less it gives stack to the Gummyball). The more Gummyball stacks collected, the bigger the ball on the collector becomes, along with a stronger aura around it and up to a 1.1x white pollen boost.

Upon reaching the max stack of Gummyball (1000) or swinging with the collector above the ground (by jumping) while being inside a field, a Gummyball will launch forward from the player's faced direction and bounce around the border of the field. It leaves a trail of goo behind and collects pollen from the flowers it hits (collection and goo spread depends on the size of the Gummyball). It will also grab any ability or honey token and pop bubbles along the way. The larger the initial Gummyball stacks when it's launched, the larger the Gummyball will start as and the longer the Gummyball will last.

The Gummyball rewards the player with "Gummyball Combo", giving 2 stacks for hitting a wall, 1 per ability token, 3 per honey token, 8 per mark and 30 per precise mark for 8 seconds. Gummyball combo has a max stack of 1000 and always provides a 1.1x white pollen boost and up to a 11x goo boost depending on the stack of Gummyball combo.

docs.title: Gummyball Combo Strategies
docs.text:
• Choose a narrow field and align your character perpendicular to the field border that you're facing by using the "," and "." keys with shift lock (rotates the camera by 45 degrees) If on mobile, go in straight vertical lines across the field. When aligned, launch the Gummyball at a place with lots of active marks, including the Honey Mark (+), Pollen Mark (+), Festive Mark, and Precise Mark. This will cause the ball to go back and forth and hit the mark(s) and other things that give stacks along the way without the Gummyball going to the left/right.
  • Time the Gummyball before Gummy Morph activates (at around 21/30 if gumdrops are being dropped), so it has the time to stack up before the Gummy Morph activates.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Gummyballer is the second most expensive item in the game in terms of honey, only behind The Planter Of Plenty which costs 100T Honey.
  • Its red counterpart is the Dark Scythe, and its blue counterpart is the Tide Popper. However, this tool is more expensive than its counterparts. This is likely because the Dark Scythe and Tide Popper require 250 quests to be finished from its corresponding shop owner, while the Gummyballer does not.
  • The Gummyballer is tied with the Pulsar and the Sticker-Seeker for the slowest tool in the game (in terms of how long the cooldown of each collection lasts).
  • On December 28, 2021, the Gummyballer was obtainable through an exploit that gave the Gummyballer for free, along with the Tide Popper and Dark Scythe.
  • Onett later patched this, and everybody who used this exploit had their data reset on their account.
  • Behind The Planter Of Plenty, this requires the most base resources to craft.
  • The Gummyballer's raw ingredients cost:
  • 10T Honey
  • 412,500 Blueberries
  • 412,500 Strawberries
  • 135,500 Sunflower Seeds
  • 902,500 Pineapples
  • 16,500 Bitterberries
  • 3,700 Neonberries
  • 12,500 Honeysuckles
  • 6,000 Coconuts
  • 812,700 Royal Jellies or 813B Honey
  • 2,400 Magic Beans or 48,000 Tickets
  • 3 Satisfying Vials or 36 hours of Satisfying Nectar
  • The Gummyballer is the only item to be added to Gummy Bear's Lair in an update after the lair came out.
  • This is the only tool that undergoes visual changes with its ability.
  • This is the only tool that has the ability to take goo patches from flowers.
  • In the Gummyballer's associated sticker's description, it is described as "A Gummy Soldier's weapon of choice", and is the only tool to be directly referred to as a weapon.
  • The Gummyball on the tool moves similarly to amulets, meaning it drags behind the collector's actual movement.
  • On occasion, the Gummyball will appear to be dislocated from the collector, this occurs if either the server or client ping (response delay) is at high levels.
  • The Gummyballer, along with The Planter Of Plenty, Hydroponic Planter, Heat-Treated Planter, and the Coconut Belt are currently the only five items that require Turpentines to craft, needing 5, 25, 1, 1, and 3 respectively.
  • The Gummyballer, alongside the Dark Scythe and Tide Popper are the only items without an in-game description which details its stats.
  • The Gummyballer, as well as any other item that costed more than 1 billion Honey, used to display the honey cost as the full number, rather than abbreviating it.
  • The Gummyballer used to cost 2500 gumdrops, on May 23, 2024, this was changed to 2000 gumdrops and 3 Satisfying Nectar Vials.

docs.title: Hard Wax
docs.text:
Hard Wax

"A firm hunk of beeswax. Has a 60% chance to improve a bee's Beequip."

Hard Wax is an inventory item and a type of wax added in the 2021-12-26 update that can be used on a Beequip to improve its stats. Upon usage, it has a 60% chance of improving the Beequip's stats. Hard Wax has Upgrade Value of 2.

Hard Waxes can also be used to craft tools and items, such as planters.

If giving a Hard Wax to a bee's Beequip is successful, the message pops up saying:

The Wax has Improved the Beequip!

However, if it fails, the message pops up saying:

The Wax didn't seem to help...

The Heat-Treated Planter is a reusable planter added in the 2021-12-26 update. Alone, it grows in about 12 hours and stores around 25 billion pollen. When harvested, it grants bonus Red Extracts and Enzymes. It is purchasable in the Red HQ. The player also needs to complete 150 Gifted Riley Bee quests for it to be unlocked.

docs.title: Growth, pollen and nectar
docs.text:
• Grows in 12 hours of playtime alone, and grows faster here: x1.5 in fields with red flowers. A flower-colour bonus is weighted by how much of the field is that colour.
  • Glitter used in its field speeds it up: x1.5 for one, rising in halving steps up to x2 at 6 stacks. The stacks stay on the planter until it is harvested.
  • Holds 25,000,000,000 pollen at full growth. A harvest gives capacity × growth × pollen bonus. Pollen bonus: x0.5 in fields with blue flowers, x1.5 in fields with red flowers.
  • Nectar multipliers: x1.4 Invigorating, x1.4 Motivating. On harvest it gives one Nectar type from its field, lasting grow time × growth × multiplier × 3 seconds.
  • Up to 3 bees can sip from it at once. Blue bees are x0.5 as likely to sip from it; Red bees are x1.333 as likely to sip from it.

Note: It holds 25 billion pollen, not the "around 10 billion" the shop text says.

docs.title: Puffshrooms
docs.text:
When it reaches 95% growth, it has a 22% chance to smoke and spawn 3 Puffshrooms (one at the planter and two nearby) at levels 6 to 7.

Rarity odds:

  • Common 70%
  • Rare 22.5%
  • Epic 7.25%
  • Legendary 0.24%
  • Mythic 0.01%

docs.title: Drops
docs.text: A full harvest gives 35 item tokens. Harvesting early gives fewer, in proportion to growth, but always at least 1. Tokens are filled in this order: guaranteed items (full harvests only), then field rules, then random picks from the pool below.

docs.title: Guaranteed
docs.text:
On every full harvest:

  • 1 Red Extract
  • 1 Enzymes
  • 3 Ticket

docs.title: Field rules
docs.text:
• In a red field (Mushroom, Strawberry, Rose, Pepper): +1 Red Extract (+3 if full).
  • Full harvests in Mushroom, Strawberry, Rose, then Pepper: 100 Red Extract, once every 30 days. Otherwise each full harvest has a 2.5% chance of 100 Red Extract.
  • Full in the Pineapple Patch 3 times in a row: 100 Enzymes, once every 30 days. Each full harvest also has a 2.5% chance of 100 Enzymes.
  • Full in the Mushroom Field: 1 Loaded Dice (once a day). Blue Flower Field: 1 Swirled Wax (every 30 days). Coconut Field: 1 Caustic Wax (every 30 days). Cactus Field: 10 Stingers.
  • Full in the Pine Tree Forest: 3.5% chance of the Dark Flame sticker. Pumpkin Patch: 3.5% chance of the Jack-O-Lantern sticker.

docs.title: Highest Robo Party Cake Rank
docs.text: The Highest Robo Party Cake Rank is one of the 64 leaderboards in the game. It was added in the 2023.04.01 ipdate. It is located near the Rose Field, to the right side of Robo Party Cake. To summon a Robo Party, the player must complete Robo Bear's Beesmas quest. Each time the player beats their Robo Party, their Robo Party Cake Rank increases by one. There are 100 ranks in total and each rank requires more party points to achieve than the one before. The player with the highest rank is displayed at the top of the leaderboard. There is no white pad on this leaderboard.

docs.text:
This leaderboard is not in Re://:Swarm. The only Snowbear leaderboard is All-Time Snowbear Kills.

The Highest Snowbear Level is one of the 64 leaderboards in the game. It was added in the 2020-12-25 update and returned in every Beesmas thereafter. It is next to the Spider Field, Bamboo Field, Gumdrop Shop, Snowbear Summoner, Basic Bee Gate, and Panda Bear. To summon a Snowbear, the player must complete Panda Bear's Beesmas quest to gain access to the summoner, allowing them to use the Snowbear Summoner. Each time the player defeats the Snowbear, its level increases by one. The leaderboard displays the players who have the highest top 100 Snowbear levels. This leaderboard does not have a white pad to stand on.
