docs.title: Dialogue
docs.text: Panda Bear gives plenty of information in his quest dialogues. Most of the information he gives is not found anywhere else in-game.

docs.title: Main Quests
docs.text:
Quest Dialogue Lesson On Ladybugs Dangerous creatures all around us... You have to be TOUGH to make it up the mountain. Your bees will need to know how to FIGHT! I'll put them to the test. First trial: Defeat a Ladybug!

-During-

Ladybugs are weak! Come back when you've defeated one.

-Completion-

That was just the beginning! By the way, have you noticed your bees returning to the hive on their own? They're going back to sleep and recover their energy. Every time a bee gathers pollen or attacks and [sic] enemy, it loses 1 energy. You can see how much energy your bee has by clicking on it's [sic] cell in the hive. Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

Rhino Rumble The Rhino Beetles around here are aggressive and territorial. Fortunately for us, they're pretty WEAK! But are they weak enough for a noob like you? Let's find out. Defeat 2 Rhino Beetles.

-During-

Rhino Beetles thrive in fields of blue flowers. Come back when you've defeated 2 of them.

-Completion-

Guess you're not a newbie! Here's a tip: when your bees attack an enemy, they use 1 energy. When they run out of energy, they have to return to the hive to sleep. You can see how much energy your bees have by clicking on your [sic] cell in the hive. Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

Beetle Battle So you can handle a few Ladybugs and Rhino Beetles... I've bonked HUNDREDS of them. If you want to reach my level, you'll need to level up your bees. If a bee is lower level than a bug it's attacking, it will probably MISS! Level up your bees or they won't be able to fight! Now let's kick your lessons up a notch. Destroy 3 Ladybugs AND 3 Rhino Beetles.

-During-

That's right, 3 of each! Come back when you've defeated 3 Ladybugs and 3 Rhino Beetles.

-Completion-

Good work. We can start your REAL training soon. Remember, you better start leveling up your bees! As the monsters become higher level, your bees need to become higher level too. If the monster's level is higher than a bee's, the bee's attacks will MISS. Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

Spider Slayer As you work your way up the mountain the monsters get TOUGHER. You can run from it, but can you slay it? I'm talking about the Spider! If you can beat it, I'll give you a jar of [Royal Jelly]. [Royal Jelly] can be used to transform a bee's type. It is useful for discovering new types of bees. Come back when you've defeated the Spider.

-During-

The spider is fast and deadly! And because it's level 3 [sic level 4], your level 1 and level 2 bees [sic and level 3] will have a hard time attacking it. You may need to level up your bees. Come back when you've defeated it.

-Completion-

Isn't it creepy? The way it scuttles out of its cave. It used to bother me, but not anymore... I can slay the Spider with a single bonk! As a reward, here's a jar of [Royal Jelly]. Use it on a bee's honeycomb cell and they will instantly transform into a new type. If you're lucky, you'll get a bee who knows how to FIGHT, for example... Brave Bee stings with the power of 5 bees... Rage Bee temporarily boosts the attack power of your entire swarm... Lion Bee, he's a [sic] the toughest of all... He strikes with the force of 8 Bees!!! When you're ready to continue your training, I'll be waiting.

Ladybug Bonker Do you have what it takes to become a REAL bug bonker like me? If you can prove it, I'll give you a [Silver Egg]. [Silver Eggs] always hatch into a Rare, Epic, Legendary, or Mythic bee! Complete my next 4 quests to me you're worth it! First: Defeat 15 Ladybugs.

-During-

[Silver Eggs] are rare. You want this egg, you got to prove yourself. Come back when you've defeated 15 Ladybugs.

-Completion-

Alright! 3 more quests and the [Silver Egg] is yours! Make sure you're leveling up your bees. It gives them more energy, and allows them to attack higher level enemies. You'll need that as your training progresses.

Spider Slayer 2 When you defeat an enemy, it takes a while for it to come back. They have to regain their strength. So this might take a while... Defeat 5 Spiders.

-During-

The spider cave is a mystery. How deep into the mountain does it go? Just how many spiders actually live in there? Come back when you've defeated 5 spiders.

-Completion-

Took you long enough! Alright, 2 more quests and the [Silver Egg] is yours!

Rhino Wrecking Did you think your training would start to slow down? Figured you've already reached the limit? Not so fast! Let's kick things up another notch! Next up: Defeat 20 Rhino Beetles.

-During-

Before I got here, this mountain was a mess. For every Ladybug you see today, there were 50. And the Werewolves back then made today's Werewolf look like a BABY. Come back when you've defeated 20 Rhino Beetles.

-Completion-

Alright! 1 more quests [sic] and the [Silver Egg] is yours.

Final Showdown This is it... The FINAL SHOWDOWN before you get your [Silver Egg]! Let's put it all together!!!! Defeat 20 Ladybugs, 20 Rhino Beetles, and 10 Spiders!

-During-

20 Ladybugs. 20 Rhino Beetles. 10 Spiders.

-Completion-

I'm almost impressed! You are worthy of this [Silver Egg]. Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

Werewolf Hunter Beyond the 15 Bee gate, the enemies get tough. You have to get TOUGHER! Bonking beetles is one thing. Slaying WEREWOLVES is another. The Werewolf is level 7 - your lower level bees won't stand a chance. Remember: You can see how much bond your bees need to level up. Just click on its cell back at the hive. Come back when you've leveled your bees and defeated a Werewolf!

-During-

Werewolves move fast and slash with their claws. You'll need to stay alert and dodge their attacks! Come back when you've defeated a Werewolves. [sic]

-Completion-

Now that's what I called a battle! Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

Skirmish with Scorpions Scorpions are equipped with many means of attacking. They've got pinsers [sic] that can crush through trees... And a stinger that can pierce through ROCK! Can you handle that? Defeat 15 Scorpions [sic]

-During-

SNIP SNAP! One wrong move and the scorpion's will break you in half. Come back when you've defeated 15 of them.

-Completion-

You're something else! Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

Mantis Massacre Mantises strike fast from far away. They're SNEAKY and DEADLY! Study their movements to learn their ways. Defeat 20 mantises.

-During-

Mantises are as smart as they are deadly. Come back when you've defeated 20.

-Completion-

BZZZRAW! Czk czk czk czk! That's the cry of the mantis! Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

The REAL Final Showdown Let's put it all together. Let's BONK UP THE MOUNTAIN! Complete this quest and I'll give you something REALLY special. Defeat 10 Ladybugs, 10 Rhino beetles, 10 Spiders... 10 Scorpions, 10 Mantises, and 5 Werewolves! YOU HEARD ME RIGHT, GO GET EM.

-During-

10 Ladybugs. 10 Rhino Beetles. 10 Spiders. 10 Scorpions. 10 Mantises. 5 Werewolves. Complete that and I’ve got something special for you. GO GO GO GO GO!

-Completion-

I'm harsh but I'm honest: You and your bees are certified TOUGH! So tough that you deserve my most prized possession... A (Gold Egg). It has been a pleasure watching you and your bees grow stronger. But for now, your lessons are complete. Never stop fighting! PEACE! ... Wait... What's that?

Ant Arrival ... What?!?! Back there, beyond the 20 bee gate... I was so focused on the mountain that I forgot the threat from below. The ANTS are back! Well, I've done it before and we'll do it again: We'll exterminate that mud-mound! This is BEE and BEAR territory! Take this pass and attempt the Ant challenge. Here's how the Ant challenge works: Gather pollen and honey to fill up the meter on the ant hill. When it reaches the top, ants will shoot out! Bonk as many as those puny bugs as you can before the timer runs out. Each ant you defeat gives you one score point. The higher your score, the better you'll be rewarded! Come back when you've defeated 10 Ants.

-During-

They attack in waves and move in coordinated patterns. They're unlike any other monsters on this mountain! But that won't save them. Come back when you've defeated 10 Ants.

-Completion-

They have some nerve showing up here again. And it looks like this time there's more of them. IT WON'T BE ENOUGH! They didn't count on you: our secret weapon. Talk to me again when you're ready to take on more ants.

Winged Wack Attack Ants... they're weak and small, but tricky and crafty... Just like bees, they come in many forms, and work as a team to overwhelm their enemies. Flying Ants are FAST and use their wings to leap-attack from far away! Think you can out-maneuver them? Defeat 15 Ants and 10 Flying Ants.

-During-

The ants are highly unpredictable. They switch up their tactics, and send out different types of ants all the time. You will need to be adaptable. Defeat 15 Ants and 10 Flying Ants.

-Completion-

Every time you attempt an Ant Challenge, you steal back some stuff the ants have taken from the mountain. This always include an [Ant Amulet]! Amulets are special items that which offer different types of boosts. You never know exactly what boosts you're going to get. The more ants you defeat, the better your [Ant Amulet] will tend to be. One day you may even earn yourself a top-of-the-line [Diamond Ant Amulet]! Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

Fire Fighter Each wave of ants become tougher. After a while, they send out the big guns. One of their trickier threats is the Fire Ant. It ignites flowers as it walks through them. Step on a burning flower and SZZZIZZAHH: just like that you're burnt to a crisp. We can't let them burn our flowers. Defeat 15 Fire Ants and report back.

-During-

You can't bonk fire. That makes it a truly challenging foe... But NO FOE is challenging enough to stop us! Defeat 15 Fire Ants and report back.

-Completion-

Some items offer damage reduction to help you survive more hits from monsters. But those items won't save you from BURNING! As you've seen, the only way to survive Fire Ants is to be quick, nimble and smart about how you move. Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

Army Ant Assault HUT, 2, 3, 4, HUT, 2, 3, 4... That's the marching song of the Ant Army! If you spot an ant wearing a helmet... you better pay attention. Those are Army Ants! Their thick helmets reduce all incoming damage. To break through them, you'll need to hit extra hard. Defeat 25 Ants and 15 Army Ants, then report back.

-During-

Although they switch things up, there's a pattern to the ants' tactics. They tend to send similar ants out in waves. Keep track of the pattern to help you determine how far you need to go to reach certain ants. Come back when you've defeat 25 Ants and 15 Army Ants.

-Completion-

Don't get cocky, this is just the beginning! The ants increase in level as you get further in the challenge. You'll need to make sure your bees are leveled up too if you want to really get far. Take this for now. Come back when you're ready for more.

Colossal Combat When the ants start to panic they send out their secret weapon... The GIANT ANT!!! This colossal beast has more health than 10 other ants COMBINED. It moves slowly, but don't let that fool you... It's the BADDEST bug around! Defeat 10 of them and report back. And to prove you're ready to move on, get a high score of 50 in the Ant Challenge. After that, I've got a special reward for you...

-During-

Years ago, all ants were the size of Giant Ants. And the Giant Ants back then were the size of the mountain! It was hard work, but I managed to bonk them down to size. Come back after you’ve defeated 10 Giant Ants and achieved a score of 50 in the Ant Challenge.

-Completion-

That's what I like to see! But this is just the beginning... We've won the battle but not the war! Are you ready to become a full time ant exterminator? It'll be tough, but I'll make it worth your while. I recently received some new special eggs during my own monster slaying rounds. And I'm willing to give them to you if you help me fight off these ants! Here's a little payment up front: a [Diamond Egg]! [Diamond Eggs] ALWAYS hatch into Legendary Bees. And if you complete my next 5 quests, I have something even better for you... A [Star Egg]! [Star Eggs] always hatch into a Gifted Bee you don't already have. Gifted Bees have increased stats, offer bonuses to your ENTIRE hive... And allow you to receive free Royal Jellies from the Star Hall above the Noob Bear's shop! Come talk to me again when you're ready for the REAL fight.

Eager Exterminator So you want that [Star Egg], huh? Or maybe you just want to keep this mountain safe! Either way, you've got a LOT of work to do. We're being assaulted from multiple fronts! I'll need you to defend us from threats both above and below. Defeat 50 Ants, 15 Ladybugs, 5 Spiders and 1 Werewolf.

-During-

HUT, 2, 3, 4, HUT, 2, 3, 4... The ants use their marching song to coordinate their movements... That's what separates them from the lone hunters like the Spider and Werewolf. Come back when you've defeated 50 Ants, 15 Ladybugs, 5 Spiders, and 1 Werewolf.

-Completion-

Good work. Here's a tip: when you see one of the doors blink red during the Ant Challenge... That means a LAWNMOWER is about to strike! This viscious(sic) machine may be the FASTEST and DEADLIEST foe you've faced yet. And to make it worse, it's immune to all attacks! When you see it coming, just get out of its way. Take this for now. Complete 4 more quests to earn yourself the [Star Egg].

Leaper Lickin' The most agile foes are the deadliest. If you let your guard down for just a moment... sRAAAAAHHH! They've leapt from a far [sic]- You are already dead. This next quest will put your reaction time to the test. Defeat 30 Flying Ants, 15 Mantises, and 3 Werewolves.

-During-

I can leap farther than any Werewolf or Mantis. When my adrenaline is flowing, I can even jump from here past the 25 Bee Gate. Come back when you've defeated 30 Flying Ants, 15 Mantises, and 3 Werewolves.

-Completion-

Looks like you came back relatively unscathed. Take this for now. Complete 3 more quests to earn yourself the [Star Egg].

Colossal Combat 2 To take your combat to the next level, your bees will need to master Critical Hits. A Critical Hit deals massively increased damage to an enemy. Use the ability "Focus'" raise your critical chance. And earn Battle Badges to increase the power of your Critical Hits. Next up: Defeat 50 Ants, 20 Giant Ants, 20 Scorpions, and 40 Rhino Beetles.

-During-

The more Critical Power you have, the more valuable Critical Hits become. Come back when you've defeated 50 Ants, 20 Giant Ants, 20 Scorpions, and 40 Rhino Beetles.

-Completion-

The ants aren't slowing down and we won't either! Take this for now. Complete 2 more quests to earn yourself the [Star Egg].

Outrageous Onslaught Listen up! Here are some insider tips that'll take your bug bonking to the next level: First, you'll need to obtain a Gifted Brave and a Gifted Rage bee. What makes them so special? They rally your entire swarm, permanently increases the attack of ALL your bees by 1! Second, you should hunt for amulets that increase bee attack. {Diamond Ant Amulets] and [King Beetle Amulets] both have a chance to boost bee attack. I'll talk more about those later... Now get back out there! Defeat 100 Ants, 50 Army Ants,30 Ladybugs, 20 Mantises, 5 Werewolves.

-During-

Some bonuses from amulets are rarer than others. You'll need to hunt for many amulets to obtain the best ones. Defeat 100 Ants, 50 Army Ants,30 Ladybugs, 20 Mantises, 5 Werewolves.

-Completion-

Good work. Here's another tip: The Rage Bee's ability can stack up to 3 times. To progress farther in the Ant Challenge, you'll need to keep Rage consistently stacked. Keeping a few Rage Bees in your hive will help you with the challenges to come. Take this for now. 1 more quest and the [Star Egg] is yours.

Royal Rumble We don't believe in royalty on this mountain! If you want respect you have to EARN it. There's one creature who doesn't agree: The King Beetle. He's the BOLDEST, BRASHEST bug around. Thinks he was born better than the rest! He's always stealing our Royal Jelly and stashing it away under the Clover Field... It's time to put him in his place! If you're lucky, you might even obtain a [King Beetle Amulet]. My [Star Egg] is yours if you complete this quest: Defeat 100 Fire Ants, 30 Giant Ants, 1 King Beetle... And obtain a score of 75 or more in the Ant Challenge.

-During-

[Star Eggs] always hatch into a Gifted Bee you don't already have. Why's that important? Because you can't obtain the same Gifted Hive Bonus twice! In addition, you require different types of gifted bees to generate [Star Amulets]. That means it's best to have a variety of Gifted Bees. Now, hurry up if you want this [Star Egg]: Defeat 100 Fire Ants, 30 Giant Ants, 1 King Beetle... And obtain a score of 75 or more in the Ant Challenge.

-Completion-

You gave that King Beetle a ROYAL WRECKING! And you've kept the ants at bay... for now... So I'm willing to give you this: my [Star Egg]. Hatch it and you will always obtain a Gifted Bee you don't already have. After that, go check out the Star Hall above the Noob Bear's shop. For every Gifted Bee type you have, you can claim 1 Royal Jelly every day. And once you've obtained enough Gifted Bee types, you can generate [Star Amulets]. But don't take too long - we aren't finished yet.

Ultimate Ant Annihilation 1 Are you ready for your biggest challenge? Think you're tough enough to take out those ants once and for all?? If you can - I've got something better than the [Star Egg] to give you. A [Star Treat]! Feed one to a bee, and it will immediately become Gifted! This lets you choose whichever Gifted Hive Bonus you want. And it's the ONLY way to obtain Gifted Event Bees! If you want this [Star Treat] here's what you'll need to do: Eradicate that ant hill once and for all and BONK UP THE MOUNTAIN! Quest #1 of 5: Defeat 250 Ants, 10 Spiders, and 5 Werewolves.

-During-

The Tabby Bee was raised by cats - which are natural born KILLERS. Feed a Tabby Bee a [Star Treat] and it becomes a Gifted Tabby Bee! Gifted Tabby Bee permanently increases the Critical Power of your entire swarm by 50%... allowing your bees to dish out even more damage. Now go out there and defeat 250 Ants, 10 Spiders, and 5 Werewolves.

-Completion-

Each individual ant is PUNY and WEAK. But together, they stand a chance of taking over the world! Lucky for us, the bees are always one step ahead. Just 4 more quests and I'll give you my [Star Treat].

Ultimate Ant Annihilation 2 Every time you defeat a King Beetle, you have a small chance of obtaining a [King Beetle Amulet]. And each King Beetle you defeat increases the average quality of the next amulet you obtain. You'll need to hunt down many King Beetles to get an optimal one! Now prepare for ROUND 2: Defeat 250 Ants, 150 Flying Ants, 50 Scorpions, and 1 King Beetle!

-During-

All monsters have a variety of items they can drop on defeat. For example, Scorpions can drop [Pineapples] and [Strawberries]... And they even have a tiny chance of dropping [Gold Eggs]! Defeating monsters is how I obtained the eggs I gave to you. Go test your luck: Defeat 250 Ants, 150 Flying Ants, 50 Scorpions, and 1 King Beetle!

-Completion-

FEEL THE BONK!!!! Just 3 more quests and I'll give you my [Star Treat].

Ultimate Ant Annihilation 3 What? Getting tired? It isn't going to get any easier! Tough it up and get ready for the main event... WE'RE IN THE END GAME NOW! Defeat 500 Ants, 150 Army Ants, 75 Mantises, and 1 King Beetle.

-During-

Defending the mountain isn't easy, but someone has to do it. Can't make honey if the ANTS take over! Go out there and defeat 500 Ants, 150 Flying Ants, 75 Mantises and 1 King Beetle.

-Completion-

Looks like my lessons are starting to pay off. You're a force to be reckoned with! Let's stay focused and close it out! Just 2 more quests and I'll give you my [Star Treat].

Ultimate Ant Annihilation 4 They're panicing [sic] now... They're throwing out everything they've got, trying to get us to back down. Call their bluff! Let's end the ants once and for all! And let's not neglect our duty to protect the fields... The Ladybugs and Rhino Beetles are weak but SNEAKY - they'll strike while you're distracted. Defeat 500 Fire Ants, 250 Flying Ants, 250 Ladybugs, 250 Rhino Beetles, and 1 King Beetle.

-During-

While you're busy taking down the ants, I'm fighting to keep other threats at bay... The mountain is constantly under threat by enemies you could never even DREAM of. You do your part, I'll do mine. Defeat 500 Fire Ants, 250 Flying Ants, 250 Ladybugs, 250 Rhino Beetles, and 1 King Beetle.

-Completion-

You're doing me proud out there. But the biggest challenge is yet to come... Complete it, and the [Star Treat] is yours.

Ultimate Ant Annihilation 5 When you first got here, you looked like a chump. You had a handful of bees, a tiny backpack... You could hardly hold your own with the beetles! But I saw the potential in you and your swarm. Here we are, after all your training... And the potential I saw has become a reality! I taught you how to FIGHT! Now I need something in return: BONK THOSE BUGS SO HARD THEY STAY OFF OUR OF OUR MOUNTAIN FOR 1,000 YEARS! And one more thing... Help me defeat another threat that's been lurking beneath the ground this whole time. Take down the Tunnel Bear! Prepare your swarm and dive into the top of the Instant Converter near Science Bear. Come back when you've finished this final quest and the [Star Treat] is yours.

-During-

We're under attack from all sides. This is no time to chat. Defeat 1000 Ants, 500 Army Ants, 100 Giant Ants... 3 King Beetles, and 1 Tunnel Bear.

-Completion-

A natural born FIGHTER just like myself! The mountain is safe for now thanks to you and your bees. I'm proud to have you as a partner in defending out home.

Here it is: your [Star Treat]! Feed it to any bee and it will immediately become Gifted. Keep training and working to grow your swarm... We're safe for now, but a new threat could surface at any time.

Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue What? You are given a choice to give a present to Panda Bear or continue talking like normal. You choose to give him a present. Oh yeah, Beesmas. What've [sic] you got here. ... WOW, an automatic monster respawn timer! Sends a notification every time the Werewolf respawns. That's a Beesmas gift I'll actually use. Thanks, I appreciate it. Oh, and here's something for you. Now let's get back to work. The bugs don't break for Beesmas. Conclusion I've got no more challenges for you! Maybe after the next update... Until then, keep training, keep fighting... Keep this mountain safe! Oh, and one more thing: "BOPMASTER." Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue 2020 Hmm... You are given a choice to give a present to Panda Bear or continue talking like normal. You choose to give him a present. A gift? Oh, that's kind of you. I'll open it now. ...(krumple krumple)... WHOA! A bamboo pull-up bar! They'll help me work on my back muscles. Well, I can't take something without giving you something too. I've got a few gifts, including the [Boxing Glove Ornament]. With that on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Bamboo Field And +5% Bee Attack Power! Stay safe out there, and Merry Beesmas.

docs.title: Red Drive Quest
docs.text:
Quest Dialogue Ready For The Red Drive? Hold on a second, what's that you've got? Is that a [White Drive]!? Hmm, so I was right... Yesterday while I was putting some Scorpions in their place [sic] I found a [Red Drive] just like yours in the Rose Field. These must be the key to activating that Robo Bear. But I don't trust that thing, not one bit... My panda-senses are telling me it'll be our TOUGHEST foe yet. Before we power it on, I'll need to TEST your MIGHT. Can you bonk over 100 ants in 5 minutes? Can you whoop the Stick Bug for over 1,000,000 points?? Are you hard enough to survive getting flung by the Windy Bee??? If not, you aren't ready for this [Red Drive].

-During-

N/A

-Completion-

Check out those Amulets. You're tough all right. But tough enough for that Robo Bear? not so sure about that... I'll give you this [Red Drive], but be warned: The Robo Bear's challenge will be the hardest one yet! You'll need to keep training to even stand a chance. So stay diligent. And good luck - you'll need it.

Quest Requirements Rewards Panda Bear's Snowbear
  • Defeat 5 Spiders.
  • Defeat 5 Vicious Bees.
  • Catch 25 Black Bloom Petals.
  • Collect 100 Snowflake Tokens.
  • Obtain 6 Blueberries to give to Panda Bear.

500,000 Honey 10 Tickets 3 Ant Passes 10 Stingers 1 Gingerbread Bear Access to summoning Snowbear

(Lost upon turning in quest) −6 Blueberries

Quest Dialogue Panda Bear's Snowbear

The Honeydays are a time of love and joy... A time where we all let our guards down... The perfect time for bugs and monsters to strike! Well, not on my watch. While others are decorating and singing, I've been working on this Snowbear. Once it's done, we'll be able to fight it to sharpen our combat skills! But it's, uh, not quite there yet. If you help me finish it, we can start some REAL training. Here's what we'll need: Defeat 5 Spiders... Defeat 5 Vicious Bees... Catch 25 [Black Bloom] Petals... Collect 100 [Snowflake] Tokens... And obtain 6 [Blueberries]... for the eyes... And the buttons.

-During-

N/A

-Completion-

Good work out there. Now let's bring this bad boy to life. A few buttons here... a few sticks there... annnnd BAM! The Snowbear's ready for action. Now you'll be able to summon a Snowbear in the Spider Field once every 90 minutes. You'll have 60 seconds to defeat it before it melts, so be prepared. They're as TOUGH as they are cold. You may even need some friends to back you up. Each time you defeat a Snowbear you summoned, the next one you summon will be bigger. They'll just keep growing, leveling up, and getting stronger. That makes them the perfect punching bags for putting your bees to the test. Oh, and they're also a great source of [Snowflakes] The higher level your Snowbear, the more [Snowflakes] you'll get by defeating it. Now train. We need to be prepared for whatever that robot has in store for us.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Battle Badge set is represented by Panda Bear.
  • Panda Bear is the only bear whose quests consist solely of defeating mobs. This may be a reference to the Kung Fu Panda. However, his 2019, 2020 and 2021 Beesmas quest does include the collection of pollen.
  • Panda Bear is the second quest giver that requires the player to defeat Tunnel Bear in his quests; the first one being Onett, the third one being Science Bear, and the fourth being Bubble Bee Man.
  • Excluding limited-time quests, he and Mother Bear are the only bears who don't require collecting pollen from fields for their quests.
  • Like many of the other quest bears, Panda Bear is aware he is in a Roblox game because, in the conclusion, he says "maybe after the next update..."
  • Panda Bear gives a total of 120 tickets when completing all of his quests.
  • In the quest “Spider Slayer 2”, he says the player needs to defeat 10 spiders, but the quest only requires 5 to complete it.
  • If the player gave a Present to Panda Bear during Beesmas 2018, he gave 5,000 honey, 1 Rage Bee jelly, 15 stingers, 10 tickets, and a x4 Bamboo Field Boost.
  • The quest “The REAL Final Showdown” used to require 10 werewolves defeated, but this was nerfed.
  • During his conclusion dialogue, he says the word "BOPMASTER", which is the name of a code of the same name (valid). He also had a code named after him called "PandaPower" (expired).
  • In his Egg Hunt quest conclusion dialogue, Panda Bear says, "Here's a marshmallow bee", indicating he was only giving one. Instead, he rewarded two.
  • Panda Bear uses the Ninja Animation Package.
  • Panda Bear can use the Roblox animation /e point.
  • Panda Bear says that Diamond Eggs always hatch into Legendary bees. This is because, before the 2019-12-23 update, Diamond Eggs could not hatch into Mythic bees.
  • In the quest 'Outrageous Onslaught', Panda Bear once said that Rage could stack up to 5 times, which was inaccurate since the latter can only stack up to 3 times since an update lowered the cap.
  • His dialogue later got updated and he now says that it can stack up to 3 times.
  • Which is also inaccurate as an update raised the cap to 4.
  • He says that the Diamond Ant Amulet is the best Ant Amulet in the quest 'Winged Wack Attack'. However, the current highest Ant Amulet tier is the Supreme Ant Amulet.
  • Panda Bear is one of the three quest givers who rewards a Star Treat on one of his quests. (The others being Mother Bear and Onett.)
  • In total, he gives 131,730,750 honey.
  • In total, he requires you to defeat 2,750 Ants, 440 Flying Ants, 115 Fire Ants, 715 Army Ants, 160 Giant Ants, 345 Rhino Beetles, 344 Ladybugs, 140 Mantises, 95 Scorpions, 41 Spiders, 20 Werewolves, 7 King Beetles, and 1 Tunnel Bear.
  • This is a total of 5173 mobs to defeat.
  • If you were to defeat every mob, you would have to wait a total of 1412100 seconds, which is 16 days, 8 hours and 15 minutes for the mobs to respawn.
  • However, if you have the Gifted Vicious Bee, this would take 1200285 seconds, which is 13 days, 21 hours, 24 minutes, and 45 seconds.
  • With the lowest possible Monster Respawn Time of -40%, this would take 847260 seconds, which is 9 days, 19 hours and 21 minutes.
    • This is achievable with Gifted Vicious Bee, a Diamond Stick Bug amulet giving -10%, and 3 Icicles Beequips giving -5% each for a total of -15%.
  • Panda Bear's last Ant Annihilation quest, 'Ultimate Ant Annihilation 5', contains a typo. Instead of "Get a Score of 100 in the Ant Challenge," it says "Get a Score of 100 in the AntChallenge Challenge."
  • Panda Bear's dialouge in the last Ant Annihilation quest, 'Ultimate Ant Annihilation 5', contains a typo. Instead of "BONK THOSE BUGS SO HARD THEY STAY OFF OF OUR MOUNTAIN FOR 1,000 YEARS!", it says "BONK THOSE BUGS SO HARD THEY STAY OFF OUR OF OUR MOUNTAIN FOR 1,000 YEARS!"
  • In his Beesmas quest dialogue, Panda is revealed to dislike Robo Bear.
  • His Beesmas quest requires you to complete his first quest to claim.
  • The name of the quest "Royal Rumble" is a direct reference to the wrestling event of the same name.

docs.text:
Paper Planter "A biodegradable pot that grows in about 1hr. Harvest to collect pollen, items, and Nectar boosts!" Stats Cost25k Honey1 Sunflower Seed ReusableNo Inventory cap100 Shop limitNo limit Grow time1 hour Grows fasterNone Pollen bonusNone Nectarx0.75 all Nectar Pollen capacity50,000 Item tokens10 Puffshroom chance10% Puffshroom level1 Guaranteed itemsNone

The Paper Planter is a single-use planter added in the 2021-12-26 update. Alone, it grows in 1 hour and stores 50,000 pollen. It can be bought in the Pro Shop for 25,000 Honey and 1 Sunflower Seed. A player can store up to 100 Paper Planters at a time, and up to 3 planters can be planted at once.

docs.title: Growth, pollen and nectar
docs.text:
• Grows in 1 hour of playtime.
  • Glitter used in its field speeds it up: x1.5 for one, rising in halving steps up to x2 at 6 stacks. The stacks stay on the planter until it is harvested.
  • Holds 50,000 pollen at full growth. A harvest gives capacity × growth × pollen bonus. It has no pollen bonus.
  • Nectar multipliers: x0.75 Satisfying, x0.75 Comforting, x0.75 Invigorating, x0.75 Motivating, x0.75 Refreshing. On harvest it gives one Nectar type from its field, lasting grow time × growth × multiplier × 3 seconds.
  • Up to 3 bees can sip from it at once.

docs.title: Puffshrooms
docs.text:
When it reaches 95% growth, it has a 10% chance to smoke and spawn 3 Puffshrooms (one at the planter and two nearby) at level 1.

They are always Common.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text: A full harvest gives 10 item tokens. Harvesting early gives fewer, in proportion to growth, but always at least 1. Tokens are filled in this order: guaranteed items (full harvests only), then field rules, then random picks from the pool below.

docs.title: Field rules
docs.text:
• Full harvest in the Pineapple Patch: +1 Enzymes. In the Sunflower Field: +1 Oil.
  • In the Coconut Field the pool also gets Coconuts (1 / 1 / 3, weight 30).

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This is the cheapest and fastest-growing planter in the game.
  • It is one of the many planters to not be sold in Dapper Bear's Shop, the others being the Red Clay Planter, Blue Clay Planter, Festive Planter, Ticket Planter, Sticker Planter, Petal Planter, Hydroponic Planter and Heat-Treated Planter.
  • This is the cheapest item in the Pro Shop in terms of honey, only costing 25,000 honey.
  • This is the only item in the Pro Shop that is cheaper than an item in the Noob Shop, being the Helmet.
  • This, the Ticket Planter and Sticker Planter the are the only one-time use planters that are renewable.
  • This is the only planter in the game that stores more pollen than the honey it costs.
  • It is one of the four planters that are one-time use. The remaining three are the Sticker Planter, Ticket Planter and the Festive Planter.
  • It is also the only one-time use planter that can be bought from a store.
  • This is also the only planter that reduces nectar gained, multiplying all nectar by 0.75x. All other planters either boost nectar gain (although some of them only boost certain types) or do not change it at all.

docs.title: Parachute
docs.text:
The Parachute is a gliding tool that can be purchased at the Pro Shop.

Crafting Ingredients Statistics 500,000 Honey Speed 30 Float -14

It allows the player to glide through the air. Its description reads, "A parachute you can use to glide down the mountain and reach new places! Press jump while in the air to open."

To activate it, jump, following up with another jump while in mid-air. If the player went airborne through some other method (a cannon, for example), then double jump in order to eject the Parachute. To disengage, jump once more. The gliding feature is hardcoded to the player, and they will glide even during a lag spike (The parachute doesn't appear immediately).

Though it is slower than walking, the Parachute enables the player to glide to places on the map that would otherwise be inaccessible through simply walking and jumping. It is vital to collecting many of the Royal Jelly and Ticket tokens around the map as well as to perform several shortcuts. The Parachute can also be used to dodge mobs since most of them can't "detect" the player while they're in mid-air. Using the Parachute in unison with the cannons will allow for a quality map navigating experience.

The Parachute's gliding speed is not affected by haste, haste+, bear morph, or other speed boosts.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• It has an upgraded form called the Glider, which can be purchased in the Mountain Top Shop.
  • If the player times a jump the moment they hit the floor, they can be slightly launched forward with the Parachute.
  • If the player enables shift-lock, they can slightly strafe to one side while using the gliding tools.
  • The player can use the Parachute along with the Glider for moving during a game of memory match.

docs.title: Strategies
docs.text:
• Party Cogmowers don't aim for the player, allowing players to easily sidestep them.
  • Stand near the Party Cogmower, this will allow your bees to lock on to the Party Cogmower and quickly deal damage.
  • Vicious Bee provides very strong single-target damage. Digital Bee can also stun the Party Cogmower in place and allow it to take extra damage via Mind Hack.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This is one of the first mobs to appear during a Robo Party if the player is just starting at the first ranks.
  • This is the only Robo Party mob to not have the same health per level as its normal version.
  • The health per level is exactly half of its normal version's health per level.
  • When Bubble Bee Man's Winter Beesmas 2024 quest was added, it originally referred to Party Cogmowers as "Festive Cogmowers".

docs.title: Party Cogturret
docs.text:
Party Cogturret Location Any field except the Coconut Field, Spider Field and Ant Field (While the Party is active)

Not to be confused with Cogturrets, the normal version of these.

The Party Cogturret is one of the mobs exclusive to the Robo Party. It behaves similarly to a normal Cogturret but spawns on a random field instead of following the player on the field they are standing on. They first appear on Cake Rank 5 and continue to spawn in the following ranks.

docs.text:

  • Robo Party Blessing
  • Ticket
  • Gumdrops
  • Jelly Beans
  • Honeysuckle
  • Whirligig
  • Micro-Converter
  • Soft Wax
  • Pink Balloon (Uncommon)
  • Red Balloon (Rare)
  • Black Balloon (Exceptionally Rare)
  • Neonberry (Rare)
  • Ticket Planter (Very Rare)

docs.title: Strategies
docs.text:
• Party Cogturrets aim for where the player is, not where the player will be. Because of this, moving to the side after they fire a cog will often result in Party Cogturrets missing their attack.
  • Party Cogturrets will always shoot straight at where they are facing so you can avoid their attacks simply by not being in front of them.
  • Stand near the Party Cogturrets, this will allow your bees to lock on to the Party Cogturrets and quickly deal damage.
  • Vicious Bee and Windy Bee provide excellent crowd control, especially since Party Cogturrets often come in pairs or packs. Digital Bee can also stun many Party Cogturrets at once and allow them to take extra damage via Mind Hack.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Party Cogturret is the only Party Robot not wearing a Party Hat.
  • This, Party Mechsquitos, and Party Mega Mechsquitos have the same health per level as their normal counterparts.

Party Mechsquito Location Any field except the Coconut Field, Spider Field and Ant Field (When Robo Party is active)

Not to be confused with Party Mega Mechsquitos, the larger counterparts of Party Mechsquitos or Mechsquitos, the normal version of these.

The Party Mechsquito is one of the mobs exclusive to Robo Party. It functions similarly to a regular Mechsquito, but roams around a field instead of following the player around.

docs.title: Strategies
docs.text:
Since they are essentially the same as their normal counterparts, Mechsquitos, the same methods used for them can be followed.

  • Party Mechsquitos aim for where the player is, not where the player will be. Because of this, moving around in circles will often result in Party Mechsquitos missing their attack.
  • Stand near the Party Mechsquito, and this will allow your bees to lock on to the Party Mechsquito and quickly deal damage.
  • Vicious Bee and Windy Bee provide excellent crowd control, especially since Party Mechsquitos often come in pairs or packs. Digital Bee can also stun many Party Mechsquitos at once and allow them to take extra damage via Mind Hack.
  • Unlike their normal counterparts, they stay in fields which can be used for the players advantage. Stand right outside the field they are in and your bees will attack it while it doesn't aim for you. Note that this can be a bit risky since they can hover around the other parts of the field and don't come close enough for your bees to target them.

Not to be confused with Party Mechsquitos, the smaller counterparts of Party Mega Mechsquitos or the Mega Mechsquito, the normal version of these.

The Party Mega Mechsquito is one of the mobs exclusive to the Robo Party. They first spawn on Rank 15 and continue to keep spawning in the following ranks. The Party Mega Mechsquitos, similarly to Mega Mechsquitos, fly away whenever a player is near them. This is the explanation to why the player always keeps distance from them.

docs.title: Passive Abilities
docs.text:
Passive Abilities, or simply passives are effects found on some accessories, amulets, or bees. These abilities are active all the time or only activate when specific actions are done, as an additional effect of those actions.

Passive abilities granted by an accessory or an amulet are displayed near the hotbar. Some passive abilities require the player to do the same action multiple times, as shown by the number displayed on the passive's icon, indicating how close it is to activating the ability. When the ability is activated, the number will reset to 0.

Some passive abilities have a cooldown. When in cooldown, the number of seconds left will be displayed on the passive's icon in pale red. No trigger will activate the ability, nor will the trigger counter be increased. These passive abilities also have an initial cooldown when the player equips items that have those passives to prevent bypassing the cooldown.

docs.title: Haste Pulser
docs.text:
Haste Pulser activates every 30th Haste token collected.

When activated, it fires a blue pulse that hops to each blue bee, identical to that of Cobalt Bee.

Haste Pulser is granted by equipping the Cobalt Guard.

If the player has no blue bees, then nothing happens.

docs.title: Focus Pulser
docs.text:
Focus Pulser activates every 30th Focus token collected.

When activated, it fires a red pulse that hops to each red bee, identical to that of Crimson Bee.

Focus Pulser is granted by equipping the Crimson Guard.

If the player has no red bees, then nothing happens.

docs.title: Bubble Bombs
docs.text:
Bubble Bombs activates every 25th Bomb token collected, with a 2-minute cooldown.

When activated, it spawns 25 bubbles randomly in the field the player is in.

Bubble Bomb is only granted by equipping the Bubble Mask, or the Diamond Mask if the player owns the Bubble Mask.

docs.title: Diamond Drain
docs.text:
Diamond Drain activates every 30th Blue ability token collected, with a 45-second cooldown.

When activated, it summons a giant diamond that instantly converts 5 million pollen plus the total conversion amount. The conversion amount increases by 10% for every Blue bee the player has and increases by 50% for every Gifted Blue bee type they have. It also pollinates 10 (+3 per Blue bee) blue flowers within the field.

Diamond Drain is granted by equipping the Diamond Mask.

docs.title: Ignite
docs.text:
Ignite activates every 15th Red ability token collected.

When activated, it creates 5 flames in a plus shape where the 15th red token is collected.

Ignite is granted by equipping the Fire Mask, or the Demon Mask if the player owns the Fire Mask.

docs.title: X-Flame
docs.text:
X-Flame activates every 25th Battle ability token collected (ability tokens that can be generated in combat), with a 20-second cooldown.

When activated, it creates 29 flames in an X shape around the player.

X-Flame is granted by equipping the Demon Mask.

docs.title: Coin Scatter
docs.text:
Coin Scatter activates every 20th Mark token collected, with a 2-minute cooldown.

When activated, it converts pollen equal to 300% of the player's total conversion amount, scattered into 24 honey tokens around the field the player was last in. The honey tokens last for 1 minute.

Each token will give a minimum of 1000 honey, increasing with the amount of pollen converted and the player's Honey From Tokens stat.

The honey tokens cannot be collected by Token Link, but can be collected by Triangulate.

Coin Scatter is granted by equipping the Honey Mask, or the Gummy Mask if the player owns the Honey Mask.

docs.title: Gummy Morph
docs.text:
Gummy Morph activates every 30 Gumdrops used or 10 Gummy Bee ability tokens collected (Gummy Bee ability tokens count as 3 gumdrops).

When activated, the player will be transformed into Gummy Bear, Gummy Bee will glow, and the field will be covered fully in goo.

As Gummy Bear, the player will be granted +75% Goo, +100% Instant Goo Conversion, +24 Movespeed, and +60 Jump Power.

As Gummy Bee glows, it is granted +1000% Gather Amount, +300 Attack, and +200% Movespeed for 10 seconds. The Gummy Bee also leaves a trail while glowing.

Gummy Morph is granted by equipping the Gummy Mask.

docs.title: Coconut Haste
docs.text:
Coconut Haste activates whenever the player is hit by a falling Coconut.

When activated, the player gains a single stack of Haste and 2 seconds of Coconut Surge, giving x1.5 Bee Movespeed and +10 Player Movespeed.

Coconut Haste is granted from equipping the Coconut Clogs or Gummy Boots.

docs.title: Goo Trail
docs.text:
The trail of goo left behind.

Goo Trail passively covers 5 surrounding flowers with goo wherever the player walks on a field. The passive is always active while the player has it.

Flowers directly behind the player will have more goo than those surrounding.

Goo Trail is granted by equipping the Gummy Boots.

docs.title: Emergency Coconut Shield
docs.text:
The icon for Emergency Coconut Shield.

Emergency Coconut Shield activates when the player takes damage directly from a mob, with a 5-minute cooldown.

When it activates, it summons 5 Coconuts in the field the player is last in, gains 100% Defense, and increases Bee Attack by x1.25 for 10 seconds.

This does not protect the player from kill bricks, Tunnel Bear or Cave Monsters, as these all instantly kill the player upon contact; however, using the shield early can be used to prevent this.

Emergency Coconut Shield is granted by equipping the Coconut Canister.

docs.title: Inspire Coconuts
docs.text:
Inspire Coconuts activates every 5th Inspire token, Star Shower's shooting stars or Beesmas Light collected.

When activated, it summons 5 falling Coconuts in the field the player is last in.

Inspire Coconuts is granted by equipping the Coconut Canister.

docs.title: Petal Storm
docs.text:
Petal Storm activates every 30th boost token collected, with a 30-second cooldown.

When activated, it fires 30 Petal Shurikens around the player in a spiral pattern. When the shuriken passes through a bee, the bee instantly converts 10,000 pollen, increased by 7% of its conversion amount.

Petal Storm is granted by equipping the Petal Belt, or the Coconut Belt if the player has the Petal Belt.

docs.title: Combo Coconuts
docs.text:
Combo Coconuts activates every 40th Coconut the player drops onto a field (through items or abilities).

The 40th Coconut dropped becomes a Combo Coconut. When caught by any player, the Combo Coconut is kicked and either falls onto the summoner's field (if on the first drop, the coconut was caught within the blue circle) or onto another player's field.

Every time it is kicked, it speeds up and gives the kicker stacks of Coconut Combo. Many more stacks are granted if caught by other players in fields with different colors:[1]

  • Gives 1 stack by default.
  • Gives 1 bonus stack if caught in a field different from where it was last caught.
  • Between +1 to +4 bonus stacks depending on how long it has been since the coconut was caught in a field with the same color classification (Red/Blue/White/Mixed) as the current field it's being caught in.
  • +10 bonus stacks if the catcher is another player who has not yet caught this coconut, in a field with a color classification that the coconut has not yet been caught in.

The buff grants between 25% to 75% Unique Instant Conversion, between x1.2 to x2 Pollen, and between +1% to +50% Red Pollen, Blue Pollen, White Pollen, Bee Attack, and Honey From Tokens.

When the Coconut fails to be caught, it despawns and reapplies the buff to all players who caught it at least once.

Combo Coconuts cannot be passed to players in the Ant Field. Combo Coconuts spawned in the Ant Field will always result in a miss.

There is a limit of 50 Combo Coconut kicks before it ends prematurely.

The blue circle doesn't work as intended and even if caught within it on the first drop, the coconut will fall onto another player's field.

Combo Coconuts is granted by equipping the Coconut Belt.

docs.title: Guiding Star
docs.text:
The icon for Guiding Star.

Guiding Star activates every 250th Boost token collected, with a 5-minute cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants 1.25x capacity.

When activated, it summons a Guiding Star over 1 of the 5 fields the summoner has collected the least from for 10 minutes. The chance that a Guiding Star falls on a field depends on how much pollen the summoner has collected on said field relative to other fields. Specifically, the n-th least collected field has a \((6-n)/15\) chance of being chosen.

The Guiding Star grants x2.5 Pollen, Convert Rate, and Capacity to the player who summoned it, and x1.25 Pollen, Convert Rate, and Capacity to other players in that field. While active, the star pollinates 15 (+1 per Gifted Bee Type) flowers every 15 seconds. It will disappear if the player who summoned it leaves the server.

Guiding Star is granted by having a Diamond or Supreme Star Amulet with the Guiding Star passive.

Guiding Star can also be summoned if a player used Onett's Lid Art during the Beesmas event.

docs.title: Star Shower
docs.text:
Star Shower activates every 40th Boost or Mark token collected, with a 30-second cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants 1.25x capacity.

When activated, 10 shooting stars will fall onto the field the player is standing on, which collect and instantly convert 30 pollen (+50% per Gifted Bee Type) from 5 flowers. Catching a shooting star grants a stack of Inspire and instantly converts 1,000,000 pollen, added by 200% of the player's total conversion amount.

Star Shower is granted by having a Diamond or Supreme Star Amulet with the Star Shower passive.

The passive is similar to the falling Beesmas Lights, which can be activated by completing Science Bear's Beesmas Lights quest during the Beesmas events.

docs.title: Pop Star
docs.text:
The icon for Pop Star.

Pop Star activates every 30th Boost token collected, with a 1-minute cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants x1.25 Blue Field Capacity.

When activated, it summons a Pop Star, which grants 10% Instant Blue Conversion and x2 Blue Pollen for 45 seconds.

When the Pop Star is activated, it automatically applies 2 minutes of Bubble Bloat. While the Pop Star is active, every one of the player's bubbles popped increases the bonus Blue Pollen by 1% (up to x4.5 from x2) and grants 4 seconds of Bubble Bloat (6 seconds if the bubble is gold, 1 second if the bubble is not the player's).

Bubble Bloat increases Blue Field Capacity and Convert Rate at Hive by up to x6 for up to 2.5 hours.

When it ends, the Pop Star spawns several bubbles over the field that increase with the number of Bubbles popped.

Pop Star is granted by having a Supreme Star Amulet with the Pop Star passive.

docs.title: Gummy Star
docs.text:
The icon for Gummy Star.

Gummy Star is activated at a 2% chance when using Gumdrops, or at the 75th use after the cooldown ends, with a 1-minute cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants x1.25 White Field Capacity.

When activated, it summons a Gummy Star, which grants 10% Instant White and Goo Conversion for 45 seconds. Collecting goo during this time will make the star grow, granting bonus White Pollen and Goo (up to x2).

After the 45 seconds are up, the Gummy Star will pop, scattering honey tokens and Gumdrops tokens on the field the player was last in. The honey tokens are worth, in total, a percentage of the goo collected during the Gummy Star's duration, equal to 1.5% per gifted colorless bee type on the player's hive. The number of Gumdrops tokens increases with the amount of goo collected.

Gummy Star is granted by having a Supreme Star Amulet with the Gummy Star passive.

docs.title: Scorching Star
docs.text:
The icon for Scorching Star.

Scorching Star activates every 30th Boost token collected, with a 1-minute cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants x1.25 Red Field Capacity.

When activated, it summons a Scorching Star for 45s, which grants 50% Instant Flame Conversion, +5 Conversion Links, and x2 Red Pollen and Convert Rate.

Standing near flames causes the star to grow, increasing the bonus Red Pollen and Convert Rate (up to x5 from x2) and the number of Conversion Links (up to 30 from 5).

When Scorching Star ends, it converts all of the player's pollen in their bag into Honey.

Scorching Star is granted by having a Supreme Star Amulet with the Scorching Star passive.

docs.title: Star Saw
docs.text:
Star Saw activates after using 3 Stingers.

The 3rd Stinger used will be refunded, while also summoning a Star Saw that lasts for 30 seconds.

The Star Saw circles around the player, damaging hostile mobs (equal to 15% of the player's Total Attack, with accuracy equal to the average bee level of the player's hive, not including summons), collecting tokens, and collecting and instantly converting 3 pollen (+0.5 for every 100 Total Attack) from 5 flowers 10 times a second. The saw instantly converts additional pollen equal to the amount it gathers.

Star Saw is granted by having a Supreme Star Amulet with the Star Saw passive.

docs.title: Gathering Bubbles
docs.text:
Main article: Bubble

Bubbles have a percentage chance to be spawned by certain bees when gathering.

Bubbles spawned by this passive ability can be generated by Bubble Bee, Tadpole Bee, and frogs. There is a 35% chance (50% if gifted) for Bubble Bees to spawn a bubble while gathering, and a 65% (85% if gifted) chance for Tadpole Bees to spawn a bubble while gathering.

docs.title: Gathering Flames
docs.text:
Main article: Flame

Flames have a percentage chance to be spawned by certain bees when gathering.

Flames spawned by this passive ability can be generated by the Fire Bee, Demon Bee, Spicy Bee's Inferno, and bees with the Electric Candle Beequip. There is a 35% chance (50% if gifted) for Fire Bees to spawn a flame while gathering, and a 65% (85% if gifted) chance for Demon Bees to spawn a flame while gathering.

docs.title: Steam Engine
docs.text: Steam Engine is a passive ability exclusive to Spicy Bee. It boosts any Spicy Bee's speed by up to 100% with Flame Heat. While Steam Engine is active, Spicy Bee will increase the number of steam particles from its exhaust pipes proportionately with the amount of flame heat.

docs.title: Fuzzy Coat
docs.text: Fuzzy Coat is a passive ability exclusive to Fuzzy Bee. It has a chance to pollinate up to 5 surrounding flowers (9 if gifted) when gathering. Lower-tier flowers have a higher chance of being pollinated than higher-tier flowers.

docs.title: Nectar Lover
docs.text: Nectar Lover is a passive ability exclusive to Shy Bee. It makes Shy Bee twice as likely to sip from a planter than any other bee. When sipping, it also collects twice as much nectar and contributes twice as much to the growth of the planter.

docs.title: Shimmering Honey
docs.text: Shimmering Honey is a passive ability exclusive to Diamond Bee. Whenever this bee converts at the hive, it grants a 25% bonus honey (+2.5% per level). This bonus is doubled if the bee is Gifted.

docs.title: Balloon Enthusiast
docs.text: Balloon Enthusiast is a passive ability exclusive to Buoyant Bee. When converting from Balloons, this bee gains x3 its normal convert amount. Additionally, this bee's base attack scales linearly up to x3 with Balloon Blessing.

docs.title: Sniper
docs.text: Sniper is a passive ability exclusive to Precise Bee. In battle, this bee uses slow, long-range, more accurate shots and deals x2 damage. The accuracy is calculated as if the bee were 1 level higher (2 if gifted), and it can never be below 5%. If the shot is a Critical Hit, the reload time after shots is cut in half. If it's a Super-Crit, it's reduced by 75%.

docs.title: Drive Expansion
docs.text:
Drive Expansion is a passive ability exclusive to Digital Bee. Using a Drive while this bee is active in Robo Bear's Challenge corrupts the field you're standing in by an amount proportional to the number of flowers that match the Drive's color (Glitched Drives corrupt all fields equally). Additionally, it permanently enhances this bee, increasing the Corruption of its abilities and granting it the following stats:

  • Red Drive: +0.03 Attack

  • Blue Drive: +2 Convert Amount

  • White Drive: +0.25 Gather Amount

  • Glitched Drive: +0.05% Ability Rate

Every 10 Glitched Drives Enhancements grants a Hive Bonus of 0.03% Ability Duplication Chance.

Digital Bee can be enhanced with up to 500 of each type of Drive. You can view the number of enhancements by clicking on Digital Bee's hive slot.

Upon maxing out with all 2000 Drives, Digital Bee gains +10 Movespeed.

docs.title: Unlimited Gumdrops
docs.text:
Free Gumdrops is a passive ability that can only be obtained through the Unlimited Gumdrops buff, which can be activated through certain codes and the Glue Dispenser.

It allows the player to use their Gumdrops without losing any from their inventory. Having this buff active does not increase the amount of Gumdrops in the player's inventory.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• There is a visual glitch where, if the player has the Fire, Honey, Bubble, Demon, Gummy, or Diamond Mask equipped, looking at it through the coconut shield will make the front of the mask disappear. This is caused by glass textures overriding particles and transparent parts.
  • Bubble Bombs causes each bubble popped to increase in pitch. This does not happen anywhere else in the game.

docs.text: 1. ↑ [1] Update log from Onett.

docs.title: Pepper Patch
docs.text:
Pepper Patch

FIELD COLOR

Red

BEE PREREQUISITES

35 bees

NECTAR TYPE

Invigorating Nectar

FIELD DIMENSIONS

27 × 21 flowers

FLOWER COUNT

567

BEE PREFERENCES

LIKE

DISLIKE

The Pepper Patch is a field that was added in the September 28, 2019 update, located past the Windy Bee Gate, to the right of the Extreme Memory Match and to the left of the Wind Shrine. There are no mobs that protect this field.

This is a 21x27 field, containing 567 flowers. The flowers are red and white, and the only natural size is triple.

Flowers White Red Blue Total Single 0 0% 0 0% 0 0% 0 0% Double 0 0% 0 0% 0 0% 0 0% Triple 85 15% 482 85% 0 0% 567 100% Total 85 15% 482 85% 0 0% 567 100%

Note: flower counts within the table may vary due to rounding. Additionally, in game, all flowers are randomly generated and may not precisely align with the percentages.

This field can spawn strawberry, bitterberry, royal jelly, red extract, ticket and magic bean tokens when gathering pollen. The only bee that likes the Pepper Patch is Spicy Bee. Bees that dislike the Pepper Patch are Looker Bee, Frosty Bee, Baby Bee and Fuzzy Bee.

This field grants Invigorating Nectar when a planter is planted here.

A level 9-12 Rogue Vicious Bee has a chance to spawn here.

docs.title: Obtaining Boosts
docs.text:
• Using the Red Field Booster may give a Pepper Patch Boost (only if the player has 35+ bees). When it does, it will give +100% Pepper Patch pollen for 15 minutes.

  • Using glitter will add 100% Pepper Patch pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out.

  • Using field dice, smooth dice, or loaded dice may add +100% - +300% Pepper Patch pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out.

  • Pepper Patch Winds can be obtained through the Wind Shrine or codes. They have a base of +20% instant Pepper Patch conversion and give +5% instant Pepper Patch conversion and +10% Pepper Patch pollen for each stack. Pepper Patch Winds can stack up to a total of 15 times.

docs.title: The methods below are no longer possible.
docs.text:
• Redeeming certain expired codes:
  • Sriracha (Gave Pepper Patch Boost x2 and Pepper Patch Capacity x2 + other stuff).
  • 10mMembers (Gives Pepper Patch Code Buff + other stuff).
  • DemiDecade (Gives Pepper Patch Boost x4 + Pepper Patch Winds x15 + other stuff).

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This, the Coconut Field, the Stump Field, the Ant Field and the Hub Field are currently the only fields released in updates.
  • This, the Mountain Top Field, Stump Field, and Coconut Field are the only fields to solely have natural triple flowers.
  • The Pepper Patch is the only field past a bee gate with nothing guarding it.
  • This and the Coconut Field are the only fields where sprouts cannot appear naturally or be planted with the Special Sprout Summoner.
  • The Pepper Badge, Coconut Badge, Mountain Top Badge and the Hive Hub Badge require more pollen collected than the other field badges.
  • The Pepper Patch used to cover the entire platform it is placed on. Now, the field has shrunk a little and the area was amplified. As a result, it does not cover the edges of the platform anymore.
  • The peppers used as decoration were also reorganized.
  • This is the only red field that gives Invigorating Nectar.
  • There used to be a Marshmallow Bee token next to this field.

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

Stats Cost750M Honey25 Magic Beans25 Neonberries15 Glue3 Caustic Wax10 Hard Wax ReusableYes Inventory cap- Shop limit1 Grow time10 hours Grows fasterx1.3 in Strawberry Field, x1.3 in Spider Field, x1.3 in Bamboo Field Pollen bonusx1.5 in Strawberry Field, x1.5 in Spider Field, x1.5 in Bamboo Field Nectarx1.3 Motivatingx1.3 Satisfying Pollen capacity200,000,000 Item tokens28 Puffshroom chance20% Puffshroom level5 to 6 Guaranteed items1 Neonberry2 Ticket

The Pesticide Planter is a reusable planter added in 2021-12-26 update. It grows in about 10 hours of playtime and stores around 200,000,000 Pollen. The planter can be purchased from Dapper Bear's Shop.

docs.title: Growth, pollen and nectar
docs.text:
• Grows in 10 hours of playtime alone, and grows faster here: x1.3 in Strawberry Field, x1.3 in Spider Field, x1.3 in Bamboo Field. A flower-colour bonus is weighted by how much of the field is that colour.
  • Glitter used in its field speeds it up: x1.5 for one, rising in halving steps up to x2 at 6 stacks. The stacks stay on the planter until it is harvested.
  • Holds 200,000,000 pollen at full growth. A harvest gives capacity × growth × pollen bonus. Pollen bonus: x1.5 in Strawberry Field, x1.5 in Spider Field, x1.5 in Bamboo Field.
  • Nectar multipliers: x1.3 Motivating, x1.3 Satisfying. On harvest it gives one Nectar type from its field, lasting grow time × growth × multiplier × 3 seconds.
  • Up to 3 bees can sip from it at once. Mutated bees are x1.25 as likely to sip from it.

Note: Its in-game description says x1.25 Motivating and Satisfying Nectar, but the game gives x1.3.

docs.title: Puffshrooms
docs.text:
When it reaches 95% growth, it has a 20% chance to smoke and spawn 3 Puffshrooms (one at the planter and two nearby) at levels 5 to 6.

Rarity odds:

  • Common 70%
  • Rare 22.5%
  • Epic 7.25%
  • Legendary 0.24%
  • Mythic 0.01%

docs.title: Drops
docs.text: A full harvest gives 28 item tokens. Harvesting early gives fewer, in proportion to growth, but always at least 1. Tokens are filled in this order: guaranteed items (full harvests only), then field rules, then random picks from the pool below.

docs.title: Guaranteed
docs.text:
On every full harvest:

  • 1 Neonberry
  • 2 Ticket

docs.title: Field rules
docs.text:
• Full in the Strawberry Field: 100 Bitterberries + 1 Swirled Wax, once every 30 days. Full in the Pepper Patch, Spider or Mountain Top Field: 8% chance of 100 Bitterberries.
  • Full harvests in Stump, then Mountain Top, then Coconut Field: 25 to 40 Neonberries, once every 7 days.
  • Full in the Strawberry, Spider or Bamboo Field: 10% chance of 1 Caustic Wax.
  • In the Coconut Field the pool also gets Coconuts (1 / 3, weight 30) and Tropical Drink (weight 8).

The Petal Planter is a reusable planter added in the 2021-12-26 update. Alone, it grows in about 14 hours and stores 100 billion pollen. When harvested, it grants bonus Jelly Beans, Field Dice, and Glitter. It can be purchased at the Petal Shop.

docs.title: Growth, pollen and nectar
docs.text:
• Grows in 14 hours of playtime alone, and grows faster here: x1.5 in fields with white flowers. A flower-colour bonus is weighted by how much of the field is that colour.
  • Glitter used in its field speeds it up: x1.5 for one, rising in halving steps up to x2 at 6 stacks. The stacks stay on the planter until it is harvested.
  • Holds 100,000,000,000 pollen at full growth. A harvest gives capacity × growth × pollen bonus. Pollen bonus: x1.5 in fields with white flowers.
  • Nectar multipliers: x1.5 Satisfying, x1.5 Comforting. On harvest it gives one Nectar type from its field, lasting grow time × growth × multiplier × 3 seconds.
  • Up to 3 bees can sip from it at once. Colourless bees are x1.333 as likely to sip from it.

docs.title: Puffshrooms
docs.text:
When it reaches 95% growth, it has a 25% chance to smoke and spawn 3 Puffshrooms (one at the planter and two nearby) at levels 7 to 8.

Rarity odds:

  • Rare 90%
  • Epic 8%
  • Legendary 1.99%
  • Mythic 0.01%

docs.text: A full harvest gives 45 item tokens. Harvesting early gives fewer, in proportion to growth, but always at least 1. Tokens are filled in this order: guaranteed items (full harvests only), then field rules, then random picks from the pool below.

Petal Shop Location In the cave near the Windy Bee Gate, under the Wind Shrine.

The Petal Shop is a shop located past the Windy Bee Gate. Inside, the player can craft the Petal Wand, the Petal Belt and the Petal Planter. The All-Time Top White Collectors Leaderboard and Daily Top White Collectors Leaderboard can also be found here.

It is called the Petal Shop because of the giant petals draped across the back wall. In addition, each of its items require a spirit petal to craft (except for the Petal Planter).

docs.title: Petal Wand
docs.text:
Petal Wand Overview Price 1 Spirit Petal, 10 Star Jellies, 25 Glitter, 75 Enzymes, 1,500,000,000 Honey Shop Petal Shop Pollen Collection Range 37 Flowers Collecting Pattern Flower collectedyou (facing up) Collecting Time 0.7 Base Collection 6 Flowers Single Double Triple Large Star White 12 24 36 48 60 Red 12 24 36 48 60 Blue 12 24 36 48 60 Special Multiplier(s): 100% Pollen Multiplier

The Petal Wand is a tool added in the 2019-09-28 update that can be crafted in the Petal Shop.

Crafting Ingredients 1.5B Honey

10 Star Jellies 25 Glitter 75 Enzymes 1 Spirit Petal

It collects 6 pollen from 37 patches in 0.7 seconds, and boosts pollen collected by 100%. It has an average base pollen collection rate of 634.29 pollen per second. It emits a yellow particle effect at the top of the tool, similar to the Petal Belt.

Every 3rd swing, it fires a Petal Shuriken, which causes bees to instantly convert pollen if it touches their hitbox. The shuriken instantly converts 10,000 + 6% of the bee's convert amount in pollen to honey + an additional 6% per field boost stack of the field you're standing in. Shurikens can also pop bubbles and fuzz bombs.

In the 2026-01-16 update, shurikens were made to cause blooms that were hit to spawn a petal, dealing damage (20% remaining hp + 5% max hp) to the bloom as well as spawning a random petal from it.

docs.title: Sound effect
docs.text: This sound plays every 3rd swing, when a petal shuriken is released.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Excluding Honey & Spirit Petals, if the ingredients were to be crafted in the Blender, then it would require 1,750 Royal Jellies, 1,375 Moon Charms, 55 Magic Beans and 3,750 Pineapples. If one were to buy the royal jelly required for it, that would be 1.75 billion honey.
  • The Petal Wand can launch its shurikens even while the player isn't in a field.
  • This can be used to spend less time at the hive converting pollen.
  • The Petal Wand is the only tool to be held by a bear (Onett holds a tool but he's not a bear), specifically Spirit Bear.
  • The version held by Spirit Bear is much bigger than a player's.
  • After the shuriken comes in contact with one of the player's bees, the sound effect changes. This also increases in pitch with every consecutive bee.

Photon Bee is a Colorless Event bee that hatches out of a Photon Bee Egg, which is available in the Ticket Tent for 500 Tickets.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, the only way to make Photon Bee gifted is either with a Star Treat, Gingerbread Bears or Aged Gingerbread Bears.

Photon Bee likes the Pineapple Patch and the Pumpkin Patch. It dislikes the Clover Field.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Photon Bee's energy is set to 999,999,999,999,999.
  • It was the first Event bee to be added in the Ticket Tent and the second Event bee added to the game, with Bear Bee being the first.
  • It was also the first Event bee that is purchased using tickets.
  • This bee and the Ninja Bee are tied as the fastest Bees in the game, with a speed of 21.
  • Photon and Exhausted Bee are the only bees that don't require sleep and have infinite energy. However, they still need to rest at the hive when you die.
  • This bee, Festive Bee and Vicious Bee are the only Event bees that have Ability Tokens generated by non-Event bees.
  • This bee, Ninja Bee, Cobalt Bee, Tadpole Bee, Windy Bee, Crimson Bee, and Precise Bee are the only bees that create a trail behind them (not counting particle trails).
  • This is the first event bee with a trail.
  • Gummy Bee also creates a trail, but it can only be seen while the Gummy Mask ability is active.
  • This bee, Bear Bee, Festive Bee, Gummy Bee, Tadpole Bee and Tabby Bee are the only bees to have a Gifted Bonus that affects their signature ability.
  • If Photon Bee is gifted, its Beamstorm is white instead of yellow and instantly converts its collected pollen.
  • The sun model on Photon Bee's rear has 20 spikes.
  • Because Photon Bee has infinite energy, there is a glitch if a Royal jelly is used on a Photon Bee, the transformed bee will have a ridiculous amount of energy.
  • This glitch is also shared when transforming an Exhausted Bee, since that has endless energy as well.
  • All versions of the Ticket Tent have had this bee on top, except for the initial release.
  • Although Photon Bee's energy is infinite, it is still possible to get an energy mutation on Photon Bee. However, the mutation will have no effect, similar to an attack mutation on a Baby Bee.
  • Photon Bee's Beamstorm ability is able to collect pollen from other fields. If the token was close enough to the other field, the range of the Beamstorm can possibly be able to reach it.

The Pine Tree Forest is a field located past the Honey Bee Gate and near the Badge Bearer's Guild. It is protected by two mantises and the Werewolf.

This field can spawn honey, blueberry, ticket, blue extract, magic bean, and neonberry tokens while gathering pollen. Planters in this field grant extra whirligigs and blue extracts.

Bees that like the Pine Tree Forest are Bear Bee, Cool Bee, Bucko Bee, Bubble Bee, Carpenter Bee, Cobalt Bee, Festive Bee, Fuzzy Bee, and Tadpole Bee. Bees that dislike the Pine Tree Forest are Rascal Bee, Rad Bee, Riley Bee, Fire Bee, Shy Bee, Precise Bee, Digital Bee and Baby Bee.

This field grants Comforting Nectar when a planter is planted here.

This is a 23x31 field, containing 713 flowers. The flowers are white and blue, in sizes of single, double, and triple.

docs.title: Obtaining Boosts
docs.text:
• Using the Blue Field Booster may give a Pine Tree Forest Boost. When it does, it will give +100% Pine Tree Forest pollen for 15 minutes.
  • Using glitter will add 100% Pine Tree Forest pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out.
  • Using field dice, smooth dice, or loaded dice may add +100% - +300% Pine Tree Forest pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out.
  • Pine Tree Forest Winds can be obtained through the Wind Shrine or codes. They have a base of 20% instant Pine Tree Forest conversion and give +5% instant Pine Tree Forest conversion and +15% Pine Tree Forest pollen for each stack. Pine Tree Forest Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times.
  • The Pinecone Beequip can grant up to +15% Pine Tree Forest Capacity and +10% Pine Tree Forest Pollen.
  • Giving Honey Bee a present during the Beesmas 2025 event gives you a x3 Pine Tree Forest boost.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Festive Bee likes the Pine Tree Forest likely since most Christmas trees are coniferous trees, like pine trees.
  • It is also the only red bee to like a field of the opposite color. The only other bee that shares this trait is Vicious Bee liking the Rose Field.
  • The Pine Tree Forest is the only field with "Forest" in its name instead of "Field" or "Patch".
  • This field is guarded by the werewolf and 2 mantises. This makes the Pine Tree Forest the field with the most mobs guarding it, at 3.
  • Standing in the area of the field closest to the Sticker Stack will prevent the werewolf from detecting the player.
  • There is a royal jelly token on top of the tallest pine tree in this field. To get it, the player can do the Cloud Obby starting near Polar Bear using the Parachute to glide to the next step. However, it is much easier to use the Red Cannon and the Parachute/Glider.
  • As of the 2020-06-06 update, Honey Bee can be found on the gray platform behind the Pine Tree Forest.

When the Badge Bearer's Guild was added, the field was shrunken to end at the door of the guild. It has been shrunken again, now being farther from the guild's door.
  • One of the pine trees still remains near the Honey Bee Gate from the field's original spot.

docs.title: Pineapple Patch
docs.text:
Pineapple Patch

FIELD COLOR

White

BEE PREREQUISITES

10 bees

NECTAR TYPE

Satisfying Nectar

FIELD DIMENSIONS

33 × 23 flowers

FLOWER COUNT

759

BEE PREFERENCES

LIKE

DISLIKE

The Pineapple Patch is a field located past the Brave Bee Gate and to the right of the Pro Shop. It is protected by a level 4 mantis and a level 5 rhino beetle.

This field can spawn honey, pineapple, bitterberry, neonberry, enzyme, ticket, magic bean, glue and glitter tokens when gathering pollen.

This field grants Satisfying Nectar when a planter is planted here.

Bees that like the Pineapple Patch are Shocked Bee, Diamond Bee, Lion Bee, Gummy Bee, and Photon Bee. Bees that dislike the Pineapple Patch are Vector Bee, Cobalt Bee, and Crimson Bee.

A level 1-20 Wild Windy Bee has the chance of spawning here.

This is a 33x23 field, containing 759 flowers. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of single, double, and triple.

docs.title: Obtaining Boosts
docs.text:
• Using the Field Booster may give a Pineapple Patch Boost. When it does, it will give +200% Pineapple Patch pollen for 15 minutes.

  • Using glitter will add 100% Pineapple Patch pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out.

  • Using field dice, smooth dice, or loaded dice may add +100% - +300% Pineapple Patch pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out.
  • Pineapple Patch winds can be obtained through the Wind Shrine or codes. They have a base of +20% instant Pineapple Patch conversion and give +5% instant Pineapple Patch conversion and +20% Pineapple Patch pollen for each stack. Pineapple Patch Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times.
  • The Moon Amulet can give a pollen boost for the Pineapple Patch between +1% and +150%.
  • It can be boosted by the Shell Amulet. If it has a Pineapple Patch Boost, it can boost the field by +7% to +30% depending on the amulet rarity.
  • Donating either the Menacing Mantis or Pineapple Patch Stamp Sticker to the Sticker Stack boosts the Pineapple Patch by 5% and 10% respectively.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This is the biggest field in the game.
  • The mobs in this field (Rhino Beetle and Mantis) are associated with blue, despite the field being white.
  • There is a pineapple token behind the pineapple closest to the shop. Collecting it grants the player five pineapples.
  • There is a ticket token worth three tickets on top of the giant pineapple. It can be obtain by using the Red Cannon and the Parachute or Glider, or by jumping up from the side of the pineapple.
  • There is a glue token behind the biggest pineapple between the Stump Field.
  • This was the third biggest field in the game before the 2018-07-11 update.
  • This field is one of the three fields to have the word "Patch" in their name instead of "Field," along with the Pumpkin Patch and the Pepper Patch.
  • The Pine Tree Forest is another field without the word "Field" in it, having "Forest" in its name instead.
  • This is one of six fields that fireflies can travel to, with the others being Bamboo Field, Cactus Field, Rose Field, Spider Field, and Strawberry Field.
  • This is one of the fields that the Stick Bug can move to during the Stick Bug Challenge.
  • This field, along with the Sunflower Field and the Pumpkin Patch, is the only field where an object may come to life and shoot sparkles.
  • The biggest pineapple will occasionally grow a face, where it will blow bubbles at patches of flowers, producing sparkles (in diamond formation) upon contact. Collecting pollen on the affected flowers can produce tickets, pineapples, moon charm, royal jelly, enzymes, or honey tokens.
  • While doing one of Spirit Bear's quests, Spirit Bear states that the Pineapple Patch was originally supposed to be a "Rhubarb Field". Instead, she and Stick Bug planted pineapples.
  • This is the only field to be guarded by two mobs of different tiers (Rhino Beetle and Mantis), if you don't include the Werewolf guarding the Pine Tree Forest as it merely happens to be located in the Werewolf's attack territory.

docs.title: Pineapple
docs.text:
Pineapple

"Increases your bond with a bee by 25."

A Pineapple token.

A Pineapple is a type of treat that can be fed to a bee to raise its bond by 25. However, when fed to a Hasty, Brave, Honey, Exhausted, Shocked, Fire, Demon, Lion, or Fuzzy Bee, the amount of bond they gain is doubled. These bees also have a small chance of becoming gifted when fed Pineapples. Mythic bees have a 1/24,000 chance to be gifted; Legendary Bees, a 1/12,000 chance; Epic bees, a 1/10,000 chance; and Rare bees, a 1/8,000 chance. Feeding a radioactive bee a pineapple has a 0.004% (1 in 25,000) to mutate a bee.
