  • As a drop from mantises, scorpions, spiders, werewolves, Commando Chick, Stick Nymphs, Stick Bug, King Beetle, and Tunnel Bear.
  • As a drop from a Festive Gift or Festive Mark.
  • As a gift from a cub buddy.
  • As a reward for completely growing any kind of sprout except for Moon, Gummy, and Debug sprouts.
  • Planting a sprout in the Pineapple Patch yields 7x more Pineapples than other fields.
  • Harvesting sparkles (Higher chances in the Pineapple Patch).
  • As a drop from Puffshrooms.
  • As a drop from planters, which include:
  • Ticket Planters
  • Festive Planters
  • Plastic Planters
  • Candy Planters
  • Blue Clay Planters
  • Red Clay Planters
  • Pesticide Planters
  • Planters Of Plenty
  • Digging into the Beesmas Feast sometimes grants Pineapples.

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

Pink Balloon

"Floats on the field for 3 minutes, storing and doubling pollen you collect beneath it. Then it floats to your hive!"

COOLDOWN

5 min

CAP

25

The Pink Balloon is a consumable item that was added in the 2021-12-26 update. Once used, it creates a pink balloon over the field the player is in. The balloon floats over the field, storing pollen collected underneath it. The pollen collected below is doubled. It holds up to double the player's capacity. It floats over the field for 3 minutes before floating to the hive balloon.

Pink balloons have a cap of 25 in the player's inventory, and 1 per player in the field.

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

docs.title: Planter
docs.text: Planters are inventory items that can be deployed in fields. Only one of each type of planter can be planted at any time, and only one planter can be planted in each field at any time. A player can only have up to 3 planters active at any given point of time. Harvesting planters grants nectar, random loot depending on the planter and the field, and has a chance to summon a Puffshroom. Planters remain where they are placed until claimed by the player.

docs.title: Mechanics
docs.text:
To use a planter, simply drag the planter in your inventory or use the planter on your hotbar while standing on an unused field. A deployed planter will naturally grow over time only when you are playing the game, unless you have an Offline Voucher, in which it will continue growing for up to 24 hours after you log out.

The growth of the planter can be boosted by using glitter on the field it is deployed (25% faster until harvest), active clouds in the field (8% faster each active cloud, 20% maximum bonus growth, lasts until the clouds despawn), a field they can naturally grow by faster (ex. Red Clay Planter grows 25% faster in red fields), or by bees sipping on the planter by standing in the field the planter is deployed. When bees are sipping on the planter, they will convert pollen in the player's bag, grant nectar, and give growth to the planter. The amount of growth added to the planter depends on the bee's energy and the amount of nectar depends on the bee's collection amount and the planter deployed.

After reaching 95% growth, the planter will roll on whether it will "smoke" or not. If the planter smoked, the planter will spawn a puffshroom on harvest. The chance for the planter to smoke depends on the type of planter, with the ticket planter and sticker planter being guaranteed to smoke.

Upon harvesting the planter, the planter will drop three things: nectar, pollen and items; the nectars are guaranteed to be granted upon harvest, items are only dropped at a certain percentage of growth, and pollen is based on planter growth. Additionally, excess pollen gained exceeding the player's capacity is instantly converted. The amount of nectar and items it drops depends on the current growth of the planter. If the planter is smoking while at full growth, it will release a puffshroom upon harvest with its level being affected by the type of planter used. The type of nectar dropped is affected by the field the planter is deployed on, and the items are affected by the type of planter and the field it is deployed on. Some planters grant more nectars than other ones.

Planters have bonus drops. Either from the planter itself, when they are deployed in a particular field, or by chaining them by planting and fully growing them at particular fields (see chart below under "All Bonus Drops (from growing in a certain field)".

When harvesting a planter on a field, the field will "degrade." When a field degrades, the natural growth of the planter slows down when it is planted there. The amount of degradation on the field depends on the current percentage of growth on the planter corresponding to the natural time of the planter's growth, and harvesting a planter also always degrade the field by 1 hour. Every field can be degraded by a maximum of 48 hours. The more degradation is put on the field, the longer they'll naturally grow and the longer they'll stay degraded. When a planter is in a degraded field, the color of the planter will be brown instead of green, getting darker the higher the degradation. It seems that after being placed for a while, the color will return to being green. However, the field will still stay degraded.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text:
Planters drop items and nectars upon harvesting, the quality and amount of items and nectars depend on the total growth. Chaining or having the planter deployed in certain fields will make them drop certain items. Some planters also exclusively drop certain items. As seen below:

Item How and Where to Obtain Ticket
  • Planters can sometimes drop tickets, the quantity of the tickets depend on the type of the Planter.
  • The Ticket Planter exclusively drops tickets as a bonus drop, ranging between 10 and 150.
Gumdrops
  • The Candy Planter drops Gumdrops as a bonus drop.
  • Placing the Candy Planter in Blue Flower Field, Strawberry Field, or Pineapple Patch makes it drop more gumdrops.
  • Planters in Stump Field can drop Gumdrops.
  • The Planter Of Plenty drops Gumdrops as a bonus drop and has a rare chance to drop 100 gumdrops.
Coconut
  • Planters in the 35 Bee Zone can drop Coconuts.
Micro-Converter
  • Planting the Blue Clay Planter in the Spider Field guarantees at least 10 Micro-Converters.
  • The Planter Of Plenty drops Micro-Converters as a bonus drop.
Stinger
  • Fully growing the Red Clay Planter in the Clover Field, Spider Field and Cactus Field consecutively rewards 10 stingers (2 weeks cooldown).
  • Planters grown in the Cactus Field and Rose Field have a chance to drop stingers.
  • The Heat-Treated Planter drops 10 Stingers when fully grown in Cactus Field.
Whirligig
  • Planters in the Pine Tree Forest can drop whirligigs.
Field Dice
  • The Tacky Planter and Petal Planter drop Field Dice as bonus drop.
Smooth Dice
  • The Tacky Planter and Petal Planters drop Smooth Dice as bonus drop.
Loaded Dice
  • The Tacky Planter has a rare chance to drop Loaded Dice.
    • Planting the Tacky Planter in the Mountain Top Field makes it drop 1 or 2 Loaded Dice (1 month cooldown).
  • The Petal Planter has an approximately 20% chance to drop Loaded Dice.
  • Planting the Heat-Treated Planter in the Mushroom Field guarantees 1 Loaded Dice with a cooldown of around 22 hours.
  • Planting the Hydroponic Planter in the Blue Flower Field guarantees 1 Loaded Dice with a cooldown of around 22 hours.
Jelly Beans
  • The Candy Planter, Petal Planter, and The Planter Of Plenty drop Jelly Beans as bonus drop.
Red Extract
  • The Red Clay Planter has a rare chance to drop 10 Red Extracts.
  • Placing the Heat-Treated Planter in the Mushroom Field, the Strawberry Field, the Rose Field, or the Pepper Patch has a rare chance to drop 100 Red Extracts (unknown cooldown).
  • Placing the Heat-Treated Planter in the Mushroom Field, the Strawberry Field, the Rose Field, and the Pepper Patch consecutively guarantees a bonus of an additional 100 Red Extracts (1 month cooldown).
  • The Red Clay Planter and Heat-Treated Planter drop Red Extracts as a bonus drop.
Blue Extract
  • Planting the Hydroponic Planter in the Blue Flower Field, the Bamboo Field, the Pine Tree Forest, and the Stump Field consecutively guarantees a bonus of an additional 100 Blue Extracts (1 month cooldown).
  • The Hydroponic Planter drops Blue Extracts as a bonus drop.
Glitter
  • The Petal Planter drops 10 Glitter in Dandelion Field (Unknown cooldown).
  • The Petal Planter drops glitter as a bonus drop.
Glue
  • Planting the Candy Planter in the Stump Field 3 times in a row will guarantee 10 glue (1 week cooldown).
  • The Candy Planter has an uncommon chance to drop glue, and a very rare chance to drop 10 glue on its own.
Oil
  • Planters in Sunflower Field have a chance to drop Oil.
  • Paper Planters are guaranteed to drop 1 or 5 Oils in the Sunflower Field.
  • The Hydroponic Planter drops Oil as a bonus drop.
  • Planting the Hydroponic Planter 3 times in a row in the Sunflower Field guarantees 100 Oils. (unknown cooldown)
Enzymes
  • Planting the Heat-Treated Planter in the Pineapple Patch 3 times in a row guarantees an bonus 100 Enzymes (unknown cooldown).
  • Planting the Heat-Treated Planter in the Pepper Patch can rarely result in a bonus of 100 Enzymes.
  • Heat-Treated Planters exclusively drop enzymes as a bonus drop.
  • Placing a planter in Pineapple Patch gives the planter a rare chance to drop enzymes.
Tropical Drink
  • Planters in Coconut Field have a rare chance to drop Tropical Drinks.
Purple Potion
  • Planting Red Clay Planters or Tacky Planter in a red field then a blue field or vice versa gives it a chance to drop a Purple Potion.
Super Smoothie
  • Plastic Planters has an uncommon chance to drop 1 Super Smoothie when harvested with 1 month cooldown.
  • Candy Planters has a rare chance to drop 1-3 Super Smoothies.
  • Planting Planters Of Plenty in the Bamboo Field makes it drop 10 Super Smoothies (1 month cooldown).
  • The Petal Planter has an approximately 2% chance to drop a Super Smoothie.
Star Jelly
  • Planting the Petal Planter in any white field makes it drop 10 Star Jelly (unknown cooldown).
  • The Petal Planter drops Star Jelly as a bonus drop.
  • The Planter Of Plenty drops Star Jelly as a bonus drop.
Sunflower Seed
  • Placing any planters in Sunflower Field makes it drop sunflower seeds.
  • The Tacky Planter exclusively drops sunflower seeds as a bonus drop.
Strawberry
  • Placing any planter in Red Fields makes them drop Strawberries.
  • The Heat-Treated Planter drops extra strawberries when planted in the Strawberry Field.
Pineapple
  • Placing any planter in Pineapple Patch makes them drop pineapples.
Blueberry
  • Placing any planter in Blue Fields makes them drop Blueberries.
Bitterberry
  • Placing the Pesticide Planter in the Pepper Patch, Spider Field, or the Mountain Top Field has a chance of dropping 100 bitterberries.
  • Placing any planter in Pepper Patch or Spider Field makes them drop Bitterberries.
Neonberry
  • Fully harvesting Pesticide Planters in the Stump Field, the Mountain Top Field, and the Coconut Field (in that order) results in at least 25 Neonberries (1 week cooldown).
  • The Planter Of Plenty and the Pesticide Planter drops Neonberries as a bonus drop. The Planter Of Plenty has a rare chance of dropping 100 Neonberries.
Moon Charm
  • Placing any planter in Pineapple Patch makes them drop Moon Charm, the amount of Moon Charms depends on the type of planter.
Soft Wax
  • Red Clay Planters drops waxes as a bonus drop, including Soft Wax.
  • Planters Of Plenty drops waxes as a bonus drop, including Soft Wax.
  • Planting any planter in Mushroom Field gives them a chance to drop Soft Wax.
Hard Wax
  • Red Clay Planters has an uncommon chance to drop Hard Wax.
  • Planters Of Plenty drops Hard Wax as a bonus drop.
Swirled Wax
  • Harvesting a fully grown Plastic Planter in the Coconut Field makes it drop 1 Swirled Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • Planting the Candy Planter in Cactus Field guarantees 1 Swirled Wax (36 day cooldown)
  • Planting the Red Clay Planter in Sunflower Field makes it drop 1 Swirled Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • Planting the Red Clay Planter in blue fields has a chance to drop a Swirled Wax.
  • Planting the Blue Clay Planter in Spider Field makes it drop 1 Swirled Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • Planting the Tacky Planter in the Pumpkin Patch makes it drop 1 Swirled Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • Planting the Pesticide Planter in the Strawberry Field guarantees 1 Swirled Wax (36 day cooldown).
  • Planting the Heat-Treated Planter in the Blue Flower Field guarantees 1 Swirled Wax if fully harvested (36 day cooldown).
  • Planting the Hydroponic Planters in the Mushroom Field guarantees 1 Swirled Wax if fully harvested (36 day cooldown).
  • Planting the Petal Planter in the Strawberry Field makes it drop 1 Swirled Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • The Planter Of Plenty has an uncommon chance to drop 5 Swirled Wax.
  • The Planter Of Plenty has an uncommon chance to drop 1 Swirled Wax.
Caustic Wax
  • Harvesting a fully grown Plastic Planter in the Rose Field makes it drop 1 Caustic Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • Planting the Candy Planter in Mountain Top Field guarantees 1 Caustic Wax (36 day cooldown).
  • Planting the Red Clay Planter in Clover Field makes it drop 1 Caustic Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • Planting the Blue Clay Planter in Clover Field makes it drop 1 Caustic Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • Planting the Tacky Planter in Bamboo Field makes it drop 1 Caustic Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • Planting the Pesticide Planter in the Strawberry Field or the Bamboo Field has higher chances of dropping a Caustic Wax.
  • Planting the Heat-Treated Planter in the Coconut Field guarantees 1 Caustic Wax if fully grown(36 day cooldown).
  • Planting the Hydroponic Planter in the Coconut Field guarantees 1 Caustic Wax if fully grown(36 day cooldown).
  • Planting thePetal Planter in the Dandelion Field makes it drop 1 Caustic Wax (1 month cooldown).
  • The Planter Of Plenty has a rare chance to drop 1 Caustic Wax.
Turpentine
  • Almost every planter has a chance to drop Turpentine.
    • The Planter Of Plenty has 10% chance.
    • The Petal Planter has an approximately >1% chance.
Sticker
  • Sticker Planters always guarantee stickers.
  • Certain planters drops certain stickers exclusive to them.

docs.title: Planter Types
docs.text: There are currently 14 planters in-game, listed below:

docs.title: One-time Use
docs.text: One-time use planters are planters that can't be reused and requires the player to acquire more of them in order for them to be used again. Paper Planter Ticket Planter Festive Planter Sticker Planter

docs.title: Permanent
docs.text: Permanent planters are planters that can be indefinitely reused after acquiring them. Once you collected the planter, it goes back into the player's inventory. docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• All planters (except the Heat-Treated Planter, Hydroponic Planter and Sticker Planter) were added in the 2021-12-26 update.
  • There are currently 10 reusable planters, thus adding 10 more inventory items that are reusable.
  • Onett hired Not_Nert for modelling all of the planter models.
  • Similarly to certain other items that can be placed down, any planters that have been placed down before the player has joined will not appear for that player.
  • Festive Planter is the only planter that can drop Gingerbread Bears and Festive Beans.
  • The pollen gained from planters counts toward quests that require pollen.
  • Sticker Planter is the newest planter, being added in the 2024-01-12 update.
  • Bees do not sip from planters during battle.
  • In spite of the game labelling many planters with "1/1" in the player's inventory, many of them listed above are reusable meaning the player can use them an infinite number of times after purchase.
  • The amount of time taken for a bee to sip nectar from a planter is twice the bee's gathering speed.

The Plastic Planter is a planter added in 2021-12-26 update. Alone, it grows in around 2 hours and stores 250,000 pollen. The planter can be bought from Dapper Bear's Shop.

docs.title: Growth, pollen and nectar
docs.text:
• Grows in 2 hours of playtime.
  • Glitter used in its field speeds it up: x1.5 for one, rising in halving steps up to x2 at 6 stacks. The stacks stay on the planter until it is harvested.
  • Holds 250,000 pollen at full growth. A harvest gives capacity × growth × pollen bonus. It has no pollen bonus.
  • Nectar multipliers: x1 Satisfying, x1 Comforting, x1 Motivating, x1 Refreshing, x1 Invigorating. On harvest it gives one Nectar type from its field, lasting grow time × growth × multiplier × 3 seconds.
  • Up to 3 bees can sip from it at once.

docs.title: Puffshrooms
docs.text:
When it reaches 95% growth, it has a 14% chance to smoke and spawn 3 Puffshrooms (one at the planter and two nearby) at levels 3 to 4.

Rarity odds:

  • Common 75%
  • Rare 25%

docs.title: Drops
docs.text: A full harvest gives 12 item tokens. Harvesting early gives fewer, in proportion to growth, but always at least 1. Tokens are filled in this order: guaranteed items (full harvests only), then field rules, then random picks from the pool below.

docs.title: Field rules
docs.text:
• Full harvest in the Pineapple Patch: +1 Enzymes. In the Sunflower Field: +1 Oil.
  • In the Coconut Field the pool also gets Coconuts (1 / 1 / 3, weight 30).

docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

Polar Bear is a quest giver, and one of the eight permanent quest bears that can be accessed in the game, the others being Black Bear, Brown Bear, Mother Bear, Panda Bear, Science Bear, Dapper Bear, and Spirit Bear.

He is the seventh quest bear to be accessed in the game, located halfway up the hill between the Honey Bee Gate and the Lion Bee Gate and above the Cactus Field.

To reach Polar Bear, the player needs to go past the Honey Bee Gate, then go up the ramp that starts next to the Pumpkin Patch. Turn right, then follow the path between the snow/ice blocks. The player will eventually find him before turning left up to the Lion Bee Gate. As another simpler shortcut, players can use the Red Cannon and a Parachute/Glider to reach Polar Bear or if the player has enough Jump Power, they can jump off the tallest cactus in the Cactus Field.

docs.title: Quests
docs.text:
Polar Bear's quests require defeating mobs, collecting pollen for him, and catching petals (excluding his Egg Hunt quest, Egg Hunt: Polar Bear). In return, he will give the Player honey, treats, Polar Power, and occasionally, Crafting Materials. Some quests also guarantee a Ticket, one guaranteeing two. There is also a chance (1 in 100) to get the Chef Hat Polar Bear sticker and a chance (1 in 500) to get the Fork And Knife sticker. If a sticker is received, a rainbow sticker token will be dispensed onto a field.

Polar Power stacks additively, your Max Bee Energy will increase by 5% (or 0.05x) per stack. The equation for the multiplier can be represented by \({\frac {1}{20}}n+1\), where \(n\) is the quantity of stacks. All Polar Power earned is permanent—it will only ever go up, never down. The indicator for Polar Power is a fork in a blue square, with a number representing the number of quests you've completed.

docs.text:
Polar Bear doesn't give much information in his quest dialogues as he has one of the simplest dialogues in the game.

Type Dialogue Initial (First Talk)

Whoa! Haven't seen you before. I'm Polar Bear. I don't get many visitors this high up the mountain... Would you mind helping me out? You see, I love to cook. But it's hard for me to collect ingredients... I can't go down there, it's just too hot! If you get the ingredients, I'll share my dishes with you and your bees. My food's so good it gives you Polar Power! Polar Power permanently increases the energy of your bees by 5%. More energy lets them work longer before they need to return to the hive to sleep. I'll even throw in some honey for dessert! Sounds like a win-win to me! What do you say? Come talk to me again whenever you're ready to start cooking.

Quests

Hey there! You hungry? If you collect the ingredients, I'll cook us up something good. So good it'll permanently increase the maximum energy of your bees by 5%! I'll even throw in some honey for dessert! Check the Quest menu to see our next recipe.

I'm starving! How are the ingredients coming along? Hurry up so we can eat. If I get too hungry, I just might have to eat YOU! Hahaa [sic], just kidding...

That's all the ingredients I need! Ok, let me whip something up... ...(chop)...(chop)... ...(sizzle)... A dash of honey... ...(stir)... All done! Enjoy! Well, I'm always ready to eat. I'll be waiting when you're ready for more cooking!

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• When Polar Bear spawns a sticker, the notification will read "Polar Bear has spawned something in the Pumpkin Patch".
  • There was a bug which prevented Polar Bear's Quests counting towards the Quest Badge. This has now been fixed.
  • He's the last bear with a list of endless repeating quests, the other two being Black Bear and Brown Bear.
  • Polar Bear uses the Cartoony Animation Package.
  • He's one of the two bears to give a unique ability (Polar Power) after every quest, the other being Science Bear, who gives the Science Enhancement.
  • He is one of the only 3 bears to give repeating quests. He, Gifted Riley Bee, Gifted Bucko Bee, Honey Bee (NPC), Black Bear, and Brown Bear are the only quest givers to give repeating quests
  • He, Gifted Bucko Bee, Gifted Riley Bee, and Honey Bee (NPC) are the only Quest Givers that give repeating quests without a cooldown.
  • His quest "Thick Smoothie" is the only mention of a smoothie in a game other than the Super Smoothie.
  • He's the only bear in the game with repeatable quests which requires defeating mobs.
  • If only considering the quests that require defeating mobs, the quests of Polar Bear may be the ones which require the most amount of time to be completed, due to the mob cooldown. This has also greatly increased the difficulty of Bee Bear's quests because they require 35 Polar Bear Quests (during Beesmas 2018) or 15 Polar Bear Quests (during Beesmas 2019). Therefore, the time taken to complete Bee Bear's quest is largely dependent on luck regarding getting quests without the need to wait for mobs to respawn.
  • He has an older cousin called Bee Bear, a Traveling Bear. Both Bee Bear and Polar Bear mention being cousins.
  • Some of Bee Bear's quests involved completing Polar Bear quests.
  • If the player gave Polar Bear a Present, he would give 3 Oils, 2,500 Treats, x4 Pumpkin Patch Boost, and x10 Polar Power buff.
  • If the player gave Polar Bear a Present, the notification read, "🎁Science Bear has given you some gifts!🎁" instead of, "🎁Polar Bear has given you some gifts!🎁"
  • Polar Bear is in his 30's, as said in Bee Bear's dialogue.
  • Polar Bear isn't from the mountain, as said in Spirit Bear's dialogue.

docs.title: Pollen
docs.text:
Are you looking for Flowers or Honey?

Pollen is one of the main features in Re://:Swarm. Pollen is collected in order to make honey. It can be obtained by using tools (via tapping or clicking) on flowers, from bees collecting pollen and/or activating their abilities, from some passive abilities, from meteors, and from coconuts. Flowers can have different sizes and different colors. Some quests require pollen to be collected from a specific flower color or field. There are many sources of pollen multipliers, including amulets, bags, masks, badges, hive bonuses, abilities, field boosts, field winds, and certain passive abilities.

Pollen is mainly used to convert it into honey at the player's hive, through Instant Converters, by using a Micro-Converter, Honeysuckle, etc. This is one of the most common ways to get honey. Pollen is also used as a counter to track how much a player has farmed from a field in badges.

docs.title: Pollen Amount Per Flower
docs.text:
In order to get more pollen per collection, collect the biggest flowers on the field. The bigger the flower, the larger the pollen multiplier. There are 5 different flower sizes: single, double, triple, large, and star.

Flower size Single Double Triple Large Star Appearance Multiplier 1 2 3 4 5 Total amount of pollen 30 45 60 75 90

Collection amount and efficiency can be increased by using better tools (either collecting in a large area or multiplying pollen collection. For example, the Scythe and the Bubble Wand each collect double red and blue pollen, respectively). Collecting Bear Morph, Inspire, Beesmas Cheer, Baby Love ability tokens, Bear Bee and Basic Bee gifted bonuses, badges, using game mechanics, expanding the hive, different amulets, using items, and different passive abilities can all lead to better pollen collection.

docs.title: Pollination
docs.text:
Main article: Pollination

When a flower is pollinated, it upgrades any kind of flower, with star flowers being the exception. Flowers can be pollinated by Fuzzy Bee, The Diamond Drain Passive, bees with the Poinsettia or Lei beequip, and Guiding Star.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Single, double, and triple flowers are the only types of flowers that can naturally spawn in fields. Large and star flowers can only be spawned through pollination.
  • Before the 2020-04-06 update, the only stages of flowers were single, double, and large, with large flowers being the third level. This was changed to the current system, where the third tier was replaced with triple flowers, moving large to stage four.
  • In real life, nectar is used by bees to be turned into honey and not pollen.
Currencies Pollen • Honey • Ticket • Cog • Snowflake • Gingerbread Bear

docs.title: Pollination
docs.text:
Pollination is a mechanic that causes flowers to grow to higher tiers, increasing their total pollen and multiplier. Flowers that are lower tier than other flowers in the field have a higher chance of being pollinated. When flowers are pollinated, they will burst flower particles.

Flowers only stay pollinated for 1 minute, but this can be stacked up to 5 times for 5 minutes. Every minute that an already pollinated flower is not pollinated, it will go down a tier, until it has reverted to its original state.

Pollination is the only method to achieve large and star flowers, as the highest natural tier is triple.

docs.title: Ways To Pollinate Flowers
docs.text:
• Fuzzy Bee's Fuzz Bombs can pollinate flowers upon popping it.
  • Fuzzy Bee's Fuzzy Coat passive has a chance to pollinate up to 5 surrounding flowers while collecting pollen. This increases to 9 when gifted.
  • Fuzzy Bee's Pollen Haze pollinates up to 30 flowers every second. Bomb tokens produced in a field with pollen haze are automatically collected and pollinate flowers.
  • Diamond Mask's Diamond Drain pollinates 10 blue flowers when activated. The number of flowers pollinated increases by 3 for every blue bee the player has.
  • If Guiding Star is active, the star will pollinate 15 (+1 per gifted bee type) flowers every 15 seconds.
  • A bee with the Poinsettia Beequip equipped has an 11% to 20% chance to pollinate flowers while gathering.
  • A bee with the Lei Beequip equipped has a 20% to 50% chance to pollinate flowers while gathering.
  • A bee with the Rose Headband has a 10% to 20% chance to pollinate flowers while gathering.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This is the only way to directly change flowers in a field.
  • Fuzzy Bee is the only bee in the game to pollinate flowers without a Beequip.

docs.title: Porcelain Dipper
docs.text:
Porcelain Dipper Overview Price 150,000,000 Honey Shop Mountain Top Shop Pollen Collection Range 49 Flowers Collecting Pattern Surround collectedyou (facing up) Collecting Time 0.7 Base Collection 3 Flowers Single Double Triple Large Star White 4.5 9 13.5 18 22.5 Red 3 6 9 12 15 Blue 3 6 9 12 15 Special Multiplier(s): 50% White Pollen Multiplier

The Porcelain Dipper is a tool that was added in the 2018-06-02 update. It can be purchased in the Mountain Top Shop.

Crafting Ingredients 150,000,000 Honey

It collects 3 pollen from 49 surrounding patches in 0.7 seconds, increasing white pollen by 50%. Its average base pollen collection rate is 245 pollen per second: 315 from white flowers and 210 from red and blue flowers (the ability is not counted, assuming all flowers are single-size). It has a maximum base pollen collection rate of 315 pollen per second, which is achievable only in the Spider Field. It emits bubbles and sparkles.

Every 10th swing will summon a large copy of this tool rising up, it then summons a pillar of light collecting lots of pollen from 29 flowers (in a 5x5 area around the player and 4 other flowers 3 tiles ahead, to the side and behind the player) and plays a sound.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The price was increased from 100,000,000 (100 million) honey to 150,000,000 (150 million) honey after the 2019-04-05 update, because an ability was added to it.
  • It used to collect more patches prior to the 2019-04-05 update.
  • The Porcelain Dipper is an upgraded version of the Honey Dipper, which can be bought in the Pro Shop.
  • This was the second tool to have an ability, first being the Golden Rake.
  • Some decals aren't visible through the glass of a porcelain dipper (such as bee faces in a hive, or the flame effect on the scythe) similar to the water of the sprinklers.
  • However, if positioned correctly, it can be used to view certain things in areas, like the Coconut Canister, Coconut Clogs, and the Coconut Belt in the Coconut Cave.
  • The average collection rate of this tool is 41% better than the Scythe's and the Bubble Wand's average rate.
  • However, the Scythe is 48% better at red flowers, and the Bubble Wand is 48% better at blue flowers. This is tempered by the fact that there are no fields that are entirely blue or entirely red, meaning the Bubble Wand and Scythe never actually achieve their theoretical maximum collection rate.
  • The Porcelain Dipper glows white during a honeystorm.
  • The ability still activates outside of a field.
  • The Porcelain Dipper's light pillar will not collect pollen if the player is above the field in any way (e.g. jumping or gliding above the field or standing outside at the edge), although the pillar visually touches the flowers.
  • If a player goes in the King Beetle's Lair and jumps right before the beam effect, they can collect pollen from the Clover Field.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Out of the four variants of Port-O-Hive, the Porcelain Port-O-Hive was the second Port-O-Hive added into the game, after the regular Port-O-Hive.
  • The bag's stats were changed multiple times since its addition to the game.

  • This is the only container that emits particles.
  • In the 2026-04-23 update, all Port-O-Hive variants had its mesh scaled down due to a bug. The bug has been fixed and its cause is unknown.

docs.title: Precise Bee
docs.text:
Precise Bee Original Gifted "This sharpshooting bee is always on point and expects the same of you." RarityMythic ColorRed Energy40 Speed11.2 Attack8 Color Scheme Skin#450302#cb4144#840909

Precise Bee is a Red Mythic bee.

Precise Bee's favorite treat is Sunflower Seeds.

Precise Bee likes the Mountain Top Field and Rose Field. It dislikes the Bamboo Field and Pine Tree Forest.

docs.title: Stats
docs.text:
• Collects 20 Pollen in 4 seconds.
  • Makes 80 Honey in 4 seconds.
  • +7 Attack, -20% Movespeed, +10 Gather Amount, +100% Energy, +5% Critical Chance, +3% Super-Crit Chance.
  • 🌟Gifted Hive Bonus: +3% Super-Crit Chance.

docs.title: AbilitiesLevels 1-8Levels 9-16Levels 17-24Levels 25-31
docs.text:
• Target Practice Causes the bee to fly into the air and project 3 targets on the field for a few seconds. Running on a target activates it.
  • When all 3 targets are activated, this collects all ability tokens and grants a stack of Precision, which grants +2% Super-Crit Chance for 60s and stacks up to 10 times. Super-Crits can only occur for Critical hits and gain x2 power and 100% Instant Conversion.
  • After a few seconds, any target activated will generate a Focus token and be shot, collecting pollen equal to double this bee's attack (+10% per Level) from 29 Flowers. With Flame Heat, the shots gain up to x4 Pollen and up to 50% instant conversion. Any unactivated target spawns a Red Boost token instead.
  • If the player is shot while standing on a target, this collects all ability tokens and consumes your Flame Heat to instantly convert Pollen in your bag, with half turning into Honey Tokens. The amount converted is equal to 50% of your Convert Total + 10x this bee's convert amount and scales up to x10 with the Flame Heat consumed and up to x3 with your current field's boost stacks.
  • If Gifted: When only the farthest target is activated, it will summon a Precise Mark which grants +7% Critical Chance and Super-Crit Chance and stacks up to 3 times.
  • If the player collects a Target Practice token that is outside the field, they will immediately be granted either the Precision or the Focus buff. The chances of getting Precision buff are 20%, and 80% for Focus buff.
  • Passive: Sniper When fighting mobs, this bee uses slow, long ranged shots that are more accurate and deal x2 damage. The accuracy is calculated as if the bee was 1 level higher (2 if gifted), and it can never be below 5%. If the shot is a Critical Hit, the reload time after shots is reduced by 50%. If it's a Super-Crit, it's reduced by 75%.

Precise Bee has a base pollen collection of 20 in 4 seconds.

That's equivalent to 5 per second.

(40 in 4 seconds with x2 Bee Pollen gamepass)

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Excluding Event bees, this bee, Demon Bee and Fire Bee are the only red bees currently in the game whose favorite treat is not strawberries.
  • This is the only red Mythic Bee who doesn't like strawberries.
  • The Precise Bee is the only Mythic Bee that does not have a gifted ability.
  • Precise Bee's attack is based on a long-ranged weapon with a sharp scope, such as a sniper.
  • This is the only bee that can attack mobs from outside the standard bee range, and likewise the only bee that shoots projectiles towards hostile mobs to deal damage.
  • This bee's attack changes appearance when landing a Critical Hit or Super-Crit. It fires a bigger projectile when landing a Critical Hit, and fires a purple projectile when landing a Super-Crit. This makes Precise Bee the only bee to have a standard attack that changes depending on whether a Critical hit (Or Super-Crit) are rolled.
  • This bee, Buoyant Bee, and Fuzzy Bee are the only mythic bees to be added since the release of the original three Mythic bees, which are Vector Bee, Tadpole Bee and Spicy Bee.
  • Precise Bee and Buoyant Bee were both added in the 2021-12-26 update.
  • This bee, Vector Bee, Spicy Bee and Buoyant Bee all have glowing parts when gifted.
  • This bee is the only bee that has a part of their body that glows even if it is not gifted.
  • This, along with Tabby Bee, are the only bees that have an ability that grants Super-Critical chance.
  • This bee is the only bee to always hit a level 26 mob (27 if gifted) when it is level 25. Its passive guarantees that it never misses against mobs one level higher (two if gifted.)
  • Unlike Fuzz Bombs and Bubbles, players cannot activate each other's targets.
  • The Precise Bee target practice of other players is seen as gray to prevent confusion on which one is the player's.
  • If the "Hide Other Bees" option were activated, other player's targets will be invisible instead.
  • This bee, Cobalt Bee, Crimson Bee, Photon Bee, Windy Bee, Tadpole Bee, and Ninja Bee are the only bees that have a trail.
  • There used to be a glitch with Gifted Precise Bee's Precise Mark, that even after the farthest target is activated, it was supposed to summon the mark, but it often wouldn't spawn.
  • Another glitch can occur where when a target is hit, it does not function which commonly occur due to server lag.
  • After giving Gifted Riley Bee a Presents during the Beesmas 2022 Event, Gifted Riley Bee explains how people would die for a Precise Mark, possibly referencing this specific bug.
  • Precise Bee's attack can still be seen by other Players even if they have their Hide Other Bees option on.
  • Factoring in the passive and the attack, this bee has the highest attack damage, only surpassed by Gummy Bee when the Gummy Bear Morph ability is active.
  • Although spawning Precise Marks is considered a mark ability, it is not affected by Mark Ability Pollen multipliers.
  • Target Practice does not receive the 10% pollen buff per level.

docs.title: Present
docs.text:
This article is about the gifts given to NPCs. Not to be confused with Ornament Presents and Gift Boxes.

Present

"A festively wrapped gift. Exchange it with an NPC for prizes!"

COOLDOWN

(None)

A Present is a Beesmas-exclusive inventory item from the Beesmas event. Presents can be given to most NPCs in the game in exchange for various prizes from the NPC. Each NPC can only receive one gift.

To give a present, the player needs to talk to an NPC of their choice. When interacted with, special dialogue will appear, allowing the player to give the present to the chosen NPC. If the player does not have a present in their inventory or have already recently given said NPC a present, normal dialogue will display. Some NPCs may have other requirements for the player before it allows itself to receive a gift.

docs.title: Beesmas
docs.text: Presents are available during the Beesmas event. Their main function is adding Ornaments to the Beesmas Tree when given to NPCs. Players can't give a present to Sun Bear, as the bear is not present during the event.

docs.title: Ways to obtain
docs.text:
• Multiple quests from Bee Bear award a total of 10 Presents, along with other rewards.
  • Bee Bear's Catalog sold 1 Present for 250 Snowflakes and 10 Gingerbread Bears.
  • Onett gives 1 Present (along with other items) upon claiming a hive for the first time during the event's period.
  • Donating Strawberries to the Galentine Shrine has a chance to give 1 Present, along with other rewards.
  • Completing Robo Party's rank 25 for the first time gives 1 Present, along with other rewards.

docs.title: Dialogue
docs.text:
NPC Dialogue Black Bear Oh, hello there!

-Present Given-

What've you gotten me this year? I'll bet it's something special. ...(krumple krumple)... Wow! A honey-straw! A straw made specifically for drinking honey. I've heard so much about these. Somehow they get a lot mroe honey up in a lot less time. Thank you so much! Now here's your present: the [Honey Jar Ornament]! With this on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate+25% Capacity in the Sunflower Fieldand +5% Honey Per Pollen!Enjoy! And Happy Honeydays!

Mother Bear The Honeydays bring the bees so much joy!

--Present Given-

Oh! Is this for me? How very sweet of you! Ill open it right now! ....(krumple krumple)... Aww! It's an evil little Snow Cub plushie! That Snow Cub is always getting up to no good, isn't it. If he were MY cub. Well, he'd probably be just as bad. I'm such a push over. Now go ahead and open up what i got for you! It's the [Stuffed Heart Ornament]! With this on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Strawberry Field And +10% Pollen from Bee Gathering! Merry Beesmas! I hope your hive enjoys that!

Brown Bear Brrrr, it's cold!

-Present Given-

But not too cold for us to exchange gifts! So what's it, huh? What'd you get ol' Brown Bear? ...(krumple krumple)... Whoa! It's a Bwhoop health-tracking wrist band! It lets you know when your Royal Jelly levels are too low. And when your quest-stressing levels are too high! Thanks bud, this should be good for my health. Now look what i got you! The [Royal Jelly Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate. +25% Capacity in the Clover Field, and +20% Pollen from "Bomb" abilities! I'm gonna go calibrate this thing, Happy Beesmas!

Panda Bear Hmm...

-Present Given-

Even though I'm on guard, I'm still open to gifts. ...(krumple krumple)... WHOA! It's a Monster-Slay Offline Voucher! Onett told me he would NEVER add one of these things. Said we'd probably never see any of you again! Guess it slipped through the cracks. Thanks. Now you take this: the [Boxing Glove Ornament]. With that on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate. +25% Capacity in the Bamboo Field, and +5% Bee Attack Power! Stay safe out there, and Merry Beesmas.

Science Bear Keeping busy on Beesmas, just like me, I presume.

-Present Given-

Ah, busy getting me a gift I see! Let's get to the inspection. ...(krumple krumple)... Fascinating! This is a Beebini Honeycincincinappannini! A creature designed by an artificial intelligence no bear can comprehend. It appears to be half bee, and half panini. A miracle of science, to be sure. I'm not counting this as a bee discovery, though. Now it's your turn! I got you the [Conical Flask] ornament! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Pineapple Patch And +25% Convert Rate at the Hive! That ought to help make this Beesmas productive. Thanks again for all your help. Happy Honeydays! Now you'll excuse me, I'm going to take a DNA sample of this thing.

Polar Bear It's good time of year [sic] to be a polar bear!

-Present Given-

Especially for my cousin, Bee Bear. His entire identity is centered around Beesmas. At first our family thought it was weird, but we've become supportive over the years. Beesmas brings Bee Bear joy and gives him a sense of purpose. Who are we to judge? We all have our quirks. Me, I'm obsessed with cooking. So I hope you brought a cooking related gift! Come on, let's see what you brought. ...(krumple krumple)... Oh wow! A $50 gift card to Bearawhon! Don't know how far that'll go at such an expensive grocery store... Might get me a half pint of [Blueberries], or a single [Super Smoothie]. But I appreciate it! Now, go ahead and open yours. It's [Cast Iron Skillet] Ornament! With this on the tree, you'll receive these boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Pumpkin Patch And +10% White Field Capacity! Hope that helps you complete my cousins [sic] crazy quests! Happy Honeydays!

Dapper Bear You're free to warm yourself up in my shop.

-Present Given-

A [Present] for me? What, do you like me or something? Well I hope so, cause I think quite highly of you. Let's see what you think I'd like. ...(krumple krumple)... Ah! A Sticker Book with all 400 slots unlocked! That must have cost a ton of [Tickets]. And for what? A little convenience? Heh, well, a little convenience goes a long way with me. Thank you. Now for you: It's the [Potpourri Ornament]. It's filled with flowers and leaves I grew in my Planters. The fragrance is pretty strong... but hey, smells like Beesmas. With this on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Dandelion Field And +5% Nectar. I hope you'll get some use out of that. Because I've already got enough stickers to get use out of mine!

Onett Is it snowing? I can't tell from in this... cave..

-Present Given-

A [Present] for me? Wow, thanks! Ok, let's see what it is. ...(krumple krumple)... Wow!! Some cough drops! Just what I needed. If this is because you've heard my voice crack... Well, I can explain. It does that when I'm tired and I've been talking a lot. A little embarrassing. But these will help! Ok, now look at what I made just for you... and everyone else who gives me a [Present]. It's the [Candy Cane Reindeer Ornament]! With this on the Beesmas tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity on the Mountain Top Field and +20% Pollen from Tools! Oh, and some other things. Like the boosts you probably actually wanted. Merry Beesmas and Happy Happy Honeymaking!

Spirit Bear Mmmm...mhmm...(she's murmuring to herself with her eyes close [sic])...

-Present Given-

nil [sic]

Robo Bear (click click click click click)

-Present Given-

CHARITABLE GIFT DETECTED I am shocked and I am thankful and I will open this package now. >> Commencing Unwrapping Sequence ...(krumple krumple)... I've been gifted 32GB OF DDR5 RAM! With this, I'll be able to generate challenge rounds approximately 0.389% faster! I will gladly accept this and offer you this in return: the [Digital Pet Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +10% Capacity +25% Capacity in the Spider Field +10% Pollen from Event Bees And +5% Pollen from Duped Abilities! >> GIFT EXCHANGE SEQUENCE COMPLETE: OUTCOME SUCCESS

Gifted Riley Bee I should have built a roof like Bucko Bee...

-Present Given-

WHAT! A GIFT? No way! Youuuuuuuu Well hand it over! Come on! ...(krumple krumple)... WHAT IS THIS????? I DIDN'T EVEN KNOW THEY EXISTED!! A 20% Red Pollen Hive Bonus Poinsettia!!! This is going to skyrocket the Red HQ into astronomical levels of wealth! Thank you thank you thank you! Now, mine's not quite that fancy, but here it is: It's the [Electric Candle Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive these boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Rose and Mushroom Field and +10% Pollen from Flames! Now to go look up what I could get for this thing I mean... to equip it and use it to it's [sic] fullest potential.

Gifted Bucko Bee Looks chilly out there!

-Present Given-

Well, if it isn't the coolest beekeeper around! You bringing me a [Present] makes you even cooler. Let's see what it is... ...(krumple krumple)... Well I'll be! A whole jar of marbles! Man... that's a lot of marbles. Some pretty cool ones in there. I see one that kind of looks like a [Swirled Wax]. That's neat. Can't wait to crack this open and roll those bad boys around. Thanks. You're truly cool. Take this, why don't you: The [Snowman Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Blue Flower Field and Pine Tree Forest and +10% Blue Field Capacity! Hope that helps your Blue Beesmas dreams come true!

Stick Bug You beekeepers are funny with your seasonal traditions.

-Present Given-

They keep me entertained for sure. Now, let's see what you've lugged up onto this mushroom. ...(krumple krumple)... Oh wow, a xylophone! Those signature playful percussive notes hit you right in the funny bone. I'll make some really funky music with this. Thank you flesh-bug! Now take this: it's a [Partridge In A Stick Bug Ornament]. With that on the tree, you'll receive the following buffs: +25% Convert Rate... +25% Capacity on the Cactus Field and Pepper Patch... And +5% Gifted Bee Pollen. Hope you find it useful. But first, let's dance.

Honey Bee Bzzz zzz zzuh...

-Present Given-

Bzzz buz ZZ! ZZZZZ BZZ BZZZZ!!! ...(krumple krumple)... (You open up the [Present] for Honey Bee) (The box is filled to the brim with honey) BUZZZZZZZUH BZZZZZZZ! Bzz zz zz! (Honey Bee's eye [sic] open wide with joy) (You can tell it's very grateful) Bzzzz zzz buzz bz BUZ zz. (Honey Bee pulls out a platic [sic] bag full of honey) (Inside floats a crude plastic figurine of Honey Bee) Zzzz! (You can sense that with this on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive these boosts:) (+25% Convert Rate) (+10% Epic Bee Pollen) (+10% Honey From Tokens) (And +1% Honey Per Goo!) Bzz zuh Buzz buzz BuzzZuhz (Honey Bee eyes your honey meter madly) (You can sense it wants to cash in the IOU immediately)

Gummy Bear A beekeeper approaches, Gummy Bee!

-If the player does not meet the requirements-

A box wrapped in colorful paper... a gift? You believe you're worthy of exchanging gifts with US? HAH We do not accept trifles from meager meat-based civilians. Prove yourself by completing our quest and we may reconsider.

-If the player meets the requirements-

What is that in your two hands, Gummy Soldier? A customary delivery... A gesture of GOO-d will. Gummy Bee and I permit you to open it for us. ...(krumple krumple)... OH! You've brought live ammunition. A case of hand GOO-nades! How EXPLOSIVELY sweet. I will put these to good use gumming up a village or two. KABOOM! In exchange, my gooey grunt, I give you this: The [Gummy Globe Ornament]! Let it serve as a constant reminder that better days WILL COME. And the unbearably bitter and salty states of all worlds will give way to a SWEET future. ALL worlds will be GOOnited when Gummy Bee and I are through. And with that ornament on your wooden plant, you'll receive the following boosts to aid in our GOO CRUCADE [sic]. +10% Capacity +25% Coconut Field Capacity +1% Super-Crit Chance And +10% GOO! Now go GOO UP the pathetic Beesmas festivities once and for all!

Pro Bear is a bear who runs the Pro Shop. He is the second shop bear encountered by most players. His presence is not required to purchase items in the shop.

Pro Bear has a similar appearance to Noob Bear and Top Bear: yellow skin, red shirt, green pants, and a smiley face. The only difference between them is the colors of their clothing.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Pro Bear is one of the four bears in the 10 Bee Area, the others being Science Bear, Dapper Bear, and Tunnel Bear.
  • This bear, Noob Bear, Top Bear, and Shadow Bear are the only bears without a function whatsoever.
  • Behind Pro Bear, there is a maze that contains a royal jelly token, sunflower seed token, and has the ability to host hidden stickers.

docs.title: Pro Shop
docs.text:
Pro Shop Location Past the Brave Bee Gate.

The Pro Shop is a shop located past the Brave Bee Gate, next to the Pineapple Patch. The Mythic Meteor Shower Summoner used to be on top of the shop before being moved in the Trading Update to the Badge Bearer's Guild.

This shop sells four Bags, five Tools, four Guards, a Hat, a Belt, a pair of Boots, Paper Planters, and the Parachute.

As with the Noob Shop, the game does not explicitly name the shop. However, the bear who runs the shop is named "Pro Bear". Therefore, the community has named the shop as such.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• The Slingshot will sometimes undershoot the player near Panda Bear or in the middle of the Bamboo Field. If the Slingshot does not undershoot, it will regularly shoot the player in front of the shop's door.
  • There are two Royal Jelly tokens, one of them on top of the shop at the end of a dark passage and one within inside the shop, the latter being hidden in the Maze behind Pro Bear. The player can obtain it by going all the way to the end, turning right, going to the end, turning right, and going to the first corridor on the right and follow through it to find the token.
  • Since the 2018-07-11 update, there is a Sunflower Seed token inside the maze that gives 10 Sunflower Seeds. The player can obtain it by going right two times, just like the Royal Jelly, but on the second right, go to the end of the hall and follow through the last corridor to the right.
  • There is a giant pineapple near the Pro Shop, where there are 3 Tickets on top that can be collected by using the Red Cannon and the Parachute or Glider to glide down onto the top.
  • If the player stands on the piece of blue wall behind the backpack models and jumps high enough, they can go into the space between the roof and the ceiling.
  • Spotted chicks were able to spawn here before they were removed.
  • Spotted chicks were also able to spawn in the space between the roof and the ceiling. When they spawned there, the feet of the chick would be visible.
  • With 18 items, the Pro Shop has the most purchasable items out of all of the shops.
  • Out of the three shops that have a shop bear, this is the only one that sells at least 1 type of guard.

docs.title: Public Sticker Board
docs.text:
The Public Sticker Board is located in the Hive Hub, and allows players to add or take stickers from it. There is a 22-hour cooldown for taking a sticker from the board and a 10-minute cooldown for adding a sticker to the board. The Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine might occasionally require players to donate a sticker to the Public Sticker Board as well. It serves as a way of obtaining stickers or removing spare stickers.

Onett may decide to disable trading for any number of reasons for a period of time. During this period, no player can request a trade or use the Public Sticker Board. For a list of times this has been observed, see the Trading article.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Play Button and Game Chat Icon stickers cannot typically be donated to the Public Sticker Board.
  • This restriction does not apply to people who can give out these stickers.
  • During the Beesmas of Summer 2024, the Fluorescent Gift Box was located behind the Public Sticker Board.

docs.title: Puffshroom
docs.text: Puffshrooms are passive entities that spawn naturally on the 15th and the 45th minute of the hour in a random field except Hive Hub and Challenge Fields (Ant Field); they may also spawn in the players' planters with their base level depending on the planter. Puffshrooms receive damage by collecting pollen around its vicinity, filling up the required pollen in the pollen meter will defeat the puffshroom, drop loot, and may release 0 to 4 spores that generates puffshrooms.

docs.title: Variants/Rarities
docs.text:
• Common/Normal (Soft/Pale Brown Cap, Beige Yellow Stem, common).
  • Rare (Silver/Gray Cap, Gray Stem, rare).
  • Epic (Gold/Yellow Cap, Pale Yellow Stem, very rare).
  • Legendary (Light/Pale Blue Cap, Baby Blue Stem, extremely rare).
  • Mythic (Purple Cap, Pale Purple Stem, exceptionally rare).
  • Supreme (Re://:Swarm only, above Mythic).

Once spawned, the first (or the main) Puffshroom will last 5 minutes before naturally despawning — a timer is shown above the pushroom that displays the time left to defeat it. Players are required to collect a certain amount of pollen (indicated by the pollen meter) within its vicinity until the meter is full. When the Puffshroom is defeated, it drops loot and turns into concentrated spores to spread to different fields. The loot is separate for all players, meaning that one player will not have the same as the other. The quality of the loot depends on the type, level, and the damage dealt to the Puffshroom before its defeat — if the player has not dealt enough damage to it, it will only drop treats and honey.

Puffshrooms have a unique way of leveling up, as it heavily depends on the generation. The Puffshroom gains chances of leveling up when the field it goes by has not been touched by its ancestor; if an ancestor Puffshroom has touched the field, it will have a chance of its levels decreasing instead. The effect lasts up to 8 generations, and this effect will not be effective when it has reached more than 8 generations until it has been done again. If the Puffshroom reaches certain levels, it starts to have a chance of spawning a rarer variant. When it reaches higher levels, the chances of getting the rarer variants also increase.

Levels required for the rarity to gain a chance to spawn:

  • Common: Level 1+
  • Rare: Level 5+
  • Epic: Level 8+
  • Legendary: Level 10+
  • Mythic: Level 12+
  • Supreme: Level 15+

docs.title: Supreme Puffshroom
docs.text:
The Supreme Puffshroom is a Puffshroom rarity added in the Painter Bee event. It ranks above Mythic, making it the rarest Puffshroom.

A Puffshroom has to be at least level 15 before it can become Supreme. For comparison, Mythic needs level 12.

docs.title: Supreme drops
docs.text:
• Fluxite Wax (1 in 10). Loot multipliers do not change this chance.
  • Supreme Puffshroom sticker (1 in 100). It is one of the Painter stickers. Stacking it gives +1% Bee Ability Rate and 5 Neonberry.

docs.title: Hiding Puffshrooms
docs.text: The "Hide Puffs Below" performance setting (Rare, Epic, Legendary or Mythic) hides Puffshrooms below the chosen rarity, and their spores in fields too.

docs.title: Spawning
docs.text:
In the game, Puffshrooms are guaranteed to appear in random fields, except for Hive Hub and Challenge Fields, at the 15th and 45th minute of every hour (e.g. 9:15, 9:45, etc) (note that you might be using the time of a clock that is either delayed or advanced compared to the clock in-game). You can use the clock on the side of the Mountain Top Shop showing how long until Mondo Chick spawns; they spawn when the timer reaches 45:00 or 15:00. Similarly, during Beesmas, the timer of Bee Bear's Catalog can be used to determine the time.

A planter that reaches 95% growth has a chance of spawning a Puffshroom:

A planter that will spawn a Puffshroom is indicated by clouds of brown smoke (spores) emitting from the planter.

docs.title: Drops
docs.text:
Puffshrooms have daily loot limits, similarly to Wild Windy Bee. The loot drops decrease the more you get and resets every day. They have their own specific loot, specific to each player, meaning loot cannot be stolen from other players. Puffshroom loot is also determined based on how much the player has contributed to defeating the Puffshroom. If a Puffshroom has been defeated and the player has not contributed to its pollen meter, it will only drop Honey tokens and Treats. On the contrary, however, more plentiful and rare rewards will be given the more the player contributes to the Puffshroom's pollen meter.

All abilities that can collect tokens except for Token Link and Target Practice can collect Puffshroom loot. Not all items dropped by the Puffshroom can be dropped by all types; some of them can only be dropped by a specific rarity.

docs.title: Guaranteed Drops
docs.text:
• Honey (Increased with Honey From Tokens and rarity).
  • Treats (Increments are based on the level).

docs.title: Possible Drops
docs.text: The types and quality of the drops depend on the rarity, level, and the damage dealt to the Puffshroom. The drops also degrade the more loot you collect from them. Treat and Honey are always dropped by a Puffshroom, with the amounts scaling from the level and damage dealt.

docs.title: Puffshroom Blessing
docs.text:
Popping a rare+ Puffshroom also grants Puffshroom Blessing buff to all contributing players. The number of stacks granted is depending on the Puffshroom's level and rarity:

  • Rare: x0.5 level
  • Epic: x1 level
  • Legendary: x1.5 level
  • Mythic: x2 level

The number of stacks granted is further increased by x2 if it's popped on a field that haven't been visited by its ancestor.

Puffshroom Blessing grants +1~10% of the following buffs for 3 hours depending on the stacks, with max stacks of 100:

  • Unique Instant Conversion
  • Pollen
  • Capacity
  • Honey from Tokens

docs.title: Strategies
docs.text:
• The clouds of spores indicate where the Puffshrooms will go next.
  • Having a large team of players can help with collecting the required pollen faster.
  • Activating as many buffs as possible will help collection become optimal.
  • If the player has many materials, but does not wish to use more expensive ones like the Super Smoothie, the recommended materials are: Oil, Tropical Drink, Blue Extract and Red Extract.
  • Using the Red Field Booster, Blue Field Booster, Mountain Top Field Booster, and the Coconut Dispenser.
  • Using Glitter or Field Dice in fields where they spawn in can increase efficiency.
  • When the Coconut Clogs or Gummy Boots are equipped, using Coconuts will grant Coconut Haste and an additional stack of Haste, which helps when following spore clouds.
  • Using Windy Bee's Tornado Ability can help collect heavy amounts of pollen from large groups of Puffshrooms.
  • Setting up Sprinklers near the Puffshrooms helps the flowers near the Puffshroom to regrow faster.
  • Puffshrooms that go to fields where the previous eight "generations" of that Puffshroom didn't travel to has a greater chance to level up.
  • Using Whirligigs can allow players to reach certain fields with Puffshrooms quicker, especially ones located at the Starter Zone.
  • Using an Oil or Super Smoothie increases movement speed, which can help with reaching different puffshrooms more quickly.
  • Targeting higher level Puffshrooms can increase your chance of better rarities.
  • Listening to the spawn sounds of different rarities of Puffshrooms will help you identify them if you can't spot them.
  • Defeating tough mobs that spawn before doing Puffshrooms prevents your bees from being distracted by the mob, such as the Mondo Chick and Coconut Crab.
  • One of the best ways to get a large amount of Puffshrooms is to get them into either the Cactus, Pumpkin, or Pine Tree field. Then, assign one player to the each of the three fields, and "bounce" the Puffshrooms between those three fields. (This is commonly referred to as the "15 zone strat".) More fields, such as Rose, Strawberry, and rarely Mountain Top can be added if more players are present.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• Its name is similar to the plant "Puff-shroom" in the Plants vs. Zombies (game) series, possibly being a reference to said franchise.
  • Puffshrooms are based on a real-life mushroom called Calvatia gigantea, which usually sport a similar structure and spread rapidly through spores.
  • Despite having a Level system, there is no way to "miss" a Puffshroom, unlike with most mobs.
  • Puffshrooms emit faint, unique brown smoke particles, which are meant to be spores.
  • After completing the quest "Puffshrooms for Presents", Bee Bear mentions that Puffshrooms are an invasive species, implying Dapper Bear might have accidentally brought Puffshrooms to the game, similar to how Sun Bear accidentally brought in the Bean Bugs and Chicks during the Egg Hunt events and how Spirit Bear brought the Coconut Crab.
  • This is the only mob that is not based on an animal and the only one that requires pollen to defeat — Sprouts do not count as a mob.
  • Harvesting planters can bypass the usual level restrictions for certain rarities. For example, a level 5 Legendary Puffshroom can spawn when harvesting a Blue Clay Planter, despite that their minimum level is level 10.
  • Defeating higher-tier Puffshrooms counts toward quests which require specific types of Puffshrooms to be defeated. For example, defeating a Mythic Puffshroom would count towards a quest that requires a player to defeat a Common, Rare, Epic, or Legendary Puffshroom as well.
  • Puffshroom rarities have an increased chance of spawning if it is a higher level.
  • All rarities of Puffshrooms have their own specific spawn sounds. For example, a Epic Puffshroom's spawn sound is lower pitched than the sound of a Rare Puffshroom.
  • Puffshrooms are unable to be damaged during a Robo Bear Challenge.
  • Onett can spawn Puffshrooms of any rarity and level globally, just like how he can control Mythic Meteor Showers, Snow Storms, Night Bells and more.
  • On 2021-12-28, Onett spawned a global Level 30 Epic Puffshroom in the Sunflower Field with 2.68 trillion HP to troll people who complained that Stick Bug's Beesmas quest was too hard.
  • On 2022-03-31, Onett spawned a global Level 4 Legendary Puffshroom in the Dandelion Field while also summoning nighttime with a message in chat reading; "The Legendary Puffshroom [sic] in the Dandelion Field has summoned nighttime..." This was most likely done to help players that were still stuck on Bee Bear's final quest which required a Legendary Puffshroom to be defeated.
    • Later that same day, he spawned multiple Legendary Puffshrooms in the Sunflower Field. According to Onett in one of his Discord messages, the Puffshrooms were supposed to be Common, but he accidentally spawned Legendary ones instead.

The Pumpkin Patch is a field located past the Honey Bee Gate and it lies right beside the Cactus Field. It is protected by the werewolf.

This field can spawn honey, treat, ticket, magic bean, and glue tokens when collecting pollen.

Bees that like the Pumpkin Patch are Honey Bee, Shy Bee, Bear Bee, and Photon Bee. Bees that dislike the Pumpkin Patch are Bomber Bee, Hasty Bee, and Gummy Bee.

This field grants Satisfying Nectar and an increased chance on dropping waxes when a planter is planted here.

A level 1-20 Wild Windy Bee has a chance of spawning here.

Additionally, the largest pumpkin in the corner of the field seldomly makes a face before generating sparkles in the field.

This is a 17x33 field, containing 561 flowers. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of double and triple.

docs.title: Obtaining Boosts
docs.text:
• Using the Field Booster may give a Pumpkin Patch Boost. When it does, it will give +200% Pumpkin Patch pollen for 15 minutes.

  • Using glitter in the field will add 100% Pumpkin Patch pollen onto the current boost if it isn't already maxed out.

  • Using Field Dice, Smooth Dice, or Loaded Dice may add +100% - 300% Pumpkin Patch pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out.
  • Pumpkin Patch Winds can be obtained through the Wind Shrine or codes. They have a base of +20% instant Pumpkin Patch conversion and give +5% instant Pumpkin Patch conversion and +20% Pumpkin Patch pollen for each stack. Pumpkin Patch Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times normally and can be boosted by up to 15x by using codes.
  • It can be boosted by the Shell Amulet. If it has a Pumpkin Patch Boost, it can boost the field by +5% to +30% depending on the amulet rarity.
  • Giving Polar Bear a Present during Beesmas gives the player Pumpkin Patch Boost x3.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This field's badge and the Sunflower Badge are used 3 times for chances in Memory Match, the most out of any field badges.
  • There is a Royal Jelly token behind the two pumpkins in the corner.
  • This is one of the 3 fields to have objects come to life. The others are Pineapple Patch and Sunflower Field.
  • Before the 2018-04-27 update, the Pumpkin Patch had the same mix of flowers as the Cactus Field.
  • This field used to be the smallest field until the Stump Field was added.
  • Due to the expansion of the Stump Field, this field has now become the smallest again (if one weren't to count the Ant Field).
  • This field is one of three fields to have the word "Patch" in their name instead of "Field," with the Pineapple Patch and Pepper Patch being the other two.
  • Prior to the 2022-12-26 update, the pumpkins nearest to the Werewolf's Cave had collision. Their collision has since been removed.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a Star Treat, Gingerbread Bears or Aged Gingerbread Bears.

Puppy Bee likes the Clover Field and the Pumpkin Patch. It dislikes the Rose Field.

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• When Puppy Bee came out on the 2018-09-10 Update, it was on sale in the Ticket Tent for 250 tickets until September 22, 2018.
  • It takes 3 hits of the ball by the owner and 3 hits by the Puppy Bee (3 volleys) to drop a treat token. The more times the ball is hit in a row, the more treats are earned from the treat token (Doubled every time a combo is done, starting at 1, capping at 256).
  • Once the treat token reaches the capped amount of treats, the ball will permanently stay light green and will not be able to produce any more treat tokens.
  • It takes a total of 54 hits to reach the max amount of treats, and 60 to get 10x Reindeer Guidance.
  • When a treat token of this kind is collected, even if more than 1 treat is earned from the treat token, it will always count as 1 treat token collected in quests.
  • Puppy Bee was the first bee to be able to create treat tokens, the second being Festive Bee with its festive gift ability.
  • Puppy Bee was likely made to be Tabby Bee's canine counterpart.
  • Sometimes, the ball spawned by the fetch token can get stuck, allowing the player and Puppy Bee to easily pass it back and forth.
  • Puppy Bee was the first bee that has a 3D model on its face (its tongue).
  • Puppy Bee, Bear Bee, and Tabby Bee are currently the only bees that were sold at a discount for a limited amount of time.
  • This bee, Bear Bee, Gummy Bee, Tabby Bee, Festive Bee, Digital Bee, and Windy Bee are the only Event bees that can be a First Edition Bee.
  • First Edition Puppy Bee could have been obtained by buying it before September 22, 2018.
  • Treat tokens produced by Puppy Bee's fetch can be collected with a Token Link, similar to Honey Gifts.
  • Puppy Bee is the third bee to produce a token that has its face on it, the second being Tabby Bee, and the first being Rage Bee.
  • This is the only bee that is able to raise the bond of other bees, through its puppy love token.
  • This bee, Vicious Bee, Crimson Bee, Cobalt Bee, and Windy Bee are the only Event bees that don't have an 'enhanced' ability if gifted.
  • The puppy love token glows when collected.
  • Puppy Bee's wings clip through its ears.
  • Bee Bear's Puppy Bee is male.
  • This and Festive Bee are the only bees that can produce gingerbread bears.
  • This bee, Festive Bee, and Demon Bee are the only bees that have an exclusive beequip for themselves.
  • During the Beesmas 2020 Event, players could purchase a special bundle for 800 Robux in the Robux Shop that would grant them a Puppy Bee Egg, the special Reindeer Antlers Beequip specifically made for the Puppy Bee, and 50 Gingerbread Bears as a bonus.
  • If the player already had a Puppy Bee when they bought the bundle, they would get 500 tickets instead.
  • This makes Puppy Bee the only bee available to purchase in the Robux Shop twice.
  • This bee, along with Tadpole Bee, Tabby Bee, Lion Bee, and Bear Bee are the only bees based on real animals.

docs.title: Purple Potion
docs.text:
Purple Potion

"Grants x1.25 Capacity and the improved boosts of Red and Blue Extracts and Glue for 15 minutes."

COOLDOWN

None

A Purple Potion is a craftable inventory item added in the 2020-04-06 update. When used, it grants the following for 15 minutes:

  • x1.25 Capacity.
  • x1.25 Convert Rate At Hive.
  • x1.5 Red Pollen.
  • x1.5 Blue Pollen.
  • x1.3 Bee Gather Pollen.
  • x1.3 Tool Pollen.

A Purple Potion buff cannot exist simultaneously along with Red Extract, Blue Extract, or a Glue buff. If any of these buffs are active when a purple potion is used, they will be overridden. Using a Super Smoothie will override the buff, due to the Purple Potion being included in its craft.

docs.title: Quest Givers
docs.text:
Quest Givers are interactive NPC characters who give quests to the player to complete. In return, they give various rewards upon completion. There are a total of 13 quest givers in-game, excluding traveling quest givers.

When the player completes a quest in a main questline, a message will appear, stating:

{Name of quest} is ready for {Quest Giver}!

If the player completes a repeatable quest, a message will appear, stating:

{Name of quest} is ready to turn in!

This is to remind the player to go to the quest giver to claim their rewards. The message will also appear again whenever the player rejoins the game if they had not turned it in before.

When the player hands in a quest to a quest giver, a message will appear stating:

{Name of quest} Complete!

docs.title: Quests
docs.text:
Quests are a major mechanic in Re://:Swarm. It allows the player to do tasks in order to receive various rewards that allow them to progress further into the game. Quests are not necessary for progression, but are highly recommended. There are a few exceptions, such as Science Bear's Translator questline, and Spirit Bear's questline, which are required to complete to progress.

Quests can be obtained and turned in through conversing with various quest givers. As of now, 8 active quest bears, 3 quest bees, Onett, and 1 machine can give out quests. Traveling bears and other various creatures also give quests but were only available for a limited time in the game.

Quests have many different types of requirements, such as collecting various amounts of pollen from fields, ability tokens, goo, treat tokens, defeating mobs, crafting items, obtaining badges, finding Stickers, and discovering bee types.

docs.title: Quest Bears
docs.text: Quest Bears are quest givers that have an appearance of a bear. They are the most common variant of quest givers.

docs.title: Black Bear
docs.text: Black Bear is likely the first quest-giver the player will encounter when they start the game. His quests completely consist of collecting pollen. He is located to the right of the hives and in front of the Red Cannon.

docs.title: Quests
docs.text: Brown Bear is an infinite quest giver. His quests scale up in difficulty the more you complete, with the reward also getting bigger the more difficult it gets. Each quest always rewards a ticket, royal jelly, and increasing amounts of honey, depending on the current difficulty of the current quest. Certain thresholds may reward other items as well.

docs.title: Scaling (<1000 quests)
docs.text:
Let x equal the minimum amount of pollen for the quest Let y equal the maximum amount of pollen for the quest

Amount of pollen required for a quest = \(x+(y-x)\times \left(\frac{numberofquestscompleted}{1000}\right)^4\)

docs.title: Sticker Seeker, Quest Bees & Onett
docs.text: Quest Bees are a variant of quest givers that are based of different types of bees. Onett is a quest giver who is a NPC version of the developer.

docs.title: Sticker Seeker Quest Machine
docs.text:
Obtaining and turning in quests from this quest giver require the player to have the Sticker-Seeker equipped.

The only quest it can give is 🔎 Sticker-Seeker: Rank X, where X represents the quest's rank, or the player's rank plus 1.

2 requirements will always show up in this quest:

Requirements
  • Find a number of Seeker Stickers Hidden [sic] in [any number of any bee zones, which can also include shops, or HQ's].
    • The amount of Seeker Stickers to find depends on the player's rank:
      • Rank 1-4: 2 Seeker Stickers
      • Rank 5-10: 3 Seeker Stickers
      • Rank 11-20: 4 Seeker Stickers
      • Rank 21-499: 5 Seeker Stickers
      • Rank 500 and onwards: 6 Seeker Stickers
    • They may be hidden in multiple zones, including:
      • The Starter Zone
      • 5 Bee Zone
      • 10 Bee Zone
      • 15 Bee Zone
      • 20 Bee Zone
      • Shops
      • HQs
      • 25 Bee Zone (On rank 11 and onwards)
      • 30 Bee Zone (On rank 40 and onwards)
      • 35 Bee Zone (On rank 80 and onwards)
  • Collect \(P(X)\) pollen with the Sticker-Seeker.
    • \(P(X)\) is equal to \(p(X)=100000+99900000\cdot \left({\frac {X-1}{499}}\right)^{2.25}+25000\cdot (X-1)+\Delta (X)\), floored to the nearest \(S(p(X))\).
      • X represents the quest's rank, or the player's rank plus 1.
      • \(\Delta(X)\) is equal to:
        • 0 if \(500<X\)
        • \(1000000*(X-500)\) otherwise
      • \(S(p(X))\) is equal to:
        • 50000 if \(p(X)\geq 1,000,000\)
        • 25000 if \(500,000\leq p(X)<1,000,000\)
        • 10000 if \(100,000\leq p(X)<500,000\)
        • 5000 if \(25,000\leq p(X)<100,000\)
        • 1000 if \(p(X)<25,000\)

On every 10th quest, there is also an extra requirement:

Requirements
  • Add [X/2] Stickers to the Sticker Stack.

The remaining requirements are randomly picked from a pool. The number of extra requirements given starts at 1, increases to 2 at quest 100, and finally to 3 at quest 250. Below is a list of all possible requirements:

Requirements Note: For requirements with two given values, use the first value for any quest between 1 and 149, and the second value for any quest from 150 onwards.
  • Collect 6 or 20 Stickers (without Trading).
  • Collect 3 or 12 Rainbow Sticker Tokens.
  • Collect 1 or 5 Stickers spawned by your Tool while Gathering.
  • Collect 1 or 3 Stickers found by your Bees while Gathering.
  • Collect 1 or 3 Stickers from Planters.
  • Collect 1 or 3 Stickers from Sprouts.
  • Collect 1 or 2 Stickers from Puffshrooms.
  • Collect a Sticker from Fireflies.
  • Collect a Sticker from Leaves.
  • Collect a Sticker from the Public Sticker Board.
  • Collect a Sticker from Wild Windy Bee.
  • Discard 5 or 25 Stickers.
  • Donate 1 or 7 Stickers to the Public Sticker Board.
  • Find 7 or 8 Hidden Stickers on Surfaces around the Map.
  • Print 1 or 3 Stickers with the Sticker Printer.
