docs.title: Belt Bag Quests
docs.text: Quest Name  Dialogue  Token Teaser  Check this place out, not bad! This mountain is world famous for its honey, so I decided to come see it for myself. I'm Sun Bear, one of the traveling bears. I see you've noticed my [Belt Bag]. I don't go anywhere without this thing. I happen to have another one if you're interested. BUT, I'll need something from you in exchange. I want you to demonstrate what makes this place so special. Show me what your bees are made of! Complete these 6 quests, all involving bee abilities, and I'll give you a [Belt Bag]. But make it quick! I'm only here for a few weeks. First off, activate 10 Ability Tokens. And while your at it, defeat 2 Ladybugs and 2 Rhino Beetles. Go on now! It's time to see what all the hype is about.-During-Not all bees create Ability Tokens, but most do. Collecting them is how you activate your bee's abilities. Try it out, activate 10 Ability Tokens. And while your at it, defeat 2 Ladybugs and 2 Rhino Beetles.-Completion-So that's what those things look like! Those are pretty cool. So cool I'll give you one of these: It's a [Ticket]! It can be used to activate special machines or purchase Event Bees from the Ticket Tent. You can get them from quests or from defeating bugs and monsters... And if you're lucky, you may even find one in the flowers. But that's enough about [Tickets], I know what you really want. Complete 5 more quests and I'll give you a [Belt Bag].  Bring On The Bombs  When I first heard about Buzz Bombs I thought it sounded ridiculous. How could a bee produce a bomb that collects pollen? But I've seen enough crazy things to know that anything possible. I just got to see those bombs in action. Collect 25 "Bomb" Ability Tokens and 5,000 pollen from that Dandelion Field right there.-During-I don't care which bombs they are, I mean a bombs a bomb right? They all look awesome to me! Come back when you've collect 25 "Bomb" Ability Tokens and 5,000 pollen from the Dandelion Field.-Completion-Now we're getting somewhere! You demolished that field with those things! But there's more I wanna see. Complete 4 more quests and I'll give you a [Belt Bag]. Trust me, these things are great.  Boost Brilliance  Now, bombs are undeniably cool, what with the explosion and the whole spectacle of it. But I'm the kind of bear who can appreciate a more subdued kind of cool. I want to check out those Boost tokens I've heard so much about. Red and Blue Boost increase the pollen you receive from Red or Blue flowers for 20 seconds. The best part is, they apparently stack up to 10 times! I gotta see this for myself. Collect 50 "Boost" Ability Tokens. And while you're at it, collect 5,000 Red and Blue pollen. Oh, and defeat 8 Ladybugs, why not?-During-I wonder if there's a bee with a White Boost out there somewhere. Now that would be cool. Maybe I'll search for one when I'm done here. But I still have stuff to see! Collect 5,000 Red and Blue Pollen, defeat 8 Ladybugs, And collect 50 "Boost" Ability Tokens! That's what I really want to see.-Completion-Haha, that was pretty cool not gonna lie. I like how the pitch of the sound they make increases as your combo gets higher. But we're just getting started! I have a lot I want to see and I don't have much time. 3 more quests and I'll give you a [Belt Bag] like mine.  A Need For Haste  I've got a need. A need for Haste. That's right, I want to see what those Haste tokens do. Is it true they can make you move up to TWICE as fast? Now that sounds like my kind of ability. Collect 75 "Haste" Ability Tokens. And to put that speed to work... Collect 31,000 pollen from the Clover Field and defeat 12 Rhino Beetles-During-What are you standing around talking to me for!? I want to see you move fast! Collect 31,000 pollen from the Clover Field, defeat 12 Rhino Beetles, And collect 75 "Haste" Ability Tokens!-Completion-Haste seems like the best bee ability to me. Think about how much time you waste just walking around... And at the end of the day, time is honey. But that's enough about Haste. 2 more quest and I'll give you a snazzy [Belt Bag] like mine.  B&B  Huh, I just thought of something. Boosts and bombs on their own, they're great and all... But imagine if you were to combine them! Boost up your bombs! Oh yeah, I can see it now, bombs collecting thousands of pollen at once! You just gotta show me that combination in action. Collect 150 "Boost" Ability Tokens, 150 "Bomb" Ability Tokens, And defeat 2 Spiders.-During-x10 Bomb Combo... x10 Red Boost... large flower bonus... The numbers become insane! Come on, put those combos to work. Collect 150 "Boost" Ability Tokens, 150 "Bomb" Ability Tokens, And defeat 2 Spiders.-Completion-Now that's what I'm talking about! Just 1 more quest and I'll give you a mint condition [Belt Bag].  Snag A Belt Bag  I'm starting to see what makes this place so special. Those Ability Tokens are out of this world! Ok, if you want a [Belt Bag], you're gonna have to show me a grand finale. How about this: Collect 50,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Defeat 4 Mantises... And collect 1,000 Ability Tokens!-During-Running around collecting tokens looks really satisfying. Man, I gotta get myself some bees. Ok, here's what I'll need to see before I give you a [Belt Bag]: Collect 50,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Defeat 4 Mantises... And collect 1,000 Ability Tokens.-Completion-Whoahoho! Now THAT was cool. You've earned this, a brand new [Belt Bag]. It grants +15,000 Container Space, +50% Conversion Rate, and 1% Critical Chance. Container Space allows you to collect more pollen before you have to return to the hive to make honey. Base Conversion Rate lets your bees convert more pollen to honey at a time. Critical Chance allows you and your bees to occasionally get twice as much pollen from flowers! It also lets your bees occasionally deal double damage to enemies. Told you it would be worth it, didn't I? But I'm not quite done with this place, come talk to me again when you want to show me more.  Focus Feature  Whats that? You want to know why my [Belt Bag] looks different from yours? That's because mines [sic] not just any [Belt Bag]... Mines a [Mondo Belt Bag]!! I told you I'd give you one like mine... I never said it'd be identical. So you want a [Mondo Belt Bag], huh? You have any idea how valuable these things are? I'm gonna have to see a LOT more cool stuff before I hand out one of these. For one, I want to see the ability Focus. Focus increases your Critical Chance by 3%, and stacks up to 10 times. I've heard Looker, Commander, and Music Bees all have that ability. So go on then, I'm getting bored! Collect 100,000 pollen from the Cactus Field... Defeat 3 Spiders... And collect 100 "Focus" Ability Tokens!-During-Looker, Commander, and Music Bees all have the ability Focus. You're gonna need some of them if you're going to complete this quest. Collect 100,000 pollen from the Cactus Field... Defeat 1 Werewolf... And collect 100 "Focus" Ability Tokens.-Completion-Did you see those critical hits? You can tell you got a critical hit when the pollen number shakes and flashes green. Imagine if you had a 100% Critical Chance! Ok, complete 5 more quests and I'll give you a [Mondo Belt Bag] that's just as cool as mine.  Look At Those Links  You know whats [sic] even cooler than collecting tokens one at a time? Collecting ALL active tokens at once! I've heard that's what the ability Token Link can do. Not only that, but it grants bonus honey for every token it collects. Isn't that something? To complete this next quest, you're going to need a Rage, Shocked, Exhausted or Music Bee. Those are the only bees I know of with the ability Token Link. Here's what I want to see: Collect 80,000 White pollen, 80,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field, And collect 150 "Token Link" Tokens.-During-I've heard Luck increases the amount of honey you get from abilities like Token Link. For example, if you have a Beekeeper's Mask and Baby Love from Baby Bee... You'd get 1,000 honey from Honey Gift instead of 250! Here's what I want to see next: Collect 80,000 White pollen, 80,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field, And collect 150 "Token Link" Tokens.-Completion-There's nothing cooler than seeing Token Link activate a ton of abilities at once! It really lights up the fields with those white beams. But I'm still not satisfied, I want to see more! 4 more quests and I'll give you a [Mondo Belt Bag]. You're gonna love this thing, trust me.  Bring Back The Boosts  You know what, I wanna see more boosts. I know, I know, you already showed [sic] me a bunch of them. But I still don't feel like I have a full understanding of them, you know? Come on now, you get to see them whenever you want. I'm only vising [sic]. Collect 250,000 pollen, defeat 6 Scorpions... And show me 500 "Boost" Ability Tokens. I'm the one with the [Mondo Belt Bag], so I choose what I get to see!-During-Red Boosts are created by Rad, Riley, and Shy Bees. Blue Boosts are created by Bucko, Cool, Diamond, amd Frosty Bees. Collect 250,000 pollen, defeat 6 Scorpions... And collect 500 "Boost" Ability Tokens, either color is fine.-Completion-Boosts are simply bonkers. Ok, 3 more quests and you'll be sporting a [Mondo Belt Bag] like mine.  Non-Stop Action  Ok, back to the bombs! I need a better look at them. Besides, I'm sure you never get sick of those things. Oh, and you know what else would be really cool? Let me see you take on some of those infamous Werewolves I've heard all about. Who would have thought there'd be Werewolves in a peaceful looking place like this? Collect 1,000 "Bomb" Ability Tokens, and defeat 3 Werewolves.-During-Bombs seem to fade away faster than other tokens. I bet that's because they offer larger combo bonuses than the other abilities. Anyways, collect 1,000 "Bomb" Ability Tokens and defeat 3 Werewolves.-Completion-That's some intense stuff!! I'm pretty happy with all I've seen so far, but if you want this [Mondo Belt Bag] I'll need to see a bit more. 2 more quests to go.  Fat Stacks  I think I'm starting to understand how the beekeepers of this place produce so much honey. It's all about keeping those ability combos going - never losing your stacks! Each bee can't do much on it's own [sic], but together they've got insane potential. And you're the link that ties them all together. Get out there and get those combos rolling! Collect 150,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest... Collect 125,000 pollen from the Pumpkin Patch... Collect 100,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... And collect 500 "Haste" and 1000 "Boost" Tokens.-During-Some abilities combo, others don't. I've noticed that some Legendary and Event bees tend to have abilities that stand on their own. I guess those bees are so good they don't need anyone else's help. Anyways, I didn't come here to chat all day. I came here to see cool stuff. Collect 150,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest... 125,000 pollen from the Pumpkin Patch... 100,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... And collect 500 "Haste" and 1000 "Boost" Tokens.-Completion-Hah, I was right. That's exactly how you do it. Ok, 1 more quest and I'll give you a [Mondo Belt Bag]. Promise.  The Mondo Mission  Now, let's just be real for a second. [Mondo Belt Bags] are worth MILLIONS of honey, you understand? Now, I'm a pretty well off bear, not gonna lie... But even the richest bear doesn't have enough honey to be tossing [Mondo Belt Bags] around. If you want this bag, I'll need to see something priceless. Something I've only heard about in legends... I want to you take down a King Beetle! Now, I'm not even sure if those things exist. But if they do... They'd probably be hanging round the Blue Flower Field, or the Clover Field, places with lots of beetles. If the rumors are correct, defeating one won't be easy. But hey, it wasn't easy for me to get this [Mondo Belt Bag] either. If you want this bag, here's what you gotta do: Collect 10,000 Ability Tokens and defeat 1 King Beetle.-During-I don't care how hard it is, don't come whining to me! If you want my [Mondo Belt Bag] you'll need to show me something that'll blow my mind. And the only thing I have left to see is someone taking down a King Beetle!-Completion-Holy smacks! That was AWESOME! This place is, without a doubt, one of the coolest little maps I've ever visited in my life. And trust me, I've been all over the place. Well, you've been a great host, I can't deny that. So go ahead and take this, my other [Mondo Belt Bag]! It grants you +50,000 Container Space, +100% Conversion Rate, and +2% Critical Chance. You and your bees surpassed my expectations, and my expectations were high. After all that action, I think I'll just relax some. I'll be heading out soon anyways. Take it easy.  Conclusion  This mountain is world famous, and now I know why. For such a quaint little place, you sure do run an impressive operation. This won't be the last time I stop by, thats for sure.

docs.title: Boot Quests
docs.text: Quest Name  Dialogue  Activating Abilities  (If player has not met Sun Bear before:)Don't think we've met. I'm Sun Bear, and I'm back at the mountain for some more action.(If player has met Sun Bear before:)Long time no see. That's right, I'm back again for some more action.(Both versions continue:)Last time I visited, the bees really blew my mind! And in return I jazzed up the place with my awesome [Belt Bags]. Well, this time I've brought something even cooler. These bad boys: my [Beekeeper's Boots]! Listen up: Shoes are in. They're a global sensation. I've been all over, and everywhere I go they're wearing shoes! You baldfooted folk at the mountain need to get with the times. I'm here to help - if you show me a good time of course.(If player has not met Sun Bear before:)I'm here to see those world famous Ability Tokens.(If player has met Sun Bear before:)You know me: I'm all about those Ability Tokens.(Both versions continue:)Ability Tokens are created by many types of bees. Some bees make them all the time, some only make them while you gather pollen from flowers... And others only make them when they're defending you from attackers. Collecting Ability Tokens causes a bee's special ability to activate! Now let's get this party started.-During-Basic Bees don't create abilities, but almost all other bees do. You'll need to spice up your hive with [Royal Jellies] to start generating Ability Tokens. I think I saw one sitting on top of the Ticket Tent as I pulled in... You'll find that to the right of the hives. Come back when you've collected 15 Ability Tokens.-Completion-Oh yeah, that's what I came to see! Ok. So I'm going to be up front [sic] with you. These aren't the only types boots [sic] I've got in my RV. If you complete 4 more quests, I'll give you a pair of boots... But you'll need to complete way more than that if I'm going to give you a pair as fine as mine. For now, I'll give you these: some [Tickets]! Save those up and trade them in for something cool. For 6 [Tickets], you can get a [Royal Jelly] from the dispenser near the Clover Field. Personally, I'd save them up for an Event Bee in the Ticket Tent. Come back when you're ready for round two. But don't take too long - I'll hit the road when the timer behinds me runs out.  Sticking To The Staples  There are two kinds of Ability Tokens that make up the core of any hive. "Boost" and "Bomb" Ability Tokens. Red and Blue "Boost" Tokens increase the pollen you receive from colored flowers for 15 seconds. "Bomb" Tokens collect pollen from many flowers at once! Together, these tokens let you collect tons of pollen in no time. Why don't you and your bees put on a demonstration? Collect 20 "Bomb" Tokens, 20 "Boost" Tokens, and 5000 pollen.-During-If you don't have a bee that can make those tokens, you'll need to transform your bees. Try searching for [Royal Jellies] around the map. You can also get them from Brown Bear near the Clover Field. Another way to get them is from promo codes... Click on the cog icon and redeem the code "SunSample" to see what I mean. Come back when you've collected 20 "Bomb" Tokens, 20 "Boost" Tokens, and 5000 pollen.-Completion-Whoa! With combos like that it's no wonder this place produces so much honey. Keep it up and you'll earn yourself that pair of sweet kicks. Believe me, shoe life is awesome. With shoes on your feet, you can run faster, jump higher... And you even collect pollen just by walking through the flowers! If you want to experience it for yourself, you'll need to complete 3 more quests. But for now, here's a little something special...  Token Treck  Bee Ability Tokens are awesome, don't get me wrong... But tokens come in tons of forms. And they're all really cool. Every once in a while, tokens will even pop out of the flowers around here. Collect those for free honey, or if you're lucky, a [Treat]. In the short time I've been here, I've seen some people find [Treat] Tokens right in that Dandelion Field. I want to see some more of that! Collect 100 Ability Tokens... 25 Honey Tokens... And 5 [Treat] Tokens...-During-I know for a fact you can find [Treat] Tokens in the Dandelion Field. But I've also heard rumors of them popping up in the Spider Field and Pumpkin Patch. Come back when you've collected 100 Ability Tokens... 25 Honey Tokens... And 5 [Treat] Tokens...-Completion-Nothing more satisfying than collecting tokens, am I right? Don't think I'd want to eat a [Treat] found just laying around outside like that though. Bees don't seem so picky... But I'll give you some clean [Treats] to feed them too, just cause [sic] I'm nice. Complete 2 more quests and I'll also give you that pair of boots.  Quick Feet, Sharp Mind  My boots are all I need to be a certified speed demon. But for a shoeless person like yourself, "Haste" Tokens are the way to go. Get yourself a Hasty Bee and it'll hype you up to get you moving faster! My sunglasses block out glare and keep my vision sharp... But your only hope is to collect "Focus" Tokens. A Looker Bee will keep you focused and unlock the potential of critical hits! Use those tokens to take yourself to the next level. Collect 25 "Haste" Tokens and "Focus" Tokens each. Oh, and 25,000 Blue pollen. Just to mix things up.-During-Whats [sic] up? Having trouble? Psst, try using the promo code "HasteHelper". Come back when you've collected 25 "Haste" Tokens... 25 "Focus" Tokens... And 25,000 Blue pollen.-Completion-Looks like I'm not the only speed demon in town. Imagine how fast you'll be moving with "Haste" AND boots. You're getting really close - just 1 more quest and we'll finally cover up those feet of yours.  Boot Lootin  I just came back from the desert. The vast arid landscape is awesome in it's [sic] own way, but it really makes you appreciate places like this. Flowers and fruits as far as the eye can see. You and your bees live in a land of plenty. Take some time to appreciate it. Go out there and take it all in. Collect 10 [Blueberry], [Strawberry], and [Treat] Tokens. And 250 Ability Tokens to keep things exciting while I watch.-During-I remember what it was like to be shoeless. Walking around in the grass all day barefooted, stepping on dirt and bugs. Haha, man it was just awful. Finish this quest and you'll see how much better life gets with boots. Collect 10 [Blueberry], [Strawberry], and [Treat] Tokens... And 250 Ability Tokens.-Completion-Good stuff, good stuff! Now these are yours: a pair of [Basic Boots] To match the basic effort you've put into entertaining me so far. Hah, nah you're doing great. But I'm just getting started. I'm only here for a short time and I want to see it all! Complete 5 more quests, and we'll swap those boots out with something a bit more durable. For now, go break those [Basic Boots] in. You'll get around faster now. Oh, and try walking through the flowers - you'll collect pollen just from moving around!  Sprouts For Sun Bear's Sanity  Somethings [sic] going on here. I swear I saw a huge plant sprout right in the middle of the Sunflower Field. I don't know what it was, but it wasn't a sunflower... After a while, it grew so large that it exploded or something, and scattered tokens everywhere! You've seen them too, right? I swear I'm not crazy! Before I go any further, I'll need your help solving this mystery. Go out there and collect 20 tokens from... magic sprouts? Whatever those things are. Oh, and 100 "Boost" Tokens. It could take a while for a sprout to show up so I'll need something to keep me entertained.-During-What the heck are those things? They weren't around the last time I visted [sic]. Help me figure this out... Collect 20 Tokens from Sprouts, and 100 "Boost" Tokens.-Completion-So I'm not goin [sic] crazy. That's a relief. So these things pop up in the middle of a field... And they grow as you and your bees collect pollen from that field. Once they're done growing they pop, scattering tokens all over the place. Now THAT's awesome. Anyways, how you liking those [Basic Boots]? They're nice, but I've got something even nicer. Complete 4 more quests, and we'll give you an upgrade.  Thinking About Those Links  Once you've tried shoes theres [sic] just no going back. As you hatch more bees, they'll produce more and more Ability Tokens. The speed boost you get from boots helps you keep up in collecting them all. But sometimes even that's not enough. That's where Token Link comes in. Collect a Token Link, and it'll collect all your other Ability Tokens as well. It looks pretty cool, too. It shoots out a bunch of white beams, looks sort of like a spider web. Speaking of spiders, let me see your bees defeat some. It's about time I've seen a good bug-on-bug beatdown. Collect 100 "Token Link" Tokens and defeat 3 Spiders. Wait... Make it 4 Spiders. Oh, and collect 100,000 pollen from the Spider Field while you're out there.-During-Only Rage Bee, Exhausted Bee, Shocked Bee, and Music Bee know Token Link. You'll need to transform your bees into one of those to complete this quest. Collect "Token Link" Tokens, 100,000 pollen from the Spider Field, and defeat 4 Spiders.-Completion-Token Link is as cool as it is helpful. Did you notice how it gave you bonus honey for every token it collects as well? I've heard that bonus honey goes up with the bee's level. Just a little tip. Ok, 3 more quests and will [sic] swap your boots out with something a little less basic.  Light Up The Night  I'm a busy bear with lots of connections. I feel like I'm always on call. That's why sometimes I just try to get away to places like this. Still, I can't help but check my phone all day, you know? That's why I like nighttime. It's the only time I get a break. Good thing you guys finally have night at the mountain. Here's a little tip from a nighttime expert: At night, you can see Fireflies wander around in packs. Chase them down and you might find yourself some [Moon Charm] Tokens. Next time it's night, why don't you look for some? Oh, and light up the night sky with 250 "Bomb" Tokens! That's gonna look pretty rad.-During-I've seen people feed [Moon Charms] to their bees. Apparently they go crazy for them. But I swear I've also seen people use them for something else near that moon on the mountain. Anyways, come back when you've collected 10 Moon Charm Tokens and 250 "Bomb" Tokens.-Completion-The night really sooths [sic] the soul. Complete 2 more quests and I'll give you another pair of soothing soles. I'm talking about the soles of shoes, get it? Whatever, here's some [Treats].  Show Me The Honey  Of course I love seeing Bee Abilities and taking in the sights of the mountain... But I'd be lying if I said I didn't come here for the honey! Yeah, that's right. I may be cool, calm and collected. But I'm still a bear. That's why Honey Tokens drive me wild! Free honey out of nowhere? Sign me up. Some bees even produce Honey Tokens for you. Honey Bee and Diamond Bee, from what I've heard. Get out there and collect 250 "Honey" Tokens! And 500 Ability Tokens... And defeat 8 Mantises, those things are cool... And, hm what else. Eh thats [sic] enough.-During-The "Luck" stat increases the honey you get from Honey Tokens that pop out of flowers. But that's not all - it also makes you more likely to receive rewards after defeating monsters! You can raise your Luck by wearing certain items, or by activating the Baby Bee's ability. Did you get all that? Listen, being a beekeeper is complicated stuff. You won't get very far if you can't keep track of your stats. If you want to see how much Luck you have, as well as other stats, they're listed in the System menu. Anyways, here's what I want to see: Collect 250 "Honey" Tokens... 500 Ability Tokens... And defeat 8 Mantises-Completion-🎶 Honey honey honey honey! HONEYYYY. 🎶 Hahaha. Ok, now that was neat. You're a pretty good host, you know that? And I'm a bear who likes to keep things fair... If you entertain me with just 1 more quest, I'll give you a pair of boots you're gonna love. But for now, want some of these [Sunflower Seeds]? I could chew on these things all day.  Battle For Boots  This place is pretty deceptive. Looks all colorful and peaceful when you first get here... But stick around and you realize things get a little crazy! That's part of what keeps me coming back. I want you and your bees to show me some of the thrills I came to see. I mean really WOW me with some intense combat action! Complete this quest, and I'll give you some boots that put yours to shame. Collect 500 "Focus" Tokens... Defeat 50 Ants... And defeat 4 Werewolves. It's a lot, I know. But trust me, the boots are worth it.-During-Running low on [Ant Passes]? You can claim a free [Ant Pass] every 2 hours from the green machine behind the 20 Bee Gate. Only works if you have less than 10 passes already, though. It's for the people who really need them. I don't need the ones I've been claiming, though. What am I gonna do, take on hundreds of ants all by myself? You can use the code "ExtraPass" if you want one of mine. Come back when you've collected 500 "Focus" Tokens... Defeated 50 Ants... And defeated 4 Werewolves.-Completion-Alright alright! All that action really picked me up. I've got to say, your bees are pretty terrifying when they're in battle mode. I love it though. You've kept me thoroughly entertained since I got here! So here you are, some [Hiking Boots]! Those are some well-crafted boots, let me tell you. Durable, but still comfortable. Perfect for getting around a place like this. These offer more speed and collection than [Basic Boots]. But most importantly, they allow you to jump higher. Great for traversing rocks and cliffs. Happy? You're welcome. Go ahead and test them out.  Sun Bear's Scavenger Hunt  Tokens popping out of flowers is something you don't see just anywhere. And those big sprout things, let me tell you... I've been all around the world, and I've never seen ANYTHING like those before. Now, hear me out. I bet you're pretty happy with your [Hiking Boots], but I see you staring. You want [Beekeeper's Boots] like mine, dont [sic] you? These babies are top-of-the-line. They don't get any finer than this. So here's my proposal, complete just 3 more quests, and I'll give you a pair of your own. But these aren't just any quests. I want to see it all. I drove a long way to get here so I'm going to make it worth my while. First up, those tokens I was talking about: Collect 50 Sunflower Seed Tokens... 50 Blueberry Tokens... 50 Strawberry Tokens... 50 Pineapple Tokens... 150 Treat Tokens... 250 Haste Tokens... And, the main event: Collect 100 tokens from Sprouts.-During-You know, when you think about it I'm not even asking for that much. The sprouts seem to produce all those treats anyways. What? Yeah yeah yeah boo hoo. If you really want these boots then just get out there and show me what I want to see.-Completion-Now THAT'S a lot of tokens! Ok, I think I've seen enough of those treat tokens though. Bet you're relieved to hear that, haha. But theres [sic] a few more things I want to see, and they aren't any easier. For now I'll give you the rest of the [Treats] I've got in my RV. Someone has to use them before they go bad.  Sun Bear's Abili-Tour  This mountain is world famous for its bees. And its bees are world famous for their abilities. I'm world famous for wanting to see world famous things. You see where this is going. Tell your bees to rev up their... spinning bee powers. Cause this time, I want to see the whole gamut. Collect 2000 "Boost" Tokens... 2000 "Bomb" Tokens... 1000 "Token Link" Tokens... 1000 "Focus" Tokens... And 250 "Honey Gift" Tokens. "Honey Gift", not just Honey. I'm talking about the ones that come from Honey and Diamond Bee. Here's 1 [Royal Jelly] to potentially give you a bee you might be missing. You're welcome. Ok start. I'll be watching from over here.-During-See that clock behind me? Well it's ticking down. Every second you spend talking to me is another second I'm not seeing what I came for. And once it hits 0, I'm gone. I'm just being real with you. You'd get more of out these [Beekeeper's Boots] than I will. So hang in there and wrap up those Ability Tokens. You've got this.-Completion-Awww yeahhhh!!!!! Good work bees. And you too, but really, those bees though... I can't get over how those tiny, simple looking creatures are able to do so much. I need to start coming back here more often. Ok, just a few more quests. I know I'm making you work for these boots but come on. Just look at them. They're gorgeous. And more importantly, they don't go on sale until probably after I leave, I'm guessing. So looks like if you want them, working with me is your only option.  Vicious Bee Begone  Things just keep getting freakier around here. I was just taking a little stroll over to Brown Bear. Wanted to catch up before I head out. Happened across this spike sticking out of the flower. Got closer to check it out. Then all of a sudden, a gosh dang bee popped out and ATTACKED me. I swear it happened! This wasn't your ordinary bee. It was... well, I don't know. Something mean. Anyways, I high-tailed it back to the campgrounds and haven't moved since. Look, I'm here to relax. This place is supposed to be my getaway. I can't do that if I'm worried about getting skewered by some bad bee gone rogue. If you want my boots, you need to take care of that thing. So before we get to your last quests, here's what you need to do: Defeat 10 Vicious Bees (that's what I'm calling them). That's right, no Ability Tokens. We don't have time for those right now.-During-No more quests until you get that thing out of here. I didn't come here to stress out. Defeat at least 10 of them, then we'll talk.-Completion-Yikes! Man I was watching those fights, looked brutal. Good thing your bees are so tough. What the heck even was that thing?? Whatever, now that it's gone I'll need to make the most of the rest of my trip. You know what that means. Impress me 1 more time, and the [Beekeeper's Boots] are yours.  Sun Bear Spectacular  I'm having a great time out here, let me tell you. And to be honest, even that mean bee spiced things up. But all good things must come to an end. That's right, it's almost time for me to head out. I can't leave this place with you looking like that, though. It would be just wrong. So if you show me one last good time, a grand finale to my trip... You'll be rocking a pair of [Beekeeper's Boots] just like yours truly. Here's what I want to see. You might want to sit down for this... Collect 25 Moon Charm Tokens. Collect 100 Tokens from Sprouts. Defeat 10 Spiders Defeat 10 Giant Ants And [sic] collect 25,000 Ability Tokens.-During-What happened here while I was gone? I come back after 4 months and suddenly everythings [sic] gone loco. The bees have levels? Ants? Hostile spikey bees?? Guess I was away for too long. Anyways, I've got a lot to see, and can't stick around much longer. Let's wrap this show up and get you decked out in some [Beekeeper's Boots].-Completion-You guys have done it again. That's why everywhere I go, I rave about this place. This mountain is a must see for anyone who loves bees, honey... Or just rad stuff in general! I'd definitely rank it in my top 10. But a bear like me isn't meant to be tied down. I've got places to go, people to see. My home is on the road. So take these and I'll head out: Your very own pair of [Beekeeper's Boots]. Thanks for the show, and good work bees. Until next time. Take it easy.  Conclusion  My RV doesn't look too flashy, but it's top-of-the-line. I've had it for years, but I'm always fixing it up. Had a little trouble on my way in here though... Once I figure out how to get it unstuck I'll hit the road. Don't worry. I don't need any help.

docs.title: Bean Bug Quests
docs.text: Quest Name  Dialogue  Bean Bug Busser  That's right, I'm back. It's me, Sun Bear. The coolest bear. Back in my favorite podunk mountain town! Nah I'm just messin' with you. This place is special. But I don't have time to chit chat - I'm not here on vacation. I was just passing through, and ran into a little trouble. Nothing I can't handle. But why get my hands dirty when I can pay some chump - I mean pay some good folks like you to help me. Put you guys to work. Here's the deal: I'm supposed to be taking a bunch of Bean Bugs to Orlando. Bean Bugs, you know - purple critters that hop around and shoot [Jelly Beans]. The thing in the cage right behind me. Anyways, I won't bore you with the details. They've broken out. I need your help to clean up this mess. Complete 10 quests and I should be able to round them up and head out. Like I said I'll pay you well. 250 [Tickets]! We got a deal? Nice. ... You know, 250 [Tickets] don't come easy. How about you make things entertaining for me while I'm stuck here waiting? Every year I stop by to see your world famous bees use their crazy abilities. May as well take in the sights while I'm here. Yeah that sounds good. OK. You want these [Tickets]? You round up those Bean Bugs. And by round up, I mean collect the Jelly Bean tokens they shoot out of their mouth. Those Jelly Bean tokens give crazy pollen-collecting buffs! You beekeepers are lucky I let those bugs loose here. How do you find them? Well, just wait around I guess. They hide away most of the time but they'll pop out every once in a while. And while you're waiting, let me see those awesome Ability Tokens! First up: Collect 10 Tokens from Bean Bugs and 25 Ability Tokens. And make it quick! I've got a deadline. I'm out of here when that clock strikes zero with or without those bugs.-During-Basic Bees don't create abilities, but almost all other bees do. You'll need to spice up your hive with [Royal Jellies] to start generating Ability Tokens. I think I saw one sitting on top of the Ticket Tent as I pulled in... You'll find that to the right of the hives. Come back when you've collected 10 Tokens from Bean Bugs and 25 Ability Tokens.-Completion-Man I can't get over the bees from around here. Those abilities aren't something you see just anywhere. Yeah, I've been all around in my RV, seen a ton of bees. Bees don't make Ability Tokens anywhere else. Anyways, you find my Bean Bugs? Well, there's way more to go. Here, take these. Some [Jelly Beans]. Don't worry, these ones didn't come from a Bean Bug. 9 more quests until you get that fat stack of [Tickets].  Bombs, Blueberries, and Bean Bugs  Every time I come here, there's one thing that impresses me the most. Watching those "Bomb" Tokens light up the fields! "Bomb" Abilities are the key to collecting massive amounts of pollen in no time. If you collect multiple "Bomb" Tokens at once, they collect even more! At least that's what I've heard. Why don't you go show me what "Bomb" Tokens can do? Over there in the Blue Flower Field. And bring back some [Blueberries]. I've heard if you collect from fields with mostly blue flowers, you might find a [Blueberry]. Yeah, that sounds good. And don't forget those Bean Bugs. Collect 50 "Bomb" Ability Tokens, 5 [Blueberry] Tokens, and 25 tokens from Bean Bugs.-During-Only certain bees produce "Bomb" Ability Tokens. You can see which bees produce which Ability Tokens by clicking on their faces in the Bee Menu. You might have to transform your bees with [Royal Jelly] to complete this quest. If you need some of that, try talking to Brown Bear. Collect 50 "Bomb" Ability Tokens, 5 [Blueberry] Tokens, and 25 tokens from Bean Bugs.-Completion-Whoa! Those bombs look different from last time. Way brighter! Totally cool. You know what else is cool? Cold hard cash. And by cash, I mean [Tickets]. Here's a sample of what you're in for. [Tickets] can be used for tons of things. Buying Event Bees, [Royal Jellies], [Magic Beans] Even [Stingers] to boost the attack power of your bees for 30 seconds. That's right, [Stingers]. There's a new dispenser behind the 20 Bee Gate, but they're pretty expensive. Be smart with your tickets. They're hard to come by. 8 more quests to go! These Bean Bugs won't round up themselves.  Bean Bugs And Boosts  You beekeepers know more than anyone that "Boost" abilities are where it's at. Those multiply the amount of pollen you collect from flowers of a specific color. Many bees have the Red and Blue Boost abilities. And I heard rumors that there's even one with a White Boost ability. Anyways, you see what I'm getting at. Here's what I need: Collect 50 "Boost" Ability Tokens, 100 Honey Tokens, and 50 tokens from Bean Bugs. That's the only way we'll get those Bean Bugs back in my RV. Trust me.-During-Where do you find Honey Tokens? Where DON'T you find Honey Tokens, am I right? They pop out of mobs when you defeat them, out of the flowers when you collect. During Honeystorms they just appear everywhere! Trust me, you'll find them. Collect 50 "Boost" Ability Tokens, 100 Honey Tokens, and 50 tokens from Bean Bugs.-Completion-Man, imagine a beekeeper with "Boost" Ability bees. They'd be a real chump. Not like you. You're cool like me, right? You wish. Hah. Nah, you're cool. Cool enough that I'll give you some of my [Gumdrops]. I eat them cause I'm normal, but you beekeepers use them to get bonus honey from flowers. Open your Items Menu and drag the [Gumdrops] to one of the slots on the bottom of your screen. That'll let you use them fast whenever you want! 7 more quests to go and I'll have those Bean Bugs in my RV And [sic] you'll have those 250 [Tickets] in your wallet.  Make It Hasty  I'm a busy bear with places to be. People to see. That's why I'm always on the road. To get places fast, I use my RV. You people here, well, an RV is a little out of your league. When you need to go fast, you rely on Haste Ability Tokens from your bees. Each one makes you move 10% faster for 20 seconds, and stacks up to 10 times. At 10 stacks you're moving twice as fast - easy math. Hope you have bees with Haste, because we need to make it hasty. I've got to get those Bean Bugs to Orlando before that timer runs out. If you want to get paid, you better hurry! Collect 100 Haste Tokens, 100 tokens from Bean Bugs, and 100,000 pollen from the Clover Field. I want some of that while I'm here, can't get it anywhere else.-During-Hey, I'm not paying you to chit chat! Collect 100 Haste Tokens, 100 tokens from Bean Bugs, and 100,000 pollen from the Clover Field.-Completion-Haste is cool and all, but you know what's cooler? My kicks. These boots make me move faster permanently. They're pretty expensive, but for a busy bear like me, they pay for themselves. You can find a pair like these up in the shop behind the 25 Bee Gate. But we don't have time for shopping, those Bean Bugs are getting into trouble. 6 more quests to go before you get your big paycheck. For now, take some of these [Field Dice]. Use one of those to grant +100% Pollen from a random field for 15 minutes. Yeah, they're pretty awesome. Pretty generous of me, huh?  Total Focus  I spend days at a time on the road. It's a pretty tough job, trucking exotic things around in my RV. Takes a lot of focus. You know what else takes a lot of focus? Memory Match. It's a minigame. I've seen it around here. Pay some honey then try to match cards to win the items on them. You can find one near the shop in the 10 Bee Zone. You know what else takes a lot of focus? Critical hits. Those multiply the pollen you collect. And how do you get focus? Focus Ability Tokens. And you know what else takes even MORE focus? Rounding up those Bean Bugs. So go out there and collect 200 Focus Tokens, Collect 250,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch, Collect 200 tokens from Bean Bugs, and match 5 pairs in Memory Match. Here, I'll give you a free trial.-During-You know what else gives me focus? Honey. Yeah, nothing like it. And the honey from this place packs a special punch! That's why I stop by every now and then. But that's not why I'm here this time. I need to get those Bean Bugs to Orlando. Collect 250,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch, Collect [sic] 200 tokens from Bean Bugs, and match 5 pairs in Memory Match.-Completion-Yeah, that's what I'm talking about. Pure focus. One track mind. Keep your eyes on the road at all times! That's rule number one. Rule number 2: Get those Bean Bugs to Orlando or neither of us get paid. OK, half way there but we've still got 5 more to go. To make this quicker, take these [Micro-Converters]. Use one and it'll instantly convert all pollen in your bag to honey.  On Your Marks  Man, those Bean Bugs are getting everywhere... Can't keep track of them if they keep moving around. You know what would help us track them? Leaving marks. "Mark" Ability Tokens that is. Yeah, can't forget those ones. "Mark" Abilities create sign-looking things around the fields. If you stand near them you get various buffs. Marks can chain together, to give you SUPER buffs. How will that help us get these Bean Bugs into my RV? I don't know, that's what I'm paying you to figure out. Collect 250 tokens from Bean Bugs, Collect [sic] 200 "Mark" Ability Tokens, Collect [sic] 30 tokens from Ladybugs, And [sic] collect 500,000 red pollen.-During-When I first came here, "Mark" Abilities didn't even exist. That was only 2 years ago. How did the bees evolve so fast? Collect 250 tokens from Bean Bugs, Collect [sic] 200 "Mark" Ability Tokens, Collect [sic] 30 tokens from Ladybugs, And [sic] collect 500,000 red pollen.-Completion-Man, those "Mark" Abilities didn't help track down those Bean Bugs at all. They fade away way too fast. What were we even thinking with that plan? Well we better come up with something soon. I've got a deadline to meet - and people are depending on those Bean Bugs. You'll need to figure something out soon because there's just 4 more quests. After that, I'll give you your paycheck. 250 [Tickets].  Look In The Leaves  Where could those Bean Bugs be hiding? They're pretty big. This doesn't make sense. Wait a sec - you see that over there? Those leaves popping out of the flowers? Maybe that's them. Yeah, that's got to be them. If you see leaves popping out of a flower, try collecting from it. You might find what we're looking for. Worst case scenario, you'll just get some items. And if that's not them, well, maybe they're in the Cactus Field. I don't know, just listing places I haven't checked yet. Go out there and collect 300 tokens from Bean Bugs, 25 tokens from Leaves, And [sic] 1,000,000 pollen from the Cactus Field.-During-You can find lots of stuff in leaves. I found some [Glue] in some leaves one time. Nobody believes me. It really happened. Collect 300 tokens from Bean Bugs, 25 tokens from Leaves, And [sic] 1,000,000 pollen from the Cactus Field.-Completion-Really? They weren't in there? Are you sure you looked close enough? Whatever. Let's just move on. We're running out of time. We've gotten most of the Bean Bugs, but it's all or nothing. And they're supposed to be in Orlando in just a few days. Best case scenario, if I drive non-stop, it'll take me 48 hours to get there from here. Well, we've got 3 quests to go. There's still hope.  What About Sprouts  Hey, I just thought of something. Maybe we can lure those Bean Bugs out with a Sprout. Nobody can resit [sic] a Sprout. When people hear those things popping, they all come running. Lucky for you I've got a bunch of [Magic Beans] in my RV. I'll let you have one to test this out. Collect 400 tokens from Bean Bugs, 1000 Ability Tokens, And [sic] 250 tokens from Sprouts.-During-Plant that [Magic Bean] to grow a sprout. I've heard if you wait until night time, it might turn into a Moon Sprout. But we don't have time to wait. We need to get those Bean Bugs back in my RV. Collect 400 tokens from Bean Bugs, 1000 Ability Tokens, And [sic] 250 tokens from Sprouts.-Completion-Guess Bean Bugs don't care about Sprouts. Probably don't even eat regular [Treats]. I should have known. Should have known. Anyways, you're still doing a pretty good job. Most of the Bean Bugs are back in my RV. Yeah, that's right. You don't see it, but every time you collect 100 of those Jelly Beans, One [sic] of the Bean Bugs gets put back in there. Just trust me. 2 more quests to go.  Bean Bug Beat Down  I figured it out. Where the rest of those Bean Bugs are. The monsters are probably hiding them. Makes sense, they want to keep them here forever so they always have Jelly Beans. I don't blame them, but it ain't meant to be. Those Bean Bugs, they've got jobs, they've got places they need to be. Orlando. Not here, this place is meant for bees. But we can't reason with those monsters out there. They only speak one language, if you catch my drift. Get out there and collect a bunch of tokens from monsters. We don't have time for me to list it all so I'll just put the tasks in your Quest Menu.-During-Hey - make sure you don't hurt those Bean Bugs while youre [sic] giving the other monsters a brusing [sic]. My job is to get them to Orlando in one piece, you hear me? If I see one bump on those Bean Bugs you ain't gettin paid.-Completion-So the monsters weren't hiding the Bean Bugs after all. Shoulda known. They ain't that clever. Well it doesn't matter now. We've almost got them all rounded up. I can hear the road calling my name already. But it's all or nothing. Each one of those Bean Bugs needs to make it to Orlando. Complete this last quest, and they will. And you'll be bathing in moolah.  Bean Bug Blackout  Look. I like hanging out here. I really do. But I can't stick around much longer. Those people in Orlando need me. They need those Bean Bugs. I'd love to watch your bees use their crazy abilities all day, But we just don't have time now. All we have time left for is rounding up the rest of those Bean Bugs. So complete this quest, and we'll both get paid big time. All you have to do is collect 2000 tokens from Bean Bugs. That's right. And by doing that, the last of the Bean Bugs will get put into my RV. That's how it works. So get out there.-During-What do they need the Bean Bugs for? I don't know. I don't ask questions, OK? All I know is they'll pay me big time once I get them there. And so will you. So hurry up!-Completion-Now that's what I'm talking about! You got them all! Each and every one of those bad boys! Knew I could count on you. You beekeepers here are always reliable. Well, wish I could stick around and enjoy myself a bit. But these Bean Bugs have a place they need to be. Orlando, FLA. So I'll just tie everything down in my RV and head out. And of course, I'm a bear of my word, so these are for you. 250 [Tickets]! Oh yeah baby! Don't spend them all in one place. OK. I'm heading out. Thanks for your help. I'll try to stop by again when I'm not working. Until then, take it easy.  Conclusion  My RV doesn't look too flashy, but it's top-of-the-line. I've had it for years, but I'm always fixing it up. Had a little trouble on my way in here though... Once I figure out how to get it unstuck I'll hit the road. Don't worry. I don't need any help.

docs.title: The Games Quests (3)
docs.text:
Quest Name Requirements Reward ⛳ The Games (1/3): Let The Golf Begin
  • Hit a Golf Ball into the Hole on the Dandelion Field.
  • Collect 200 Pollen.
1 Hour of New Golfer's Luck (Upon receiving quest)----1,000 Honey5 Tickets1 Micro-Converter"The Games" Silver ⛳ The Games (2/3): Right On Target
  • Hit 2 Golf Balls into the Hole on the Blue Flower Field.
  • Activate 2 Targets with Golf Balls.
  • Defeat 2 Rhino Beetles.
1 Hour of New Golfer's Luck (Upon receiving quest)----2,500 Honey1 Royal Jelly5 Tickets3 Field Dice"The Games" Silver ⛳ The Games (3/3): Hole In One
  • Hit 3 Golf Balls into the Hole on the Sunflower Field.
  • Activate 3 Targets with Golf Balls.
  • Get a Hole in One on any Field.
  • Convert 2,500 Pollen at the Hive.
  • Obtain 3 Bees.
1 Hour of New Golfer's Luck (Upon receiving quest)----5,000 Honey1 Ticket Planter25 Gumdrops1 Enzymes1 Gingerbread Bear1 Atomic Treat1 Red Balloon"The Games" Silver Quest Name Dialogue ⛳ The Games (1/3): Let The Golf Begin What's with all the snow? It IS summer, right? This place gets weirder every time I visit... Anyways, the name's Sun Bear. I'm one of the traveling bears. I just drove in with my RV. Nearly got stuck, but it's all good. I've been sent to this quaint mountain town to host a summer event for ROBLOX's "The Games"! As you can see, I've got a golf club in my hand. I've also set up Golf Balls and Holes around the flower fields. That's right - we're playing golf in Bee Swarm Simulator! Hopefully this snow won't make things too tricky... I've got 3 ["The Games" Silvers] to hand out! That is, if you can impress me with these golfing quests... ["The Games" Silvers] don't do anything in Bee Swarm, but they unlock cool stuff in The Game's event hub, and help lead your team to victory! And if that's not enough, I've got some other rewards more relevant to honeymaking in store as well. Sound good? Awesome! To start, let me give you some golfing pointers: To hit a Golf Ball, you first need to fill its pollen meter by collecting pollen from flowers near the ball. Find a Golf Ball in a flower field, and click or tap to scoop up pollen with your shovel. Once the ball's meter is full, launch it by scooping while facing the ball. The further you stand from the ball when you launch it, the stronger the launch will be. You can do precise putts, or hard swings! Anyone who contributes to the pollen meter of a Golf Ball gets credit if it makes it to the hole. No need to fight over them. Oh, and watch out for Mud Traps. Dark brown patches of flowers. If a ball lands in one of those, it'll sink! You get all that? I hope so, cause it's time to get golfing! Here's what you'll need to do for this first quest: Collect 200 pollen from flowers... And hit 1 Golf Ball into the hole on the Dandelion Field to your right. Get out there and hit those balls!-During-To hit a Golf Ball, you'll need to fill its pollen meter by collecting pollen from flowers around the ball. Once the meter is full, launch it by scooping with your collector while facing the ball. The closer you stand to the ball, the softer the launch will be. Pretty cool, huh?-Completion-Pretty good work out there! You're a natural on the green... er, or white? You've earned yourself the first ["The Games" Silver]. And 5 [Tickets]! A bonus for your good form. Save those up to buy special things in the tent behind you. OK, 2 more Silvers to earn. Talk to me again when you're ready to tackle the next hole! ⛳ The Games (2/3): Right On Target Honestly, golf isn't the most exciting sport. That's why I'm trying to re-invent it. Make it hip. You may have noticed some 🎯 Targets placed around the fields. If you hit those with a Golf Ball, you'll get some sweet rewards! Takes some precision, but you've got it in you, right? Once a 🎯 Target has been hit, it'll turn green to show that it's been activated. 🎯 Targets only reward items the first time you hit them. If you want this next ["The Games" Silver], you'll need to impress me with your accuracy! Hit 2 Golf Balls into the hole on the Blue Flower Field... Activate 2 different 🎯 Targets by hitting them with Golf Balls... And defeat 2 Rhino Beetles, which will probably try to interrupt your flow anyhow.-During-To hit a Golf Ball, you'll need to fill its pollen meter by collecting pollen from flowers around the ball. Once the meter is full, launch it by scooping with your collector while facing the ball. The closer you stand to the ball, the softer the launch will be. And remember, there's no downside to teamwork. Everyone who helps hit the ball gets credit.-Completion-Wow, that was some good aim! Not the best I've seen, but still good. 'Good enough to earn this: the second ["The Games" Silver]! Oh, and a [Royal Jelly]. Just a little something extra from yours truly. Drag that [Royal Jelly] onto a bee's hive slot to transform it into a random special type of bee! Don't use it on the same one you used your [Star Jelly] on, though. It'll get rid of the Gifted status. OK, one more Silver to go. And this one will be the trickiest yet. Talk to me again when you're ready to attempt the next hole. ⛳ The Games (3/3): Hole In One This is it, the last ["The Games" Silver] to be earned in Bee Swarm Simulator! These are pretty valuable, so I'm not handing this out willy-nilly. I'm putting your golfing skills to the test. For this quest, you'll need to hit a Hole in One! That means you'll have to get a Golf Ball into a Hole in just a single launch. Sounds tricky, huh? Not to tricky for you, though, am I right? You'll also need to play a round on the Sunflower Field. The Golf Balls there require way more pollen to activate. If it's taking too long, try working as a team with other players, Remember, all players who help fill the meter get credit when the ball goes in the hole! And if other players aren't enough, you should try buying new tools in the shop past Bee Bear. A [Rake] or some [Clippers] will really speed up the pollen-collection process. And a new [Backpack] can increase the amount of pollen you can hold before having to return to the hive. Get ready to give your all! If you want this last Silver, you'll need to wow me. Have at least 3 bees in your hive... Convert 2,500 Pollen into Honey at your hive... Hit 3 Golf Balls into the hole on the Sunflower Field... Activate another 🎯 Target by hitting it with a Golf Ball... And get a Hole in One on ANY flower field!-During-To hit a Golf Ball, you'll need to fill its pollen meter by collecting pollen from flowers around the ball. Once the meter is full, launch it by scooping with your collector while facing the ball. The closer you stand to the ball, the softer the launch will be. If you're having trouble aiming, it might help to reflect the Balls off the boundaries of the flower fields. I've been to a few tournaments. Seen the real pros pull that stuff.-Completion-Now that was a sight to see! A Hole in One! You've definitely earned it: the last ["The Games" Silver]! And just for you, I'll throw in a [Ticket Planter]! Plop this down on a field and let it grow. When it's done, it'll reward you with [Tickets] and Nectar. You fought off the cold, golfed in the snow, and now you're bringing home 3 Silvers for your team! Impressive stuff! You beekeepers have a bunch of talents up your sleeves. Well, that's all the Silvers to earn in Bee Swarm Simulator. But there are 49 other games to test your athleticism in as well. Good luck with farming the rest of those Silvers, out in the great beyond. If you check back in with me next week, I'll have more golfing tests for you. And I'll make it worth your while. Beesmas in the Summer... it's kind of nice. I think I'll hang around a while. Conclusion This mountain is world famous for the honey produced here. And now it'll be even more famous for its golfers! For such a quaint little place, there sure is a lot going on. I think I'll stick around a while. If you check back in with me next week, I'll have more quests to put your golfing to the test.

docs.text:

  • Earn 2 Ability Badges.
  • Collect 400 Haste Tokens.
  • Collect 400 Focus Tokens.

2,500,000,000 Honey250 Tickets1 Super Smoothie1 Black Balloon Stranded Sun Bear Sticker Quest Name Dialogue ⌛Waiting With Sun Bear (1/6) Soo... SOMEONE was supposed to set up more golf courses a few months ago. Should be here any day now. I mean, I hope so. I got place to be. I talked with some of the other bears. Nobody has a clue what's happening. But we'll just give you some filler quests to do for now, I guess. If you complete all 7 of these quests before Onett finishes whatever he was working on... You'll earn the limited Edition [Stranded Sun Bear Sticker] featuring yours truly! Who wouldn't want a drawing of me on their hive? Oh, and we'll also give you 250 [Tickets], and a uh, a [Super Smoothie]! Us bears pitched it together to gather those prizes. That stuff ain't cheap! Sooo... how about them ability tokens? Some types of bees create Ability Tokens while gathering from flowers. Pick them up to activate cool effects, like making you walk faster, or unlocking critical hits! I want to see those tokens action! Earn the Ability Ace Badge by collecting a lifetime total of 25,000 Ability Tokens... Collect 400 Haste Tokens... And Collect 400 Focus Tokens. ... Hmm, that might not keep you busy long enough. How about you also collect 50 tokens created by Bean Bugs? What's a Bean Bug? Bascially a weird purple critter shaped like a walking jelly bean. They pop up in flower fields every now and then, you can't miss them. Keep yourself busy with that quest while we keep waiting.-During-Guess I didn't get to put an ornament on the Beesmas Tree this year after all... Way to make a traveling bear feel at home, Onett.-Completion-Those Ability Tokens were pretty cool, not gonna lie! Unfortunately, Onett's still not done with whatever he's doing. So Mother Bear's agreed to keep you busy for a while. Why don't you check with her next? ⌛Waiting With Sun Bear (6/6): Still Stranded Man, you did ALL that and the rest of the golf courses still ain't done? Amazing how this game still has players when it takes this long to update! I can't wait around forever - I have places to be! And I'm not even sure if my RV will start up at this point. Anyways, we'll go ahead with one last quest. Finish this, and the Limited Edition [Stranded Sun Bear Sticker] is all yours! With that, you'll get to stare at my cool sunglasses even when I'm gone. Go out there and impress me! Uh, but don't finish it too fast. We're still waiting here, after all...-Completion-Hot diggity! You and your bees put on an impressive show. At least you've kept me entertained while I've been stuck here waiting on Onett. You've really earned this: the [Stranded Sun Bear Sticker]! It's cool, handsome, rare, and will probably be worth a fortune some day. Great stuff. ... Welp. That was fun. But, uh. Back to waiting...

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• He was the only traveling bear to not introduce his own event bee.
  • In the quest 'Focus Feature', Sun Bear said to defeat a Werewolf instead of 3 Spiders.
  • The Ability Badge is represented by him in the game's description.
  • After his spring visit, the belt bags can be bought in Pro Shop (Belt Bag) and the Mountain Top Shop (Mondo Belt Bag).
  • During his spring visit, there was a Ticket behind Sun Bear's RV. When Sun Bear went away, the ticket stayed there for a little time, but now it's gone.
  • Sun Bear uses the Knight Animation Package.
  • Sun Bear says that only Rage, Exhausted, and Music Bees spawn Token Link, but Shocked Bee does as well. This was fixed a few days later.
  • In his second visit (2018-09-10 Update) and his third visit (2019-09-28 Update), his RV had a Flag of Phoenix bumper sticker on the back.
  • During his first visit, Sun Bear was shown to be wearing the Mondo Belt Bag, which he gave at the very end of his quests. During his second visit, he was shown to be wearing both the Mondo Belt Bag and Beekeeper's Boots, which he gave at the end of his quests.
  • Sun Bear gives 48 Tickets throughout all his quests with the ticket token that was behind the RV.
  • During the quest 'Sun Bear's Scavenger Hunt', he says 3 more quests are needed to be completed to get the Beekeeper's Boots, when it is actually 4 quests. However, Onett could have done this on purpose, because Sun Bear was completely surprised by Vicious Bee in his dialogue, and gives you a quest around this.
  • He was the first traveling bear added to the game, with Gummy Bear being the second and Bee Bear being the third.
  • The item prices of his rewards after his visit are: Basic Boots are 4,400, Hiking Boots are 2,200,000, Beekeeper's Boots are 15,000,000, Belt Bag is 440,000, and Mondo Belt Bag is 12,400,000 Honey.
  • He was the only traveling bear who never gave an egg on his last quest.
  • He and Bubble Bee Man were the only NPCs to give an Accessory.
  • It was hinted that Sun Bear is from Arizona, this is from the Code "Arizona", and the City of Arizona flag that was on his RV the second and the third visit.
  • During the quests in his third visit, it is revealed that the reason he had Bean Bugs was that he was taking them to Orlando for an unknown reason.
  • In the quest 'Total Focus', Sun Bear said to collect 200 Focus Tokens before you received the quest, but he didn't say to collect 200 Focus Tokens after you received the quest.
  • For the 'Total Focus' quest, after you finish the dialogue with Sun Bear, a Memory Match game will start automatically for free.
  • He stated only Basic Bee doesn't generate tokens, but Brave Bee doesn't as well, even though both of them can generate Inspire tokens when they are gifted.
  • To complete every quest on his third visit, you must collect 3835 tokens from Bean Bugs.
  • It was possible for his trapped Bean Bug to jump out of its cage.
  • It was also possible for the player to go in and out of the Bean Bug's cage.
  • This could possibly be the reason that they got out in the first place
  • Onett has stated that Sun Bear isn't welcome on the mountain anymore for accidentally releasing Bean Bugs and the chicks. It seems as if Sun Bear was unbanned in 2024 with his visit during The Games.
  • In “Boot Lootin” Sun Bear mentions that he has been to a desert before.
  • In “Light Up The Night” Sun Bear mentions that he prefers Nighttime to Daytime, as he is able to relax.
  • Sun Bear likes mantises. Referring to them as ‘cool’ in his quest “Show Me The Honey”.
  • Sun Bear mentions in his quest “Vicious Bee Begone” that he has had an encounter with a Rogue Vicious Bee while going to visit Brown Bear.
  • In his quest “Total Focus” Sun Bear mentions that he transports ‘exotic things’ around in his RV as a job.

docs.text:
Sunflower Field

FIELD COLOR

White

BEE PREREQUISITES

None

NECTAR TYPE

Satisfying Nectar

FIELD DIMENSIONS

20 × 33 flowers

660

BEE PREFERENCES

LIKE

The Sunflower Field is one of the five starting fields that any player can visit upon starting the game. There are no mobs that protect this field.

This field can spawn sunflower seed, ticket, red boost, blue boost, oil, and magic bean tokens when gathering pollen.

Item Drops list Sunflower Seeds (20% Chance)

Oils (0.0167% Chance) Magic Beans (0.0025% Chance)

This field grants Satisfying Nectar when a planter is planted here.

Bees that like the Sunflower Field are Basic Bee, Baby Bee, Hasty Bee, and Exhausted Bee. The only bee that dislikes the Sunflower Field is Looker Bee.

This is a 20×33 field, containing 660 flowers. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of single and double.

docs.title: Events
docs.text:
• Randomly, the large sunflower behind the Daily Top Honeymakers make have a face and spit sparkles around the field.
  • When starting a Stick Bug Challenge, Stick Bug first spawns in this field and may also jump into this field when defeating him in a round if he is not on this field.

docs.title: Obtaining Boosts
docs.text:
• Using the Field Booster may give a Sunflower Field Boost. When it does, it will give +300% Sunflower Field pollen for 15 minutes.
  • Using glitter will add 100% Sunflower Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes, if the current boost isn't already maxed out.
  • Using field dice, smooth dice, or loaded dice may add +100% Sunflower Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out.
  • Sunflower Field Winds can be obtained through the Wind Shrine or codes. They have a base of 20% instant Sunflower Field conversion and give +5% instant Sunflower Field conversion and +25% Sunflower Field pollen for each stack. Sunflower Field Winds can stack up to a total of 15 times.
  • It can be boosted by the Shell Amulet. If it has a Sunflower Field Boost, it can boost the field by +1% to +27% depending on the amulet rarity.
  • Giving a Present to Black Bear grants 3x Sunflower Field Boost + other stuff.
  • Having an active Autumn Sunhat Beequip with a Sunflower Field Pollen Hive Bonus (+18% to +24% base, up to +44% with Waxing)
  • Having an active Lei Beequip with a Sunflower Field Pollen Hive Bonus (+3% to +5% base, not guaranteed, up to +25% with Waxing)

docs.title: Trivia
docs.text:
• This is the only field in the game where the player can find sunflower seeds that spawn naturally, without the need of sprouts.
  • This is the first field Black Bear assigns a quest to.
  • The Sunflower badges and the Pumpkin badges are used 3 times for chances in Memory Match, the most for any field badges.
  • This was the second-biggest field in the game, the biggest one being the Clover Field. After the 2018-07-11 update, this isn't the case anymore.
  • Similar to why the Clover Field was shrunk, this field was decreased in size to make room for Mother Bear and the Treat Shop, which can be found at the end of the field.
  • This field along with the Pineapple Patch and the Pumpkin Patch are the only fields where an object may come to life and shoot sparkles.
  • The fence bordering the Sunflower Field and the hives was temporarily removed after Beesmas Winter 2024. It was soon added back in the following update.

docs.title: Sunflower Seed
docs.text:
Sunflower Seed

"Increases your bond with a bee by 25."

A Sunflower Seed token.

A Sunflower Seed is a type of treat that can be fed to a Bee to raise its bond by 25. However, when fed to Basic, Bomber, Looker, Demo, Commander, Carpenter, Ninja, Vector, or Precise Bees, the amount of bond they gain is doubled, raising their bond by 50. These bees also have a small chance of becoming gifted when fed Sunflower Seeds, though this only happens with a 0.0125% (1 in 8,000) chance for Rare bees, 0.01% (1 in 10,000) chance for Epic bees, 0.0083% (1 in 12,000) chance for Common and Legendary bees, and 0.00417% (1 in 24,000) chance for Mythic bees per Sunflower Seed. Feeding a radioactive bee a sunflower seed has a 0.004% (1 in 25,000) to mutate a bee. Sunflower Seeds can also be used to craft Oils, Paper Planters, Belt Pocket, Mondo Belt Bag, Bomber Guard, Looker Guard and Basic Boots.

docs.title: Super Smoothie
docs.text:
Super Smoothie

"Grants the improved boosts of many consumable items combined for 20 minutes!"

COOLDOWN

20 minutes

The Super Smoothie is a craftable inventory item added in the 2020-06-06 update. When used, it grants the following buffs for 20 minutes:

  • x1.5 Capacity;
  • x1.6 Red Pollen;
  • x1.6 Blue Pollen;
  • x1.6 White Pollen;
  • x1.4 Bee Gather Pollen;
  • x1.4 Tool Pollen;
  • x1.5 Convert Rate;
  • x1.5 Convert Rate At Hive;
  • +20% Instant Conversion;
  • +1% Super-Crit Chance;
  • +6% Critical Chance;
  • x1.25 Bee Movespeed; and
  • x1.25 Player Movespeed.

Red Extracts, Blue Extracts, Glues, Oils, Tropical Drinks, Purple Potions, and Enzymes cannot be active simultaneously with a Super Smoothie. If any of these buffs are active when a Super Smoothie is used, they are removed and replaced by the Super Smoothie buff. If the player attempts to use any of these buffs, they will be prevented from doing so.

  • As an extremely rare drop from Mythic Meteor Showers.
  • As a reward from the Robo Bear Challenge.
  • As a very rare drop from planters. Some guaranteed sources are listed below:
  • Plastic Planters have a rare chance of dropping 1 Super Smoothie in any field, 36 days cooldown.
  • The Planter Of Plenty drops 10 Super Smoothies when harvested from the Bamboo Field, 36 days cooldown.
  • As a reward from certain quests:
  • Dapper Bear's "More Than Myth" (#15) gives 1 Super Smoothie and other items.
  • Science Bear's "Corrupting The Glitched Drive" gives 1 Super Smoothie and other items.

docs.title: Possible Stats
docs.text:
Rarity: Common · Equip limit: 3 · Who can wear it: level 5+

Stats and hive bonuses each roll on their own. Higher potential makes a stat more likely to appear and pulls its value towards the top of its range. docs.title: Max possible stats
docs.text:
A beequip takes 5 waxes, and a failed wax still uses a slot. Soft and Hard Wax give at most 10 upgrade rolls. Caustic Wax and Debug Wax give 4 rolls each, so 5 of them give 20 rolls and can also pick Caustic-only upgrades; Debug Wax always succeeds, while Caustic only succeeds 25% of the time and destroys the beequip when it fails. Every roll picks one upgrade at random, and an upgrade stops being picked once it reaches its max picks.

Best base value is the top roll before any wax, with how often a roll lands on it at 1 ★ and 5 ★. Realistic max is the best you can expect to actually see: the most picks of that upgrade that about 1 in 1,000 fully waxed 5 ★ beequips get, each at its top value. Absolute ceiling is the most the game allows, with every roll landing on that upgrade up to its max picks. Where it is higher than the realistic max, players are very unlikely to ever see it.

docs.title: Swirled Wax
docs.text:
Swirled Wax

"A spiraled hunk of beeswax. Used to redetermine the stats of a Bee's Beequip."

Swirled Wax is an inventory item and a type of wax that can be used on a beequip to reroll its stats. Beequips with higher potential have a greater chance of having better stats when rerolled. Swirled wax has Upgrade Value of 0.

When used on a beequip, it will change its stats. If the Beequip has waxes used on it, it will alter the enhancements as well.

When a swirled wax is applied to a beequip, a message pops up saying:

The Wax altered the Beequip's stats

Sometimes, the stats won't show any changes when you use a swirled wax. Most of the time, the bug can be fixed by rejoining the game.
